theorem cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError mu nu x = cdfUpperError nu mu x := rfl

theorem cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError mu nu x = -cdfUpperError mu nu x := by
  unfold cdfLowerError cdfUpperError
  ring

theorem abs_cdfLowerError_eq_abs_cdfUpperError
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError mu nu x| = |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
  rw [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg]

/-- Algebraic telescoping of a signed CDF error through an intermediate
convolution law. -/
theorem cdfUpperError_conv_telescope
    (mu nu kappa lambda : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError (kappa ∗ mu) (lambda ∗ nu) x =
      cdfUpperError (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x +
        cdfUpperError (kappa ∗ nu) (lambda ∗ nu) x := by
  unfold cdfUpperError
  ring

/-- Algebraic telescoping of a signed lower CDF error through an intermediate
convolution law. -/
theorem cdfLowerError_conv_telescope
    (mu nu kappa lambda : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError (kappa ∗ mu) (lambda ∗ nu) x =
      cdfLowerError (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x +
        cdfLowerError (kappa ∗ nu) (lambda ∗ nu) x := by
  unfold cdfLowerError
  ring

/-- Kolmogorov distance, presented as the supremum of pointwise CDF gaps. -/
noncomputable def kolmogorovDistance (μ ν : Measure ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (cdfGap μ ν))

/-- Supremum of the signed upper CDF error.  Keeping this direction separate
prevents the two-endpoint loss caused by taking an absolute value before
averaging. -/
noncomputable def upperCDFDistance (mu nu : Measure ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (cdfUpperError mu nu))

/-- Supremum of the signed lower CDF error. -/
noncomputable def lowerCDFDistance (mu nu : Measure ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range (cdfLowerError mu nu))

/-- A pointwise CDF bound. Keeping this predicate alongside the supremum form
makes later smoothing estimates convenient to apply. -/
def CDFBound (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, cdfGap μ ν x ≤ ε

theorem cdfGap_nonneg (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ cdfGap μ ν x :=
  abs_nonneg _

theorem cdfGap_le_one (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap μ ν x ≤ 1 := by
  rw [cdfGap, abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [cdf_nonneg μ x, cdf_le_one ν x]
  · linarith [cdf_nonneg ν x, cdf_le_one μ x]

theorem cdfUpperError_le_one (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError mu nu x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold cdfUpperError
  linarith [cdf_nonneg nu x, cdf_le_one mu x]

theorem cdfLowerError_le_one (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError mu nu x ≤ 1 := by
  unfold cdfLowerError
  linarith [cdf_nonneg mu x, cdf_le_one nu x]

theorem bddAbove_range_cdfGap (μ ν : Measure ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (cdfGap μ ν)) := by
  exact ⟨1, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact cdfGap_le_one μ ν x⟩

theorem bddAbove_range_cdfUpperError (mu nu : Measure ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (cdfUpperError mu nu)) := by
  exact ⟨1, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact cdfUpperError_le_one mu nu x⟩

theorem bddAbove_range_cdfLowerError (mu nu : Measure ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range (cdfLowerError mu nu)) := by
  exact ⟨1, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact cdfLowerError_le_one mu nu x⟩

theorem cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap μ ν x ≤ kolmogorovDistance μ ν :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_range_cdfGap μ ν) ⟨x, rfl⟩

theorem cdfUpperError_le_upperCDFDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError mu nu x ≤ upperCDFDistance mu nu :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_range_cdfUpperError mu nu) ⟨x, rfl⟩

theorem cdfLowerError_le_lowerCDFDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError mu nu x ≤ lowerCDFDistance mu nu :=
  le_csSup (bddAbove_range_cdfLowerError mu nu) ⟨x, rfl⟩

theorem upperCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance (mu nu : Measure ℝ) :
    upperCDFDistance mu nu ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    cdfUpperError mu nu x ≤ cdfGap mu nu x := by
      unfold cdfUpperError cdfGap
      exact le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x

theorem lowerCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance (mu nu : Measure ℝ) :
    lowerCDFDistance mu nu ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    cdfLowerError mu nu x ≤ cdfGap mu nu x := by
      unfold cdfLowerError cdfGap
      simpa only [neg_sub] using neg_le_abs (cdf mu x - cdf nu x)
    _ ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x

theorem cdfGap_eq_max_signed (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap mu nu x =
      max (cdfUpperError mu nu x) (cdfLowerError mu nu x) := by
  unfold cdfGap cdfUpperError cdfLowerError
  rw [abs_eq_max_neg]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The maximum of two real numbers, expressed through their sum and signed
difference. -/
theorem max_eq_add_add_abs_sub_div_two (a b : ℝ) :
    max a b = (a + b + |a - b|) / 2 := by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [max_eq_right hab, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab)]
    ring
  · rw [max_eq_left hba, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba)]
    ring

/-- Kolmogorov distance is exactly the maximum of its two signed one-sided
CDF distances. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed (mu nu : Measure ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu nu =
      max (upperCDFDistance mu nu) (lowerCDFDistance mu nu) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [cdfGap_eq_max_signed]
    exact max_le_max
      (cdfUpperError_le_upperCDFDistance mu nu x)
      (cdfLowerError_le_lowerCDFDistance mu nu x)
  · exact max_le
      (upperCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu)
      (lowerCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu)

/-- Probability laws with matching first and second moments integrate every
quadratic polynomial equally. -/
theorem integral_quadratic_eq_of_moments
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = ∫ y, y ∂nu)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu)
    (a0 a1 a2 : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu) =
      ∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu := by
  have hmuLin : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => a0 + a1 * y) mu :=
    (integrable_const a0).add (hmu1.const_mul a1)
  have hnuLin : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => a0 + a1 * y) nu :=
    (integrable_const a0).add (hnu1.const_mul a1)
  have hmuCalc :
      (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        a0 + a1 * (∫ y, y ∂mu) + a2 * (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) := by
    calc
      (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu) =
          (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y ∂mu) + ∫ y, a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu :=
        integral_add hmuLin (hmu2.const_mul a2)
      _ = ((∫ _y : ℝ, a0 ∂mu) + ∫ y, a1 * y ∂mu) +
          ∫ y, a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu := by
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const a0) (hmu1.const_mul a1)]
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_const, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]; simp
  have hnuCalc :
      (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu) =
        a0 + a1 * (∫ y, y ∂nu) + a2 * (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu) := by
    calc
      (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu) =
          (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y ∂nu) + ∫ y, a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu :=
        integral_add hnuLin (hnu2.const_mul a2)
      _ = ((∫ _y : ℝ, a0 ∂nu) + ∫ y, a1 * y ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu := by
        rw [integral_add (integrable_const a0) (hnu1.const_mul a1)]
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_const, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]; simp
  calc
    (∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        a0 + a1 * (∫ y, y ∂mu) + a2 * (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) := hmuCalc
    _ = a0 + a1 * (∫ y, y ∂nu) + a2 * (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu) := by
      rw [hmean, hsecond]
    _ = ∫ y, a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2 ∂nu := hnuCalc.symm

/-- If a common integrable approximation has the same integral under two
laws, a cubic pointwise remainder controls the difference of the target
integrals. -/
theorem abs_integral_sub_integral_le_of_common_approximation
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (f p : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfmu : Integrable f mu) (hfnu : Integrable f nu)
    (hpmu : Integrable p mu) (hpnu : Integrable p nu)
    (hpEq : (∫ y, p y ∂mu) = ∫ y, p y ∂nu)
    {C : ℝ}
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu)
    (hrem : ∀ y, |f y - p y| ≤ C * |y| ^ 3) :
    |(∫ y, f y ∂mu) - ∫ y, f y ∂nu| ≤
      C * ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) := by
  have hrmu : Integrable (fun y => f y - p y) mu := hfmu.sub hpmu
  have hrnu : Integrable (fun y => f y - p y) nu := hfnu.sub hpnu
  calc
    |(∫ y, f y ∂mu) - ∫ y, f y ∂nu| =
        |(∫ y, f y - p y ∂mu) - ∫ y, f y - p y ∂nu| := by
      rw [integral_sub hfmu hpmu, integral_sub hfnu hpnu, hpEq]
      ring
    _ ≤ |∫ y, f y - p y ∂mu| + |∫ y, f y - p y ∂nu| :=
      abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (∫ y, |f y - p y| ∂mu) + ∫ y, |f y - p y| ∂nu :=
      add_le_add abs_integral_le_integral_abs abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ (∫ y, C * |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, C * |y| ^ 3 ∂nu := by
      exact add_le_add
        (integral_mono hrmu.abs (hmu3.const_mul C) hrem)
        (integral_mono hrnu.abs (hnu3.const_mul C) hrem)
    _ = C * ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      ring

/-- Equal first and second moments cancel every quadratic Taylor term, so a
third-order remainder is the only contribution to the integral comparison. -/
theorem abs_integral_sub_integral_le_of_quadratic_moment_match
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfmu : Integrable f mu) (hfnu : Integrable f nu)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = ∫ y, y ∂nu)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu)
    (a0 a1 a2 M : ℝ)
    (hrem : ∀ y,
      |f y - (a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2)| ≤ (M / 6) * |y| ^ 3) :
    |(∫ y, f y ∂mu) - ∫ y, f y ∂nu| ≤
      (M / 6) * ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) := by
  let p : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2
  have hpmu : Integrable p mu :=
    ((integrable_const a0).add (hmu1.const_mul a1)).add (hmu2.const_mul a2)
  have hpnu : Integrable p nu :=
    ((integrable_const a0).add (hnu1.const_mul a1)).add (hnu2.const_mul a2)
  apply abs_integral_sub_integral_le_of_common_approximation
    mu nu f p hfmu hfnu hpmu hpnu
  · exact integral_quadratic_eq_of_moments
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hmu2 hnu2 hmean hsecond a0 a1 a2
  · exact hmu3
  · exact hnu3
  · exact hrem

theorem integrable_standardNormal_id :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  simpa only [id_eq] using
    ((ProbabilityTheory.memLp_id_gaussianReal
      (μ := (0 : ℝ)) (v := (1 : ℝ≥0)) 1).integrable (by norm_num))

theorem integrable_standardNormal_sq :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  simpa only [id_eq] using
    (ProbabilityTheory.memLp_id_gaussianReal
      (μ := (0 : ℝ)) (v := (1 : ℝ≥0)) 2).integrable_sq

theorem integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  simpa only [id_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
    (ProbabilityTheory.memLp_id_gaussianReal
      (μ := (0 : ℝ)) (v := (1 : ℝ≥0)) 3).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)

theorem integral_standardNormal_id :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) = 0 := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.integral_id_gaussianReal

theorem integral_standardNormal_sq :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) = 1 := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  have hv := @ProbabilityTheory.variance_id_gaussianReal (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ≥0)
  change Var[(fun y : ℝ => y); ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1] =
    (1 : ℝ≥0) at hv
  rw [variance_of_integral_eq_zero measurable_id'.aemeasurable (by simp)] at hv
  norm_num at hv ⊢
  exact hv

/-- Standard-normal specialization of quadratic moment cancellation. -/
theorem abs_integral_sub_standardNormal_le_of_quadratic_remainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hfmu : Integrable f mu)
    (hfGaussian : Integrable f
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (a0 a1 a2 M : ℝ)
    (hrem : ∀ y,
      |f y - (a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2)| ≤ (M / 6) * |y| ^ 3) :
    |(∫ y, f y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, f y
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw| ≤
      (M / 6) * ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  apply abs_integral_sub_integral_le_of_quadratic_moment_match
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw f
    hfmu hfGaussian hmu1 integrable_standardNormal_id hmu2
    integrable_standardNormal_sq
  · rw [hmean, integral_standardNormal_id]
  · rw [hsecond, integral_standardNormal_sq]
  · exact hmu3
  · exact integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube
  · exact hrem

theorem kolmogorovDistance_nonneg (μ ν : Measure ℝ) :
    0 ≤ kolmogorovDistance μ ν :=
  (cdfGap_nonneg μ ν 0).trans (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance μ ν 0)

theorem kolmogorovDistance_le_one (μ ν : Measure ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ ν ≤ 1 := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact cdfGap_le_one μ ν x

theorem kolmogorovDistance_le_iff (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (ε : ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ ν ≤ ε ↔ CDFBound μ ν ε := by
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance μ ν x).trans h
  · intro h
    apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact h x

theorem kolmogorovDistance_comm (μ ν : Measure ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ ν = kolmogorovDistance ν μ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff μ ν _).2
    intro x
    simpa only [cdfGap, abs_sub_comm] using
      cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance ν μ x
  · apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff ν μ _).2
    intro x
    simpa only [cdfGap, abs_sub_comm] using
      cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance μ ν x

theorem kolmogorovDistance_triangle (μ ν ρ : Measure ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ ρ ≤
      kolmogorovDistance μ ν + kolmogorovDistance ν ρ := by
  apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff μ ρ _).2
  intro x
  change |cdf μ x - cdf ρ x| ≤ _
  calc
    |cdf μ x - cdf ρ x| =
        |(cdf μ x - cdf ν x) + (cdf ν x - cdf ρ x)| := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ |cdf μ x - cdf ν x| + |cdf ν x - cdf ρ x| :=
      abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ kolmogorovDistance μ ν + kolmogorovDistance ν ρ := by
      exact add_le_add
        (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance μ ν x)
        (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance ν ρ x)

@[simp] theorem kolmogorovDistance_self (μ : Measure ℝ) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ μ = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff μ μ 0).2
    intro x
    simp [cdfGap]
  · exact kolmogorovDistance_nonneg μ μ

theorem kolmogorovDistance_eq_zero_iff
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    kolmogorovDistance μ ν = 0 ↔ μ = ν := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply MeasureTheory.Measure.eq_of_cdf μ ν
    ext x
    have hx : cdfGap μ ν x ≤ 0 := by
      rw [← h]
      exact cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance μ ν x
    have habs : |cdf μ x - cdf ν x| = 0 :=
      le_antisymm hx (abs_nonneg _)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp habs)
  · rintro rfl
    exact kolmogorovDistance_self μ

theorem cdf_map_eq_real_preimage
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : Measurable X) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf (μ.map X) x = μ.real (X ⁻¹' Iic x) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.map X) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX.aemeasurable
  rw [cdf_eq_real, map_measureReal_apply hX measurableSet_Iic]

/-- The CDF of a positive scalar pushforward is evaluated at the inversely
scaled argument. -/
theorem cdf_map_mul
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) x = cdf mu (x / c) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  rw [cdf_eq_real, map_measureReal_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Iic,
    cdf_eq_real]
  congr 1
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, mem_Iic]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
  simp only [mul_comm]

theorem cdfGap_map_mul
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x =
      cdfGap mu nu (x / c) := by
  unfold cdfGap
  rw [cdf_map_mul mu hc, cdf_map_mul nu hc]

/-- Kolmogorov distance is invariant under a common positive scalar
pushforward. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_map_mul_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) =
      kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff _ _ _).2
    intro x
    rw [cdfGap_map_mul mu nu hc]
    exact cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu (x / c)
  · apply (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff _ _ _).2
    intro x
    calc
      cdfGap mu nu x = cdfGap
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) (c * x) := by
        rw [cdfGap_map_mul mu nu hc]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) :=
        cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance _ _ (c * x)

/-- Scaling a common-convolution replacement by the same positive factor
does not change its Kolmogorov distance; the conclusion is oriented for the
Gaussian replacement bounds below. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_map_mul_conv_eq
    (kappa mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) (kappa ∗ mu))
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) (kappa ∗ nu)) =
      kolmogorovDistance (mu ∗ kappa) (nu ∗ kappa) := by
  rw [kolmogorovDistance_map_mul_eq (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) hc,
    Measure.conv_comm kappa mu, Measure.conv_comm kappa nu]

theorem cdfUpperError_map_mul
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x =
      cdfUpperError mu nu (x / c) := by
  unfold cdfUpperError
  rw [cdf_map_mul mu hc, cdf_map_mul nu hc]

theorem cdfLowerError_map_mul
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x =
      cdfLowerError mu nu (x / c) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    cdfUpperError_map_mul nu mu hc x

/-- The spatial `L¹` norm of the upper signed CDF error scales linearly under
a common positive scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integral_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x, |cdfUpperError
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
      c * ∫ x, |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
  calc
    (∫ x, |cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
        ∫ x, |cdfUpperError mu nu (c⁻¹ * x)| := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
        change |cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x| =
            |cdfUpperError mu nu (c⁻¹ * x)|
        rw [cdfUpperError_map_mul mu nu hc]
        congr 2
        field_simp
    _ = |(c⁻¹)⁻¹| * ∫ x, |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
        (Measure.integral_comp_mul_left
          (fun x => |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) c⁻¹)
    _ = c * ∫ x, |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
      rw [inv_inv, abs_of_pos hc]

/-- Lower signed-error companion to
`integral_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq`. -/
theorem integral_abs_cdfLowerError_map_mul_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x, |cdfLowerError
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
      c * ∫ x, |cdfLowerError mu nu x| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    integral_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq nu mu hc

/-- The second spatially weighted `L¹` norm of the upper signed CDF error
scales cubically under a common positive scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
      c ^ 3 * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
  calc
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
        ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu (c⁻¹ * x)| := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
        change |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x| =
            |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu (c⁻¹ * x)|
        rw [cdfUpperError_map_mul mu nu hc]
        congr 3
        field_simp
    _ = |(c⁻¹)⁻¹| *
        ∫ x, |c * x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
      convert (Measure.integral_comp_mul_left
        (fun x => |c * x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) c⁻¹) using 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
        field_simp
    _ = c ^ 3 * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x| := by
      rw [inv_inv, abs_of_pos hc]
      simp_rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc, mul_pow]
      rw [show (fun x => c ^ 2 * |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) =
          fun x => c ^ 2 * (|x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) by
        funext x
        ring]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      ring

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the cubic weighted scaling identity. -/
theorem integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfLowerError_map_mul_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu)
      (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) x|) =
      c ^ 3 * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError mu nu x| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq nu mu hc

/-- Centered Gaussian variances add under convolution, specialized to the
successive natural variances used by the leave-one-out recurrence. -/
theorem gaussianReal_nat_succ_conv_standardNormalLaw (N : ℕ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0) ∗
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw =
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0) := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  convert (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_conv_gaussianReal
      (m₁ := 0) (m₂ := 0)
      (v₁ := (N + 1 : ℝ≥0)) (v₂ := (1 : ℝ≥0))) using 1
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]

/-- Scaling a centered Gaussian of natural variance `N + 1` by
`1 / sqrt(N + 1)` gives the standard normal law. -/
theorem map_gaussianReal_nat_succ_eq_standardNormalLaw (N : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0)) =
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_const_mul,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  congr 2
  · simp
  · rw [← NNReal.coe_inj]
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mk, NNReal.coe_one]
    have hs : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    field_simp
    norm_cast

/-- The measure of the strict lower ray is the left limit of the CDF. -/
theorem measureReal_Iio_eq_leftLim_cdf
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (t : ℝ) :
    mu.real (Iio t) = leftLim (cdf mu) t := by
  calc
    mu.real (Iio t) = (cdf mu).measure.real (Iio t) := by
      rw [measure_cdf mu]
    _ = leftLim (cdf mu) t := by
      rw [Measure.real, (cdf mu).measure_Iio (tendsto_cdf_atBot mu)]
      simp only [sub_zero]
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
      exact (cdf_nonneg mu (t - 1)).trans
        ((monotone_cdf mu).le_leftLim (sub_lt_self t zero_lt_one))

/-- Kolmogorov distance controls strict lower-tail probabilities as well as
the closed lower-tail probabilities used to define the CDF. -/
theorem measureReal_Iio_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (t : ℝ) :
    |mu.real (Iio t) - nu.real (Iio t)| ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  rw [measureReal_Iio_eq_leftLim_cdf mu t,
    measureReal_Iio_eq_leftLim_cdf nu t]
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|)
      (nhdsWithin t (Iio t))
      (nhds |leftLim (cdf mu) t - leftLim (cdf nu) t|) :=
    ((monotone_cdf mu).tendsto_leftLim t |>.sub
      ((monotone_cdf nu).tendsto_leftLim t)).abs
  exact le_of_tendsto hlim (Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
    cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x)

/-- The midpoint CDF averages the closed lower-tail probability with its
strict-lower counterpart.  It is the atom-symmetric coordinate naturally
exposed by the off-diagonal Prawitz imbalance. -/
noncomputable def midpointCDF (mu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (cdf mu x + mu.real (Iio x)) / 2

/-- Signed two-law difference in the midpoint-CDF coordinate. -/
noncomputable def midpointCDFDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpointCDF mu x - midpointCDF nu x

theorem midpointCDFDifference_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    midpointCDFDifference mu nu x =
      ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x) +
        (mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x))) / 2 := by
  unfold midpointCDFDifference midpointCDF
  ring

/-- Kolmogorov distance controls the atom-symmetric midpoint-CDF coordinate
with coefficient one. -/
theorem abs_midpointCDFDifference_le_kolmogorovDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x : ℝ) :
    |midpointCDFDifference mu nu x| ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  rw [midpointCDFDifference_eq, abs_div,
    abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  have hClosed : |cdf mu x - cdf nu x| ≤
      kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
    simpa only [cdfGap] using cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  have hOpen : |mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)| ≤
      kolmogorovDistance mu nu :=
    measureReal_Iio_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  have hAdd := abs_add_le
    (cdf mu x - cdf nu x)
    (mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x))
  linarith

/-- A singleton mass is the jump between the closed CDF and its strict
lower-tail value. -/
theorem measureReal_singleton_eq_cdf_sub_Iio
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (x : ℝ) :
    mu.real {x} = cdf mu x - mu.real (Iio x) := by
  rw [cdf_eq_real]
  have hsubset : Iio x ⊆ Iic x := Iio_subset_Iic_self
  have hdiff : Iic x \ Iio x = {x} := by
    ext y
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_Iic, mem_Iio, mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hyx, hnlt⟩
      exact le_antisymm hyx (not_lt.mp hnlt)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨le_rfl, lt_irrefl _⟩
  rw [← measureReal_diff hsubset measurableSet_Iio, hdiff]

/-- The signed difference of two atom masses separates into the closed-CDF
difference minus the strict-lower-tail difference. -/
theorem measureReal_singleton_sub_eq_cdf_sub_sub_Iio
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x : ℝ) :
    mu.real {x} - nu.real {x} =
      (cdf mu x - cdf nu x) -
        (mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)) := by
  rw [measureReal_singleton_eq_cdf_sub_Iio mu x,
    measureReal_singleton_eq_cdf_sub_Iio nu x]
  ring

/-- The atom-mass difference is bounded by one closed-CDF gap and one
strict-lower-tail gap. -/
theorem abs_measureReal_singleton_sub_le_cdfGap_add_IioGap
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x : ℝ) :
    |mu.real {x} - nu.real {x}| ≤
      cdfGap mu nu x +
        |mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)| := by
  rw [measureReal_singleton_sub_eq_cdf_sub_sub_Iio mu nu x, cdfGap]
  exact abs_sub _ _

/-- Consequently Kolmogorov distance controls atom-mass differences with the
sharp coefficient supplied by the two CDF sides. -/
theorem abs_measureReal_singleton_sub_le_two_mul_kolmogorovDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x : ℝ) :
    |mu.real {x} - nu.real {x}| ≤
      2 * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  have hAtom :=
    abs_measureReal_singleton_sub_le_cdfGap_add_IioGap mu nu x
  have hClosed := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  have hOpen := measureReal_Iio_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  linarith

/-- Kolmogorov distance controls the closed upper-tail probabilities printed
in the source, without any atomlessness assumption on the first measure. -/
theorem measureReal_Ici_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (t : ℝ) :
    |mu.real (Ici t) - nu.real (Ici t)| ≤ kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  have hmu : mu.real (Ici t) = 1 - mu.real (Iio t) := by
    rw [← compl_Iio, measureReal_compl measurableSet_Iio, probReal_univ]
  have hnu : nu.real (Ici t) = 1 - nu.real (Iio t) := by
    rw [← compl_Iio, measureReal_compl measurableSet_Iio, probReal_univ]
  rw [hmu, hnu]
  simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_sub_comm] using
    measureReal_Iio_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu t

/-- A first absolute moment gives the characteristic function a quantitative
modulus at the origin. This removes the apparent `1 / |t|` singularity in the
truncated integral occurring in Esseen smoothing. -/
theorem norm_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment
    {μ : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - 1‖ ≤
      |t| * ∫ x, |x| ∂μ := by
  have hExp : Integrable
      (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1 ?_
    exact ae_of_all μ fun x => by
      simp only [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
      norm_num
  have hOne : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) μ := integrable_const 1
  have hSub :
      (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 ∂μ) =
        (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ) - 1 := by
    rw [integral_sub hExp hOne]
    simp [integral_const]
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real]
  simp_rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  rw [← hSub]
  calc
    ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 ∂μ‖ ≤
        ∫ x : ℝ, |t| * |x| ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hμ1.const_mul |t|) <|
        ae_of_all μ fun x => by
          simpa only [mul_comm ((t * x : ℝ) : ℂ), Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_mul] using
            (Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le (x := t * x))
    _ = |t| * ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ∂μ := by rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- The characteristic functions of two laws with finite first moments differ
by `O(|t|)` at the origin. -/
theorem norm_charFun_sub_charFun_le_firstMoments
    {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ ≤
      |t| * ((∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + ∫ x, |x| ∂ν) := by
  calc
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ =
        ‖(MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - 1) +
          (1 - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t)‖ := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - 1‖ +
        ‖1 - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - 1‖ +
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun ν t - 1‖ := by
      rw [← norm_neg (1 - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t)]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ ≤ |t| * (∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + |t| * ∫ x, |x| ∂ν :=
      add_le_add
        (norm_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment hμ1 t)
        (norm_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment hν1 t)
    _ = |t| * ((∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + ∫ x, |x| ∂ν) := by ring

/-- The discrepancy quotient used in Esseen's truncated Fourier integral,
defined to be zero at the removable singularity. -/
noncomputable def charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 0
  else ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ / |t|

theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν t := by
  rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · positivity

theorem norm_charFun_sub_eq_abs_mul_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t‖ =
      |t| * charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht]
  field_simp [abs_ne_zero.mpr ht]

/-- Universal large-frequency bound obtained only from the unit norm of
probability characteristic functions. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_le_two_div_abs
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (t : ℝ) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν t ≤ 2 / |t| := by
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht]
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg t)
    calc
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ ≤
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t‖ + ‖MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ :=
        norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := add_le_add
        (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
        (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
      _ = 2 := by norm_num

theorem stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    StronglyMeasurable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν) := by
  unfold charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
  exact (Measurable.ite (measurableSet_singleton 0) measurable_const
    (by fun_prop)).stronglyMeasurable

theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_le_firstMoments
    {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν) (t : ℝ) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν t ≤
      (∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + ∫ x, |x| ∂ν := by
  rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  split_ifs with ht
  · exact add_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr ht)]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using
      norm_charFun_sub_charFun_le_firstMoments hμ1 hν1 t

/-- Under finite first moments the discrepancy quotient is integrable on
every bounded interval, so the truncated Esseen integral is well-defined. -/
theorem intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν) (a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν) volume a b := by
  let M : ℝ := (∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + ∫ x, |x| ∂ν
  have hM : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => M) volume a b :=
    intervalIntegrable_const
  refine hM.mono_fun' ?_ ?_
  · exact (stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all (volume.restrict (uIoc a b)) fun t => by
      change |charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν t| ≤ M
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg μ ν t)]
      simpa only [M] using
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_le_firstMoments hμ1 hν1 t

/-- Exact standard-normal CDF increment as an interval integral of its
density. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_eq_integral
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw b -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a =
      ∫ x in a..b, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x := by
  open NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems in
  rw [cdf_eq_real, cdf_eq_real]
  have hsubset : Iic a ⊆ Iic b := Iic_subset_Iic.mpr hab
  rw [← measureReal_diff hsubset measurableSet_Iic]
  have hdiff : Iic b \ Iic a = Ioc a b := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_Iic, mem_Ioc, not_le]
    tauto
  rw [hdiff, standardNormalLaw, Measure.real_def,
    gaussianReal_apply_eq_integral 0 (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0) (Ioc a b)]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (integral_nonneg fun x => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 x)]
  exact (intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab).symm

theorem standardNormalCDF_eq_add_integral (a b : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw b =
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a +
        ∫ x in a..b, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x := by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · have h := standardNormalCDF_sub_eq_integral hab
    linarith
  · have h := standardNormalCDF_sub_eq_integral hba
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
    linarith

theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x) x := by
  have hfun :
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw =
        fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x +
          ∫ t in x..u, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 t := by
    funext u
    exact standardNormalCDF_eq_add_integral x u
  rw [hfun]
  convert (hasDerivAt_const x
    (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)).add
      (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).intervalIntegrable
        (ProbabilityTheory.stronglyMeasurable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).stronglyMeasurableAtFilter
        (by rw [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def]; fun_prop)) using 1; simp

/-- The standard-normal density exactly cancels the integrating factor in
the Stein equation. -/
theorem sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_half_sq_mul_standardNormalPDF (z : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z = 1 := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  calc
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2)) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        (Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2)) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hsqrt, ← Real.exp_add,
        show z ^ 2 / 2 + -(z ^ 2) / 2 = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
      norm_num

/-- Lower branch of the standard-normal Stein solution for the half-line
test at threshold `x`. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalSteinLower (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z *
    (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)

/-- Upper branch of the standard-normal Stein solution for the half-line
test at threshold `x`. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalSteinUpper (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x *
    (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z)

theorem standardNormalSteinLower_eq_upper (x : ℝ) :
    standardNormalSteinLower x x = standardNormalSteinUpper x x := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinLower standardNormalSteinUpper
  ring

/-- The lower branch solves the half-line Stein equation. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinLower (x z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (standardNormalSteinLower x)
      (z * standardNormalSteinLower x z +
        (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)) z := by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) z z := by
    convert ((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2 using 1; simp
  have hexp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2))
      (Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) * z) z := by
    convert (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (z ^ 2 / 2)).comp z hinner using 1
  have h :=
    (((hexp.const_mul (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))).mul
      (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF z)).mul_const
        (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x))
  convert h using 1
  · rw [sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_half_sq_mul_standardNormalPDF]
    unfold standardNormalSteinLower
    ring

/-- The upper branch solves the complementary half-line Stein equation. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinUpper (x z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (standardNormalSteinUpper x)
      (z * standardNormalSteinUpper x z -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) z := by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) z z := by
    convert ((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2 using 1; simp
  have hexp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (y ^ 2 / 2))
      (Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) * z) z := by
    convert (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (z ^ 2 / 2)).comp z hinner using 1
  have honeSub := (hasDerivAt_const z 1).sub (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF z)
  have h :=
    (((hexp.const_mul (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))).mul_const
      (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)).mul honeSub)
  convert h using 1
  unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
  have hcancel := sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_half_sq_mul_standardNormalPDF z
  calc
    z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x *
          (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z)) -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x *
          (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z)) -
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z) *
          cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
        rw [hcancel]
        ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring

theorem continuous_standardNormalCDF :
    Continuous
      (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  exact fun z => (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF z).continuousAt

/-- The continuous half-line Stein solution, obtained by joining the two
closed-form branches at the threshold. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalSteinSolution (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if z ≤ x then standardNormalSteinLower x z else standardNormalSteinUpper x z

theorem standardNormalSteinSolution_of_le {x z : ℝ} (hz : z ≤ x) :
    standardNormalSteinSolution x z = standardNormalSteinLower x z := by
  simp only [standardNormalSteinSolution, if_pos hz]

theorem standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt {x z : ℝ} (hz : x < z) :
    standardNormalSteinSolution x z = standardNormalSteinUpper x z := by
  simp only [standardNormalSteinSolution, if_neg (not_le.mpr hz)]

theorem continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution (x : ℝ) :
    Continuous (standardNormalSteinSolution x) := by
  have hlower : Continuous (standardNormalSteinLower x) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinLower
    exact (((continuous_const.mul (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2)))).mul
        continuous_standardNormalCDF).mul continuous_const)
  have hupper : Continuous (standardNormalSteinUpper x) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
    exact (((continuous_const.mul (by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2)))).mul continuous_const).mul
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_standardNormalCDF))
  unfold standardNormalSteinSolution
  apply continuous_if_le continuous_id continuous_const
    hlower.continuousOn hupper.continuousOn
  intro z hz
  have hzx : z = x := by simpa using hz
  subst z
  exact standardNormalSteinLower_eq_upper x

/-- Away from the threshold, the joined solution satisfies the lower branch
of the half-line Stein equation. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt
    {x z : ℝ} (hz : z < x) :
    HasDerivAt (standardNormalSteinSolution x)
      (z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
        (1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)) z := by
  have heq : standardNormalSteinSolution x =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      standardNormalSteinLower x := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_le_nhds hz] with y hy
    exact standardNormalSteinSolution_of_le hy
  have h := (hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinLower x z).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  simpa only [standardNormalSteinSolution_of_le hz.le] using h

/-- Away from the threshold, the joined solution satisfies the upper branch
of the half-line Stein equation. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_gt
    {x z : ℝ} (hz : x < z) :
    HasDerivAt (standardNormalSteinSolution x)
      (z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) z := by
  have heq : standardNormalSteinSolution x =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      standardNormalSteinUpper x := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hz] with y hy
    exact standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt hy
  have h := (hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinUpper x z).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  simpa only [standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt hz] using h

/-- Centered half-line test appearing on the right side of the standard-normal
Stein equation. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if z ≤ x then
    1 - cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x
  else
    -cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x

theorem measurable_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget (x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x) := by
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic measurable_const measurable_const

theorem abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_le_one (x z : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z| ≤ 1 := by
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  split_ifs
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr
      (cdf_le_one NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x))]
    linarith [cdf_nonneg
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x]
  · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)]
    exact cdf_le_one NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x

theorem standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg (x z : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ standardNormalSteinSolution x z := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinSolution
  split_ifs
  · unfold standardNormalSteinLower
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
        (cdf_nonneg NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr
        (cdf_le_one NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x))
  · unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
        (cdf_nonneg NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x))
      (sub_nonneg.mpr
        (cdf_le_one NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z))

/-- Pointwise Stein identity away from the half-line threshold. -/
theorem deriv_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_mul
    {x z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    deriv (standardNormalSteinSolution x) z -
        z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z =
      standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hzx | hxz
  · rw [(hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt hzx).deriv]
    simp only [standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget, if_pos hzx.le]
    ring
  · rw [(hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_gt hxz).deriv]
    simp only [standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget, if_neg (not_le.mpr hxz)]
    ring

/-- Almost-everywhere Stein identity in the Lebesgue form used for integration
and leave-one-out arguments. -/
theorem ae_deriv_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_mul (x : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂volume,
      deriv (standardNormalSteinSolution x) z -
          z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z =
        standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z := by
  filter_upwards [(volume : Measure ℝ).ae_ne x] with z hz
  exact deriv_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_mul hz

/-- Total derivative representative for Stein expectations.  Unlike the
analytic derivative, this definition also fixes the value at the threshold,
where an arbitrary comparison law may have an atom. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalSteinDerivative (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z + standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z

theorem standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_deriv
    {x z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    standardNormalSteinDerivative x z =
      deriv (standardNormalSteinSolution x) z := by
  have h := deriv_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_mul hz
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  linarith

theorem standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_eq_derivative_sub_mul (x z : ℝ) :
    standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z =
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  ring

theorem integrable_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x) nu := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (measurable_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x).aestronglyMeasurable 1
  exact ae_of_all nu fun z => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_le_one x z

/-- The expectation of the centered half-line Stein target under an arbitrary
probability law is exactly its CDF gap from the standard normal. -/
theorem integral_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_eq_cdf_sub
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ z, standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z ∂nu) =
      cdf nu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      ((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) nu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  have hfun : standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x = fun z =>
      (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
    funext z
    unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply, mem_Iic]
    by_cases hz : z ≤ x <;> simp [hz]
  have hIntInd :
      (∫ z, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z ∂nu) =
        nu.real (Iic x) := integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Iic
  have hCDFnu : cdf nu x = nu.real (Iic x) := cdf_eq_real nu x
  have hCDFnormal :
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw.real (Iic x) :=
    cdf_eq_real NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x
  rw [hfun, integral_sub hInd (integrable_const _),
    hIntInd, integral_const,
    probReal_univ, one_smul, hCDFnu, hCDFnormal]

section SteinBounds

open NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems

/-- Standard-normal reflection identifies its lower CDF with the opposite
closed upper tail. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_eq_tail_neg (z : ℝ) :
    cdf standardNormalLaw z = standardNormalLaw.real (Ici (-z)) := by
  rw [cdf_eq_real]
  have hmap : standardNormalLaw.map (fun y : ℝ => -y) = standardNormalLaw := by
    simpa [standardNormalLaw] using
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_neg (μ := (0 : ℝ)) (v := (1 : ℝ≥0)))
  calc
    standardNormalLaw.real (Iic z) =
        (standardNormalLaw.map (fun y : ℝ => -y)).real (Iic z) := by rw [hmap]
    _ = standardNormalLaw.real (Ici (-z)) := by
      simp only [Measure.real_def,
        Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun y : ℝ => -y)) measurableSet_Iic,
        neg_preimage, neg_Iic]

/-- The upper Mills-ratio estimate cancels the standard-normal integrating
factor outside the unit interval. -/
theorem sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t) ≤ 1 := by
  have htail :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.GaussianTails.standardNormalTail_le_density t ht
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    positivity
  calc
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hfactor
    _ = 1 := by
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hsqrt, one_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
      have hzero : t ^ 2 / 2 + -(t ^ 2) / 2 = 0 := by ring
      rw [hzero, Real.exp_zero]

/-- CDF-complement version of the upper Mills-ratio cancellation bound. -/
theorem sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_one_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw t) ≤ 1 := by
  have hopen : 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw t =
      standardNormalLaw.real (Ioi t) := by
    rw [cdf_eq_real, ← probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic, compl_Iic]
  rw [hopen]
  calc
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ioi t) ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact measureReal_mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self
      · positivity
    _ ≤ 1 := sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one t ht

/-- Reflected lower-tail version of the Mills-ratio cancellation bound. -/
theorem sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalCDF_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ -1) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        cdf standardNormalLaw t ≤ 1 := by
  rw [standardNormalCDF_eq_tail_neg]
  simpa only [neg_sq] using
    sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one (-t) (by linarith)

/-- The sharp Mills-ratio cancellation with the extra positive location
factor.  Unlike the coarser tail bound above, this holds all the way down to
zero. -/
theorem mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t)) ≤ 1 := by
  have htail :=
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.GaussianTails.standardNormalTail_bounds t ht).2
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ t *
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2)) := by positivity
  calc
    t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t)) =
      (t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2))) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t) := by ring
    _ ≤ (t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2))) *
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((1 / t) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hfactor
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [one_div]
      calc
        (t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2))) *
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
              (t⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2))) =
          (t * t⁻¹) *
            (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
            (Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) := by ring
        _ = 1 := by
          rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ht0, mul_inv_cancel₀ hsqrt, ← Real.exp_add]
          rw [show t ^ 2 / 2 + -(t ^ 2) / 2 = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
          norm_num

/-- CDF-complement form of the sharp positive-location cancellation. -/
theorem mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_one_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw t)) ≤ 1 := by
  have hopen : 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw t =
      standardNormalLaw.real (Ioi t) := by
    rw [cdf_eq_real, ← probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic, compl_Iic]
  rw [hopen]
  calc
    t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ioi t)) ≤
      t * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        standardNormalLaw.real (Ici t)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact measureReal_mono Ioi_subset_Ici_self
        · positivity
      · exact ht.le
    _ ≤ 1 := mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one t ht

/-- Reflected sharp Mills-ratio cancellation for a negative location. -/
theorem neg_mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalCDF_le_one
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t < 0) :
    (-t) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (t ^ 2 / 2) *
        cdf standardNormalLaw t) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [standardNormalCDF_eq_tail_neg]
  simpa only [neg_sq] using
    mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalTail_le_one (-t) (by linarith)

/-- At a negative location, the magnitude of the linear part of the Stein
solution is controlled by the upper tail at the test threshold. -/
theorem neg_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_one_sub_cdf
    (x z : ℝ) (hz : z < 0) :
    (-z) * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤
      1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have hcancel :=
    neg_mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalCDF_le_one z hz
  unfold standardNormalSteinSolution
  split_ifs with hzx
  · unfold standardNormalSteinLower
    calc
      (-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x)) =
        ((-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z)) * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcancel
          (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw x))
      _ = 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x := one_mul _
  · have hxz : x < z := lt_of_not_ge hzx
    have hmono : cdf standardNormalLaw x ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw z :=
      monotone_cdf standardNormalLaw hxz.le
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ (-z) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2)) :=
      mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hz.le) (by positivity)
    have hcancel' :
        ((-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hcancel
    have htail : 0 ≤ 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw z)
    unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
    calc
      (-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw x * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z)) =
        (((-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw x) * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) := by ring
      _ ≤ (((-z) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z) * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hfactor) htail
      _ ≤ 1 * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcancel' htail
      _ ≤ 1 * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) := by linarith
      _ = 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x := one_mul _

/-- At a positive location, the linear part of the Stein solution is
controlled by the lower probability at the test threshold. -/
theorem mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_cdf
    (x z : ℝ) (hz : 0 < z) :
    z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have hcancel :=
    mul_sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_one_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_one z hz
  unfold standardNormalSteinSolution
  split_ifs with hzx
  · have hmono : cdf standardNormalLaw z ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw x :=
      monotone_cdf standardNormalLaw hzx
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ z *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2)) := by positivity
    have hp : 0 ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw z := cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw z
    have hcancel' :
        (z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
          (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) ≤ 1 := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using hcancel
    have htail : 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x ≤
        1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z := by linarith
    unfold standardNormalSteinLower
    calc
      z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x)) =
        cdf standardNormalLaw z *
          ((z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x)) := by ring
      _ ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw z *
          ((z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2))) *
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail hfactor) hp
      _ ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw z * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcancel' hp
      _ ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw x := by simpa using hmono
  · have hp : 0 ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw x := cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw x
    unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
    calc
      z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw x * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z)) =
        cdf standardNormalLaw x *
          (z * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z))) := by ring
      _ ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw x * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcancel hp
      _ = cdf standardNormalLaw x := mul_one _

/-- The total half-line Stein derivative has the classical sharp uniform
bound, including at the threshold where its value was fixed explicitly. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_le_one (x z : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z| ≤ 1 := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  by_cases hzx : z ≤ x
  · simp only [if_pos hzx]
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst z
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_add]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw x))]
      linarith [cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw x]
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz0 with hz | hz
      · have hlin := neg_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_one_sub_cdf x z hz
        have hf := standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) := by
          nlinarith
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
        have hmul : z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hz.le hf
        linarith [cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw x]
      · have hlin := mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_cdf x z hz
        have hf := standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) :=
          add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hz.le hf)
            (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw x))
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
        linarith
  · simp only [if_neg hzx]
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst z
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_add, abs_neg]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw x)]
      exact cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw x
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz0 with hz | hz
      · have hlin := neg_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_one_sub_cdf x z hz
        have hf := standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z
        have hnonpos : z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
            -cdf standardNormalLaw x ≤ 0 := by
          have hmul : z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤ 0 :=
            mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hz.le hf
          linarith [cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw x]
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hnonpos]
        nlinarith
      · have hlin := mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_le_cdf x z hz
        have hf := standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z
        have hnonpos : z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
            -cdf standardNormalLaw x ≤ 0 := by linarith
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hnonpos]
        have hmul : 0 ≤ z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z :=
          mul_nonneg hz.le hf
        linarith [cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw x]

/-- A coarse universal bound for the half-line Stein solution.  Sharpness is
not needed here; this bound is chosen to make first-moment integrability
immediate. -/
theorem standardNormalSteinSolution_le (x z : ℝ) :
    standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hC : 1 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    have hsqrt : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [Real.one_le_sqrt]
      nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
    have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul hsqrt hexp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi))]
  have hsolution : standardNormalSteinSolution x z ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
        cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinSolution
    split_ifs with hzx
    · unfold standardNormalSteinLower
      have hmono := monotone_cdf standardNormalLaw hzx
      have hpref : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
          (cdf_nonneg _ _)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hpref
    · unfold standardNormalSteinUpper
      have hmono := monotone_cdf standardNormalLaw (le_of_not_ge hzx)
      have hfactor : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
        positivity
      have hprefix := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hfactor
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprefix
        (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw z))
  apply hsolution.trans
  by_cases hzlo : z ≤ -1
  · calc
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) ≤
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z * 1 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · linarith [cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw z]
        · exact mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
            (cdf_nonneg _ _)
      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 := sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_standardNormalCDF_le_one z hzlo
      _ ≤ C := hC
  · by_cases hzhi : 1 ≤ z
    · calc
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
            cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) ≤
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
            1 * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            exact cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw z
            positivity
          · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one standardNormalLaw z)
        _ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
            (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 :=
          sqrt_two_pi_mul_exp_mul_one_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_one z hzhi
        _ ≤ C := hC
    · have hzlower : -1 ≤ z := by linarith
      have hzupper : z ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hzsq : z ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ z + 1) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - z)]
      have hexp : Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have hA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
        positivity
      have hPnonneg : 0 ≤ cdf standardNormalLaw z := cdf_nonneg _ _
      have hQnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z :=
        sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one _ _)
      have hPle : cdf standardNormalLaw z ≤ 1 := cdf_le_one _ _
      have hQle : 1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z ≤ 1 := by
        linarith [cdf_nonneg standardNormalLaw z]
      have hAP : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
          cdf standardNormalLaw z ≤
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPle hA
      calc
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) *
            cdf standardNormalLaw z * (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw z) ≤
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (z ^ 2 / 2) * 1 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul hAP hQle hQnonneg (mul_nonneg hA zero_le_one)
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 1 * 1 := by
          gcongr
        _ = C := by simp [C]

theorem integrable_standardNormalSteinSolution
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (standardNormalSteinSolution x) nu := by
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).aestronglyMeasurable C
  exact ae_of_all nu fun z => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z)]
    exact standardNormalSteinSolution_le x z

theorem measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative (x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (standardNormalSteinDerivative x) := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  exact (measurable_id.mul
    (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable).add
      (measurable_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x)

theorem integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution
    (nu : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) nu) :
    Integrable (fun z => z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z) nu := by
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => C * |z|) nu := hfirst.const_mul C
  apply hmajor.mono'
    (measurable_id.mul
      (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all nu fun z => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z)]
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (standardNormalSteinSolution_le x z) (abs_nonneg z)]

theorem integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x : ℝ)
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) nu) :
    Integrable (standardNormalSteinDerivative x) nu := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  exact (integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution nu x hfirst).add
    (integrable_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget nu x)

/-- The sharp derivative bound makes every measurable pullback integrable on
a probability space, without a moment hypothesis. -/
theorem integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : Omega → ℝ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega => standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Y omega)) mu := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound
    ((measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x).comp_aemeasurable hY
      |>.aestronglyMeasurable) 1
  exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_le_one x (Y omega)

/-- Integrated Stein identity for an arbitrary probability law with finite
first absolute moment.  The total derivative representative makes the formula
valid even when the law has an atom at the threshold. -/
theorem integral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_eq_cdf_sub
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (x : ℝ)
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) nu) :
    (∫ z, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z ∂nu) -
        ∫ z, z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ∂nu =
      cdf nu x - cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have hDeriv := integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative nu x hfirst
  have hMul := integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution nu x hfirst
  calc
    (∫ z, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z ∂nu) -
        ∫ z, z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ∂nu =
      ∫ z, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ∂nu :=
      (integral_sub hDeriv hMul).symm
    _ = ∫ z, standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z ∂nu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all nu fun z =>
        (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_eq_derivative_sub_mul x z).symm
    _ = cdf nu x - cdf standardNormalLaw x :=
      integral_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_eq_cdf_sub nu x

/-- Pull the integrated Stein identity for the law of a random variable back
to its original probability space. -/
theorem integral_comp_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_eq_cdf_sub
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : Omega → ℝ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu)
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun omega => |Y omega|) mu) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Y omega) ∂mu) -
        ∫ omega, Y omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (Y omega) ∂mu =
      cdf (probabilityLaw Y hY) x - cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  let law : Measure ℝ := probabilityLaw Y hY
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLawFirst : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hfirst
  have h := integral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_eq_cdf_sub
    law x hLawFirst
  have hDerivMeas := measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x
  have hMulMeas : Measurable
      (fun z : ℝ => z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z) :=
    measurable_id.mul (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable
  change (∫ z, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z ∂Measure.map Y mu) -
      ∫ z, z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z ∂Measure.map Y mu =
    cdf (Measure.map Y mu) x - cdf standardNormalLaw x at h
  change (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Y omega) ∂mu) -
      ∫ omega, Y omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (Y omega) ∂mu =
    cdf (Measure.map Y mu) x - cdf standardNormalLaw x
  rw [integral_map hY hDerivMeas.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_map hY hMulMeas.aestronglyMeasurable] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using h

/-- Exact Stein expectation representation for a normalized centered iid sum.
This is the entry point for the summand-by-summand leave-one-out expansion. -/
theorem integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_standardNormalStein_eq_cdf_sub
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        ∫ omega, W omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu =
      cdf (probabilityLaw W
          (normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hW : MemLp W 2 mu := normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  have hfirst : Integrable (fun omega => |W omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hW.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  exact integral_comp_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_eq_cdf_sub
    W hW.aemeasurable hfirst x

/-- The normalized iid sum with one indexed summand removed. -/
noncomputable def normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    Omega → ℝ :=
  fun omega => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
    ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1, X j omega

theorem normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (omega : Omega) :
    normalizedCenteredIidSum X N omega =
      normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega +
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega := by
  unfold normalizedCenteredIidSum normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
  have hsum : (∑ j : Fin (N + 1), X j.1 omega) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X j omega := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply] using
      (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => X j omega) (N + 1))
  rw [hsum, ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_range.2 i.isLt)]
  ring

theorem normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    MemLp (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) 2 mu := by
  have hs : MemLp
      (fun omega => ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1, X j omega) 2 mu :=
    memLp_finset_sum ((Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1) (fun j _ => hX j)
  exact hs.const_mul (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹

theorem indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega}
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (X j) mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    IndepFun (X i.1) (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu := by
  have hi : i.1 ∉ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1 := by simp
  have hind :=
    (hIndep.indepFun_finset_sum_of_notMem₀ hX hi).symm
  have hcomp := hind.comp measurable_id
    (show Measurable (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y) by fun_prop)
  change IndepFun (X i.1)
    (fun omega => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1, X j omega) mu
  simpa [Function.comp_def, Finset.sum_apply] using hcomp

/-- On a probability space, a unit second moment bounds the first absolute
moment by one. -/
theorem integral_abs_le_one_of_secondMoment_eq_one
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {Y : Omega → ℝ} (hY : MemLp Y 2 mu)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (Y omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1) :
    ∫ omega, |Y omega| ∂mu ≤ 1 := by
  have h := expectedAbs_le_sqrt_secondMoment hY
  rw [hSecond] at h
  simpa using h

/-- Identically distributed real random variables have the same third
absolute moment. -/
theorem integral_abs_cube_eq_of_identDistrib
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} {Y Z : Omega → ℝ}
