    (hIdent : IdentDistrib Y Z mu mu) :
    (∫ omega, |Y omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) = ∫ omega, |Z omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
  have h := hIdent.comp
    (by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using h.integral_eq

/-- The exact second moment of a normalized iid sum with one summand
removed.  There are `N` surviving unit-variance terms but the normalization
still uses `sqrt (N + 1)`. -/
theorem integral_sq_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_eq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (∫ omega, (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
      (N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  let s : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1
  let S : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ j ∈ s, X j omega
  have hS : MemLp S 2 mu := by
    dsimp only [S]
    exact memLp_finset_sum s (fun j _ => hX j)
  have hSMean : ∫ omega, S omega ∂mu = 0 := by
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [integral_finset_sum]
    · simp only [hMean, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    · intro j _
      exact (hX j).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hPair : Set.Pairwise (↑s : Set ℕ)
      (fun j k => IndepFun (X j) (X k) mu) := by
    intro j hj k hk hjk
    exact hIndep.indepFun hjk
  have hVarSum : Var[S; mu] = ∑ j ∈ s, Var[X j; mu] := by
    have h := ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum
      (s := s) (X := X) (fun j _ => hX j) hPair
    have hfun : S = ∑ j ∈ s, X j := by
      funext omega
      simp only [S, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hfun]
    exact h
  have hVarEach : ∀ j, Var[X j; mu] = 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [variance_of_integral_eq_zero (hX j).aemeasurable (hMean j)]
    exact hSecond j
  have hCard : s.card = N := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_range.2 i.isLt), Finset.card_range]
    omega
  have hVarS : Var[S; mu] = (N : ℝ) := by
    rw [hVarSum]
    simp_rw [hVarEach]
    simp [hCard]
  have hWMean :
      ∫ omega, normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega ∂mu = 0 := by
    unfold normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    change ∫ omega, (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * S omega ∂mu = 0
    rw [integral_const_mul, hSMean, mul_zero]
  have hVarW : Var[normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i; mu] =
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N : ℝ) := by
    unfold normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    rw [variance_const_mul]
    change (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Var[S; mu] = _
    rw [hVarS]
  calc
    (∫ omega, (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
        Var[normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i; mu] :=
      (variance_of_integral_eq_zero
        (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i).aemeasurable
        hWMean).symm
    _ = (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N : ℝ) := hVarW
    _ = (N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
      rw [inv_pow, hsqrt]
      ring

/-- The normalized leave-one-out sum has first absolute moment at most one. -/
theorem integral_abs_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_le_one
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    ∫ omega, |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| ∂mu ≤ 1 := by
  have h := expectedAbs_le_sqrt_secondMoment
    (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i)
  rw [integral_sq_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_eq
    X hX hIndep hMean hSecond N i] at h
  exact h.trans (by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_one]
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < N + 1)).2 (by norm_num))

/-- Adding a deterministic nonnegative Stein-envelope constant preserves the
unit first-moment bound for the leave-one-out sum. -/
theorem integral_abs_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_add_const_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (C : ℝ) :
    (∫ omega,
        |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| + C ∂mu) ≤ 1 + C := by
  have hWi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hAbs : Integrable
      (fun omega => |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hWi.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  rw [integral_add hAbs (integrable_const C)]
  simpa using add_le_add_right
    (integral_abs_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_le_one
      X hX hIndep hMean hSecond N i) C

/-- `Fin.succAbove i` enumerates the finite range with `i` erased, so the two
forms of a leave-one-out sum agree exactly. -/
theorem sum_range_erase_eq_sum_succAbove
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (omega : Omega) :
    (∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1, X j omega) =
      ∑ j : Fin N, X (i.succAbove j).1 omega := by
  have hRange : (∑ j : Fin (N + 1), X j.1 omega) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X j omega := by
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply] using
      (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => X j omega) (N + 1))
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ (Finset.range (N + 1)).erase i.1, X j omega) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X j omega) - X i.1 omega := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_range.2 i.isLt)]
      ring
    _ = (∑ j : Fin (N + 1), X j.1 omega) - X i.1 omega := by
      rw [hRange]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin N, X (i.succAbove j).1 omega := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun j : Fin (N + 1) => X j.1 omega) i]
      ring

/-- Any `N`-element subfamily selected from an iid sequence has the same sum
law as the first `N` variables. -/
theorem map_sum_succAbove_eq_map_sum_fin
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (X j) mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X j) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    Measure.map (∑ j : Fin N, X (i.succAbove j).1) mu =
      Measure.map (∑ j : Fin N, X j.1) mu := by
  cases N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N =>
      let j0 : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos N⟩
      let Y : Fin (N + 1) → Omega → ℝ :=
        fun j => X (i.succAbove j).1
      let Z : Fin (N + 1) → Omega → ℝ := fun j => X j.1
      have hY : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (Y j) mu := fun j => hX _
      have hZ : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (Z j) mu := fun j => hX _
      have hYIndep : iIndepFun Y mu := by
        exact hIndep.precomp
          (Fin.val_injective.comp i.succAbove_right_injective)
      have hZIndep : iIndepFun Z mu := hIndep.precomp Fin.val_injective
      have hYIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (Y j) (Y j0) mu mu := by
        intro j
        exact (hIdent (i.succAbove j).1).trans
          (hIdent (i.succAbove j0).1).symm
      have hZIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (Z j) (Z j0) mu mu := by
        intro j
        exact (hIdent j.1).trans (hIdent j0.1).symm
      have hYZ : IdentDistrib (Y j0) (Z j0) mu mu :=
        (hIdent (i.succAbove j0).1).trans (hIdent j0.1).symm
      apply Measure.ext_of_charFun
      funext t
      calc
        MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.map (∑ j, Y j) mu) t =
            MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.map (Y j0) mu) t ^ (N + 1) :=
          by simpa using charFun_map_iid_sum_eq_pow Y j0 hY hYIndep hYIdent t
        _ = MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.map (Z j0) mu) t ^ (N + 1) := by
          rw [hYZ.map_eq]
        _ = MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.map (∑ j, Z j) mu) t :=
          by simpa using
            (charFun_map_iid_sum_eq_pow Z j0 hZ hZIndep hZIdent t).symm

/-- For `N > 0`, every leave-one-out law is the common `N`-summand
standardized iid law, contracted by `sqrt N / sqrt (N + 1)`. -/
theorem map_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_eq_map_mul_normalizedPrefix
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (X j) mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X j) (X 0) mu mu)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu =
      Measure.map
        (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N - 1)) mu) := by
  let U : Omega → ℝ := fun omega =>
    ∑ j : Fin N, X (i.succAbove j).1 omega
  let V : Omega → ℝ := fun omega => ∑ j : Fin N, X j.1 omega
  let P := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    X (N - 1)
  let a : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  have hU : AEMeasurable U mu := by
    dsimp only [U]
    fun_prop
  have hV : AEMeasurable V mu := by
    dsimp only [V]
    fun_prop
  have hP : AEMeasurable P mu := by
    dsimp only [P]
    unfold NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    fun_prop
  have hMapUV : Measure.map U mu = Measure.map V mu := by
    have hUFun : U = ∑ j : Fin N, X (i.succAbove j).1 := by
      funext omega
      simp only [U, Finset.sum_apply]
    have hVFun : V = ∑ j : Fin N, X j.1 := by
      funext omega
      simp only [V, Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hUFun, hVFun]
    exact map_sum_succAbove_eq_map_sum_fin X hX hIndep hIdent N i
  have haMeas : AEMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => a * y) (Measure.map U mu) := by
    fun_prop
  have haMeasV : AEMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => a * y) (Measure.map V mu) := by
    fun_prop
  have hcMeas : AEMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => c * y) (Measure.map P mu) := by
    fun_prop
  have hCoeff : c * (Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))⁻¹ = a := by
    dsimp only [c, a]
    field_simp [show Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity,
      show Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity]
  have hWiFun : normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i =
      fun omega => a * U omega := by
    funext omega
    unfold normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    dsimp only [a, U]
    rw [sum_range_erase_eq_sum_succAbove X N i omega]
  have hPPoint : ∀ omega, P omega =
      (Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))⁻¹ * V omega := by
    intro omega
    dsimp only [P, V]
    unfold NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    rw [show N - 1 + 1 = N by omega]
    rw [show ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (N : ℝ) by
      norm_cast
      omega]
  have hPFun : (fun omega => a * V omega) = fun omega => c * P omega := by
    funext omega
    rw [hPPoint]
    rw [← hCoeff]
    ring
  calc
    Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu =
        Measure.map (fun omega => a * U omega) mu := by rw [hWiFun]
    _ = Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => a * y) (Measure.map U mu) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
        (haMeas.map_map_of_aemeasurable hU).symm
    _ = Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => a * y) (Measure.map V mu) := by
      rw [hMapUV]
    _ = Measure.map (fun omega => a * V omega) mu := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
        haMeasV.map_map_of_aemeasurable hV
    _ = Measure.map (fun omega => c * P omega) mu := by rw [hPFun]
    _ = Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) (Measure.map P mu) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
        (hcMeas.map_map_of_aemeasurable hP).symm

/-- The leave-one-out Kolmogorov error is bounded by the preceding normalized
iid error plus the standard-normal defect caused by the exact contraction. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_le_prefix_add_scalingDefect
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (X j) mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X j) (X 0) mu mu)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
              X (N - 1)) mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ =>
              Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let P := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    X (N - 1)
  let c : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let nu : Measure ℝ := Measure.map P mu
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  have hP : AEMeasurable P mu := by
    dsimp only [P]
    unfold NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hP
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := inferInstance
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    positivity
  have hLaw :=
    map_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_eq_map_mul_normalizedPrefix
      X hX hIndep hIdent hN i
  change kolmogorovDistance
      (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu) gamma ≤
    kolmogorovDistance nu gamma +
      kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) gamma) gamma
  rw [hLaw]
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu) gamma ≤
        kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) nu)
            (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) gamma) +
          kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) gamma) gamma :=
      kolmogorovDistance_triangle _ _ _
    _ = kolmogorovDistance nu gamma +
          kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) gamma) gamma := by
      rw [kolmogorovDistance_map_mul_eq nu gamma hc]

/-- Fubini formula for an arbitrary integrable real function of two
independent random variables.  This complements the product-only integration
lemmas in Mathlib and is the interface needed for random interval endpoints. -/
theorem integral_comp_pair_eq_integral_integral_of_indepFun
    {Omega A B : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y : Omega → A) (X : Omega → B)
    (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu) (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hIndep : IndepFun Y X mu) (F : A × B → ℝ)
    (hF : Integrable F ((Measure.map Y mu).prod (Measure.map X mu))) :
    (∫ omega, F (Y omega, X omega) ∂mu) =
      ∫ y, ∫ x, F (y, x) ∂Measure.map X mu ∂Measure.map Y mu := by
  have hmap : Measure.map (fun omega => (Y omega, X omega)) mu =
      (Measure.map Y mu).prod (Measure.map X mu) :=
    (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hY hX).mp hIndep
  have hFmap : AEStronglyMeasurable F
      (Measure.map (fun omega => (Y omega, X omega)) mu) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hF.aestronglyMeasurable
  calc
    (∫ omega, F (Y omega, X omega) ∂mu) =
        ∫ p, F p ∂Measure.map (fun omega => (Y omega, X omega)) mu :=
      (integral_map (hY.prodMk hX) hFmap).symm
    _ = ∫ p, F p ∂(Measure.map Y mu).prod (Measure.map X mu) := by rw [hmap]
    _ = ∫ y, ∫ x, F (y, x) ∂Measure.map X mu ∂Measure.map Y mu :=
      integral_prod F hF

/-- Independence and centering cancel the contribution in which the removed
summand is multiplied by the Stein solution evaluated at the leave-one-out
sum. -/
theorem integral_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_leaveOneOut_eq_zero
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X i.1 omega ∂mu = 0) :
    (∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
        standardNormalSteinSolution x
          (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) = 0 := by
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hfact := hind.integral_comp_mul_comp
    (hX i.1).aemeasurable hLeave.aemeasurable
    aestronglyMeasurable_id
    (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).aestronglyMeasurable
  simpa [Function.comp_def, hMean] using hfact

theorem integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_comp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega}
    (Y Z : Omega → ℝ) (hY : Integrable Y mu) (hZ : AEMeasurable Z mu)
    (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun omega =>
      Y omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (Z omega)) mu := by
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun omega => C * |Y omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hY.norm.const_mul C
  apply hmajor.mono'
    (hY.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      ((continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable.comp_aemeasurable hZ
        |>.aestronglyMeasurable))
  exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
    change |Y omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (Z omega)| ≤ C * |Y omega|
    rw [abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x (Z omega))]
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (standardNormalSteinSolution_le x (Z omega)) (abs_nonneg (Y omega))]

/-- Exact leave-one-out expansion of the drift term in the normalized-sum
Stein identity. -/
theorem integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_mul_steinSolution_eq_leaveOneOut
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    (∫ omega, W omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu) =
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          X i.1 omega *
            (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
              standardNormalSteinSolution x
                (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) ∂mu := by
  let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  change (∫ omega, W omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu) =
    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
      ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        X i.1 omega *
          (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) ∂mu
  have hW : MemLp W 2 mu := normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  have hXiW : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), Integrable (fun omega =>
      X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega)) mu := by
    intro i
    exact integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_comp
      (X i.1) W ((hX i.1).integrable (by norm_num)) hW.aemeasurable x
  have hXiLeave : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1), Integrable (fun omega =>
      X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x
        (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) mu := by
    intro i
    exact integrable_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_comp
      (X i.1) (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i)
      ((hX i.1).integrable (by norm_num))
      (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i).aemeasurable x
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1),
      (∫ omega, X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu) =
        ∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
          (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) ∂mu := by
    intro i
    have hzero :=
      integral_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_leaveOneOut_eq_zero
        X hX hIndep N i x (hMean i.1)
    calc
      (∫ omega, X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu) =
          (∫ omega, X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu := by rw [hzero, sub_zero]
      _ = ∫ omega,
          X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
            X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu :=
        (integral_sub (hXiW i) (hXiLeave i)).symm
      _ = ∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
          (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) ∂mu := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring
  have hpoint : (fun omega =>
      W omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega)) =
      fun omega => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          X i.1 omega * standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) := by
    funext omega
    dsimp only [W, normalizedCenteredIidSum]
    rw [mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [hpoint, integral_const_mul, integral_finset_sum]
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact hterm i
  · intro i _
    exact hXiW i

/-- The normalized-sum Stein identity after the drift term has been expanded
summand by summand around the corresponding leave-one-out sums. -/
theorem integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_eq_leaveOneOut
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
            X i.1 omega *
              (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
                standardNormalSteinSolution x
                  (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)) ∂mu =
      cdf (probabilityLaw W
          (normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have h := integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_standardNormalStein_eq_cdf_sub
    X hX N x
  have hDrift :=
    integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_mul_steinSolution_eq_leaveOneOut
      X hX hIndep hMean N x
  dsimp only at h hDrift ⊢
  rw [hDrift] at h
  exact h

theorem antitone_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget (x : ℝ) :
    Antitone (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x) := by
  intro a b hab
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  by_cases ha : a ≤ x
  · by_cases hb : b ≤ x
    · simp [ha, hb]
    · simp [ha, hb]
  · have hb : ¬b ≤ x := fun hbx => ha (hab.trans hbx)
    simp [ha, hb]

/-- The discontinuous part of the Stein derivative changes only when the
unoriented interval between the two arguments contains the threshold. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_sub_le_crossing
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x b -
        standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x a| ≤
      (uIcc a b).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
  classical
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  by_cases ha : a ≤ x
  · by_cases hb : b ≤ x
    · simp only [if_pos ha, if_pos hb, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x
    · have hmem : x ∈ uIcc a b :=
        Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl ⟨ha, (le_of_not_ge hb)⟩)
      rw [if_neg hb, if_pos ha, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rw [show -cdf standardNormalLaw x -
          (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) = (-1 : ℝ) by ring]
      norm_num
  · by_cases hb : b ≤ x
    · have hmem : x ∈ uIcc a b :=
        Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hb, (le_of_not_ge ha)⟩)
      rw [if_pos hb, if_neg ha, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rw [show (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) -
          -cdf standardNormalLaw x = (1 : ℝ) by ring]
      norm_num
    · simp only [if_neg ha, if_neg hb, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x

/-- If adding `y` crosses the threshold `x`, then the starting point lies in
the symmetric interval of radius `|y|` around that threshold. -/
theorem mem_Icc_sub_abs_add_abs_of_mem_uIcc_add
    {x w y : ℝ} (h : x ∈ uIcc w (w + y)) :
    w ∈ Icc (x - |y|) (x + |y|) := by
  rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp h with h | h
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [le_abs_self y, neg_le_abs y]
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [le_abs_self y, neg_le_abs y]

/-- Indicator form of the deterministic crossing containment. -/
theorem indicator_uIcc_add_le_indicator_Icc_sub_abs_add_abs
    (x w y : ℝ) :
    (uIcc w (w + y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x ≤
      (Icc (x - |y|) (x + |y|)).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  classical
  by_cases h : x ∈ uIcc w (w + y)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h,
      Set.indicator_of_mem (mem_Icc_sub_abs_add_abs_of_mem_uIcc_add h)]
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w

/-- For a nonnegative increment, a change in the half-line target forces the
starting point into the half-open interval `(x - y, x]`. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x (w + y) -
        standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x w| ≤
      (Ioc (x - y) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  classical
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  by_cases hw : w ≤ x
  · by_cases hwy : w + y ≤ x
    · simp only [if_pos hw, if_pos hwy, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w
    · have hmem : w ∈ Ioc (x - y) x := ⟨by linarith, hw⟩
      rw [if_neg hwy, if_pos hw, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rw [show -cdf standardNormalLaw x -
          (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) = (-1 : ℝ) by ring]
      norm_num
  · have hwy : ¬w + y ≤ x := by
      intro h
      exact hw (by linarith)
    simp only [if_neg hw, if_neg hwy, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w

/-- For a nonpositive increment, a change in the half-line target forces the
starting point into the half-open interval `(x, x - y]`. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x (w + y) -
        standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x w| ≤
      (Ioc x (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  classical
  unfold standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget
  by_cases hw : w ≤ x
  · have hwy : w + y ≤ x := by linarith
    simp only [if_pos hw, if_pos hwy, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w
  · by_cases hwy : w + y ≤ x
    · have hmem : w ∈ Ioc x (x - y) := ⟨lt_of_not_ge hw, by linarith⟩
      rw [if_pos hwy, if_neg hw, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
      rw [show (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x) -
          -cdf standardNormalLaw x = (1 : ℝ) by ring]
      norm_num
    · simp only [if_neg hw, if_neg hwy, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w

theorem indicator_Ioc_sub_le_of_nonneg
    (x w s y : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsy : s ≤ y) :
    (Ioc (x - s) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w ≤
      (Ioc (x - y) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  classical
  by_cases hmem : w ∈ Ioc (x - s) x
  · have hmem' : w ∈ Ioc (x - y) x := ⟨by linarith [hmem.1], hmem.2⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem']
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w

theorem indicator_Ioc_sub_le_of_nonpos
    (x w y s : ℝ) (hys : y ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 0) :
    (Ioc x (x - s)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w ≤
      (Ioc x (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  classical
  by_cases hmem : w ∈ Ioc x (x - s)
  · have hmem' : w ∈ Ioc x (x - y) := ⟨hmem.1, by linarith [hmem.2]⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem']
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) w

/-- Measurable two-variable event encoding the direction-sensitive half-open
interval crossed by an additive displacement `scale * v`. -/
def standardNormalSteinCrossingSet (x scale : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  {p | (0 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 ∈ Ioc (x - scale * p.2) x) ∨
    (p.2 ≤ 0 ∧ p.1 ∈ Ioc x (x - scale * p.2))}

theorem measurableSet_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet (x scale : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale) := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinCrossingSet
  measurability

theorem intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (standardNormalSteinDerivative x) volume a b := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  exact ((continuous_id.mul (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x)).intervalIntegrable a b).add
    ((antitone_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x).intervalIntegrable)

/-- Right derivative of the joined solution, using the upper branch at the
threshold. -/
noncomputable def standardNormalSteinRightDerivative (x z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if z < x then
    z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z + (1 - cdf standardNormalLaw x)
  else
    z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z - cdf standardNormalLaw x

theorem standardNormalSteinRightDerivative_eq_total
    {x z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ x) :
    standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x z =
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x z := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hzx | hxz
  · unfold standardNormalSteinRightDerivative standardNormalSteinDerivative
    simp [standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget, hzx, hzx.le]
  · unfold standardNormalSteinRightDerivative standardNormalSteinDerivative
    simp [standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget, not_lt_of_ge hxz.le,
      not_le.mpr hxz, sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinRightDerivative
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x) volume a b := by
  apply (intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x a b).congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(volume.restrict (uIoc a b)).ae_ne x] with z hz
  exact (standardNormalSteinRightDerivative_eq_total hz).symm

theorem hasDerivWithinAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_right
    (x z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (standardNormalSteinSolution x)
      (standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x z) (Ioi z) z := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy z x with hzx | hzx | hxz
  · simpa [standardNormalSteinRightDerivative, hzx] using
      (hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt hzx).hasDerivWithinAt
  · subst z
    have hu : HasDerivWithinAt (standardNormalSteinUpper x)
        (x * standardNormalSteinUpper x x - cdf standardNormalLaw x)
        (Ioi x) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinUpper x x).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hj := hu.congr
      (fun y hy => standardNormalSteinSolution_of_lt hy)
      (by rw [standardNormalSteinSolution_of_le le_rfl,
        standardNormalSteinLower_eq_upper])
    have hjoin : standardNormalSteinSolution x x = standardNormalSteinUpper x x := by
      rw [standardNormalSteinSolution_of_le le_rfl,
        standardNormalSteinLower_eq_upper]
    simpa [standardNormalSteinRightDerivative, hjoin] using hj
  · simpa [standardNormalSteinRightDerivative, not_lt_of_ge hxz.le] using
      (hasDerivAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_of_gt hxz).hasDerivWithinAt

theorem intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinRightDerivative_eq_sub
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x z) =
      standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a := by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right
  · exact (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).continuousOn
  · intro z _
    exact hasDerivWithinAt_standardNormalSteinSolution_right x z
  · exact intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x a b

/-- Exact increment formula for the joined Stein solution.  The total
representative differs from the one-sided analytic derivative only at the
threshold, which has Lebesgue measure zero. -/
theorem intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) =
      standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a := by
  calc
    (∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) =
        ∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinRightDerivative x z := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(volume : Measure ℝ).ae_ne x] with z hz _
      exact (standardNormalSteinRightDerivative_eq_total hz).symm
    _ = standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a :=
      intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinRightDerivative_eq_sub x a b

/-- The first-order interval remainder is bounded by the integral of the
derivative increment from the starting point. -/
theorem abs_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_intervalIntegral_le
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |(b - a) * standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
        (∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
      ∫ z in uIoc a b,
        |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x a| := by
  have hD := intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x a b
  have hconst : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun _ : ℝ => standardNormalSteinDerivative x a) volume a b :=
    intervalIntegrable_const
  calc
    |(b - a) * standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
        (∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| =
      ‖∫ z in a..b, (standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hconst hD,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      congr 1
    _ = ‖∫ z in uIoc a b, (standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)‖ :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_intervalIntegral_eq
        (fun z => standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) a b volume
    _ ≤ ∫ z in uIoc a b,
        ‖standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ :=
      norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ = ∫ z in uIoc a b,
        |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x a| := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun z => by
        change |standardNormalSteinDerivative x a -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x z| =
            |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x a|
        exact abs_sub_comm _ _

theorem abs_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le_integral_abs_derivative
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a| ≤
      ∫ z in uIoc a b, |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z| := by
  calc
    |standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a| =
        ‖∫ z in a..b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ = ‖∫ z in uIoc a b, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_intervalIntegral_eq
        (standardNormalSteinDerivative x) a b volume
    _ ≤ ∫ z in uIoc a b, ‖standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ :=
      norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ = ∫ z in uIoc a b, |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z| := by
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- The sharp global Lipschitz estimate for the half-line Stein solution. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le (x a b : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a| ≤
      |b - a| := by
  have hbound : ∀ z ∈ uIoc a b,
      ‖standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro z _
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_le_one x z
  have hnorm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
  rw [intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub,
    Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
  simpa using hnorm

/-- The continuous drift part of the total Stein derivative has a local
increment bound in terms of the starting point. -/
theorem abs_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |b * standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
        a * standardNormalSteinSolution x a| ≤
      (|a| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * |b - a| := by
  have hsplit :
      b * standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
          a * standardNormalSteinSolution x a =
        a * (standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x a) +
          (b - a) * standardNormalSteinSolution x b := by ring
  rw [hsplit]
  apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
  calc
    |a * (standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
          standardNormalSteinSolution x a)| +
        |(b - a) * standardNormalSteinSolution x b| =
      |a| * |standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
          standardNormalSteinSolution x a| +
        |b - a| * standardNormalSteinSolution x b := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x b)]
    _ ≤ |a| * |b - a| +
        |b - a| *
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (abs_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le x a b) (abs_nonneg a))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (standardNormalSteinSolution_le x b) (abs_nonneg (b - a)))
    _ = (|a| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        |b - a| := by ring

/-- Increment bound for the total Stein derivative.  Its continuous drift
part is controlled by the one-Lipschitz solution, while the only discontinuous
contribution is the explicit threshold-crossing indicator. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_crossing
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x b -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x a| ≤
      (|a| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * |b - a| +
        (uIcc a b).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
  have hsplit :
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x b -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x a =
        (a * (standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x a) +
          (b - a) * standardNormalSteinSolution x b) +
        (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x b -
          standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x a) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  apply (abs_add_le _ _).trans
  apply add_le_add
  · calc
      |a * (standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x a) +
          (b - a) * standardNormalSteinSolution x b| ≤
        |a * (standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x a)| +
          |(b - a) * standardNormalSteinSolution x b| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |a| * |standardNormalSteinSolution x b -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x a| +
          |b - a| * standardNormalSteinSolution x b := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x b)]
      _ ≤ |a| * |b - a| +
          |b - a| *
            (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
        exact add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (abs_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le x a b) (abs_nonneg a))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (standardNormalSteinSolution_le x b) (abs_nonneg (b - a)))
      _ = (|a| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          |b - a| := by ring
  · exact abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_sub_le_crossing x a b

/-- Directional derivative-increment bound for a nonnegative displacement;
the atomic crossing term is a half-open interval of length exactly `y`. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (w + y) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w| ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * |y| +
        (Ioc (x - y) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  have hsplit :
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x (w + y) -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x w =
        ((w + y) * standardNormalSteinSolution x (w + y) -
          w * standardNormalSteinSolution x w) +
        (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x (w + y) -
          standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x w) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
    (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using
      abs_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le x w (w + y))
    (abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
      x w y hy))

/-- Directional derivative-increment bound for a nonpositive displacement;
the atomic crossing term is again a half-open interval of length `|y|`. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (w + y) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w| ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * |y| +
        (Ioc x (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  have hsplit :
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x (w + y) -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x w =
        ((w + y) * standardNormalSteinSolution x (w + y) -
          w * standardNormalSteinSolution x w) +
        (standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x (w + y) -
          standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x w) := by
    unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
    (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using
      abs_mul_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le x w (w + y))
    (abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
      x w y hy))

/-- Positive-displacement integral of the derivative increment.  The smooth
part is quadratic in the displacement and all intermediate jumps are absorbed
by the single endpoint crossing event. -/
theorem integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_of_nonneg
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|) ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (y ^ 2 / 2) +
        y * (Ioc (x - y) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  let A : ℝ := |w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let K : ℝ := (Ioc (x - y) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w
  have hDiffII : IntervalIntegrable (fun z =>
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w)
      volume w (w + y) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x w (w + y)).sub
      intervalIntegrable_const
  have hLeft : IntegrableOn (fun z =>
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|)
      (uIoc w (w + y)) volume := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hDiffII.norm.def'
  have hContII : IntervalIntegrable (fun z : ℝ => A * |z - w|)
      volume w (w + y) := by
    exact ((continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => A)).mul
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)).intervalIntegrable w (w + y)
  have hConstII : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => K) volume w (w + y) :=
    intervalIntegrable_const
  have hCont := hContII.def'
  have hConst := hConstII.def'
  have hMajor := hCont.add hConst
  have hpoint : ∀ z ∈ uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w| ≤
        A * |z - w| + K := by
    intro z hz
    have hwy : w ≤ w + y := by linarith
    rw [uIoc_of_le hwy] at hz
    have hs : 0 ≤ z - w := sub_nonneg.mpr hz.1.le
    have hsy : z - w ≤ y := by linarith [hz.2]
    have hD :=
      abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
        x w (z - w) hs
    rw [show w + (z - w) = z by ring] at hD
    exact hD.trans (by
      simpa only [A, K] using add_le_add_right
        (indicator_Ioc_sub_le_of_nonneg x w (z - w) y hs hsy)
        ((|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          |z - w|))
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on hLeft hMajor measurableSet_uIoc hpoint
  have hpow : (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), |z - w|) = y ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h := integral_pow_abs_sub_uIoc (a := w) (b := w + y) (n := 1)
    norm_num [abs_of_nonneg hy] at h
    simpa using h
  have hconst : (∫ _z in uIoc w (w + y), K) = y * K := by
    have hvol : volume.real (uIoc w (w + y)) = y := by
      simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hy]
    rw [setIntegral_const, hvol, smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|) ≤
      ∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), (A * |z - w| + K) := hmono
    _ = A * (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), |z - w|) +
        ∫ _z in uIoc w (w + y), K := by
      rw [integral_add hCont hConst, integral_const_mul]
    _ = A * (y ^ 2 / 2) + y * K := by rw [hpow, hconst]
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Negative-displacement integral of the derivative increment.  Reversing the
interval changes only the directional crossing event and replaces its length
by `-y = |y|`. -/
theorem integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_of_nonpos
    (x w y : ℝ) (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|) ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (y ^ 2 / 2) +
        (-y) * (Ioc x (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w := by
  let A : ℝ := |w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let K : ℝ := (Ioc x (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w
  have hDiffII : IntervalIntegrable (fun z =>
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w)
      volume w (w + y) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x w (w + y)).sub
      intervalIntegrable_const
  have hLeft : IntegrableOn (fun z =>
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|)
      (uIoc w (w + y)) volume := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hDiffII.norm.def'
  have hContII : IntervalIntegrable (fun z : ℝ => A * |z - w|)
      volume w (w + y) := by
    exact ((continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => A)).mul
      ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs)).intervalIntegrable w (w + y)
  have hConstII : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => K) volume w (w + y) :=
    intervalIntegrable_const
  have hCont := hContII.def'
  have hConst := hConstII.def'
  have hMajor := hCont.add hConst
  have hpoint : ∀ z ∈ uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z - standardNormalSteinDerivative x w| ≤
        A * |z - w| + K := by
    intro z hz
    have hwy : w + y ≤ w := by linarith
    rw [uIoc_of_ge hwy] at hz
    have hys : y ≤ z - w := by linarith [hz.1]
    have hs : z - w ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr hz.2
    have hD :=
      abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
        x w (z - w) hs
    rw [show w + (z - w) = z by ring] at hD
    exact hD.trans (by
      simpa only [A, K] using add_le_add_right
        (indicator_Ioc_sub_le_of_nonpos x w y (z - w) hys hs)
        ((|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          |z - w|))
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on hLeft hMajor measurableSet_uIoc hpoint
  have hpow : (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), |z - w|) = y ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have h := integral_pow_abs_sub_uIoc (a := w) (b := w + y) (n := 1)
    norm_num [abs_of_nonpos hy] at h
    convert h using 1
  have hconst : (∫ _z in uIoc w (w + y), K) = (-y) * K := by
    have hvol : volume.real (uIoc w (w + y)) = -y := by
      simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hy]
    rw [setIntegral_const, hvol, smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|) ≤
      ∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), (A * |z - w| + K) := hmono
    _ = A * (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y), |z - w|) +
        ∫ _z in uIoc w (w + y), K := by
      rw [integral_add hCont hConst, integral_const_mul]
    _ = A * (y ^ 2 / 2) + (-y) * K := by rw [hpow, hconst]
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Sign-free derivative-increment integral bound, with the directional atomic
term represented by the measurable crossing set. -/
theorem integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_crossingSet
    (x w y : ℝ) :
    (∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x w|) ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (y ^ 2 / 2) +
        |y| * (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, y) := by
  by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hy with hzero | hpos
    · subst y
      simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet]
    · have hnpos : ¬ y ≤ 0 := not_le_of_gt hpos
      simpa [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply, hy,
        hnpos, abs_of_pos hpos] using
        integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_of_nonneg x w y hy
  · have hneg : y < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy
    have hy' : y ≤ 0 := hneg.le
    simpa [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply, hy,
      hy', abs_of_neg hneg] using
      integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_of_nonpos x w y hy'

/-- First-order interval remainder bound with a quadratic continuous term and
the direction-sensitive threshold-crossing term exposed explicitly. -/
theorem abs_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_intervalIntegral_le_crossingSet
    (x w y : ℝ) :
    |y * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
        (∫ z in w..w + y, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (y ^ 2 / 2) +
        |y| * (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, y) := by
  have h := abs_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_intervalIntegral_le
    x w (w + y)
  have h' :
      |y * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
          (∫ z in w..w + y, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
        ∫ z in uIoc w (w + y),
          |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z -
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x w| := by
    convert h using 1; ring
  exact h'.trans
    (integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_crossingSet x w y)

/-- After multiplying the first-order remainder by the displacement, the
continuous term is cubic and the crossing term carries the squared
displacement. -/
theorem abs_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_intervalIntegral_le_crossingSet
    (x w y : ℝ) :
    |y ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
        y * (∫ z in w..w + y, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (|y| ^ 3 / 2) +
        y ^ 2 * (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, y) := by
  have h :=
    abs_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_intervalIntegral_le_crossingSet
      x w y
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg y)
  calc
    |y ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
        y * (∫ z in w..w + y, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| =
      |y| * |y * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
        (∫ z in w..w + y, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| := by
          rw [← abs_mul]
          congr 1
          ring
    _ ≤ |y| *
        ((|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
            (y ^ 2 / 2) +
          |y| * (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, y)) := hmul
    _ = (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (|y| ^ 3 / 2) +
        y ^ 2 * (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, y) := by
      rw [← sq_abs y]
      ring

/-- A nonnegative scale can be moved from the displacement coordinate into the
scale parameter of the crossing set. -/
theorem mem_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_one_mul_iff
    (x scale w v : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    (w, scale * v) ∈ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1 ↔
      (w, v) ∈ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale := by
  by_cases hzero : scale = 0
  · subst scale
    simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet]
  · have hpos : 0 < scale := lt_of_le_of_ne hscale (Ne.symm hzero)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ scale * v ↔ 0 ≤ v :=
      mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hpos
    have hnonpos : scale * v ≤ 0 ↔ v ≤ 0 := by
      simpa using
        (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hpos : scale * v ≤ scale * 0 ↔ v ≤ 0)
    simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, hnonneg, hnonpos]

theorem standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_indicator_one_mul_eq
    (x scale w v : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, scale * v) =
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v) := by
  classical
  have hmem := mem_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_one_mul_iff
    x scale w v hscale
  by_cases h : (w, scale * v) ∈ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x 1
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h, Set.indicator_of_mem (hmem.mp h)]
  · have h' : (w, v) ∉ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale :=
      fun hv => h (hmem.mpr hv)
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h, Set.indicator_of_notMem h']

/-- Scaled version of the cubic interval-remainder bound, arranged in the
normalization used by the leave-one-out sum. -/
theorem abs_scale_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_scale_mul_intervalIntegral_le
    (x w scale v : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    |scale ^ 2 * v ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x w -
        scale * v *
          (∫ z in w..w + scale * v, standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
      (|w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale ^ 3 * |v| ^ 3 / 2) +
        scale ^ 2 * v ^ 2 *
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v) := by
  have h :=
    abs_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_mul_intervalIntegral_le_crossingSet
      x w (scale * v)
  rw [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_indicator_one_mul_eq
    x scale w v hscale] at h
  simpa [mul_pow, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale, mul_assoc] using h

/-- Pointwise interval-remainder estimate for one normalized summand in the
leave-one-out decomposition. -/
theorem abs_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
      (|Wi omega| +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) +
        scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
            (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add]
  exact
    abs_scale_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_scale_mul_intervalIntegral_le
      x (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ (X i.1 omega)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))

/-- Pointwise leave-one-out specialization of the derivative-increment
bound, with the normalized removed summand exposed explicitly. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le_crossing
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ≤
      (|Wi omega| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
        (uIcc (Wi omega) (W omega)).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
  dsimp only
  have h := abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sub_le_crossing x
    (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
    (normalizedCenteredIidSum X N omega)
  have hscale : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hdiff :
      |normalizedCenteredIidSum X N omega -
          normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| =
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * |X i.1 omega| := by
    rw [normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add,
      add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale]
  rw [hdiff] at h
  exact h

/-- Positive removed-summand specialization with a half-open crossing
interval of the exact normalized summand length. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le_of_nonneg
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : ℝ) (omega : Omega) (hXi : 0 ≤ X i.1 omega) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ≤
      (|Wi omega| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
        (Ioc (x - scale * X i.1 omega) x).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add]
  have hscale : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h := abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
    x (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
      ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega)
      (mul_nonneg hscale hXi)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale] at h
  exact h

/-- Negative removed-summand specialization with a half-open crossing
interval of the exact normalized summand length. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le_of_nonpos
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : ℝ) (omega : Omega) (hXi : X i.1 omega ≤ 0) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ≤
      (|Wi omega| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
        (Ioc x (x - scale * X i.1 omega)).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add]
  have hscale : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h := abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
    x (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
      ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega)
      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hscale hXi)
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale] at h
  exact h

/-- Unified pointwise leave-one-out increment bound.  The measurable crossing
set records the sign split without placing a decidable conditional in the
statement. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le_crossingSet
    {Omega : Type*} (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : ℝ) (omega : Omega) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ≤
      (|Wi omega| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_leaveOneOut_add]
  have hscale : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  by_cases hzero : X i.1 omega = 0
  · rw [hzero]
    simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet]
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzero with hneg | hpos
    · have h :=
        abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonpos
          x (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega)
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hscale hneg.le)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale] at h
      simpa [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply,
        hneg.le, not_le_of_gt hneg] using h
    · have h :=
        abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_add_sub_le_indicator_Ioc_of_nonneg
          x (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega)
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega)
          (mul_nonneg hscale hpos.le)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hscale] at h
      simpa [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply,
        hpos.le, not_le_of_gt hpos] using h

theorem abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_le_linear (x z : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinDerivative x z| ≤
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |z| + 1 := by
  unfold standardNormalSteinDerivative
  calc
    |z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
        standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z| ≤
      |z * standardNormalSteinSolution x z| +
        |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |z| * standardNormalSteinSolution x z +
        |standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget x z| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x z)]
    _ ≤ |z| * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) + 1 :=
      add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (standardNormalSteinSolution_le x z) (abs_nonneg z))
        (abs_standardNormalHalfLineSteinTarget_le_one x z)
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |z| + 1 := by ring

/-- A location-dependent Lipschitz bound obtained from the exact increment
formula and the coarse linear bound for the total Stein derivative. -/
theorem abs_standardNormalSteinSolution_sub_le_linear
    (x a b : ℝ) :
    |standardNormalSteinSolution x b - standardNormalSteinSolution x a| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          max |a| |b| + 1) * |b - a| := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  have hbound : ∀ z ∈ uIoc a b,
      ‖standardNormalSteinDerivative x z‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          max |a| |b| + 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzabs : |z| ≤ max |a| |b| := by
      rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
      · rw [uIoc_of_le hab] at hz
        exact abs_le_max_abs_abs (le_of_lt hz.1) hz.2
      · rw [uIoc_of_ge hba] at hz
        simpa only [max_comm] using abs_le_max_abs_abs (le_of_lt hz.1) hz.2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_le_linear x z).trans
      (by linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzabs hC])
  have hnorm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
  rw [intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub,
    Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
  exact hnorm

/-- Exact normalized-sum leave-one-out identity with every Stein-solution
increment rewritten as an oriented integral of the total derivative. -/
theorem integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_eq_leaveOneOutInterval
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
            X i.1 omega *
              (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..W omega,
                standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu =
      cdf (probabilityLaw W
          (normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have h := integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_eq_leaveOneOut
    X hX hIndep hMean N x
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  simpa only [intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub] using h

/-- Independence and unit variance identify the quadratic summand factor with
the derivative expectation at the corresponding leave-one-out sum. -/
theorem integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_leaveOneOut_eq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1) :
    (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
        (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) =
      ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
        (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu := by
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hfact := hind.integral_comp_mul_comp
    (hX i.1).aemeasurable hLeave.aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2)
        (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)
    (measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x).aestronglyMeasurable
  simpa [Function.comp_def, hSecond] using hfact

/-- Exact variance-cancellation decomposition of the normalized-sum Stein
identity.  The first bracket compares derivative expectations, while the
second is the summandwise interval remainder before any estimate. -/
theorem integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_varianceCancellation
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let a := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    ((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        a ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) +
      (a ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
        a * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          X i.1 omega *
            (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..W omega,
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu) =
      cdf (probabilityLaw W
          (normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf standardNormalLaw x := by
  have h := integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_eq_leaveOneOutInterval
    X hX hIndep hMean N x
  have hVar :
      (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) =
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinDerivative_leaveOneOut_eq
      X hX hIndep N i x (hSecond i.1)
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  rw [hVar]
  linarith

end SteinBounds

theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1)
      (-x * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x) x := by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -(y - 0) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 : ℝ))) (-x) x := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const 0).pow 2).neg.div_const (2 * 1) using 1
    simp; ring
  have hexp : HasDerivAt
      (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-(y - 0) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 : ℝ))))
      (Real.exp (-(x - 0) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 : ℝ))) * (-x)) x :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_exp _).comp x hinner
  have hmul := hexp.const_mul (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℝ)))⁻¹
  simpa only [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def, NNReal.coe_one,
    mul_one, sub_zero, neg_mul, mul_neg, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmul

theorem hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF_deriv (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun y => -y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y)
      ((x ^ 2 - 1) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x) x := by
  convert (hasDerivAt_id x).neg.mul (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF x) using 1
  simp; ring

theorem contDiff_three_standardNormalCDF :
    ContDiff ℝ 3
      (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  rw [show (3 : WithTop ℕ∞) = 2 + 1 by norm_num, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
  refine ⟨fun x => (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF x).differentiableAt, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  have hderiv :
      deriv (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 := by
    funext x
    exact (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF x).deriv
  rw [hderiv, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def]
  fun_prop

theorem iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF (x : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 3
        (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x =
      (x ^ 2 - 1) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x := by
  rw [show 3 = 2 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ']
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ']
  simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
  have hderivCDF :
      deriv (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 := by
    funext y
    exact (hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF y).deriv
  rw [hderivCDF]
  have hderivPDF :
      deriv (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1) =
        fun y => -y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y := by
    funext y
    exact (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF y).deriv
  rw [hderivPDF]
  exact (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF_deriv x).deriv

theorem sq_mul_exp_neg_half_le_two (x : ℝ) :
    x ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 2 := by
  have hmain := Real.mul_exp_neg_le_exp_neg_one (x ^ 2 / 2)
  have hone : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h := hmain.trans hone
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) = Real.exp (-(x ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  nlinarith

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF_le (x : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv 3
        (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x| ≤
      3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF,
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
  have hC : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have habs : |x ^ 2 - 1| ≤ x ^ 2 + 1 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
  have hpoly :
      |x ^ 2 - 1| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 3 := by
    calc
      |x ^ 2 - 1| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤
          (x ^ 2 + 1) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right habs (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = x ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) +
          Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 + 1 := add_le_add (sq_mul_exp_neg_half_le_two x) hexp
      _ = 3 := by norm_num
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hC, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly hC]

/-- The standard-normal density is twice continuously differentiable. -/
theorem contDiff_two_standardNormalPDF :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1) := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def]
  fun_prop

theorem iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalPDF (a y t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 1
        (fun u => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) t =
      y * (-(a + y * t) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)) := by
  rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_zero]
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => a + y * u) y t := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_const t a).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul y) using 1
    simp
  convert ((hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF (a + y * t)).comp t hinner).deriv using 1
  ring

theorem iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalPDF (a y t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2
        (fun u => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) t =
      y ^ 2 * (((a + y * t) ^ 2 - 1) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)) := by
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hfirst :
      iteratedDeriv 1
          (fun u => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) =
        fun u => y * (-(a + y * u) *
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) := by
    funext u
    exact iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalPDF a y u
  rw [hfirst]
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => a + y * u) y t := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_const t a).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul y) using 1
    simp
  have hpdf :=
    (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF_deriv (a + y * t)).comp t hinner
  convert hpdf.const_mul y |>.deriv using 1; ring

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalPDF_le (a y t : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv 2
        (fun u => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) t| ≤
      (3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 2 := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalPDF, abs_mul, abs_pow]
  have h := abs_iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF_le (a + y * t)
  rw [iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF] at h
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg y) 2)]

theorem taylorWithinEval_one_affine_standardNormalPDF (a y : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval
        (fun t => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t))
        1 (Icc 0 1) 0 1 =
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
        y * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g := contDiff_two_standardNormalPDF.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by norm_num
  have hwithin0 : iteratedDerivWithin 0 g (Icc 0 1) 0 = iteratedDeriv 0 g 0 :=
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.of_le (by norm_num)).contDiffAt hzero
  have hwithin1 : iteratedDerivWithin 1 g (Icc 0 1) 0 = iteratedDeriv 1 g 0 :=
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.of_le (by norm_num)).contDiffAt hzero
  change taylorWithinEval g 1 (Icc 0 1) 0 1 = _
  rw [taylor_within_apply]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, hwithin0, hwithin1, iteratedDeriv_zero,
    g, iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalPDF, Nat.factorial]

/-- The standard-normal density admits a linear Taylor polynomial with the
uniform second-order remainder needed to exploit two signed spatial
cancellations. -/
theorem standardNormalPDF_linear_remainder (a y : ℝ) :
    |ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y) -
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
          y * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a))| ≤
      ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) * |y| ^ 2 := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 2 g := contDiff_two_standardNormalPDF.comp (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨t, _ht, hrem⟩ :=
    taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv
      (f := g) (n := 1) (x₀ := 0) (x := 1) zero_lt_one hg.contDiffOn
  have hpoly := taylorWithinEval_one_affine_standardNormalPDF a y
  have hbound := abs_iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalPDF_le a y t
  have hdiv : |iteratedDeriv 2 g t| / 2 ≤
      ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 2) / 2 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (by norm_num)
  calc
    |ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y) -
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
          y * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a))| =
        |g 1 - taylorWithinEval g 1 (Icc 0 1) 0 1| := by
      rw [hpoly]
      simp only [g, mul_one]
    _ = |iteratedDeriv 2 g t| / 2 := by
      rw [hrem]
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul]
      change |iteratedDeriv 2 g t| * |(1 : ℝ)| / |(2 : ℝ)| =
        |iteratedDeriv 2 g t| / 2
      simp
    _ ≤ ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 2) / 2 := hdiv
    _ = ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) * |y| ^ 2 := by ring

/-- The linear density remainder after scaling the standard normal by a
positive standard deviation.  The second-order coefficient scales exactly
as the inverse cube of the standard deviation. -/
theorem scaledStandardNormalPDF_linear_remainder
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a y : ℝ) :
    |σ⁻¹ *
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a + y) / σ) -
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ) +
          (y / σ) * (-(a / σ) *
            ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ))))| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) * |y| ^ 2 := by
  have hrem := standardNormalPDF_linear_remainder (a / σ) (y / σ)
  rw [show a / σ + y / σ = (a + y) / σ by ring] at hrem
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hσ)]
  calc
    σ⁻¹ *
        |ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a + y) / σ) -
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ) +
            (y / σ) * (-(a / σ) *
              ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ)))| ≤
        σ⁻¹ * (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
          |y / σ| ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrem (inv_nonneg.mpr hσ.le)
    _ = (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) *
        |y| ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hσ]
      field_simp

/-- A positive scaled-normal density converts two exact spatial
cancellations into a second-order weighted `L¹ -> L∞` estimate. -/
theorem abs_integral_scaledStandardNormalPDF_mul_le_of_cancellations
    (e : ℝ → ℝ) (he : Integrable e)
    (he1 : Integrable (fun z => z * e z))
    (he2 : Integrable (fun z => |z| ^ 2 * |e z|))
    (hzero : (∫ z, e z) = 0)
    (hone : (∫ z, z * e z) = 0)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (x : ℝ) :
    |∫ z, σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) * e z| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) *
        ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |e z| := by
  let K : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
    σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ)
  let Q : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => σ⁻¹ *
    (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ) +
      (-z / σ) * (-(x / σ) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ)))
  let C : ℝ := ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3
  let A : ℝ := σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ)
  let D : ℝ := σ⁻¹ * σ⁻¹ * (x / σ) *
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp only [C]
    positivity
  have hrem (z : ℝ) : |K z - Q z| ≤ C * |z| ^ 2 := by
    have h := scaledStandardNormalPDF_linear_remainder hσ x (-z)
    dsimp only [K, Q, C]
    calc
      |σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) -
          σ⁻¹ * (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ) +
            (-z / σ) * (-(x / σ) *
              ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ)))| =
          |σ⁻¹ *
            (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) -
              (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ) +
                (-z / σ) * (-(x / σ) *
                  ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (x / σ))))| := by
        congr 1
        ring
      _ ≤ (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) *
          |z| ^ 2 := by
        simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_neg_cancel_right, neg_div,
          abs_neg] using h
