  have hQfun : (fun z => Q z * e z) =
      fun z => A * e z + D * (z * e z) := by
    funext z
    dsimp only [Q, A, D]
    ring
  have hQProd : Integrable (fun z => Q z * e z) := by
    rw [hQfun]
    exact (he.const_mul A).add (he1.const_mul D)
  have hQInt : (∫ z, Q z * e z) = 0 := by
    rw [hQfun, integral_add (he.const_mul A) (he1.const_mul D),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hzero, hone]
    ring
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun z => C * (|z| ^ 2 * |e z|)) :=
    he2.const_mul C
  have hRProd : Integrable (fun z => (K z - Q z) * e z) := by
    apply hmajor.mono' (by fun_prop)
    exact ae_of_all _ fun z => by
      change ‖(K z - Q z) * e z‖ ≤ C * (|z| ^ 2 * |e z|)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrem z) (abs_nonneg (e z))
  have hKfun : (fun z => K z * e z) =
      fun z => (K z - Q z) * e z + Q z * e z := by
    funext z
    ring
  calc
    |∫ z, σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) * e z| =
        |∫ z, K z * e z| := by rfl
    _ = |(∫ z, (K z - Q z) * e z) + ∫ z, Q z * e z| := by
      rw [hKfun, integral_add hRProd hQProd]
    _ = |∫ z, (K z - Q z) * e z| := by rw [hQInt, add_zero]
    _ ≤ ∫ z, |(K z - Q z) * e z| := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun z => (K z - Q z) * e z))
    _ ≤ ∫ z, C * (|z| ^ 2 * |e z|) := by
      apply integral_mono hRProd.norm hmajor
      intro z
      change ‖(K z - Q z) * e z‖ ≤ C * (|z| ^ 2 * |e z|)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrem z) (abs_nonneg (e z))
    _ = C * ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |e z| := by rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- Change of variables from averaging against a positively scaled standard
normal law to the corresponding translated scaled-density convolution. -/
theorem integral_comp_sub_map_mul_standardNormalLaw_eq_integral_scaledPDF
    (e : ℝ → ℝ) (he : Measurable e) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, e (x - y) ∂Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      ∫ z, σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) * e z := by
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : ℝ => e (x - y))
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    (he.comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hmap := MeasureTheory.integral_map
    (μ := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
    (φ := fun z : ℝ => σ * z) (f := fun y : ℝ => e (x - y))
    (by fun_prop) hfm
  rw [hmap,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul
      (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
    σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((x - z) / σ) * e z
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
    σ⁻¹ * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (y / σ) * e (x - y)
  have htranslate : (∫ z, F z) = ∫ y, G y := by
    calc
      (∫ z, F z) = ∫ z, F (z + x) :=
        (MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self F x).symm
      _ = ∫ z, F (-z + x) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self (fun z => F (z + x)) volume]
      _ = ∫ y, G y := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun y => by
          dsimp only [F, G]
          rw [show x - (-y + x) = y by ring,
            show -y + x = x - y by ring]
  have hscale : (∫ y, G y) =
      ∫ y, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y * e (x - σ * y) := by
    have hcomp := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G σ
    have habs : |σ⁻¹| = σ⁻¹ := abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hσ)
    rw [habs, smul_eq_mul] at hcomp
    calc
      (∫ y, G y) = σ * (σ⁻¹ * ∫ y, G y) := by
        field_simp
      _ = σ * ∫ y, G (σ * y) := by rw [hcomp]
      _ = ∫ y, σ * G (σ * y) := by rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ = ∫ y, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y *
          e (x - σ * y) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun y => by
          dsimp only [G]
          field_simp
  exact hscale.symm.trans htranslate.symm

theorem iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalCDF (a y t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 1
        (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) t =
      y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t) := by
  rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ', iteratedDeriv_zero]
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => a + y * u) y t := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_const t a).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul y) using 1
    simp
  convert ((hasDerivAt_standardNormalCDF (a + y * t)).comp t hinner).deriv using 1
  ring

theorem iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalCDF (a y t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2
        (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) t =
      y ^ 2 * (-(a + y * t) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)) := by
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hfirst :
      iteratedDeriv 1
          (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) =
        fun u => y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u) := by
    funext u
    exact iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalCDF a y u
  rw [hfirst]
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => a + y * u) y t := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_const t a).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul y) using 1
    simp
  have hpdf := (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF (a + y * t)).comp t hinner
  convert hpdf.const_mul y |>.deriv using 1; ring

theorem iteratedDeriv_three_affine_standardNormalCDF (a y t : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 3
        (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) t =
      y ^ 3 * (((a + y * t) ^ 2 - 1) *
        ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * t)) := by
  rw [show 3 = 2 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hsecond :
      iteratedDeriv 2
          (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) =
        fun u => y ^ 2 * (-(a + y * u) *
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a + y * u)) := by
    funext u
    exact iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalCDF a y u
  rw [hsecond]
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => a + y * u) y t := by
    convert (hasDerivAt_const t a).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul y) using 1
    simp
  have hpdf :=
    (hasDerivAt_standardNormalPDF_deriv (a + y * t)).comp t hinner
  convert hpdf.const_mul (y ^ 2) |>.deriv using 1; ring

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_three_affine_standardNormalCDF_le (a y t : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv 3
        (fun u => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * u)) t| ≤
      (3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 3 := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_three_affine_standardNormalCDF, abs_mul, abs_pow]
  have h := abs_iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF_le (a + y * t)
  rw [iteratedDeriv_three_standardNormalCDF] at h
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg y) 3)]

theorem taylorWithinEval_two_affine_standardNormalCDF (a y : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval
        (fun t => cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * t))
        2 (Icc 0 1) 0 1 =
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a +
        y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
        (y ^ 2 / 2) * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * t)
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g :=
    contDiff_three_standardNormalCDF.comp
      (by fun_prop)
  have hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by norm_num
  have hwithin0 : iteratedDerivWithin 0 g (Icc 0 1) 0 = iteratedDeriv 0 g 0 :=
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.of_le (by norm_num)).contDiffAt hzero
  have hwithin1 : iteratedDerivWithin 1 g (Icc 0 1) 0 = iteratedDeriv 1 g 0 :=
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.of_le (by norm_num)).contDiffAt hzero
  have hwithin2 : iteratedDerivWithin 2 g (Icc 0 1) 0 = iteratedDeriv 2 g 0 :=
    iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv hu (hg.of_le (by norm_num)).contDiffAt hzero
  change taylorWithinEval g 2 (Icc 0 1) 0 1 = _
  rw [taylor_within_apply]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, hwithin0, hwithin1, hwithin2, iteratedDeriv_zero,
    g, iteratedDeriv_one_affine_standardNormalCDF,
    iteratedDeriv_two_affine_standardNormalCDF, Nat.factorial]
  ring_nf

/-- The standard-normal CDF admits a quadratic Taylor polynomial with a
uniform cubic remainder.  Parameterizing the displacement on `[0,1]` makes
the estimate valid for positive and negative `y` without separate endpoint
arguments. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder (a y : ℝ) :
    |cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y) -
        (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a +
          y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
          (y ^ 2 / 2) * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a))| ≤
      ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y * t)
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g :=
    contDiff_three_standardNormalCDF.comp (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨t, _ht, hrem⟩ :=
    taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv
      (f := g) (n := 2) (x₀ := 0) (x := 1) zero_lt_one hg.contDiffOn
  have hpoly := taylorWithinEval_two_affine_standardNormalCDF a y
  have hbound := abs_iteratedDeriv_three_affine_standardNormalCDF_le a y t
  have hdiv : |iteratedDeriv 3 g t| / 6 ≤
      ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 3) / 6 :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (by norm_num)
  calc
    |cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (a + y) -
        (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a +
          y * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a +
          (y ^ 2 / 2) * (-a * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 a))| =
        |g 1 - taylorWithinEval g 2 (Icc 0 1) 0 1| := by
      rw [hpoly]
      simp only [g, mul_one]
    _ = |iteratedDeriv 3 g t| / 6 := by
      rw [hrem]
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul]
      change |iteratedDeriv 3 g t| * |(1 : ℝ)| / |(6 : ℝ)| =
        |iteratedDeriv 3 g t| / 6
      simp
    _ ≤ ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) * |y| ^ 3) / 6 := hdiv
    _ = ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by ring

/-- The standard-normal CDF remainder transported through a positive scalar
pushforward. -/
theorem scaledStandardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a y : ℝ) :
    |cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y) -
        (cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) a +
          (y / σ) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ) +
          ((y / σ) ^ 2 / 2) *
            (-(a / σ) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ)))| ≤
      ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 6) * |y / σ| ^ 3 := by
  rw [cdf_map_mul NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hσ,
    cdf_map_mul NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hσ]
  convert standardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder (a / σ) (y / σ) using 1
  field_simp [hσ.ne']

/-- Canonical-polynomial form of the scaled standard-normal CDF remainder.
The cubic constant scales as the inverse cube of the smoothing standard
deviation. -/
theorem scaledStandardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder_canonical
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a y : ℝ) :
    |cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y) -
        (cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) a +
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ) / σ) * y +
          ((-(a / σ) * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (a / σ)) /
            (2 * σ ^ 2)) * y ^ 2)| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
  have h := scaledStandardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder hσ a y
  convert h using 1
  · field_simp [hσ.ne']
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hσ]
    field_simp [hσ.ne']

theorem standardNormalPDF_le (x : ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  change (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
      (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg x)) (by norm_num))
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)))

theorem abs_standardNormalPDF_deriv_le (x : ℝ) :
    |-x * ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x| ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  have hC : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
  have hxexp : |x| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 2 := by
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ 1
    · nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-(x ^ 2) / 2)]
    · have hxle : |x| ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
      calc
        |x| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤
            x ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxle (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ ≤ 2 := sq_mul_exp_neg_half_le_two x
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hC, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), abs_neg]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxexp hC]

/-- The standard-normal CDF has the sharp global density Lipschitz constant.
This is the target regularity term used by Esseen smoothing. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_le
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw b -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (b - a) := by
  open NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems in
  rw [cdf_eq_real, cdf_eq_real]
  have hsubset : Iic a ⊆ Iic b := Iic_subset_Iic.mpr hab
  rw [← measureReal_diff hsubset measurableSet_Iic]
  have hdiff : Iic b \ Iic a = Ioc a b := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_Iic, mem_Ioc, not_le]
    tauto
  rw [hdiff, standardNormalLaw, Measure.real_def,
    gaussianReal_apply_eq_integral 0 (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0) (Ioc a b)]
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (integral_nonneg fun x => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 x)]
  rw [standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  have hpdf : Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) volume := by
    rw [← standardNormalLaw_pdf]
    exact ProbabilityTheory.integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1
  calc
    (∫ x in Ioc a b,
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) ≤
        ∫ _x in Ioc a b, (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
      apply setIntegral_mono_on
        hpdf.integrableOn (integrableOn_const measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne) measurableSet_Ioc
      intro x _
      have hexp : Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x])
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)))
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (b - a) := by
      simp [MeasureTheory.integral_const, hab]
      ring

theorem standardNormalCDF_lipschitz (a b : ℝ) :
    |cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw b -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw a| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * |b - a| := by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr <|
      monotone_cdf
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hab),
      abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
    exact standardNormalCDF_sub_le hab
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr <|
      monotone_cdf
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hba),
      abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hba)]
    simpa only [neg_sub] using standardNormalCDF_sub_le hba

/-- Probability of a half-open interval as a CDF increment. -/
theorem measureReal_Ioc_eq_cdf_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    mu.real (Ioc a b) = cdf mu b - cdf mu a := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← ProbabilityTheory.measure_cdf mu]
  rw [Measure.real_def,
    StieltjesFunction.measure_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr (monotone_cdf mu hab)

/-- Every interval probability is bounded by its standard-normal length term
plus twice the Kolmogorov discrepancy. -/
theorem measureReal_Ioc_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    mu.real (Ioc a b) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (b - a) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance mu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let normal : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let D : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance mu normal
  have ha := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu normal a
  have hb := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu normal b
  have hnormal := standardNormalCDF_lipschitz a b
  rw [cdfGap] at ha hb
  have ha' : cdf normal a - cdf mu a ≤ D := by
    calc
      cdf normal a - cdf mu a ≤ |cdf normal a - cdf mu a| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |cdf mu a - cdf normal a| := abs_sub_comm _ _
      _ ≤ D := by simpa only [normal, D] using ha
  have hb' : cdf mu b - cdf normal b ≤ D := by
    calc
      cdf mu b - cdf normal b ≤ |cdf mu b - cdf normal b| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ D := by simpa only [normal, D] using hb
  have hnormal' : cdf normal b - cdf normal a ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (b - a) :=
    (le_abs_self _).trans (by
      simpa only [normal, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)] using hnormal)
  rw [measureReal_Ioc_eq_cdf_sub mu hab]
  dsimp only [normal, D] at ha' hb' hnormal' ⊢
  linarith

/-- Lévy concentration function, using half-open intervals of length `h`. -/
noncomputable def concentrationFunction (mu : Measure ℝ) (h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range fun x : ℝ => mu.real (Ioc x (x + h)))

theorem bddAbove_range_concentrationInterval
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (h : ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun x : ℝ => mu.real (Ioc x (x + h))) := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    mu.real (Ioc x (x + h)) ≤ mu.real Set.univ :=
      measureReal_mono (subset_univ _)
    _ = 1 := by simp

theorem measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (h x : ℝ) :
    mu.real (Ioc x (x + h)) ≤ concentrationFunction mu h := by
  apply le_csSup (bddAbove_range_concentrationInterval mu h)
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

/-- Interval mass under multiplication by a positive scalar, with the
endpoints divided by that scalar. -/
theorem measureReal_map_mul_Ioc
    (mu : Measure ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (x h : ℝ) :
    (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu).real (Ioc x (x + h)) =
      mu.real (Ioc (x / c) (x / c + h / c)) := by
  rw [map_measureReal_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Ioc]
  congr 1
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, mem_Ioc]
  rw [← add_div]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    constructor
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hc]
      simpa [mul_comm] using hy₁
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
      simpa [mul_comm] using hy₂
  · rintro ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    constructor
    · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hc] at hy₁
      simpa [mul_comm] using hy₁
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hc] at hy₂
      simpa [mul_comm] using hy₂

/-- Positive scaling transports the concentration function by dividing the
interval length by the scale.  The inequality direction is the one needed
for normalized partial sums. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_map_mul_le
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (h : ℝ) :
    concentrationFunction (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) h ≤
      concentrationFunction mu (h / c) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  change (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu).real (Ioc x (x + h)) ≤ _
  rw [measureReal_map_mul_Ioc mu hc]
  exact measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction mu (h / c) (x / c)

/-- The concentration function transforms exactly under a positive scalar
map. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_map_mul_eq
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (h : ℝ) :
    concentrationFunction (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) h =
      concentrationFunction mu (h / c) := by
  apply le_antisymm (concentrationFunction_map_mul_le mu hc h)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    mu.real (Ioc x (x + h / c)) =
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu).real
          (Ioc (c * x) (c * x + h)) := by
      rw [measureReal_map_mul_Ioc mu hc]
      simp [hc.ne']
    _ ≤ concentrationFunction (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) h :=
      measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => c * y) mu) h (c * x)

/-- The law of the first `N + 1` independent summands is the convolution of
the first `N`-summand law with the law of the last summand. -/
theorem map_sum_range_succ_eq_conv
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {mu : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) :
    Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu =
      Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, X i) mu ∗
        Measure.map (X N) mu := by
  have hi := hIndep.indepFun_sum_range_succ₀ hX N
  have hs : AEMeasurable (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, X i) mu := by
    fun_prop
  have hm := hi.map_add_eq_map_conv_map₀ hs (hX N)
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  exact hm

/-- The normalized centered iid law is the positive scalar pushforward of
the corresponding unnormalized range-sum law. -/
theorem map_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_map_mul_sum_range
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {mu : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu) (N : ℕ) :
    Measure.map
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu =
      Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu) := by
  have hs : AEMeasurable (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu := by
    fun_prop
  have hc : AEMeasurable
      (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
      (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu) := by
    fun_prop
  rw [hc.map_map_of_aemeasurable hs]
  congr 1
  funext ω
  simp only [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum,
    Function.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  simpa only [Finset.sum_apply] using
    (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => X i ω) (N + 1))

/-- Standard-normal comparison bound for the Lévy concentration function. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    concentrationFunction mu h ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * h +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance mu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using
    measureReal_Ioc_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov
      mu (show x ≤ x + h by linarith)

/-- Each fixed-displacement section of the Stein crossing set has mass at
most the concentration function at the exact displacement length. -/
theorem integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_section_le_concentrationFunction
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x scale v : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    (∫ w, (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v) ∂nu) ≤
      concentrationFunction nu (scale * |v|) := by
  by_cases hv0 : v = 0
  · subst v
    have h := measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction nu 0 x
    simpa [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet] using h
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hv0 with hv | hv
    · have hfun :
        (fun w => (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v)) =
        (Ioc x (x - scale * v)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
        funext w
        simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply,
          hv.le, not_le_of_gt hv]
      rw [hfun]
      have hint :
          (∫ w, (Ioc x (x - scale * v)).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w ∂nu) =
            nu.real (Ioc x (x - scale * v)) :=
        integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ioc
      rw [hint]
      have h := measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction nu
        (scale * (-v)) x
      simpa [abs_of_neg hv] using h
    · have hfun :
        (fun w => (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v)) =
        (Ioc (x - scale * v) x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
        funext w
        simp [standardNormalSteinCrossingSet, Set.indicator_apply,
          hv.le, not_le_of_gt hv]
      rw [hfun]
      have hint :
          (∫ w, (Ioc (x - scale * v) x).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) w ∂nu) =
            nu.real (Ioc (x - scale * v) x) :=
        integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ioc
      rw [hint]
      have h := measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction nu
        (scale * v) (x - scale * v)
      simpa [abs_of_pos hv] using h

/-- Independence turns the random Stein crossing event into fixed interval
sections.  Standard-normal comparison then bounds its expectation by the
scaled first absolute moment plus twice the leave-one-out Kolmogorov gap. -/
theorem integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_comp_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y X : Omega → ℝ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu) (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hIndep : IndepFun Y X mu)
    (hXfirst : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => |v|) (Measure.map X mu))
    (x scale : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    (∫ omega, (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Y omega, X omega) ∂mu) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ v, |v| ∂Measure.map X mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Y mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let nuY : Measure ℝ := Measure.map Y mu
  let nuX : Measure ℝ := Measure.map X mu
  let D : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance nuY
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
    (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
      (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.2, p.1)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuY := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuX := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  have hFmeas : Measurable F := by
    dsimp only [F]
    exact (measurable_const.indicator
      (measurableSet_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale)).comp measurable_swap
  have hFint : Integrable F (nuX.prod nuY) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    exact ae_of_all _ fun p => by
      dsimp only [F]
      by_cases hp : (p.2, p.1) ∈ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale <;>
        simp [hp]
  have heq := integral_comp_pair_eq_integral_integral_of_indepFun
    X Y hX hY hIndep.symm F hFint
  have hleft : Integrable (fun v => ∫ w, F (v, w) ∂nuY) nuX :=
    hFint.integral_prod_left
  have hscaled : Integrable
      (fun v : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (scale * |v|)) nuX :=
    hXfirst.const_mul scale |>.const_mul (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹
  have hmajor : Integrable
      (fun v : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (scale * |v|) + 2 * D) nuX :=
    hscaled.add (integrable_const (2 * D))
  change (∫ omega, F (X omega, Y omega) ∂mu) ≤ _
  rw [heq]
  calc
    (∫ v, ∫ w, F (v, w) ∂nuY ∂nuX) ≤
        ∫ v, ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (scale * |v|) + 2 * D) ∂nuX := by
      apply integral_mono hleft hmajor
      intro v
      exact (integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_section_le_concentrationFunction
        nuY x scale v hscale).trans
          (concentrationFunction_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov
            nuY (mul_nonneg hscale (abs_nonneg v)))
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ v, |v| ∂nuX) + 2 * D := by
      rw [integral_add hscaled (integrable_const _),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const,
        probReal_univ, one_smul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Weighted independent-pair crossing estimate.  The quadratic weight turns
the interval-length contribution into a third absolute moment and retains a
second-moment factor on the Kolmogorov term. -/
theorem integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_comp_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (Y X : Omega → ℝ) (hY : AEMeasurable Y mu) (hX : AEMeasurable X mu)
    (hIndep : IndepFun Y X mu)
    (hXsecond : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => v ^ 2) (Measure.map X mu))
    (hXthird : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => |v| ^ 3) (Measure.map X mu))
    (x scale : ℝ) (hscale : 0 ≤ scale) :
    (∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 *
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Y omega, X omega) ∂mu) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ v, |v| ^ 3 ∂Measure.map X mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Y mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
          (∫ v, v ^ 2 ∂Measure.map X mu) := by
  let nuY : Measure ℝ := Measure.map Y mu
  let nuX : Measure ℝ := Measure.map X mu
  let D : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance nuY
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => p.1 ^ 2 *
    (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
      (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.2, p.1)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuY := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hY
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuX := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hX
  have hFmeas : Measurable F := by
    dsimp only [F]
    exact (measurable_fst.pow_const 2).mul
      ((measurable_const.indicator
        (measurableSet_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale)).comp measurable_swap)
  have hFint : Integrable F (nuX.prod nuY) := by
    apply (hXsecond.comp_fst nuY).mono' hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact ae_of_all _ fun p => by
      dsimp only [F]
      by_cases hp : (p.2, p.1) ∈ standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale <;>
        simp [hp, sq_nonneg]
  have heq := integral_comp_pair_eq_integral_integral_of_indepFun
    X Y hX hY hIndep.symm F hFint
  have hleft : Integrable (fun v => ∫ w, F (v, w) ∂nuY) nuX :=
    hFint.integral_prod_left
  have hcubic : Integrable
      (fun v : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale) * |v| ^ 3) nuX :=
    hXthird.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale)
  have hquadratic : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => (2 * D) * v ^ 2) nuX :=
    hXsecond.const_mul (2 * D)
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun v : ℝ =>
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale) * |v| ^ 3 +
        (2 * D) * v ^ 2) nuX :=
    hcubic.add hquadratic
  change (∫ omega, F (X omega, Y omega) ∂mu) ≤ _
  rw [heq]
  calc
    (∫ v, ∫ w, F (v, w) ∂nuY ∂nuX) ≤
        ∫ v, (((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale) * |v| ^ 3 +
          (2 * D) * v ^ 2) ∂nuX := by
      apply integral_mono hleft hmajor
      intro v
      have hsection :=
        (integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_section_le_concentrationFunction
          nuY x scale v hscale).trans
          (concentrationFunction_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov
            nuY (mul_nonneg hscale (abs_nonneg v)))
      calc
        (∫ w, F (v, w) ∂nuY) =
            v ^ 2 * ∫ w,
              (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
                (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (w, v) ∂nuY := by
          dsimp only [F]
          rw [integral_const_mul]
        _ ≤ v ^ 2 *
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (scale * |v|) + 2 * D) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsection (sq_nonneg v)
        _ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale) * |v| ^ 3 +
            (2 * D) * v ^ 2 := by
          rw [← sq_abs v]
          ring
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ v, |v| ^ 3 ∂nuX) +
        2 * D * (∫ v, v ^ 2 ∂nuX) := by
      rw [integral_add hcubic hquadratic, integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul]
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Leave-one-out specialization of the weighted crossing estimate under the
third-moment hypothesis used by Berry--Esseen. -/
theorem integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_leaveOneOut_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
          (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
          (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) := by
  dsimp only
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX2 N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hbase2 : Integrable (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2) mu :=
    ((hX i.1).mono_exponent (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≤ 3)).integrable_sq
  have hbase3 : Integrable (fun omega => |X i.1 omega| ^ 3) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hX i.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hlaw2 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => v ^ 2)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) := by
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX i.1).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hbase2
  have hlaw3 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => |v| ^ 3)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) := by
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX i.1).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hbase3
  have h := integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_comp_le
    (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) (X i.1)
    hLeave.aemeasurable (hX i.1).aemeasurable hind.symm hlaw2 hlaw3 x
    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  rw [integral_map (hX i.1).aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => v ^ 2)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)] at h
  rw [integral_map (hX i.1).aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => |v| ^ 3)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using h

/-- Independence factors the continuous cubic part of the normalized
summand interval remainder. -/
theorem integral_leaveOneOut_cubicDriftMajorant_eq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) *
        (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) ∂mu) =
      (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) := by
  dsimp only
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX2 N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hfact := hind.integral_comp_mul_comp
    (hX i.1).aemeasurable hLeave.aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => |v| ^ 3)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ =>
        |w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu) by fun_prop)
  have hfact' :
      (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 *
        (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∂mu) =
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
          ∫ omega, |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.mul_apply] using hfact
  calc
    (∫ omega, (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) ∂mu) =
      ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2) *
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 *
          (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∂mu) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring
    _ = ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2) *
        ((∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
          ∫ omega, |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu) := by
      rw [hfact']
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Leave-one-out specialization of the integrated crossing estimate. -/
theorem integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_leaveOneOut_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    (∫ omega, (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  dsimp only
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hbase : Integrable (fun omega => |X i.1 omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((hX i.1).integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hlaw : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => |v|) (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) := by
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX i.1).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hbase
  have h := integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_comp_le
    (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) (X i.1)
    hLeave.aemeasurable (hX i.1).aemeasurable hind.symm hlaw x
    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  rw [integral_map (hX i.1).aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => |v|)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)] at h
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using h

/-- Independence factors the continuous part of the pointwise leave-one-out
derivative majorant. -/
theorem integral_leaveOneOut_driftMajorant_eq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|) ∂mu) =
      scale * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) := by
  dsimp only
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hfact := hind.integral_comp_mul_comp
    (hX i.1).aemeasurable hLeave.aemeasurable
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => |v|)
      (Measure.map (X i.1) mu) by fun_prop)
    (show AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ =>
        |w| + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu) by fun_prop)
  have hfact' :
      (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| *
        (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∂mu) =
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) *
          ∫ omega, |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.mul_apply] using hfact
  calc
    (∫ omega, (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * |X i.1 omega|) ∂mu) =
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| *
          (|normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∂mu) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring
    _ = (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        ((∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) *
          ∫ omega, |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
            Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu) := by
      rw [hfact']
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Integrated leave-one-out derivative increment.  The continuous term is
factored by independence and the atomic term is controlled by the
leave-one-out Kolmogorov distance. -/
theorem integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    (∫ omega, |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ∂mu) ≤
      scale * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  dsimp only
  let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
  let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  let scale : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hW :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hWiAbs : Integrable (fun omega => |Wi omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((hLeave.integrable (by norm_num)).norm)
  have hXiAbs : Integrable (fun omega => |X i.1 omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (((hX i.1).integrable (by norm_num)).norm)
  have hA : Integrable (fun omega => |Wi omega| + C) mu :=
    hWiAbs.add (integrable_const C)
  have hindAbs0 := hind.symm.comp
    (show Measurable (fun w : ℝ => |w| + C) by fun_prop)
    (show Measurable (fun v : ℝ => |v|) by fun_prop)
  have hindAbs : IndepFun (fun omega => |Wi omega| + C)
      (fun omega => |X i.1 omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi, Function.comp_apply] using hindAbs0
  have hprod : Integrable
      ((fun omega => |Wi omega| + C) * fun omega => |X i.1 omega|) mu :=
    hindAbs.integrable_mul hA hXiAbs
  have hDrift : Integrable (fun omega =>
      (|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|)) mu := by
    exact (hprod.const_mul scale).congr (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
      ring)
  have hCrossMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega =>
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) mu :=
    ((measurable_const.indicator
      (measurableSet_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale)).comp_aemeasurable
        (hLeave.aemeasurable.prodMk (hX i.1).aemeasurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hCross : Integrable (fun omega =>
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hCrossMeas 1
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      by_cases hp : (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∈
          standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale <;>
        simp [hp]
  have hLeft : Integrable (fun omega =>
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp W hW.aemeasurable x).sub
        (integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp Wi hLeave.aemeasurable x)).norm
  have hPoint : ∀ omega,
      |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ≤
        (|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) := by
    intro omega
    simpa only [W, Wi, scale, C] using
      abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le_crossingSet
        X N i x omega
  have hMono := integral_mono hLeft (hDrift.add hCross) hPoint
  have hDriftEq := integral_leaveOneOut_driftMajorant_eq X hX hIndep N i
  have hCrossLe := integral_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_leaveOneOut_le
    X hX hIndep N i x
  have hDriftEq' :
      (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|) ∂mu) =
        scale * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) := by
    simpa only [Wi, scale, C] using hDriftEq
  have hCrossLe' :
      (∫ omega, (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    simpa only [Wi, scale] using hCrossLe
  calc
    (∫ omega, |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ∂mu) ≤
      ∫ omega, ((|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|) +
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) ∂mu := hMono
    _ = (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) * (scale * |X i.1 omega|) ∂mu) +
        ∫ omega, (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu :=
      integral_add hDrift hCross
    _ ≤ scale * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
      rw [hDriftEq']
      exact add_le_add_right hCrossLe' _
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Integrability of both terms in one normalized-summand interval remainder.
This is the linearity side condition needed to collect the
variance-cancellation bracket into a finite sum. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_components
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    Integrable (fun omega => scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu ∧
    Integrable (fun omega =>
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)) mu := by
  dsimp only
  let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
  let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  let scale : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX2 N i
  have hW :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX2 N
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hXiSq : Integrable (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2) mu :=
    (hX2 i.1).integrable_sq
  have hDWi : Integrable
      (fun omega => standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi] using
      integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp Wi hLeave.aemeasurable x
  have hindA0 := hind.comp
    (show Measurable (fun v : ℝ => v ^ 2) by fun_prop)
    (measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x)
  have hindA : IndepFun (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2)
      (fun omega => standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi, Function.comp_apply] using hindA0
  have hA0 : Integrable (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu :=
    hindA.integrable_mul hXiSq hDWi
  have hA : Integrable (fun omega => scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
      standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu := by
    exact (hA0.const_mul (scale ^ 2)).congr
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring)
  have hXi : Integrable (X i.1) mu := (hX i.1).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hfW : AEMeasurable
      (fun omega => standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega)) mu :=
    (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      hW.aemeasurable
  have hfWi : AEMeasurable
      (fun omega => standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)) mu :=
    (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable.comp_aemeasurable
      hLeave.aemeasurable
  have hDiffMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega =>
      standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)) mu :=
    (hfW.sub hfWi).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hDiffBound : ∀ᵐ omega ∂mu,
      ‖standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)‖ ≤ 2 * C :=
    ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc
        |standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
            standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)| ≤
          |standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega)| +
            |standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) +
            standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x _),
            abs_of_nonneg (standardNormalSteinSolution_nonneg x _)]
        _ ≤ C + C := add_le_add
          (by simpa only [C] using standardNormalSteinSolution_le x (W omega))
          (by simpa only [C] using standardNormalSteinSolution_le x (Wi omega))
        _ = 2 * C := by ring
  have hB0 : Integrable (fun omega => X i.1 omega *
      (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega))) mu :=
    hXi.mul_bdd hDiffMeas hDiffBound
  have hB : Integrable (fun omega => scale * X i.1 omega *
      (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)) mu := by
    exact (hB0.const_mul scale).congr (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      have hInt := intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub
        x (Wi omega) (W omega)
      calc
        scale * (X i.1 omega *
            (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
              standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega))) =
          scale * X i.1 omega *
            (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
              standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)) := by ring
        _ = scale * X i.1 omega *
            (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) :=
          congrArg (fun q : ℝ => scale * X i.1 omega * q) hInt.symm)
  exact ⟨hA, hB⟩

/-- Integrability of one normalized-summand interval remainder. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    Integrable (fun omega =>
      scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)) mu := by
  have hComponents :=
    integrable_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_components
      X hX hIndep N i x
  exact hComponents.1.sub hComponents.2

/-- The integral of one normalized-summand remainder is exactly the
corresponding difference of the two terms in the variance-cancellation
bracket. -/
theorem integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_eq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    (∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu) =
      scale ^ 2 * (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) ∂mu) -
        scale * (∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu) := by
  dsimp only
  have hComponents :=
    integrable_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_components
      X hX hIndep N i x
  rw [integral_sub hComponents.1 hComponents.2]
  congr 1
  · rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring
  · rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring

/-- The complete second variance-cancellation bracket is the finite sum of
the one-summand interval remainders. -/
theorem varianceCancellation_secondBracket_eq_sum_integral_remainders
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
          (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
      scale * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu =
      ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) -
          scale * X i.1 omega *
            (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..W omega,
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu := by
  dsimp only
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_eq
    X hX hIndep N i x).symm

/-- Integrated second-bracket remainder for one normalized summand.  The
continuous contribution factors into a leave-one-out first moment and the
third absolute summand moment; the atomic contribution is controlled by the
weighted crossing estimate. -/
theorem integral_abs_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    (∫ omega, |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ∂mu) ≤
      (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        scale ^ 2 *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
              (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)) := by
  dsimp only
  let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
  let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  let scale : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
  let C : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hLeave := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX2 N i
  have hW :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX2 N
  have hind := indepFun_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut
    X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep N i
  have hWiAbs : Integrable (fun omega => |Wi omega|) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((hLeave.integrable (by norm_num)).norm)
  have hXiCube : Integrable (fun omega => |X i.1 omega| ^ 3) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hX i.1).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hXiSq : Integrable (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2) mu :=
    (hX2 i.1).integrable_sq
  have hA : Integrable (fun omega => |Wi omega| + C) mu :=
    hWiAbs.add (integrable_const C)
  have hindCube0 := hind.symm.comp
    (show Measurable (fun w : ℝ => |w| + C) by fun_prop)
    (show Measurable (fun v : ℝ => |v| ^ 3) by fun_prop)
  have hindCube : IndepFun (fun omega => |Wi omega| + C)
      (fun omega => |X i.1 omega| ^ 3) mu := by
    simpa only [Wi, Function.comp_apply] using hindCube0
  have hprod : Integrable
      ((fun omega => |Wi omega| + C) *
        fun omega => |X i.1 omega| ^ 3) mu :=
    hindCube.integrable_mul hA hXiCube
  have hDrift : Integrable (fun omega =>
      (|Wi omega| + C) *
        (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2)) mu := by
    exact (hprod.const_mul (scale ^ 3 / 2)).congr
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
        simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
        ring)
  have hIndicatorMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega =>
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) mu :=
    ((measurable_const.indicator
      (measurableSet_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale)).comp_aemeasurable
        (hLeave.aemeasurable.prodMk (hX i.1).aemeasurable)).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hCross0 : Integrable (fun omega => (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) mu := by
    apply hXiSq.mono'
      (((hX i.1).aemeasurable.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        hIndicatorMeas)
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      by_cases hp : (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∈
          standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale <;>
        simp [hp, sq_nonneg]
  have hCross : Integrable (fun omega => scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
      (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
        (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) mu := by
    exact (hCross0.const_mul (scale ^ 2)).congr
      (ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring)
  have hMajor := hDrift.add hCross
  have hPoint : ∀ omega,
      |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ≤
        (|Wi omega| + C) *
            (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) +
          scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
            (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
              (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
              (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) := by
    intro omega
    simpa only [W, Wi, scale, C] using
      abs_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le X N i x omega
  have hLeftMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun omega =>
      |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)|) mu := by
    simp_rw [intervalIntegral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_eq_sub]
    have hXiMeas : AEMeasurable (X i.1) mu := (hX i.1).aemeasurable
    have hDWi : AEMeasurable
        (fun omega => standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) mu :=
      (measurable_standardNormalSteinDerivative x).comp_aemeasurable
        hLeave.aemeasurable
    have hfW : AEMeasurable
        (fun omega => standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega)) mu :=
      (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable.comp_aemeasurable
        hW.aemeasurable
    have hfWi : AEMeasurable
        (fun omega => standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega)) mu :=
      (continuous_standardNormalSteinSolution x).measurable.comp_aemeasurable
        hLeave.aemeasurable
    have hInner : AEMeasurable (fun omega =>
        scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
          scale * X i.1 omega *
            (standardNormalSteinSolution x (W omega) -
              standardNormalSteinSolution x (Wi omega))) mu :=
      (((hXiMeas.pow_const 2).const_mul (scale ^ 2)).mul hDWi).sub
        ((hXiMeas.const_mul scale).mul (hfW.sub hfWi))
    exact (continuous_abs.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hInner).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hLeft : Integrable (fun omega =>
      |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)|) mu := by
    apply hMajor.mono' hLeftMeas
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)]
      exact hPoint omega
  have hMono := integral_mono hLeft hMajor hPoint
  have hDriftEq := integral_leaveOneOut_cubicDriftMajorant_eq
    X hX hIndep N i
  have hCrossLe :=
    integral_sq_mul_standardNormalSteinCrossingSet_leaveOneOut_le
      X hX hIndep N i x
  have hDriftEq' :
      (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) *
        (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) ∂mu) =
        (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) := by
    simpa only [Wi, scale, C] using hDriftEq
  have hCrossLe' :
      (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
          (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
            (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) := by
    simpa only [Wi, scale] using hCrossLe
  have hCrossScaledLe :
      (∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
          (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) ≤
        scale ^ 2 *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
              (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)) := by
    calc
      (∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
        (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
          (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
          (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu) =
        scale ^ 2 * ∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
            (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu := by
          rw [← integral_const_mul]
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCrossLe' (sq_nonneg scale)
  calc
    (∫ omega, |scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z)| ∂mu) ≤
      ∫ omega, ((|Wi omega| + C) *
          (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) +
        scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
            (Wi omega, X i.1 omega)) ∂mu := hMono
    _ = (∫ omega, (|Wi omega| + C) *
          (scale ^ 3 * |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 / 2) ∂mu) +
        ∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          (standardNormalSteinCrossingSet x scale).indicator
            (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
            (Wi omega, X i.1 omega) ∂mu :=
      integral_add hDrift hCross
    _ ≤ (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        scale ^ 2 *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
              (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)) :=
      add_le_add hDriftEq'.le hCrossScaledLe

/-- Expectation form of the one-summand second-bracket estimate. -/
theorem abs_integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| ≤
      (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        scale ^ 2 *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw *
              (∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact abs_integral_le_integral_abs.trans
    (integral_abs_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le
      X hX hIndep N i x)

/-- Unit-variance specialization of the one-summand second-bracket estimate. -/
theorem abs_integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le_unitSecond
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |∫ omega, scale ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) -
        scale * X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in Wi omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| ≤
      (scale ^ 3 / 2) * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        scale ^ 2 *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  have h := abs_integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le
    X hX hIndep N i x
  simpa only [hSecond i.1, mul_one] using h

/-- The entire unit-variance second variance-cancellation bracket is bounded
by the sum of the explicit one-summand remainder estimates. -/
theorem abs_varianceCancellation_secondBracket_le_sum_unitSecond
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
          (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
      scale * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        X i.1 omega *
          (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..W omega,
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| ≤
      ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
        (scale ^ 3 / 2) *
            (∫ omega,
              |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| + C ∂mu) *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          scale ^ 2 *
            ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
                (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
              2 * kolmogorovDistance
                (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) := by
  dsimp only
  calc
    |(Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
            (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 * standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
            X i.1 omega *
              (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N omega,
                standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| =
      |∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega *
            (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                  X N omega,
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| :=
        congrArg abs
          (varianceCancellation_secondBracket_eq_sum_integral_remainders
            X hX hIndep N x)
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
        |∫ omega,
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x
                (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) -
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * X i.1 omega *
              (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N omega,
                standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact abs_integral_normalizedSummand_steinIntervalRemainder_le_unitSecond
        X hX hIndep hSecond N i x

/-- The first variance-cancellation bracket is the normalized average of the
leave-one-out derivative-expectation differences. -/
theorem varianceCancellation_firstBracket_eq_scaled_sum_differences
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega}
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu =
      scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
        ((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
          ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) := by
  dsimp only
  have hsqrtPos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hscale : (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N + 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [inv_pow]
    field_simp [hsqrtPos.ne']
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N + 1)).symm
  symm
  calc
    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          ((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X N omega) ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) =
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ((N + 1 : ℝ) *
            (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X N omega) ∂mu) -
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        simp
    _ = (∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
              X N omega) ∂mu) -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu := by
      rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hscale, one_mul]

/-- Expectation form of the integrated leave-one-out derivative estimate. -/
theorem abs_integral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) ∂mu| ≤
      scale * (∫ omega, |Wi omega| + C ∂mu) *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
          (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance (Measure.map Wi mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  dsimp only
  let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  let Wi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i
  have hW :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  have hWi := normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_memLp X hX N i
  have hDW := integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp W hW.aemeasurable x
  have hDWi := integrable_standardNormalSteinDerivative_comp Wi hWi.aemeasurable x
  have hAbs := integral_abs_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le
    X hX hIndep N i x
  dsimp only at hAbs
  calc
    |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega) ∂mu| =
      |∫ omega, (standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)) ∂mu| := by
      rw [integral_sub hDW hDWi]
    _ ≤ ∫ omega, |standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
        standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega)| ∂mu := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun omega =>
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) -
            standardNormalSteinDerivative x (Wi omega))
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [W, Wi] using hAbs

/-- The complete first variance-cancellation bracket is bounded by the
normalized sum of its explicit leave-one-out derivative estimates. -/
theorem abs_varianceCancellation_firstBracket_le_sum
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x (W omega) ∂mu) -
        scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), ∫ omega,
          standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu| ≤
      scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
        scale *
            (∫ omega,
              |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| + C ∂mu) *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          2 * kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  dsimp only
  have hEq := varianceCancellation_firstBracket_eq_scaled_sum_differences
    (mu := mu) X N x
  dsimp only at hEq
  calc
    |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X N omega) ∂mu) -
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu| =
      |(Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          ((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
