              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X N omega) ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu)| :=
        congrArg abs hEq
    _ = (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        |∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          ((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X N omega) ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu)| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X N omega) ∂mu) -
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
        (sq_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact abs_integral_standardNormalSteinDerivative_sum_sub_leaveOneOut_le
        X hX hIndep N i x

/-- Pointwise standard-normal CDF error obtained by combining both complete
variance-cancellation bracket estimates. -/
theorem abs_cdf_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormal_le_steinSums
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
      (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    |cdf (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw W
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX2 N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
        scale *
            (∫ omega,
              |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| + C ∂mu) *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          2 * kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) +
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
          (scale ^ 3 / 2) *
              (∫ omega,
                |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| + C ∂mu) *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            scale ^ 2 *
              ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * scale *
                  (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
                2 * kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) := by
  dsimp only
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hIdentity :=
    integral_normalizedCenteredIidSum_stein_varianceCancellation
      X hX2 hIndep hMean hSecond N x
  have hFirst := abs_varianceCancellation_firstBracket_le_sum
    X hX2 hIndep N x
  have hSecondBound :=
    abs_varianceCancellation_secondBracket_le_sum_unitSecond
      X hX hIndep hSecond N x
  dsimp only at hIdentity hFirst hSecondBound
  calc
    |cdf (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX2 N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| =
      |((∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
              X N omega) ∂mu) -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu) +
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x
                (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
              (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N omega,
                standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu)| :=
        congrArg abs hIdentity.symm
    _ ≤
      |(∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
              X N omega) ∂mu) -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, standardNormalSteinDerivative x
              (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu| +
        |(Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, (X i.1 omega) ^ 2 *
              standardNormalSteinDerivative x
                (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega) ∂mu -
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            ∫ omega, X i.1 omega *
              (∫ z in normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega..
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N omega,
                standardNormalSteinDerivative x z) ∂mu| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hFirst hSecondBound

/-- Under the iid unit-variance hypotheses, the two explicit Stein sums
collapse to one deterministic `1 / sqrt (N + 1)` term and a recursive sum of
leave-one-out Kolmogorov distances.  The coefficient `4` records the two
distance contributions from each variance-cancellation bracket. -/
theorem abs_cdf_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormal_le_collapsedStein
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X j) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
      (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    let rho := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
    |cdf (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw W
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX2 N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      scale *
          ((1 + C) + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ +
            rho * ((1 + C) / 2 + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹)) +
        4 * scale ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  dsimp only
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hBase :=
    abs_cdf_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormal_le_steinSums
      X hX hIndep hMean hSecond N x
  dsimp only at hBase
  refine hBase.trans ?_
  have hscale : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hnormal : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hscaleSq :
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N + 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [inv_pow]
    field_simp [show Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity]
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N + 1)).symm
  calc
    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (∫ omega,
              |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
                Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu) *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
              (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) +
          2 * kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) +
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2) *
              (∫ omega,
                |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
                  Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu) *
              (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
              ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
                    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
                  (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
                2 * kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ +
          2 * kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) +
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2) *
              (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
              ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
                    (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
                  (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
                2 * kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hXi := integral_abs_le_one_of_secondMoment_eq_one
          (hX2 i.1) (hSecond i.1)
        have hWi :=
          integral_abs_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_add_const_le
            X hX2 hIndep hMean hSecond N i
              (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))
        have hXiNonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu :=
          integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _
        have hCNonneg :
            0 ≤ 1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          positivity
        apply add_le_add
        · apply add_le_add
          · calc
              (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
                    (∫ omega,
                      |normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i omega| +
                        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∂mu) *
                    (∫ omega, |X i.1 omega| ∂mu) ≤
                  (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
                    (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * 1 := by
                      rw [mul_one, mul_assoc]
                      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hscale
                      simpa using mul_le_mul hWi hXi hXiNonneg hCNonneg
              _ = _ := by ring
          · simpa using
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXi (mul_nonneg hnormal hscale)
        · rfl
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hWi :=
          integral_abs_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_add_const_le
            X hX2 hIndep hMean hSecond N i
              (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))
        have hXi3 := integral_abs_cube_eq_of_identDistrib (hIdent i.1)
        rw [hXi3]
        apply add_le_add
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWi (by positivity)) hrho
        · rfl
    _ = (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N + 1 : ℝ) *
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            ((1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) +
              (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ +
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
                ((1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2 +
                  (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹))) +
        4 * (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
            kolmogorovDistance
              (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin,
        nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hscaleSq, one_mul]

/-- Substituting the exact leave-one-out law transport into the collapsed
Stein estimate yields an explicit recurrence.  Its inherited-error
coefficient is exactly `4`. -/
theorem abs_cdf_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormal_le_steinRecurrence
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ j, IdentDistrib (X j) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∀ j, ∫ omega, X j omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∀ j, ∫ omega, (X j omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (x : ℝ) :
    let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
      (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
    let W := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let scale := (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹
    let C := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    let rho := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
    let previousLaw := Measure.map
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
        X (N - 1)) mu
    let contractedNormal := Measure.map
      (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    |cdf (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw W
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX2 N).aemeasurable) x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      scale *
          ((1 + C) + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ +
            rho * ((1 + C) / 2 + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹)) +
        4 * (kolmogorovDistance previousLaw
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
            kolmogorovDistance contractedNormal
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  dsimp only
  let hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 mu := fun j =>
    (hX j).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  have hBase :=
    abs_cdf_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormal_le_collapsedStein
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N x
  dsimp only at hBase
  refine hBase.trans ?_
  refine add_le_add le_rfl ?_
  have hEach : ∀ i : Fin (N + 1),
      kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
        kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X (N - 1)) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
          kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map
              (fun y : ℝ =>
                Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    intro i
    exact
      kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut_le_prefix_add_scalingDefect
        X (fun j => (hX j).aemeasurable) hIndep hIdent hN i
  have hSum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hEach i)
  have hscaleSq :
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (N + 1 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [inv_pow]
    field_simp [show Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity]
    exact (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N + 1)).symm
  calc
    4 * (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin (N + 1),
          kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map (normalizedCenteredIidLeaveOneOut X N i) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      4 * (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        ∑ _i : Fin (N + 1),
          (kolmogorovDistance
              (Measure.map
                (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                  X (N - 1)) mu)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
            kolmogorovDistance
              (Measure.map
                (fun y : ℝ =>
                  Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSum (by positivity)
    _ = 4 *
        (kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                X (N - 1)) mu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
          kolmogorovDistance
            (Measure.map
              (fun y : ℝ =>
                Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      calc
        4 * (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ((N + 1 : ℝ) *
              (kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map
                    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                      X (N - 1)) mu)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
                kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map
                    (fun y : ℝ =>
                      Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) =
            4 * ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
              (N + 1 : ℝ)) *
              (kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map
                    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                      X (N - 1)) mu)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
                kolmogorovDistance
                  (Measure.map
                    (fun y : ℝ =>
                      Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * y)
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hscaleSq, mul_one]

/-- The exact inherited-error coefficient exposed by the completed Stein
recurrence is noncontractive. -/
theorem one_lt_steinRecurrenceInheritedCoefficient : (1 : ℝ) < 4 := by
  norm_num

/-- Even the coefficient multiplying the standardized third moment in the
deterministic part of the collapsed Stein majorant exceeds one. -/
theorem one_lt_collapsedSteinRhoCoefficient :
    (1 : ℝ) <
      (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2 +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  have harg : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using
      Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) harg
  have hexp : (1 : ℝ) < Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hC : (1 : ℝ) <
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    one_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hsqrt hexp.le
  have hinv : (0 : ℝ) < (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by positivity
  nlinarith

/-- Consequently, for every standardized third moment `rho ≥ 1`, the
deterministic coefficient in the completed Stein estimate already lies
strictly above the source budget `rho`, before either recursive distance term
is added. -/
theorem rho_lt_collapsedSteinDeterministicMajorant
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 1 ≤ rho) :
    rho <
      (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ +
        rho * ((1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2 +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) := by
  have hrhoPos : 0 < rho := zero_lt_one.trans_le hrho
  have hCoeff := one_lt_collapsedSteinRhoCoefficient
  have hmul : 0 < rho *
      (((1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) / 2 +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) - 1) :=
    mul_pos hrhoPos (sub_pos.mpr hCoeff)
  have hadd : 0 <
      (1 + Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by positivity
  nlinarith

/-- A shifted CDF sandwich converts to an ordinary pointwise CDF bound when
the comparison law has a Lipschitz CDF.  This is the order-theoretic step in
Esseen smoothing: the later Fourier argument only has to produce the two
shifted inequalities. -/
theorem cdfBound_of_shift_bounds
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) {L δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hν : ∀ a b,
      |cdf ν b - cdf ν a| ≤ L * |b - a|)
    (hlower : ∀ x, cdf ν (x - δ) - ε ≤ cdf μ x)
    (hupper : ∀ x, cdf μ x ≤ cdf ν (x + δ) + ε) :
    CDFBound μ ν (ε + L * δ) := by
  intro x
  rw [cdfGap, abs_le]
  have hleft := hν (x - δ) x
  have hright := hν x (x + δ)
  have hleft' : cdf ν x - cdf ν (x - δ) ≤ L * δ := by
    calc
      cdf ν x - cdf ν (x - δ) ≤
          |cdf ν x - cdf ν (x - δ)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ L * |x - (x - δ)| := hleft
      _ = L * δ := by
        rw [show x - (x - δ) = δ by ring, abs_of_nonneg hδ]
  have hright' : cdf ν (x + δ) - cdf ν x ≤ L * δ := by
    calc
      cdf ν (x + δ) - cdf ν x ≤
          |cdf ν (x + δ) - cdf ν x| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ L * |(x + δ) - x| := hright
      _ = L * δ := by
        rw [show (x + δ) - x = δ by ring, abs_of_nonneg hδ]
  constructor
  · linarith [hlower x]
  · linarith [hupper x]

/-- The shifted-sandwich reduction specialized to the standard-normal target.
It isolates the remaining Fourier-analytic part of the Berry--Esseen proof
from the already certified Gaussian-density regularity. -/
theorem standardNormalCDFBound_of_shift_bounds
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlower : ∀ x,
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (x - δ) - ε ≤
        cdf μ x)
    (hupper : ∀ x,
      cdf μ x ≤
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (x + δ) + ε) :
    CDFBound μ NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      (ε + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * δ) :=
  cdfBound_of_shift_bounds μ
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hδ
    standardNormalCDF_lipschitz hlower hupper

/-- Supremum-form consequence of `standardNormalCDFBound_of_shift_bounds`. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_of_shift_bounds
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hlower : ∀ x,
      cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (x - δ) - ε ≤
        cdf μ x)
    (hupper : ∀ x,
      cdf μ x ≤
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (x + δ) + ε) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ε + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * δ :=
  (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff _ _ _).2 <|
    standardNormalCDFBound_of_shift_bounds μ hδ hlower hupper

/-- A function `H` is a `δ`-smoothing of the CDF of `μ` when its value at
`x` lies between the CDF values at the two endpoints of the `δ`-window about
`x`.  Compactly supported convolution kernels will supply this property. -/
def CDFSmoothingApproximation
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (H : ℝ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, cdf μ (x - δ) ≤ H x ∧ H x ≤ cdf μ (x + δ)

/-- Average the translates of a CDF against a smoothing measure. -/
noncomputable def smoothedCDF
    (μ κ : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y, cdf μ (x - y) ∂κ

/-- A measure is supported in the closed smoothing window `[-δ, δ]`, stated
in the almost-everywhere form used directly by integration. -/
def IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow (κ : Measure ℝ) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ᵐ y ∂κ, y ∈ Icc (-δ) δ

/-- The normalized Lebesgue probability measure on `[-δ, δ]`.  It is used
as a concrete compact smoothing kernel when `δ > 0`. -/
noncomputable def uniformSmoothingKernel (δ : ℝ) : Measure ℝ :=
  (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * δ))⁻¹ • volume.restrict (Icc (-δ) δ)

theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) := by
  constructor
  rw [uniformSmoothingKernel, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply
    MeasurableSet.univ, univ_inter, Real.volume_Icc]
  have htwo : 0 < 2 * δ := mul_pos (by norm_num) hδ
  rw [show δ - -δ = 2 * δ by ring, smul_eq_mul,
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel]
  · exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr htwo).ne'
  · exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_supported
    (δ : ℝ) :
    IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) δ := by
  unfold IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow uniformSmoothingKernel
  exact Measure.ae_smul_measure
    (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc) _

/-- The characteristic function of the normalized uniform kernel is `sinc`.
This is the explicit Fourier multiplier used by the smoothing construction. -/
theorem charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) t =
      Real.sinc (t * δ) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real, uniformSmoothingKernel,
    integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_inv]
  have htwo : 0 < 2 * δ := mul_pos (by norm_num) hδ
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal htwo.le]
  have hscale :
      (∫ x in -δ..δ,
          Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        t⁻¹ •
          ∫ u in -(t * δ)..t * δ, Complex.exp (u * Complex.I) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_neg] using
      (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left
        (f := fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp ((u : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        (a := -δ) (b := δ) ht)
  have hset :
      (∫ x in Icc (-δ) δ,
          Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        ∫ x in -δ..δ, Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (neg_le_self hδ.le)]
  rw [hset, hscale, integral_exp_mul_I_eq_sinc]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
  change (((2 * δ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (2 * (((t * δ : ℝ) : ℂ)) * ((Real.sinc (t * δ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
    ((Real.sinc (t * δ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  norm_cast
  field_simp

theorem abs_sinc_le_inv_abs {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    |Real.sinc x| ≤ |x|⁻¹ := by
  rw [Real.sinc_of_ne_zero hx, abs_div]
  simpa only [one_div] using
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.abs_sin_le_one x) (abs_nonneg x)

/-- A CDF composed with a measurable real function is integrable against
every finite measure, by the universal bound `0 ≤ cdf ≤ 1`. -/
theorem integrable_cdf_comp
    (mu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure kappa]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Integrable (fun y => cdf mu (f y)) kappa := by
  refine Integrable.of_bound
    (((monotone_cdf mu).measurable.comp hf).aestronglyMeasurable) 1 ?_
  exact ae_of_all kappa fun y => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg mu (f y))]
    exact cdf_le_one mu (f y)

theorem integrable_cdf_translate
    (μ κ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure κ] (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => cdf μ (x - y)) κ := by
  refine Integrable.of_bound
    (((monotone_cdf μ).measurable.comp
      (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable) 1 ?_
  exact ae_of_all κ fun y => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg μ (x - y))]
    exact cdf_le_one μ (x - y)

/-- Averaging an upper signed CDF error against a probability law costs no
constant: the integral is bounded by the same one-sided supremum. -/
theorem integral_cdfUpperError_comp_le
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫ y, cdfUpperError mu nu (f y) ∂kappa) ≤
      upperCDFDistance mu nu := by
  have hmu := integrable_cdf_comp mu kappa hf
  have hnu := integrable_cdf_comp nu kappa hf
  calc
    (∫ y, cdfUpperError mu nu (f y) ∂kappa) ≤
        ∫ _y, upperCDFDistance mu nu ∂kappa := by
      apply integral_mono (hmu.sub hnu) (integrable_const _)
      intro y
      exact cdfUpperError_le_upperCDFDistance mu nu (f y)
    _ = upperCDFDistance mu nu := by simp

/-- Lower signed-error companion to `integral_cdfUpperError_comp_le`. -/
theorem integral_cdfLowerError_comp_le
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫ y, cdfLowerError mu nu (f y) ∂kappa) ≤
      lowerCDFDistance mu nu := by
  have hmu := integrable_cdf_comp mu kappa hf
  have hnu := integrable_cdf_comp nu kappa hf
  calc
    (∫ y, cdfLowerError mu nu (f y) ∂kappa) ≤
        ∫ _y, lowerCDFDistance mu nu ∂kappa := by
      apply integral_mono (hnu.sub hmu) (integrable_const _)
      intro y
      exact cdfLowerError_le_lowerCDFDistance mu nu (f y)
    _ = lowerCDFDistance mu nu := by simp

/-- Averaging against a probability measure supported in `[-δ, δ]` gives
the promised CDF smoothing approximation.  This supplies the compact-support
half of the smoothing method independently of any Fourier representation. -/
theorem smoothedCDF_isSmoothingApproximation
    (μ κ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure κ] {δ : ℝ}
    (hκ : IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow κ δ) :
    CDFSmoothingApproximation μ (smoothedCDF μ κ) δ := by
  intro x
  have hInt : Integrable (fun y => cdf μ (x - y)) κ :=
    integrable_cdf_translate μ κ x
  constructor
  · rw [smoothedCDF]
    calc
      cdf μ (x - δ) = ∫ _ : ℝ, cdf μ (x - δ) ∂κ := by simp
      _ ≤ ∫ y, cdf μ (x - y) ∂κ :=
        integral_mono_ae (integrable_const _) hInt <|
          hκ.mono fun y hy =>
            monotone_cdf μ (by linarith [hy.2])
  · rw [smoothedCDF]
    calc
      (∫ y, cdf μ (x - y) ∂κ) ≤
          ∫ _ : ℝ, cdf μ (x + δ) ∂κ :=
        integral_mono_ae hInt (integrable_const _) <|
          hκ.mono fun y hy =>
            monotone_cdf μ (by linarith [hy.1])
      _ = cdf μ (x + δ) := by simp

/-- The concrete normalized-uniform kernel realizes the abstract smoothing
interface at every positive window radius. -/
theorem uniformSmoothedCDF_isSmoothingApproximation
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    CDFSmoothingApproximation μ
      (smoothedCDF μ (uniformSmoothingKernel δ)) δ := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  exact smoothedCDF_isSmoothingApproximation μ
    (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) (uniformSmoothingKernel_supported δ)

/-- Averaging CDF translates is exactly the CDF of convolution by the
smoothing measure.  This bridge exposes `MeasureTheory.charFun_conv` to the
remaining Fourier comparison. -/
theorem smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv
    (μ κ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure κ]
    (x : ℝ) :
    smoothedCDF μ κ x = cdf (κ ∗ μ) x := by
  have hInt : Integrable
      ((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) (κ ∗ μ) :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  rw [smoothedCDF]
  calc
    (∫ y, cdf μ (x - y) ∂κ) =
        ∫ y, ∫ z, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (y + z) ∂μ ∂κ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all κ fun y => by
        change cdf μ (x - y) = _
        rw [cdf_eq_real]
        calc
          μ.real (Iic (x - y)) =
              ∫ z, (Iic (x - y)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z ∂μ :=
            (integral_indicator_one (s := Iic (x - y)) measurableSet_Iic).symm
          _ = ∫ z, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (y + z) ∂μ := by
            apply integral_congr_ae
            exact ae_of_all μ fun z => by
              simp only [Set.indicator_apply, mem_Iic]
              by_cases hz : z ≤ x - y
              · have hyz : y + z ≤ x := by linarith
                simp [hz, hyz]
              · have hyz : ¬ y + z ≤ x := by intro h; apply hz; linarith
                simp [hz, hyz]
    _ = ∫ z, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z ∂(κ ∗ μ) :=
      (integral_conv hInt).symm
    _ = cdf (κ ∗ μ) x := by
      calc
        (∫ z, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) z ∂(κ ∗ μ)) =
            (κ ∗ μ).real (Iic x) :=
          integral_indicator_one (s := Iic x) measurableSet_Iic
        _ = cdf (κ ∗ μ) x := (cdf_eq_real (κ ∗ μ) x).symm

/-- Convolution by an arbitrary probability law preserves the global
Lipschitz constant of the standard-normal CDF. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_lipschitz_conv
    (kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] (u v : ℝ) :
    |cdf (kappa ∗
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) u -
        cdf (kappa ∗
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) v| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * |u - v| := by
  rw [← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa u,
    ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa v]
  unfold smoothedCDF
  rw [← integral_sub
    (integrable_cdf_translate
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa u)
    (integrable_cdf_translate
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa v)]
  calc
    |∫ y, (cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (u - y) -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (v - y)) ∂kappa| ≤
        ∫ y, |cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (u - y) -
          cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (v - y)| ∂kappa :=
      abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ _y : ℝ, (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * |u - v| ∂kappa := by
      apply integral_mono
      · exact (integrable_cdf_translate
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa u).sub
          (integrable_cdf_translate
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa v) |>.abs
      · exact integrable_const _
      · intro y
        simpa only [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] using
          standardNormalCDF_lipschitz (v - y) (u - y)
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * |u - v| := by simp

/-- Convolution by an arbitrary probability law preserves the uniform
quadratic remainder of a positive Gaussian-smoothed CDF section.  The three
polynomial coefficients are obtained by averaging their pointwise Gaussian
counterparts. -/
theorem exists_quadratic_remainder_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal
    (kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ,
      |cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y) -
          (a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2)| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let c0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => cdf gamma (a - z)
  let c1 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a - z) / σ) / σ
  let c2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
    (-((a - z) / σ) *
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a - z) / σ)) / (2 * σ ^ 2)
  have hc0 : Integrable c0 kappa := by
    simpa only [c0] using integrable_cdf_translate gamma kappa a
  have hc1 : Integrable c1 kappa := by
    have harg : Measurable (fun z : ℝ => (a - z) / σ) := by fun_prop
    have hmeas := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).comp harg
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by
      simpa only [c1] using (hmeas.div_const σ).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ / σ) ?_
    exact ae_of_all kappa fun z => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos hσ,
        abs_of_nonneg (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 _)]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (standardNormalPDF_le _) hσ.le
  have hc2 : Integrable c2 kappa := by
    have harg : Measurable (fun z : ℝ => (a - z) / σ) := by fun_prop
    have hpdf := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).comp harg
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by
      simpa only [c2] using
        ((harg.neg.mul hpdf).div_const (2 * σ ^ 2)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / |2 * σ ^ 2|) ?_
    exact ae_of_all kappa fun z => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (abs_standardNormalPDF_deriv_le _) (abs_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨∫ z, c0 z ∂kappa, ∫ z, c1 z ∂kappa, ∫ z, c2 z ∂kappa, ?_⟩
  intro y
  have hf : Integrable (fun z => cdf gamma (a + y - z)) kappa :=
    integrable_cdf_translate gamma kappa (a + y)
  have hc1y : Integrable (fun z => c1 z * y) kappa := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hc1.const_mul y
  have hc2y : Integrable (fun z => c2 z * y ^ 2) kappa := by
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hc2.const_mul (y ^ 2)
  have hp : Integrable (fun z => c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2) kappa :=
    (hc0.add hc1y).add hc2y
  have hpoint : ∀ z,
      |cdf gamma (a + y - z) - (c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2)| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
    intro z
    simpa only [gamma, c0, c1, c2] using
      (show |cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y - z) -
          (cdf (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a - z) +
            (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a - z) / σ) / σ) * y +
            ((-((a - z) / σ) *
                ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((a - z) / σ)) /
              (2 * σ ^ 2)) * y ^ 2)| ≤
            (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 by
        convert scaledStandardNormalCDF_quadratic_remainder_canonical hσ (a - z) y using 1
        ring)
  rw [← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv gamma kappa (a + y)]
  unfold smoothedCDF
  have hpoly :
      (∫ z, c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2 ∂kappa) =
        (∫ z, c0 z ∂kappa) + (∫ z, c1 z ∂kappa) * y +
          (∫ z, c2 z ∂kappa) * y ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (∫ z, c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2 ∂kappa) =
          (∫ z, c0 z + c1 z * y ∂kappa) +
            ∫ z, c2 z * y ^ 2 ∂kappa :=
        integral_add (hc0.add hc1y) hc2y
      _ = ((∫ z, c0 z ∂kappa) + ∫ z, c1 z * y ∂kappa) +
          ∫ z, c2 z * y ^ 2 ∂kappa := by
        rw [integral_add hc0 hc1y]
      _ = _ := by rw [integral_mul_const, integral_mul_const]
  rw [← hpoly, ← integral_sub hf hp]
  calc
    |∫ z, cdf gamma (a + y - z) -
        (c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2) ∂kappa| ≤
        ∫ z, |cdf gamma (a + y - z) -
          (c0 z + c1 z * y + c2 z * y ^ 2)| ∂kappa :=
      abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ _z : ℝ,
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 ∂kappa := by
      apply integral_mono (hf.sub hp).abs (integrable_const _)
      exact hpoint
    _ = (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
      simp

/-- Gaussian smoothing makes the one-summand replacement section smooth
enough for exact first/second-moment cancellation. -/
theorem abs_integral_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal_sub_standardNormal_le
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a : ℝ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    |(∫ y, cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a + y)
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) *
        ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => cdf (kappa ∗ gamma) (a + y)
  have hfmu : Integrable f mu := by
    exact integrable_cdf_comp (kappa ∗ gamma) mu
      (f := fun y : ℝ => a + y) (by fun_prop)
  have hfGaussian : Integrable f
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    exact integrable_cdf_comp (kappa ∗ gamma)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      (f := fun y : ℝ => a + y) (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2, hrem⟩ :=
    exists_quadratic_remainder_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal kappa hσ a
  simpa only [gamma, f] using
    abs_integral_sub_standardNormal_le_of_quadratic_remainder
      mu f hfmu hfGaussian hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
      a0 a1 a2 ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) hrem

/-- Subtraction-oriented form of the convolved Gaussian Taylor remainder,
matching the `x - y` convention in convolution CDF formulas. -/
theorem exists_quadratic_remainder_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal_sub
    (kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 : ℝ, ∀ y : ℝ,
      |cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a - y) -
          (a0 + a1 * y + a2 * y ^ 2)| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) * |y| ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2, hrem⟩ :=
    exists_quadratic_remainder_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal kappa hσ a
  refine ⟨a0, -a1, a2, fun y => ?_⟩
  convert hrem (-y) using 1 <;> simp only [abs_neg, neg_sq]; ring

theorem abs_integral_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal_sub_standardNormal_le_sub
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (a : ℝ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    |(∫ y, cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a - y) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, cdf (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) (a - y)
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) *
        ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => cdf (kappa ∗ gamma) (a - y)
  have hfmu : Integrable f mu := by
    exact integrable_cdf_comp (kappa ∗ gamma) mu
      (f := fun y : ℝ => a - y) (by fun_prop)
  have hfGaussian : Integrable f
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    exact integrable_cdf_comp (kappa ∗ gamma)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      (f := fun y : ℝ => a - y) (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2, hrem⟩ :=
    exists_quadratic_remainder_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal_sub kappa hσ a
  simpa only [gamma, f] using
    abs_integral_sub_standardNormal_le_of_quadratic_remainder
      mu f hfmu hfGaussian hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
      a0 a1 a2 ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) hrem

/-- Pointwise signed one-summand replacement after a common arbitrary-law
and positive-Gaussian smoothing factor. -/
theorem abs_cdfUpperError_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_le
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (x : ℝ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    |cdfUpperError
        (mu ∗ (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗
          (kappa ∗ Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6) *
        ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have h := abs_integral_cdf_conv_scaledStandardNormal_sub_standardNormal_le_sub
    kappa mu hσ x hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
  rw [cdfUpperError, ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv (kappa ∗ gamma) mu x,
    ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv (kappa ∗ gamma)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x]
  simpa only [smoothedCDF, gamma] using h

/-- A common convolution factor averages the signed upper CDF error exactly.
This identity retains cancellations that are lost after taking absolute
values or a concentration supremum. -/
theorem cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x =
      ∫ y, cdfUpperError mu nu (x - y) ∂kappa := by
  rw [cdfUpperError, ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv mu kappa x,
    ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv nu kappa x]
  unfold smoothedCDF cdfUpperError
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_cdf_translate mu kappa x)
    (integrable_cdf_translate nu kappa x)]

/-- The corresponding exact averaging identity for the signed lower CDF
error. -/
theorem cdfLowerError_conv_left_eq_integral
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x =
      ∫ y, cdfLowerError mu nu (x - y) ∂kappa := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral nu mu kappa x

/-- Two spatial cancellations turn convolution by a positively scaled
standard normal into a second-order weighted pointwise bound for the upper
signed CDF error. -/
theorem abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_standardNormal_conv_le_of_cancellations
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (he : Integrable (cdfUpperError mu nu))
    (he1 : Integrable (fun z => z * cdfUpperError mu nu z))
    (he2 : Integrable (fun z => |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu z|))
    (hzero : (∫ z, cdfUpperError mu nu z) = 0)
    (hone : (∫ z, z * cdfUpperError mu nu z) = 0)
    (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ mu)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ nu) x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) *
        ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError mu nu z| := by
  let kappa := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure kappa :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have hmeas : Measurable (cdfUpperError mu nu) :=
    (monotone_cdf mu).measurable.sub (monotone_cdf nu).measurable
  rw [cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral]
  rw [integral_comp_sub_map_mul_standardNormalLaw_eq_integral_scaledPDF
    (cdfUpperError mu nu) hmeas hσ x]
  exact abs_integral_scaledStandardNormalPDF_mul_le_of_cancellations
    (cdfUpperError mu nu) he he1 he2 hzero hone hσ x

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the scaled-normal cancellation bound. -/
theorem abs_cdfLowerError_map_mul_standardNormal_conv_le_of_cancellations
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (he : Integrable (cdfLowerError mu nu))
    (he1 : Integrable (fun z => z * cdfLowerError mu nu z))
    (he2 : Integrable (fun z => |z| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError mu nu z|))
    (hzero : (∫ z, cdfLowerError mu nu z) = 0)
    (hone : (∫ z, z * cdfLowerError mu nu z) = 0)
    (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ mu)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ nu) x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / σ ^ 3) *
        ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError mu nu z| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_standardNormal_conv_le_of_cancellations
      nu mu hσ
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using he)
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using he1)
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using he2)
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using hzero)
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using hone) x

/-- A centered Gaussian density is bounded by its value at the mean. -/
theorem gaussianPDFReal_zero_le_peak
    {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 v y ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal]
  calc
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
        Real.exp (-(y - 0) ^ 2 / (2 * (v : ℝ))) ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ * 1 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
        (neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg (y - 0))) (by positivity)
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ := mul_one _

/-- Convolution by a centered nondegenerate Gaussian maps the spatial `L¹`
norm of an upper signed CDF error to a pointwise bound using the exact peak
of the Gaussian density. -/
theorem abs_cdfUpperError_gaussianReal_conv_le_integral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (he : Integrable (cdfUpperError mu nu)) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗ mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗ nu) x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
        ∫ z, |cdfUpperError mu nu z| := by
  let kappa := ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure kappa := inferInstance
  let C : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹
  let e : ℝ → ℝ := cdfUpperError mu nu
  have heTrans : Integrable (fun y => |e (x - y)|) := by
    have h := (he.norm.comp_add_right x).comp_neg
    simpa only [e, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h
  have htrans : (∫ y, |e (x - y)|) = ∫ z, |e z| := by
    calc
      (∫ y, |e (x - y)|) = ∫ y, |e (-y + x)| := by
        congr 1
        funext y
        congr 2
        ring
      _ = ∫ y, |e (y + x)| :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self (fun y => |e (y + x)|) volume
      _ = ∫ z, |e z| :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (fun z => |e z|) x
  have hpdfProd : Integrable (fun y =>
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 v y * |e (x - y)|) := by
    apply heTrans.bdd_mul
    · exact (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_gaussianPDFReal 0 v).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact ae_of_all _ fun y => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 v y)]
        exact gaussianPDFReal_zero_le_peak hv y
  have hCTrans : Integrable (fun y => C * |e (x - y)|) :=
    heTrans.const_mul C
  rw [cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral]
  calc
    |∫ y, e (x - y) ∂kappa| ≤ ∫ y, |e (x - y)| ∂kappa := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        (norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun y => e (x - y)) (μ := kappa))
    _ = ∫ y, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 v y *
        |e (x - y)| := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul hv]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ∫ y, C * |e (x - y)| := by
      apply integral_mono hpdfProd hCTrans
      intro y
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (gaussianPDFReal_zero_le_peak hv y) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = C * ∫ z, |e z| := by rw [integral_const_mul, htrans]

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the Gaussian `L¹ -> L∞` estimate. -/
theorem abs_cdfLowerError_gaussianReal_conv_le_integral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (he : Integrable (cdfLowerError mu nu)) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗ mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗ nu) x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
        ∫ z, |cdfLowerError mu nu z| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using
    abs_cdfUpperError_gaussianReal_conv_le_integral nu mu hv
      (by simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_upper_swap] using he) x

/-- Coefficient of the preceding normalized sum in one Gaussian replacement
step. -/
noncomputable def normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹

/-- Coefficient of the fresh standard Gaussian in one normalized replacement
step. -/
noncomputable def normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹

/-- One Gaussian-stationary keep/innovation step applied to a real
probability law. -/
noncomputable def normalizedGaussianStepLaw (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) : Measure ℝ :=
  Measure.map
      (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗
    Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu

theorem normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos (N : ℕ) :
    0 < normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient
  positivity

theorem normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient_pos (N : ℕ) :
    0 < normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient
  positivity

/-- The Gaussian density peak and keep-coordinate Jacobian simplify to the
closed coefficient used by the normalized smoothing estimate. -/
theorem normalizedGaussianDensityPeak_mul_keep (N : ℕ) :
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi *
      normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2))⁻¹ *
        normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N =
      Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [show 2 * Real.pi * normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2 =
      (2 * Real.pi) * normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2 by ring,
    Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi),
    Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient_pos N)]
  unfold normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient
  field_simp

/-- Exact simplification of the second-order cancellation coefficient: the
cubic keep Jacobian cancels the cubic innovation denominator, leaving the
three-halves power of the preceding sample count. -/
theorem normalizedGaussianCancellationCoefficient (N : ℕ) :
    (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) /
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 3) *
      normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 3 =
    ((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3 := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient
  field_simp

theorem normalizedGaussianCoefficients_sq_add (N : ℕ) :
    normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 2 +
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2 = 1 := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient
  rw [mul_pow, inv_pow,
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N + 1),
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N + 2)]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Integrability of the identity is preserved by scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integrable_id_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) := by
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hmu1.const_mul c

/-- The first moment of a scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integral_id_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) = c * ∫ y, y ∂mu := by
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), integral_const_mul]

/-- Integrability of the square is preserved by scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integrable_sq_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) := by
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  change Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (c * z) ^ 2) mu
  simpa only [mul_pow] using hmu2.const_mul (c ^ 2)

/-- The second moment of a scalar pushforward. -/
theorem integral_sq_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) =
      c ^ 2 * ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu := by
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp only [mul_pow]
  rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- Integrability of the third absolute moment is preserved by scalar
pushforward. -/
theorem integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) := by
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  change Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |c * z| ^ 3) mu
  simpa only [abs_mul, mul_pow] using hmu3.const_mul (|c| ^ 3)

/-- Convolution preserves finite first moments. -/
theorem integrable_id_conv (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) (mu ∗ nu) := by
  unfold Measure.conv
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  exact (hmu1.comp_fst nu).add (hnu1.comp_snd mu)

/-- First moments add under convolution of probability laws. -/
theorem integral_id_conv (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂(mu ∗ nu)) = (∫ y, y ∂mu) + ∫ y, y ∂nu := by
  unfold Measure.conv
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rw [integral_add (hmu1.comp_fst nu) (hnu1.comp_snd mu)]
  rw [integral_fun_fst (μ := mu) (ν := nu) (fun x : ℝ => x),
    integral_fun_snd (μ := mu) (ν := nu) (fun x : ℝ => x)]
  simp

/-- Convolution preserves finite second moments when both first moments are
finite. -/
theorem integrable_sq_conv (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (mu ∗ nu) := by
  unfold Measure.conv
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hmu2p := hmu2.comp_fst nu
  have hnu2p := hnu2.comp_snd mu
  have hcross := hmu1.mul_prod hnu1
  apply Integrable.congr ((hmu2p.add (hcross.const_mul 2)).add hnu2p)
  filter_upwards [] with z
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  ring

/-- The second moment of a convolution, including its mean cross term. -/
theorem integral_sq_conv (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂(mu ∗ nu)) =
      (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) + 2 * (∫ y, y ∂mu) * (∫ y, y ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu := by
  unfold Measure.conv
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hmu2p := hmu2.comp_fst nu
  have hnu2p := hnu2.comp_snd mu
  have hcross := hmu1.mul_prod hnu1
  have hmiddle : Integrable (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (z.1 * z.2)) (mu.prod nu) :=
    hcross.const_mul 2
  calc
    (∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, (z.1 + z.2) ^ 2 ∂mu.prod nu) =
        ∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 + 2 * (z.1 * z.2) + z.2 ^ 2 ∂mu.prod nu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with z
      ring
    _ = (∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 + 2 * (z.1 * z.2) ∂mu.prod nu) +
        ∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.2 ^ 2 ∂mu.prod nu := by
      convert integral_add (hmu2p.add hmiddle) hnu2p using 1
    _ = ((∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 ∂mu.prod nu) +
        ∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, 2 * (z.1 * z.2) ∂mu.prod nu) +
        ∫ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.2 ^ 2 ∂mu.prod nu := by
      rw [integral_add hmu2p hmiddle]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_fun_fst (μ := mu) (ν := nu) (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2),
        integral_fun_snd (μ := mu) (ν := nu) (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2),
        integral_const_mul,
        integral_prod_mul (μ := mu) (ν := nu) (fun x : ℝ => x) (fun x : ℝ => x)]
      simp only [probReal_univ, one_smul]
      ring

/-- Convolution preserves finite third absolute moments. -/
theorem integrable_abs_cube_conv (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) (mu ∗ nu) := by
  have hmuLp : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu := by
    rw [← integrable_norm_rpow_iff (p := (3 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by fun_prop)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hmu3
  have hnuLp : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
    rw [← integrable_norm_rpow_iff (p := (3 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by fun_prop)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnu3
  have hconv : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (mu ∗ nu) := by
    unfold Measure.conv
    rw [memLp_map_measure_iff (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    exact (hmuLp.comp_fst nu).add (hnuLp.comp_snd mu)
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hconv.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)

instance normalizedGaussianStepLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianStepLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  infer_instance

/-- The Gaussian keep/innovation step preserves finite first moments. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_id
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) (gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled)
  apply integrable_id_conv gammaScaled nuScaled
  · exact integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_id
  · exact integrable_id_map_mul_real nu _ hnu1

/-- The Gaussian keep/innovation step preserves centering. -/
theorem integral_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_id
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hmean : (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂nu) = 0) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) = 0 := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  change (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂(gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled)) = 0
  rw [integral_id_conv gammaScaled nuScaled
      (integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_id)
      (integrable_id_map_mul_real nu _ hnu1),
    integral_id_map_mul_real, integral_id_map_mul_real,
    integral_standardNormal_id, hmean]
  ring

/-- The Gaussian keep/innovation step preserves finite second moments. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_sq
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled)
  exact integrable_sq_conv gammaScaled nuScaled
    (integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_id)
    (integrable_id_map_mul_real nu _ hnu1)
    (integrable_sq_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_sq)
    (integrable_sq_map_mul_real nu _ hnu2)

/-- The Gaussian keep/innovation step preserves unit second moment on
centered input laws. -/
theorem integral_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_sq
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu)
    (hmean : (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂nu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂nu) = 1) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) = 1 := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  change (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂(gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled)) = 1
  rw [integral_sq_conv gammaScaled nuScaled
      (integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_id)
      (integrable_id_map_mul_real nu _ hnu1)
      (integrable_sq_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_sq)
      (integrable_sq_map_mul_real nu _ hnu2),
    integral_sq_map_mul_real, integral_sq_map_mul_real,
    integral_id_map_mul_real, integral_id_map_mul_real,
    integral_standardNormal_id, integral_standardNormal_sq, hmean, hsecond]
  rw [show normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2 * 1 +
      2 * (normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * 0) *
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * 0) +
      normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 2 * 1 =
      normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 2 +
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2 by ring]
  exact normalizedGaussianCoefficients_sq_add N

/-- The Gaussian keep/innovation step preserves finiteness of the third
absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_abs_cube
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) (gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled)
  exact integrable_abs_cube_conv gammaScaled nuScaled
    (integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube)
    (integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real nu _ hnu3)

/-- For a real law, the `L³` condition on the identity is exactly finiteness
of the third absolute moment. -/
theorem memLp_id_three_iff_integrable_abs_cube (mu : Measure ℝ) :
    MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu ↔ Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu := by
  rw [← integrable_norm_rpow_iff (p := (3 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by fun_prop)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- Minkowski's inequality for the identity under convolution of real
probability laws. -/
theorem eLpNorm_id_conv_le (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] :
    eLpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (mu ∗ nu) ≤
      eLpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu + eLpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
  unfold Measure.conv
  rw [eLpNorm_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    eLpNorm ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) + fun z => z.2) 3 (mu.prod nu) ≤
        eLpNorm (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) 3 (mu.prod nu) +
          eLpNorm (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) 3 (mu.prod nu) := by
      exact eLpNorm_add_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1) = (fun y : ℝ => y) ∘ Prod.fst by rfl,
        show (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.2) = (fun y : ℝ => y) ∘ Prod.snd by rfl,
        eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving (by fun_prop)
          (measurePreserving_fst (μ := mu) (ν := nu)),
        eLpNorm_comp_measurePreserving (by fun_prop)
          (measurePreserving_snd (μ := mu) (ν := nu))]

/-- Real-valued `L³` Minkowski inequality for convolution. -/
theorem lpNorm_id_conv_le (mu nu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu3 : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu)
    (hnu3 : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu) :
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (mu ∗ nu) ≤
      lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu + lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
  have hconv : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (mu ∗ nu) := by
    unfold Measure.conv
    rw [memLp_map_measure_iff (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    exact (hmu3.comp_fst nu).add (hnu3.comp_snd mu)
  rw [← toReal_eLpNorm hconv.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← toReal_eLpNorm hmu3.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← toReal_eLpNorm hnu3.aestronglyMeasurable,
    ← ENNReal.toReal_add hmu3.eLpNorm_ne_top hnu3.eLpNorm_ne_top]
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.2
    ⟨hmu3.eLpNorm_ne_top, hnu3.eLpNorm_ne_top⟩)
    (eLpNorm_id_conv_le mu nu)

/-- The real `L³` norm of the identity scales by the absolute value of a
scalar pushforward. -/
theorem lpNorm_id_map_mul_real (mu : Measure ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => c * z) mu) =
      |c| * lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 mu := by
  rw [← toReal_eLpNorm (p := (3 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by fun_prop),
    eLpNorm_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  change (eLpNorm (c • (fun y : ℝ => y)) 3 mu).toReal = _
  rw [eLpNorm_const_smul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_eLpNorm (by fun_prop)]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- Quantitative third-moment-root envelope for one Gaussian
keep/innovation step. -/
theorem lpNorm_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) ≤
      normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N *
          lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma
  let nuScaled := Measure.map
    (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have hgammaScaled3 : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 gammaScaled :=
    (memLp_id_three_iff_integrable_abs_cube gammaScaled).2
      (integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real gamma _ integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube)
  have hnuScaled3 : MemLp (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nuScaled :=
    (memLp_id_three_iff_integrable_abs_cube nuScaled).2
      (integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real nu _ hnu3)
  change lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled) ≤ _
  calc
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (gammaScaled ∗ nuScaled) ≤
        lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 gammaScaled +
          lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nuScaled :=
      lpNorm_id_conv_le gammaScaled nuScaled hgammaScaled3 hnuScaled3
    _ = |normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N| *
          lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 gamma +
        |normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N| * lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
      rw [lpNorm_id_map_mul_real, lpNorm_id_map_mul_real]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [abs_of_pos (normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient_pos N),
        abs_of_pos (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos N)]

/-- A real probability law with zero mean, unit second moment, finite third
absolute moment, and a specified `L³` bound.  This is the admissible domain
for moment-sensitive estimates on the Gaussian keep/innovation operator. -/
structure IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw (nu : Measure ℝ) (B : ℝ) : Prop where
  probability : IsProbabilityMeasure nu
  integrable_id : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) nu
  centered : (∫ y : ℝ, y ∂nu) = 0
  integrable_sq : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu
  unit_second_moment : (∫ y : ℝ, y ^ 2 ∂nu) = 1
  integrable_abs_cube : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu
  lpNorm_three_le : lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu ≤ B

/-- The standard-normal law belongs to the bounded standardized-law domain
at its own `L³` norm. -/
theorem standardNormal_isStandardizedThirdMomentLaw :
    IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      (lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  exact ⟨inferInstance, integrable_standardNormal_id, integral_standardNormal_id,
    integrable_standardNormal_sq, integral_standardNormal_sq,
    integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube, le_rfl⟩

/-- The exact bounded standardized-law domain transported by one Gaussian
keep/innovation step. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.normalizedGaussianStepLaw
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) (N : ℕ) :
    IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      (normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N *
          lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * B) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  refine ⟨inferInstance,
    integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_id N nu h.integrable_id,
    integral_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_id N nu h.integrable_id h.centered,
    integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_sq N nu h.integrable_id h.integrable_sq,
    integral_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_sq N nu h.integrable_id h.integrable_sq
      h.centered h.unit_second_moment,
    integrable_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_abs_cube N nu h.integrable_abs_cube, ?_⟩
  refine (lpNorm_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le N nu h.integrable_abs_cube).trans ?_
  exact add_le_add_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.lpNorm_three_le
      (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos N).le) _

/-- The standard normal law is stationary under the precise Gaussian
keep/innovation split in the normalized leave-one-out recurrence. -/
theorem standardNormalLaw_normalizedGaussian_step (N : ℕ) :
    normalizedGaussianStepLaw N
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw =
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  unfold normalizedGaussianStepLaw
  rw [Measure.conv_comm,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_const_mul,
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_const_mul,
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_conv_gaussianReal]
  congr 2
  · ring
  · rw [← NNReal.coe_inj]
    simp only [NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_mk, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one]
    exact normalizedGaussianCoefficients_sq_add N

/-- The affine Gaussian average in the normalized signed recurrence is
exactly one step of the Gaussian-stationary keep/innovation operator. -/
theorem integral_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y))
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      cdfUpperError
        (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  calc
    (∫ y, cdfUpperError nu gamma
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y)) ∂gamma) =
        ∫ y, cdfUpperError nu gamma
          ((x - normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * y) /
            normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with y
      congr 1
