      unfold normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient
      have h1 : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    _ = ∫ y, cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu)
        (Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma)
        (x - normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * y) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with y
      rw [cdfUpperError_map_mul nu gamma
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos N)]
    _ = ∫ w, cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu)
        (Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma)
        (x - w)
        ∂(Measure.map
          (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma) := by
      have hmeas : Measurable (fun w : ℝ => cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu)
          (Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma)
          (x - w)) := by
        exact ((monotone_cdf _).measurable.comp
          (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).sub
          ((monotone_cdf _).measurable.comp
            (measurable_const.sub measurable_id))
      rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable]
    _ = cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma ∗
          Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu)
        (Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma ∗
          Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma) x := by
      rw [cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral]
    _ = cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma ∗
          Measure.map
            (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) nu)
        gamma x := by
      have hstationary :
          Measure.map
              (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N * z) gamma ∗
            Measure.map
              (fun z : ℝ => normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * z) gamma =
            gamma := by
        simpa only [gamma, normalizedGaussianStepLaw] using
          standardNormalLaw_normalizedGaussian_step N
      rw [hstationary]

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the exact Gaussian keep/innovation
identity. -/
theorem integral_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y))
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      cdfLowerError
        (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
  simp only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, integral_neg]
  rw [integral_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq]

/-- A common convolution factor cannot increase the one-sided upper CDF
distance. -/
theorem upperCDFDistance_conv_left_le
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] :
    upperCDFDistance (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) ≤
      upperCDFDistance mu nu := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral]
  apply integral_cdfUpperError_comp_le
  fun_prop

/-- Lower one-sided companion to `upperCDFDistance_conv_left_le`. -/
theorem lowerCDFDistance_conv_left_le
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] :
    lowerCDFDistance (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) ≤
      lowerCDFDistance mu nu := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [cdfLowerError_conv_left_eq_integral]
  apply integral_cdfLowerError_comp_le
  fun_prop

/-- The exact normalized Gaussian keep/innovation step is nonexpansive for
the upper one-sided Kolmogorov distance from its stationary law. -/
theorem upperCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (N : ℕ) :
    upperCDFDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      upperCDFDistance nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [← integral_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq]
  apply integral_cdfUpperError_comp_le
  fun_prop

/-- Lower one-sided companion to
`upperCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le`. -/
theorem lowerCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (N : ℕ) :
    lowerCDFDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      lowerCDFDistance nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [← integral_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq]
  apply integral_cdfLowerError_comp_le
  fun_prop

/-- Kolmogorov nonexpansiveness of one exact normalized Gaussian
keep/innovation step. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le
    (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (N : ℕ) :
    kolmogorovDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      kolmogorovDistance nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw =
        max
          (upperCDFDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          (lowerCDFDistance (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
      kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed _ _
    _ ≤ max
          (upperCDFDistance nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          (lowerCDFDistance nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
      max_le_max
        (upperCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le nu N)
        (lowerCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le nu N)
    _ = kolmogorovDistance nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw :=
      (kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed _ _).symm

/-- Exact signed upper-error leave-one-out recurrence for a raw partial sum.
The first term replaces the newest summand by a standard Gaussian; the
integral retains the preceding signed error instead of taking its absolute
value before averaging. -/
theorem cdfUpperError_sum_range_succ_gaussian_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0)) x =
      cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x +
        ∫ y, cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0)) (x - y)
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sprev mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1))
  rw [map_sum_range_succ_eq_conv X hX hIndep (N + 1),
    ← gaussianReal_nat_succ_conv_standardNormalLaw N]
  calc
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
          Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0) ∗
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x =
      cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x +
        cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0) ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x :=
      cdfUpperError_conv_telescope _ _ _ _ x
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      rw [Measure.conv_comm
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
        Measure.conv_comm
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0))
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
        cdfUpperError_conv_left_eq_integral]

/-- Exact signed lower-error companion to
`cdfUpperError_sum_range_succ_gaussian_telescope`. -/
theorem cdfLowerError_sum_range_succ_gaussian_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0)) x =
      cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x +
        ∫ y, cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0)) (x - y)
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sprev mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1))
  rw [map_sum_range_succ_eq_conv X hX hIndep (N + 1),
    ← gaussianReal_nat_succ_conv_standardNormalLaw N]
  calc
    cdfLowerError
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
          Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0) ∗
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x =
      cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x +
        cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0) ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x :=
      cdfLowerError_conv_telescope _ _ _ _ x
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      rw [Measure.conv_comm
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
        Measure.conv_comm
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0))
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
        cdfLowerError_conv_left_eq_integral]

/-- Normalized signed upper-error leave-one-out recurrence.  The first term
is the newest-summand replacement error after applying the current
normalization; the second term averages the preceding normalized signed error
against a standard Gaussian. -/
theorem cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) x +
        ∫ y, cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y))
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have hc : 0 < (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hd : 0 < (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sprev mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1))
  have hSfull : AEMeasurable
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu := by
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSfull
  have hnorm :
      Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu =
        Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu) := by
    rw [map_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_map_mul_sum_range X hX (N + 1)]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]
  have hgauss :
      Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0)) =
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    convert map_gaussianReal_nat_succ_eq_standardNormalLaw (N + 1) using 1
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]
  calc
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu))
          (Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0))) x := by
      rw [hnorm, hgauss]
    _ = cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 2 : ℝ≥0))
          (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) :=
      cdfUpperError_map_mul _ _ hc x
    _ = cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) +
        ∫ y, cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0))
          (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y)
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw :=
      cdfUpperError_sum_range_succ_gaussian_telescope
        X hX hIndep N (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹)
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      · exact (cdfUpperError_map_mul _ _ hc x).symm
      · apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun y => by
          calc
            cdfUpperError
                (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
                (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0))
                (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y) =
              cdfUpperError
                (Measure.map
                  (fun z : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * z)
                  (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu))
                (Measure.map
                  (fun z : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ * z)
                  (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (N + 1 : ℝ≥0)))
                ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
                  (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y)) := by
              rw [cdfUpperError_map_mul _ _ hd]
              congr 1
              field_simp
            _ = _ := by
              rw [map_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_map_mul_sum_range X hX N,
                map_gaussianReal_nat_succ_eq_standardNormalLaw N]

/-- Normalized signed lower-error companion to
`cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope`. -/
theorem cdfLowerError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) x +
        ∫ y, cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (x / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ - y))
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have h :=
    cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
      X hX hIndep N x
  simp only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, integral_neg]
  rw [h]
  ring

/-- Exact normalized upper-error recurrence with the inherited Gaussian
average exposed as a keep/innovation step on the preceding law. -/
theorem cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_step_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfUpperError
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      cdfUpperError
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) x +
        cdfUpperError
          (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N
            (Measure.map
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
              mu))
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        mu) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by
          change AEMeasurable (fun omega =>
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
              ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), X i.1 omega) mu
          fun_prop)
  rw [cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    X hX hIndep N x,
    integral_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq]

/-- Exact normalized lower-error companion with the inherited term exposed
as the same Gaussian keep/innovation step. -/
theorem cdfLowerError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_step_telescope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfLowerError
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x =
      cdfLowerError
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) x +
        cdfLowerError
          (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N
            (Measure.map
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
              mu))
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        mu) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by
          change AEMeasurable (fun omega =>
            (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
              ∑ i : Fin (N + 1), X i.1 omega) mu
          fun_prop)
  rw [cdfLowerError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    X hX hIndep N x,
    integral_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussian_affine_eq]

/-- One-sided upper-distance recurrence obtained from the exact normalized
telescope.  The inherited error appears with coefficient exactly one. -/
theorem upperCDFDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) :
    upperCDFDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      upperCDFDistance
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        upperCDFDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [cdfUpperError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    X hX hIndep N x]
  apply add_le_add
  · apply cdfUpperError_le_upperCDFDistance
  · apply integral_cdfUpperError_comp_le
    fun_prop

/-- One-sided lower-distance companion to
`upperCDFDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le`. -/
theorem lowerCDFDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) :
    lowerCDFDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      lowerCDFDistance
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        lowerCDFDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [cdfLowerError_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_gaussian_telescope
    X hX hIndep N x]
  apply add_le_add
  · apply cdfLowerError_le_lowerCDFDistance
  · apply integral_cdfLowerError_comp_le
    fun_prop

/-- Kolmogorov recurrence through the normalized one-summand replacement.
Unlike the concentration recurrence, this bound carries the preceding
Kolmogorov error with coefficient one. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_replacement
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  rw [kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed]
  apply max_le
  · exact (upperCDFDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
      X hX hIndep N).trans (add_le_add
        (upperCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance _ _)
        (upperCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance _ _))
  · exact (lowerCDFDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
      X hX hIndep N).trans (add_le_add
        (lowerCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance _ _)
        (lowerCDFDistance_le_kolmogorovDistance _ _))

/-- The normalized coefficient-one recurrence with its one-summand
replacement term rewritten as an unscaled common-convolution distance. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_unscaledReplacement
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu ∗
            Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗
            Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu) +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sprev mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1))
  have hc : 0 < (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu))
          (Measure.map
            (fun y : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ * y)
            (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu ∗
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw :=
      kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_replacement
        X hX hIndep N
    _ = _ := by
      rw [kolmogorovDistance_map_mul_conv_eq
        (Measure.map Sprev mu) (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hc]

/-- Adding an independent convolution factor cannot increase interval mass
beyond the concentration function of the right factor. -/
theorem measureReal_Ioc_conv_le_concentrationFunction_right
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (x : ℝ) :
    (mu ∗ nu).real (Ioc x (x + h)) ≤ concentrationFunction nu h := by
  have hUpper := integrable_cdf_translate nu mu (x + h)
  have hLower := integrable_cdf_translate nu mu x
  rw [measureReal_Ioc_eq_cdf_sub (mu ∗ nu) (by linarith)]
  rw [← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv nu mu (x + h),
    ← smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv nu mu x]
  unfold smoothedCDF
  rw [← integral_sub hUpper hLower]
  calc
    (∫ y, cdf nu (x + h - y) - cdf nu (x - y) ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ _y, concentrationFunction nu h ∂mu := by
      apply integral_mono (hUpper.sub hLower) (integrable_const _)
      intro y
      calc
        cdf nu (x + h - y) - cdf nu (x - y) =
            nu.real (Ioc (x - y) ((x - y) + h)) := by
          rw [measureReal_Ioc_eq_cdf_sub nu (by linarith)]
          congr 2
          ring
        _ ≤ concentrationFunction nu h :=
          measureReal_Ioc_le_concentrationFunction nu h (x - y)
    _ = concentrationFunction nu h := by simp

/-- Convolution cannot increase the concentration function beyond that of
its right factor. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_conv_le_right
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    concentrationFunction (mu ∗ nu) h ≤ concentrationFunction nu h := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact measureReal_Ioc_conv_le_concentrationFunction_right mu nu hh x

/-- Convolution cannot increase the concentration function beyond that of
its left factor. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_conv_le_left
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    concentrationFunction (mu ∗ nu) h ≤ concentrationFunction mu h := by
  rw [Measure.conv_comm]
  exact concentrationFunction_conv_le_right nu mu hh

/-- Leave-one-out concentration recurrence for normalized independent sums.
The new summand disappears through convolution domination; the interval
length is rescaled to the preceding normalization. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {mu : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X (N + 1)) mu) h ≤
      concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu)
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          (h * Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))) := by
  let Sfull : Ω → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i
  let Sprev : Ω → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  have hSfull : AEMeasurable Sfull mu := by
    dsimp only [Sfull]
    fun_prop
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sfull mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSfull
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map Sprev mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1))
  have hcfull : 0 < (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hcprev : 0 < (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
  rw [map_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_map_mul_sum_range X hX (N + 1)]
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [show (N : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = (N : ℝ) + 2 by ring]
  rw [concentrationFunction_map_mul_eq
      (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu) hcfull]
  calc
    concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), X i) mu)
        (h / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤
      concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu)
        (h / (Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
      rw [map_sum_range_succ_eq_conv X hX hIndep (N + 1)]
      exact concentrationFunction_conv_le_left _ _
        (div_nonneg hh hcfull.le)
    _ = concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu)
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          (h * Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))) := by
      rw [map_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_map_mul_sum_range X hX N,
        concentrationFunction_map_mul_eq
          (Measure.map (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i) mu) hcprev]
      field_simp

/-- The leave-one-out recurrence combined with the standard-normal interval
bound for the preceding normalized sum. -/
theorem concentrationFunction_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_gaussian_previous
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {mu : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (N : ℕ) {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) :
    concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X (N + 1)) mu) h ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
            (h * Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))) +
        2 * kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have hnorm : AEMeasurable
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu := by
    unfold NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hnorm
  calc
    concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X (N + 1)) mu) h ≤
      concentrationFunction
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N) mu)
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))⁻¹ *
          (h * Real.sqrt (N + 2 : ℝ))) :=
      concentrationFunction_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le
        X hX hIndep N hh
    _ ≤ _ :=
      concentrationFunction_le_standardNormal_length_add_kolmogorov _
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mul_nonneg hh (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))

/-- A probability CDF is continuous at every point carrying no atom. -/
theorem continuousAt_cdf_of_measure_singleton_eq_zero
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {x : ℝ}
    (hx : μ {x} = 0) : ContinuousAt (cdf μ) x := by
  rw [(ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf μ).continuousAt_iff_leftLim_eq_rightLim,
    (cdf μ).rightLim_eq]
  have hm : (cdf μ).measure {x} = 0 := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.measure_cdf μ]
    exact hx
  rw [StieltjesFunction.measure_singleton] at hm
  have hle : cdf μ x - Function.leftLim (cdf μ) x ≤ 0 :=
    ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hm
  have hge : 0 ≤ cdf μ x - Function.leftLim (cdf μ) x :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr ((cdf μ).mono.leftLim_le le_rfl)
  linarith

/-- Absolute continuity with respect to Lebesgue measure removes every CDF
jump. -/
theorem continuous_cdf_of_absolutelyContinuous
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hμ : μ ≪ volume) :
    Continuous (cdf μ) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  exact continuousAt_cdf_of_measure_singleton_eq_zero μ (hμ (by simp))

/-- The normalized uniform smoothing kernel has a Lebesgue density. -/
theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_absolutelyContinuous (δ : ℝ) :
    uniformSmoothingKernel δ ≪ volume := by
  unfold uniformSmoothingKernel
  exact Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous.trans
    Measure.restrict_le_self.absolutelyContinuous

/-- Convolution with the uniform kernel has a Lebesgue density, even when
the other probability measure is singular. -/
theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_absolutelyContinuous
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ ≪ volume := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  rw [Measure.conv_comm]
  exact Measure.conv_absolutelyContinuous
    (uniformSmoothingKernel_absolutelyContinuous δ)

/-- Uniform smoothing makes every probability CDF continuous. -/
theorem continuous_cdf_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Continuous (cdf (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  exact continuous_cdf_of_absolutelyContinuous _
    (uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_absolutelyContinuous μ hδ)

/-- A finite first absolute moment makes the radial real-valued tail
integrable on the positive half-line.  This is the layer-cake input for the
integrability of a difference of two CDFs. -/
theorem integrableOn_measureReal_abs_ge
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => μ.real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}) (Ioi 0) := by
  have hanti : Antitone (fun t : ℝ => μ.real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}) := by
    intro s t hst
    exact measureReal_mono fun x hx => hst.trans hx
  have htail :
      ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), μ {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|} < ∞ := by
    rw [← lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_le μ
      (f := fun x : ℝ => |x|)
      (ae_of_all μ fun x => abs_nonneg x) hμ1.aemeasurable]
    exact hμ1.lintegral_lt_top
  refine ⟨hanti.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal
    (ae_of_all (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) fun t => measureReal_nonneg)]
  rw [show (∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (μ.real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|})) =
      ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), μ {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|} by
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro t
    exact ofReal_measureReal]
  exact htail

/-- The difference of two probability CDFs is integrable when both measures
have a finite first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => cdf μ x - cdf ν x) := by
  let qμ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => μ.real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}
  let qν : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ν.real {x : ℝ | t ≤ |x|}
  have hqμ : IntegrableOn qμ (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [qμ] using integrableOn_measureReal_abs_ge μ hμ1
  have hqν : IntegrableOn qν (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [qν] using integrableOn_measureReal_abs_ge ν hν1
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => cdf μ x - cdf ν x) :=
    (ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf μ).measurable.sub
      (ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf ν).measurable
  have hpos : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => cdf μ x - cdf ν x) (Ioi 0) := by
    apply (hqμ.add hqν).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have htailμ : 1 - cdf μ x = μ.real (Ioi x) := by
      rw [cdf_eq_real, ← probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic, compl_Iic]
    have htailν : 1 - cdf ν x = ν.real (Ioi x) := by
      rw [cdf_eq_real, ← probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic, compl_Iic]
    have hμ_le : μ.real (Ioi x) ≤ qμ x := by
      exact measureReal_mono fun a ha =>
        (le_of_lt ha).trans (le_abs_self a)
    have hν_le : ν.real (Ioi x) ≤ qν x := by
      exact measureReal_mono fun a ha =>
        (le_of_lt ha).trans (le_abs_self a)
    calc
      |cdf μ x - cdf ν x| =
          |(1 - cdf ν x) - (1 - cdf μ x)| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |1 - cdf ν x| + |1 - cdf μ x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ = (1 - cdf ν x) + (1 - cdf μ x) := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one ν x)),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (cdf_le_one μ x))]
      _ = μ.real (Ioi x) + ν.real (Ioi x) := by rw [htailμ, htailν]; ring
      _ ≤ qμ x + qν x := add_le_add hμ_le hν_le
  have hqμ_neg : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => qμ (-x)) (Iic 0) := by
    rw [← Measure.map_neg_eq_self (volume : Measure ℝ)]
    let m : MeasurableEmbedding fun x : ℝ => -x :=
      (Homeomorph.neg ℝ).measurableEmbedding
    rw [m.integrableOn_map_iff]
    simp_rw [Function.comp_def, neg_preimage, neg_Iic, neg_zero]
    apply Iff.mpr integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hqμ
  have hqν_neg : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => qν (-x)) (Iic 0) := by
    rw [← Measure.map_neg_eq_self (volume : Measure ℝ)]
    let m : MeasurableEmbedding fun x : ℝ => -x :=
      (Homeomorph.neg ℝ).measurableEmbedding
    rw [m.integrableOn_map_iff]
    simp_rw [Function.comp_def, neg_preimage, neg_Iic, neg_zero]
    apply Iff.mpr integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hqν
  have hneg : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => cdf μ x - cdf ν x) (Iic 0) := by
    apply (hqμ_neg.add hqν_neg).mono' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Iic fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hμ_le : cdf μ x ≤ qμ (-x) := by
      rw [cdf_eq_real]
      exact measureReal_mono fun a ha => by
        have ha0 : a ≤ 0 := ha.trans hx
        change -x ≤ |a|
        rw [abs_of_nonpos ha0]
        exact neg_le_neg ha
    have hν_le : cdf ν x ≤ qν (-x) := by
      rw [cdf_eq_real]
      exact measureReal_mono fun a ha => by
        have ha0 : a ≤ 0 := ha.trans hx
        change -x ≤ |a|
        rw [abs_of_nonpos ha0]
        exact neg_le_neg ha
    calc
      |cdf μ x - cdf ν x| ≤ |cdf μ x| + |cdf ν x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ = cdf μ x + cdf ν x := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg μ x), abs_of_nonneg (cdf_nonneg ν x)]
      _ ≤ qμ (-x) + qν (-x) := add_le_add hμ_le hν_le
  rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Iic_union_Ioi]
  exact hneg.union hpos

/-- Pointwise `L¹ -> L∞` control of the upper signed error after one exact
normalized Gaussian keep/innovation step.  The two displayed factors are the
exact Gaussian density peak and the positive keep-coordinate Jacobian. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi *
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2))⁻¹ *
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N *
          ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let a := normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N
  let b := normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N
  let v : ℝ≥0 := ⟨b ^ 2, sq_nonneg b⟩
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have ha : 0 < a := normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos N
  have hb : 0 < b := normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient_pos N
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ← NNReal.coe_inj]
    simp only [v, NNReal.coe_mk, NNReal.coe_zero]
    exact (sq_pos_of_pos hb).ne'
  have hkappa : Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => b * z) gamma =
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v := by
    dsimp only [gamma]
    rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_map_const_mul]
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, v]
  have hnuMapId : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu) :=
    integrable_id_map_mul_real nu a h.integrable_id
  have hgammaMapId : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) :=
    integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma a integrable_standardNormal_id
  have hscaled : Integrable (cdfUpperError
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma)) := by
    have hnuAbs : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|)
        (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnuMapId.norm
    have hgammaAbs : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|)
        (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hgammaMapId.norm
    simpa only [cdfUpperError] using
      integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments _ _ hnuAbs hgammaAbs
  have hgauss := abs_cdfUpperError_gaussianReal_conv_le_integral
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu)
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) hv hscaled x
  nth_rewrite 1 [← standardNormalLaw_normalizedGaussian_step N]
  change |cdfUpperError
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => b * z) gamma ∗
        Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => b * z) gamma ∗
        Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) x| ≤ _
  rw [hkappa]
  calc
    |cdfUpperError
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗
          Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 v ∗
          Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma) x| ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)))⁻¹ *
          ∫ z, |cdfUpperError
            (Measure.map (fun w : ℝ => a * w) nu)
            (Measure.map (fun w : ℝ => a * w) gamma) z| := hgauss
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * b ^ 2))⁻¹ *
        (a * ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu gamma z|) := by
      rw [integral_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq nu gamma ha]
      rfl

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the normalized Gaussian `L¹ -> L∞`
estimate. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi *
        normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2))⁻¹ *
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N *
          ∫ z, |cdfLowerError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral N x

/-- Closed-form upper pointwise smoothing estimate. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  calc
    |cdfUpperError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi *
          normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 2))⁻¹ *
          (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N *
            ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) :=
      h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral N x
    _ = (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, normalizedGaussianDensityPeak_mul_keep]

/-- Closed-form lower pointwise smoothing estimate. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfLowerError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral_explicit N x

/-- The closed-form `L¹ -> L∞` estimate lifted to the upper one-sided CDF
distance. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.upperCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) :
    upperCDFDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    cdfUpperError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
        |cdfUpperError
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| :=
      le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ _ := h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral_explicit N x

/-- Lower one-sided distance companion to the closed-form smoothing bound. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.lowerCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) :
    lowerCDFDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfLowerError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  calc
    cdfLowerError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
        |cdfLowerError
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| :=
      le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ _ := h.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral_explicit N x

/-- The closed-form smoothing estimate for the full Kolmogorov distance. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  rw [kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed]
  apply max_le
  · exact h.upperCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral N
  · simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
      h.lowerCDFDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral N

/-- The compactly supported uniform smoothing kernel has a finite first
absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_abs_uniformSmoothingKernel {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) := by
  unfold uniformSmoothingKernel
  exact continuous_abs.integrableOn_Icc.integrable.smul_measure <| by
    exact ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by positivity))

/-- Convolution preserves finiteness of the first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments
    (κ μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure κ] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hκ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) κ)
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (κ ∗ μ) := by
  rw [Measure.conv]
  apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).mpr
  change Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => |p.1 + p.2|) (κ.prod μ)
  have hmajor : Integrable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => |p.1| + |p.2|) (κ.prod μ) :=
    (hκ1.comp_fst μ).add (hμ1.comp_snd κ)
  apply hmajor.mono' (by fun_prop)
  exact ae_of_all (κ.prod μ) fun p => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
    exact abs_add_le p.1 p.2

/-- Both uniformly smoothed laws have finite first moments, so their CDF
difference is integrable. -/
theorem integrable_cdf_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_sub
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
      cdf (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) x -
        cdf (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) x) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  exact integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments _ _
    (integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments _ _
      (integrable_abs_uniformSmoothingKernel hδ) hμ1)
    (integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments _ _
      (integrable_abs_uniformSmoothingKernel hδ) hν1)

/-- A CDF centered against the atom at zero.  Unlike a single probability
CDF, this function decays at both ends and is integrable under a first-moment
hypothesis. -/
noncomputable def centeredCDF (μ : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cdf μ x - cdf (Measure.dirac 0) x

/-- Pointwise kernel whose expectation is `centeredCDF`. -/
def centeredCDFKernel (y x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Ici y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x -
    (Ici (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x

@[simp] theorem cdf_dirac_zero (x : ℝ) :
    cdf (Measure.dirac (0 : ℝ)) x =
      (Ici (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
  rw [cdf_eq_real, Measure.real_def]
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x <;> simp [hx]

/-- The centered CDF is the expectation of the centered half-line kernel. -/
theorem centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : ℝ) :
    centeredCDF μ x = ∫ y, centeredCDFKernel y x ∂μ := by
  change cdf μ x - cdf (Measure.dirac 0) x =
    ∫ y, ((Ici y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x -
      (Ici (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) ∂μ
  have hfirst :
      (fun y : ℝ => (Ici y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
        (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext y
    simp [Set.indicator_apply]
  have hIntFirst : Integrable
      (fun y : ℝ => (Ici y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) μ := by
    rw [hfirst]
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  have hIntSecond : Integrable
      (fun _y : ℝ =>
        (Ici (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) μ :=
    integrable_const _
  rw [integral_sub hIntFirst hIntSecond, hfirst]
  congr 1
  · rw [cdf_eq_real]
    exact (integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Iic).symm
  · rw [cdf_dirac_zero, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

/-- A centered probability CDF is integrable under a finite first absolute
moment. -/
theorem integrable_centeredCDF
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ) :
    Integrable (centeredCDF μ) := by
  have hdirac : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.dirac 0) :=
    integrable_dirac (by simp)
  exact integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments μ (Measure.dirac 0) hμ1 hdirac

theorem centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos
    {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≤ 0) :
    centeredCDFKernel y = (Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  funext x
  simp only [centeredCDFKernel, Set.indicator_apply, mem_Ici, mem_Ico]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> linarith

theorem centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    centeredCDFKernel y = -(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
  funext x
  simp only [centeredCDFKernel, Set.indicator_apply, mem_Ici, mem_Ico,
    Pi.neg_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> linarith

/-- For fixed `y`, the centered half-line kernel is integrable in `x`. -/
theorem integrable_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (centeredCDFKernel y) := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    exact (integrableOn_const (s := Ico y 0) (C := (1 : ℝ)) (by simp)).integrable_indicator
      measurableSet_Ico
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos (lt_of_not_ge hy)]
    exact ((integrableOn_const (s := Ico 0 y) (C := (1 : ℝ)) (by simp)).integrable_indicator
      measurableSet_Ico).neg

/-- The exact `L¹` norm of the centered half-line kernel is the displacement
from its centering point. -/
theorem integral_norm_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ = |y| := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x‖) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
          by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx]
      _ = volume.real (Ico y 0) := integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ico
      _ = |y| := by rw [Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le hy, abs_of_nonpos hy]; ring
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(-(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) x‖) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
          by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx]
      _ = volume.real (Ico 0 y) := integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ico
      _ = |y| := by
        rw [Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le hy'.le, abs_of_pos hy']
        ring

/-- The signed spatial mass of one centered half-line kernel is its negative
displacement. -/
theorem integral_centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, centeredCDFKernel y x) = -y := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, (Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          volume.real (Ico y 0) := integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ico
      _ = -y := by rw [Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le hy]; ring
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    change (∫ x : ℝ,
      -((Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x)) = -y
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, -((Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x)) =
          -(∫ x : ℝ, (Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) :=
        integral_neg _
      _ = -(volume.real (Ico 0 y)) := by
        exact congrArg Neg.neg (integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ico)
      _ = -y := by rw [Real.volume_real_Ico_of_le hy'.le]; ring

/-- The first spatial moment of one centered half-line kernel is negative
one half of the squared displacement. -/
theorem integral_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, x * centeredCDFKernel y x) = -(y ^ 2) / 2 := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => x * (Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          (Ico y 0).indicator (fun x : ℝ => x) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx]
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, x * (Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          ∫ x in Ico y 0, x := by
        rw [hind, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico]
      _ = ∫ x in Ioc y 0, x := by rw [restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
      _ = ∫ x in y..0, x := (intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy).symm
      _ = -(y ^ 2) / 2 := by rw [integral_id]; ring
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => x * (-(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) x) =
          (fun x : ℝ => -((Ico 0 y).indicator (fun x : ℝ => x) x)) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx]
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, x * (-(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) x) =
          -(∫ x in Ico 0 y, x) := by
        rw [hind, integral_neg, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico]
      _ = -(∫ x in Ioc 0 y, x) := by rw [restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
      _ = -(∫ x in 0..y, x) := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy'.le]
      _ = -(y ^ 2) / 2 := by rw [integral_id]; ring

/-- The product of the spatial coordinate with a centered half-line kernel
is always nonpositive. -/
theorem id_mul_centeredCDFKernel_nonpos (y x : ℝ) :
    x * centeredCDFKernel y x ≤ 0 := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, mul_one]
      exact hx.2.le
    · simp [hx]
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y
    · simpa [hx] using (neg_nonpos.mpr hx.1)
    · simp [hx]

/-- Exact absolute first spatial moment of one centered half-line kernel. -/
theorem integral_norm_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, ‖x * centeredCDFKernel y x‖) = y ^ 2 / 2 := by
  have hpoint (x : ℝ) : ‖x * centeredCDFKernel y x‖ =
      -(x * centeredCDFKernel y x) := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (id_mul_centeredCDFKernel_nonpos y x)]
  simp_rw [hpoint, integral_neg, integral_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel]
  ring

/-- Multiplying a centered half-line kernel by the spatial coordinate
preserves integrability. -/
theorem integrable_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => x * centeredCDFKernel y x) := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    have hIco : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x) (Ico y 0) :=
      (integrableOn_Icc_iff_integrableOn_Ico).mp continuous_id.integrableOn_Icc
    have hInd := hIco.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ico
    convert hInd using 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx]
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    have hIco : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x) (Ico 0 y) :=
      (integrableOn_Icc_iff_integrableOn_Ico).mp continuous_id.integrableOn_Icc
    have hInd := (hIco.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ico).neg
    convert hInd using 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx]

/-- The exact squared-spatial-weight mass of one centered half-line kernel
is one third of the cubed displacement. -/
theorem integral_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖) = |y| ^ 3 / 3 := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 2 *
          ‖(Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x‖) =
          (Ico y 0).indicator (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx, sq_abs]
    rw [hind, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico,
      restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy, integral_pow]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hy]
    ring
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 2 *
          ‖(-(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) x‖) =
          (Ico 0 y).indicator (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx, sq_abs]
    rw [hind, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico,
      restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy'.le, integral_pow,
      abs_of_pos hy']
    ring

/-- The squared-spatial-weight norm of a centered half-line kernel is
integrable. -/
theorem integrable_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel (y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖) := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    have hIco : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (Ico y 0) :=
      (integrableOn_Icc_iff_integrableOn_Ico).mp
        ((continuous_id.pow 2).integrableOn_Icc)
    have hInd := hIco.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ico
    convert hInd using 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx, sq_abs]
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    have hIco : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (Ico 0 y) :=
      (integrableOn_Icc_iff_integrableOn_Ico).mp
        ((continuous_id.pow 2).integrableOn_Icc)
    have hInd := hIco.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Ico
    convert hInd using 1
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx, sq_abs]

/-- The oscillatory factor in Mathlib's normalized real Fourier transform. -/
noncomputable def normalizedFourierPhase (w x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * x * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

theorem continuous_normalizedFourierPhase (w : ℝ) :
    Continuous (normalizedFourierPhase w) := by
  apply Complex.continuous_exp.comp
  change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (((-2 * Real.pi * x * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
  fun_prop

/-- The Fourier integral of one centered half-line kernel, away from frequency
zero. This is the elementary interval calculation behind the CDF/characteristic-
function transform identity. -/
theorem integral_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    {w : ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) (y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ)) =
      (normalizedFourierPhase w y - 1) /
        (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
  let c : ℂ := (((-2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero) hw)
    · exact Complex.I_ne_zero
  have hphase (x : ℝ) : normalizedFourierPhase w x = Complex.exp (c * x) := by
    simp only [normalizedFourierPhase, c]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  by_cases hy : y ≤ 0
  · rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_indicator_of_nonpos hy]
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
          (((Ico y 0).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (Ico y 0).indicator (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico y 0 <;> simp [hx]
    rw [hind, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico]
    rw [restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy]
    simp_rw [hphase]
    rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
    have hd : (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = -c := by
      dsimp [c]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [show Complex.exp (c * (0 : ℝ)) = 1 by simp, ← hphase y, hd]
    field_simp
    ring
  · have hy' : 0 < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg_indicator_of_pos hy']
    have hind :
        (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
          (((-(Ico 0 y).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => -((Ico 0 y).indicator
            (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x) x)) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Ico 0 y <;> simp [hx]
    rw [hind, integral_neg, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ico]
    rw [restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy'.le]
    simp_rw [hphase]
    rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
    have hd : (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = -c := by
      dsimp [c]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [show Complex.exp (c * (0 : ℝ)) = 1 by simp, ← hphase y, hd]
    field_simp

/-- Joint measurability of the centered half-line kernel in displacement and
evaluation point. -/
theorem measurable_centeredCDFKernel_uncurry :
    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2) := by
  simp only [centeredCDFKernel, Set.indicator_apply, mem_Ici]
  apply Measurable.sub
  · exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_fst measurable_snd)
      measurable_const measurable_const
  · exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_const measurable_snd)
      measurable_const measurable_const

/-- Multiplication by the normalized Fourier phase preserves integrability of
each centered half-line kernel section. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    (w y : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
      (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ)) := by
  apply (integrable_centeredCDFKernel y).ofReal.bdd_mul (c := 1)
  · exact (continuous_normalizedFourierPhase w).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
      change ‖Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * x * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

/-- The normalized Fourier phase has unit norm, so the oscillatory kernel has
the same exact `L¹` norm as the underlying centered half-line kernel. -/
theorem integral_norm_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    (w y : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, ‖normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ)‖) = |y| := by
  simp_rw [norm_mul, normalizedFourierPhase,
    Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  exact integral_norm_centeredCDFKernel y

/-- Exact first-moment domination makes the centered-CDF Fourier kernel
integrable on the product space, which licenses Fubini. -/
theorem integrable_prod_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) (w : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w p.2 *
      (centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2 : ℂ)) (mu.prod volume) := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w p.2 *
      (centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2 : ℂ)) := by
    exact ((continuous_normalizedFourierPhase w).measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_centeredCDFKernel_uncurry)
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable]
  constructor
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun y =>
      integrable_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel w y
  · convert hmu1 using 1
    funext y
    exact integral_norm_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel w y

/-- Exact first-moment domination makes the real centered-CDF kernel
integrable on the product space. -/
theorem integrable_prod_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2)
      (mu.prod volume) := by
  have h :=
    (integrable_prod_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu1 0).re
  simpa [normalizedFourierPhase] using h

/-- A finite second moment makes the coordinate-weighted centered-CDF
kernel integrable on the product space. -/
theorem integrable_prod_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      p.2 * centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2) (mu.prod volume) := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      p.2 * centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2) :=
    measurable_snd.mul measurable_centeredCDFKernel_uncurry
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable]
  constructor
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun y => integrable_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel y
  · have hhalf : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 / 2) mu := by
      convert hmu2.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) using 1
      funext y
      ring
    convert hhalf using 1
    funext y
    exact integral_norm_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel y

/-- A finite third absolute moment makes the squared-spatial-weight kernel
norm integrable on the product space. -/
theorem integrable_prod_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      |p.2| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2‖) (mu.prod volume) := by
  have hmeas : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      |p.2| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2‖) :=
    ((continuous_abs.measurable.comp measurable_snd).pow_const 2).mul
      measurable_centeredCDFKernel_uncurry.norm
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable]
  constructor
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun y =>
      integrable_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel y
  · have hthird : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3 / 3) mu := by
      convert hmu3.const_mul (1 / 3 : ℝ) using 1
      funext y
      ring
    convert hthird using 1
    funext y
    simpa only [Prod.snd, Prod.fst, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow,
      abs_abs] using integral_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel y

/-- Signed squared-spatial-weight kernel integrability, obtained from its
exact norm majorant. -/
theorem integrable_prod_sq_mul_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      p.2 ^ 2 * centeredCDFKernel p.1 p.2) (mu.prod volume) := by
  apply (integrable_prod_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu3).mono'
  · exact ((measurable_snd.pow_const 2).mul
      measurable_centeredCDFKernel_uncurry).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun p => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- The spatial integral of a centered probability CDF is the negative
first moment of the law. -/
theorem integral_centeredCDF_eq_neg_integral_id
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) :
    (∫ x, centeredCDF mu x) = -(∫ y, y ∂mu) := by
  simp_rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel]
  have hprod := integrable_prod_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu1
  have hswap : Integrable
      (Function.uncurry (fun x y : ℝ => centeredCDFKernel y x))
        (volume.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Function.comp_apply] using hprod.swap
  rw [integral_integral_swap hswap]
  simpa only [integral_centeredCDFKernel_eq_neg] using
    (integral_neg (μ := mu) (f := fun y : ℝ => y))

/-- A centered probability CDF has an integrable coordinate-weighted form
under a finite second moment. -/
theorem integrable_id_mul_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu) :
    Integrable (fun x => x * centeredCDF mu x) := by
  have hprod := integrable_prod_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu2
  have hout := hprod.swap.integral_prod_left
  convert hout using 1
  funext x
  change x * centeredCDF mu x =
    ∫ y, x * centeredCDFKernel y x ∂mu
  rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel, integral_const_mul]

/-- The first spatial moment of a centered probability CDF is negative one
half of the law's second moment. -/
theorem integral_id_mul_centeredCDF_eq_neg_half_secondMoment
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu) :
    (∫ x, x * centeredCDF mu x) =
      -(∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) / 2 := by
  rw [show (fun x => x * centeredCDF mu x) =
      (fun x => ∫ y, x * centeredCDFKernel y x ∂mu) by
    funext x
    rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel, integral_const_mul]]
  have hprod := integrable_prod_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu2
  have hswap : Integrable
      (Function.uncurry (fun x y : ℝ =>
        x * centeredCDFKernel y x)) (volume.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Function.comp_apply] using hprod.swap
  rw [integral_integral_swap hswap]
  simp_rw [integral_id_mul_centeredCDFKernel, integral_div, integral_neg]

/-- A centered probability CDF becomes integrable after multiplication by
the squared spatial coordinate under a finite third absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    Integrable (fun x => x ^ 2 * centeredCDF mu x) := by
  have hprod := integrable_prod_sq_mul_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu3
  have hout := hprod.swap.integral_prod_left
  convert hout using 1
  funext x
  change x ^ 2 * centeredCDF mu x =
    ∫ y, x ^ 2 * centeredCDFKernel y x ∂mu
  rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel, integral_const_mul]

/-- The squared-spatial-weight `L¹` norm of a centered CDF is bounded by one
third of the law's third absolute moment. -/
theorem integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_centeredCDF_le
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) ≤
      ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂mu := by
  have hsigned := integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF mu hmu3
  have hleft : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow] using hsigned.norm
  have habsprod :=
    integrable_prod_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu3
  have hswap : Integrable
      (Function.uncurry (fun x y : ℝ =>
        |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖)) (volume.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Function.comp_apply] using
      habsprod.swap
  have hright : Integrable (fun x =>
      ∫ y, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu) :=
    hswap.integral_prod_left
  calc
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) ≤
        ∫ x, (∫ y, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu) := by
      apply integral_mono hleft hright
      intro x
      change |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x| ≤
        ∫ y, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu
      rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel]
