      have hnorm : |∫ y, centeredCDFKernel y x ∂mu| ≤
          ∫ y, ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          (norm_integral_le_integral_norm
            (fun y => centeredCDFKernel y x) (μ := mu))
      calc
        |x| ^ 2 * |∫ y, centeredCDFKernel y x ∂mu| ≤
            |x| ^ 2 * ∫ y, ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm (sq_nonneg |x|)
        _ = ∫ y, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖ ∂mu := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ = ∫ y, (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * ‖centeredCDFKernel y x‖) ∂mu :=
      integral_integral_swap hswap
    _ = ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun y =>
        integral_abs_sq_mul_norm_centeredCDFKernel y

/-- The spatial integral of a difference of probability CDFs is the reverse
difference of their first moments. -/
theorem integral_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_integral_id_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu) :
    (∫ x, cdf mu x - cdf nu x) =
      (∫ y, y ∂nu) - ∫ y, y ∂mu := by
  have hmuC := integrable_centeredCDF mu hmu1
  have hnuC := integrable_centeredCDF nu hnu1
  calc
    (∫ x, cdf mu x - cdf nu x) =
        ∫ x, centeredCDF mu x - centeredCDF nu x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by unfold centeredCDF; ring
    _ = (∫ x, centeredCDF mu x) - ∫ x, centeredCDF nu x :=
      integral_sub hmuC hnuC
    _ = (∫ y, y ∂nu) - ∫ y, y ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_centeredCDF_eq_neg_integral_id mu hmu1,
        integral_centeredCDF_eq_neg_integral_id nu hnu1]
      ring

/-- The first spatial moment of a probability-CDF difference is one half
of the reverse difference of the laws' second moments. -/
theorem integral_id_mul_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_secondMoment_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) nu) :
    (∫ x, x * (cdf mu x - cdf nu x)) =
      ((∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu) - ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) / 2 := by
  have hmuC := integrable_id_mul_centeredCDF mu hmu2
  have hnuC := integrable_id_mul_centeredCDF nu hnu2
  calc
    (∫ x, x * (cdf mu x - cdf nu x)) =
        ∫ x, x * centeredCDF mu x - x * centeredCDF nu x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by unfold centeredCDF; ring
    _ = (∫ x, x * centeredCDF mu x) -
        ∫ x, x * centeredCDF nu x := integral_sub hmuC hnuC
    _ = ((∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂nu) - ∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) / 2 := by
      rw [integral_id_mul_centeredCDF_eq_neg_half_secondMoment mu hmu2,
        integral_id_mul_centeredCDF_eq_neg_half_secondMoment nu hnu2]
      ring

/-- A third absolute moment controls the squared-spatial-weight `L¹` norm
of the difference of two probability CDFs. -/
theorem integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdf_sub_cdf_le
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|) ≤
      (∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂nu := by
  have hmuSigned := integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF mu hmu3
  have hnuSigned := integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF nu hnu3
  have hmuW : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow] using hmuSigned.norm
  have hnuW : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow] using hnuSigned.norm
  have hpoint (x : ℝ) :
      |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x| ≤
        |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x| +
          |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x| := by
    have heq : cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
        centeredCDF mu x - centeredCDF nu x := by
      unfold centeredCDF
      ring
    rw [heq, ← mul_add]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub _ _)
      (sq_nonneg |x|)
  have hgapMeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|) :=
    (((measurable_id.abs.pow_const 2).mul
      (((monotone_cdf mu).measurable.sub
        (monotone_cdf nu).measurable).abs))).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hgap : Integrable
      (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|) := by
    apply (hmuW.add hnuW).mono' hgapMeas
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg |x|) (abs_nonneg _))]
      exact hpoint x
  calc
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|) ≤
        ∫ x, (|x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x| +
          |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x|) := by
      apply integral_mono hgap (hmuW.add hnuW)
      exact hpoint
    _ = (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) +
        ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x| :=
      integral_add hmuW hnuW
    _ ≤ (∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂mu) + ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂nu :=
      add_le_add
        (integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_centeredCDF_le mu hmu3)
        (integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_centeredCDF_le nu hnu3)

/-- The weighted CDF difference appearing in the third-moment estimate is
itself integrable. -/
theorem integrable_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdf_sub_cdf
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x|) := by
  have hmuSigned := integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF mu hmu3
  have hnuSigned := integrable_sq_mul_centeredCDF nu hnu3
  have hmuW : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow] using hmuSigned.norm
  have hnuW : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x|) := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow] using hnuSigned.norm
  apply (hmuW.add hnuW).mono'
  · exact (((measurable_id.abs.pow_const 2).mul
      (((monotone_cdf mu).measurable.sub
        (monotone_cdf nu).measurable).abs))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg |x|) (abs_nonneg _))]
      have heq : cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
          centeredCDF mu x - centeredCDF nu x := by
        unfold centeredCDF
        ring
      change |x| ^ 2 * |cdf mu x - cdf nu x| ≤
        |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF mu x| +
          |x| ^ 2 * |centeredCDF nu x|
      rw [heq, ← mul_add]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_sub _ _)
        (sq_nonneg |x|)

/-- Weighted Markov estimate for the spatial tail of an integrable real
function. -/
theorem integral_abs_restrict_abs_ge_le_inv_sq_mul
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hweighted : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |f x|))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |f x|) ≤
      (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |f x| := by
  let s : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}
  have hs : MeasurableSet s :=
    measurableSet_le measurable_const continuous_abs.measurable
  have hInv : 0 ≤ (R ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg R)
  have hpoint {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ s) :
      |f x| ≤ (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (|x| ^ 2 * |f x|) := by
    have hxR : R ≤ |x| := hx
    have hsq : R ^ 2 ≤ |x| ^ 2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
    calc
      |f x| = (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (R ^ 2 * |f x|) := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (|x| ^ 2 * |f x|) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (abs_nonneg (f x))) hInv
  have hmajor : Integrable
      (fun x => (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (|x| ^ 2 * |f x|)) :=
    hweighted.const_mul _
  have hleft : IntegrableOn (fun x => |f x|) s := by
    apply hmajor.integrableOn.mono' hf.abs.aestronglyMeasurable
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hs fun x hx => ?_
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] using hpoint hx
  calc
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |f x|) = ∫ x in s, |f x| := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ x in s, (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (|x| ^ 2 * |f x|) := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hleft hmajor.integrableOn
      exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hs fun x hx => hpoint hx
    _ = (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x in s, |x| ^ 2 * |f x| := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |f x| := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hInv
      exact setIntegral_le_integral hweighted
        (ae_of_all _ fun x =>
          mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg |x|) (abs_nonneg (f x)))

/-- On a central interval, the absolute upper signed CDF error integrates to
at most the interval length times Kolmogorov distance. -/
theorem integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_lt_le
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | |x| < R}, |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  have hset : {x : ℝ | |x| < R} = Ioo (-R) R := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_Ioo]
    exact abs_lt
  have hleft : IntegrableOn (fun x => |cdfUpperError mu nu x|)
      (Ioo (-R) R) := by
    have hmu : Integrable (fun x => cdf mu x)
        (volume.restrict (Ioo (-R) R)) :=
      integrable_cdf_comp mu _ measurable_id
    have hnu : Integrable (fun x => cdf nu x)
        (volume.restrict (Ioo (-R) R)) :=
      integrable_cdf_comp nu _ measurable_id
    simpa only [cdfUpperError, Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hmu.sub hnu).norm
  have hright : IntegrableOn
      (fun _x : ℝ => kolmogorovDistance mu nu) (Ioo (-R) R) :=
    integrableOn_const (by simp)
  rw [hset]
  calc
    (∫ x in Ioo (-R) R, |cdfUpperError mu nu x|) ≤
        ∫ _x in Ioo (-R) R, kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
      apply integral_mono hleft hright
      intro x
      simpa only [cdfGap, cdfUpperError] using
        cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
    _ = 2 * R * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
      rw [setIntegral_const,
        Real.volume_real_Ioo_of_le (by linarith)]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      ring

/-- Central-interval companion for the lower signed CDF error. -/
theorem integral_abs_cdfLowerError_restrict_abs_lt_le
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | |x| < R}, |cdfLowerError mu nu x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_lt_le mu nu hR

/-- The signed upper CDF error of every standardized law has zero spatial
mass against the standard normal. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_cdfUpperError_standardNormal
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) = 0 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  have hnuAbs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h.integrable_id.norm
  have hgaussAbs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using integrable_standardNormal_id.norm
  unfold cdfUpperError
  rw [integral_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_integral_id_sub _ _ hnuAbs hgaussAbs,
    h.centered, integral_standardNormal_id]
  ring

/-- The signed upper CDF error of every standardized law also has zero first
spatial moment against the standard normal. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_id_mul_cdfUpperError_standardNormal
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, x * cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) = 0 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  unfold cdfUpperError
  rw [integral_id_mul_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_secondMoment_sub _ _
      h.integrable_sq integrable_standardNormal_sq,
    h.unit_second_moment, integral_standardNormal_sq]
  ring

/-- Lower signed-error companion to
`IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_cdfUpperError_standardNormal`. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_cdfLowerError_standardNormal
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) = 0 := by
  simp only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, integral_neg,
    h.integral_cdfUpperError_standardNormal, neg_zero]

/-- First-spatial-moment companion for the lower signed CDF error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_id_mul_cdfLowerError_standardNormal
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, x * cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) = 0 := by
  simp only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, mul_neg, integral_neg,
    h.integral_id_mul_cdfUpperError_standardNormal, neg_zero]

/-- Third-moment weighted `L¹` control of the standardized upper signed CDF
error against the standard normal. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  unfold cdfUpperError
  calc
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdf nu x - cdf
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
        (∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3 ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3 / 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw :=
      integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdf_sub_cdf_le _ _
        h.integrable_abs_cube integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube
    _ = ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3 := by
      rw [integral_div, integral_div]
      ring

/-- The same weighted control for the lower signed CDF error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfLowerError_le
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3 := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le

/-- Outside-radius `L¹` tail bound for the upper standardized signed CDF
error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  have hmeas : Measurable (cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    (monotone_cdf nu).measurable.sub
      (monotone_cdf
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).measurable
  have hweighted : Integrable (fun x => |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) := by
    unfold cdfUpperError
    exact integrable_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdf_sub_cdf _ _
      h.integrable_abs_cube integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube
  calc
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfUpperError nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| :=
      integral_abs_restrict_abs_ge_le_inv_sq_mul _ hmeas hweighted hR
    _ ≤ (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg R))

/-- Outside-radius companion for the lower standardized signed CDF error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfLowerError_restrict_abs_ge_le
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le hR

/-- Combined central/tail `L¹` estimate for the upper standardized signed
CDF error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x, |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  let s : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | |x| < R}
  have hs : MeasurableSet s :=
    measurableSet_lt continuous_abs.measurable measurable_const
  have hcompl : sᶜ = {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|} := by
    ext x
    simp only [s, mem_compl_iff, mem_setOf_eq]
    exact not_lt
  have hnuAbs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h.integrable_id.norm
  have hgaussAbs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using integrable_standardNormal_id.norm
  have herr : Integrable (fun x => |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) := by
    unfold cdfUpperError
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments _ _ hnuAbs hgaussAbs).norm
  calc
    (∫ x, |cdfUpperError nu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) =
        (∫ x in s, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) +
        ∫ x in sᶜ, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| :=
      (integral_add_compl hs herr).symm
    _ = (∫ x in {x : ℝ | |x| < R}, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) +
        ∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfUpperError nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| := by
      rw [hcompl]
    _ ≤ 2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) :=
      add_le_add
        (integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_lt_le _ _ hR.le)
        (h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le hR)

/-- Combined central/tail companion for the lower standardized signed CDF
error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfLowerError_le_central_tail
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x, |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) / 3) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail hR

/-- Away from frequency zero, the normalized Fourier transform of a centered
probability CDF is its characteristic-function increment divided by `2πwi`. -/
theorem fourier_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {w : ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ)) w =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-2 * Real.pi * w) - 1) /
        (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
  rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
  change (∫ x, normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ)) = _
  have hcenter (x : ℝ) :
      (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ) = ∫ y, (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ) ∂mu := by
    rw [centeredCDF_eq_integral_kernel]
    exact (integral_complex_ofReal (μ := mu)
      (f := fun y => centeredCDFKernel y x)).symm
  have hmul (x : ℝ) :
      normalizedFourierPhase w x *
          (∫ y, (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ) ∂mu) =
        ∫ y, normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ) ∂mu := by
    exact (integral_const_mul (μ := mu) (normalizedFourierPhase w x)
      (fun y => (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ))).symm
  simp_rw [hcenter, hmul]
  have hprod :=
    integrable_prod_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel mu hmu1 w
  have hswap : Integrable
      (Function.uncurry (fun x y : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
        (centeredCDFKernel y x : ℂ))) (volume.prod mu) := by
    simpa only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, Function.comp_apply] using hprod.swap
  rw [integral_integral_swap hswap]
  simp_rw [integral_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDFKernel hw]
  have hphaseInt : Integrable (normalizedFourierPhase w) mu := by
    have hone : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) mu := integrable_const (1 : ℂ)
    simpa only [mul_one] using hone.bdd_mul (c := 1)
      (continuous_normalizedFourierPhase w).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all mu fun x => by
        change ‖Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * x * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ 1
        rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I])
  have hchar :
      (∫ y, normalizedFourierPhase w y ∂mu) =
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-2 * Real.pi * w) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
      simp only [normalizedFourierPhase]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
  let d : ℂ := (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  calc
    (∫ y, (normalizedFourierPhase w y - 1) / d ∂mu) =
        (∫ y, normalizedFourierPhase w y - 1 ∂mu) / d :=
      integral_div d (fun y => normalizedFourierPhase w y - 1)
    _ = ((∫ y, normalizedFourierPhase w y ∂mu) -
          ∫ _y : ℝ, (1 : ℂ) ∂mu) / d := by
      rw [integral_sub hphaseInt (integrable_const (1 : ℂ))]
    _ = (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-2 * Real.pi * w) - 1) / d := by
      rw [hchar, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

/-- The normalized Fourier phase preserves integrability of a centered CDF. -/
theorem integrable_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) (w : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
      (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ)) := by
  apply (integrable_centeredCDF mu hmu1).ofReal.bdd_mul (c := 1)
  · exact (continuous_normalizedFourierPhase w).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
      change ‖Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * x * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ 1
      rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

/-- Subtracting two centered-CDF identities cancels the common Dirac term and
gives the Fourier transform of the ordinary CDF difference. -/
theorem fourier_cdf_sub_cdf
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {w : ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ)) w =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-2 * Real.pi * w) -
        MeasureTheory.charFun nu (-2 * Real.pi * w)) /
          (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
  rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
  change (∫ x, normalizedFourierPhase w x *
    ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ)) = _
  have hfun :
      (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
        ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => normalizedFourierPhase w x *
          (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ) - normalizedFourierPhase w x *
            (centeredCDF nu x : ℂ)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [centeredCDF]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  rw [integral_sub
    (integrable_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDF mu hmu1 w)
    (integrable_normalizedFourierPhase_mul_centeredCDF nu hnu1 w)]
  have hmuFormula :
      (∫ x, normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDF mu x : ℂ)) =
        (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-2 * Real.pi * w) - 1) /
          (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    simpa only [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      normalizedFourierPhase] using fourier_centeredCDF mu hmu1 hw
  have hnuFormula :
      (∫ x, normalizedFourierPhase w x * (centeredCDF nu x : ℂ)) =
        (MeasureTheory.charFun nu (-2 * Real.pi * w) - 1) /
          (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    simpa only [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, smul_eq_mul,
      normalizedFourierPhase] using fourier_centeredCDF nu hnu1 hw
  rw [hmuFormula, hnuFormula]
  have hd : (((2 * Real.pi * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
        (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero) hw)
    · exact Complex.I_ne_zero
  field_simp [hd]
  ring

/-- The norm of the transformed CDF difference is exactly the characteristic-
function discrepancy quotient at the normalized frequency. -/
theorem norm_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {w : ℝ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ‖𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ)) w‖ =
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu (-2 * Real.pi * w) := by
  have ht : -2 * Real.pi * w ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero) hw
  rw [fourier_cdf_sub_cdf mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hw,
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht, norm_div, norm_mul,
    Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  congr 1
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * w = -(2 * Real.pi * w) by ring, abs_neg]

/-- Any globally integrable characteristic-function discrepancy quotient makes
the Fourier transform of the corresponding CDF difference integrable. -/
theorem integrable_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_of_integrable_discrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    (hquot : Integrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu)) :
    Integrable (𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => ((cdf mu x - cdf nu x : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hf : Integrable f :=
    (integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments mu nu hmu1 hnu1).ofReal
  have hFourierCont : Continuous (𝓕 f) := by
    exact VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous
      Real.continuous_fourierChar continuous_inner hf
  have hscale : Integrable (fun w : ℝ =>
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu ((-2 * Real.pi) * w)) :=
    hquot.comp_mul_left' (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero)
  have hnorm : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ‖𝓕 f w‖) := by
    apply hscale.congr
    filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (0 : ℝ)] with w hw
    dsimp only [f]
    convert (norm_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hw).symm using 1
  exact (integrable_norm_iff hFourierCont.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hnorm

/-- Convolution by a common probability smoothing measure cannot increase
the pointwise characteristic-function discrepancy. -/
theorem norm_charFun_conv_sub_charFun_conv_le
    (μ ν κ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure κ] (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun (κ ∗ μ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun (κ ∗ ν) t‖ ≤
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ := by
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, ← mul_sub,
    norm_mul]
  calc
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun κ t‖ *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ ≤
        1 * ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
        (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := one_mul _

/-- Exact characteristic-function damping supplied by the normalized uniform
kernel. -/
theorem norm_charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_sub
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) t‖ =
      |Real.sinc (t * δ)| *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, MeasureTheory.charFun_conv,
    charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel hδ, ← mul_sub, norm_mul]
  simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- Away from the origin, uniform smoothing upgrades the discrepancy quotient
to inverse-square decay. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) t ≤
      2 * δ⁻¹ * (|t| ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht,
    norm_charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_sub μ ν hδ]
  have htd : t * δ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ht hδ.ne'
  have hsinc := abs_sinc_le_inv_abs htd
  have hdiff :
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ ≤
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t‖ + ‖MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ :=
        norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := add_le_add
        (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
        (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  calc
    |Real.sinc (t * δ)| *
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun μ t - MeasureTheory.charFun ν t‖ / |t| ≤
        |t * δ|⁻¹ * 2 / |t| := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul hsinc hdiff (norm_nonneg _)
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _))) (abs_nonneg t)
    _ = 2 * δ⁻¹ * (|t| ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hδ]
      field_simp [abs_ne_zero.mpr ht, hδ.ne']

theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_le
    (μ ν κ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] [IsProbabilityMeasure κ] (t : ℝ) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient (κ ∗ μ) (κ ∗ ν) t ≤
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient μ ν t := by
  unfold charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
  split_ifs with ht
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_charFun_conv_sub_charFun_conv_le μ ν κ t) (abs_nonneg t)

/-- Uniform convolution makes the characteristic-function discrepancy
quotient globally integrable: first moments control the removable singularity
and the sinc multiplier supplies inverse-square decay at infinity. -/
theorem integrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv
    {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμ1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) μ)
    (hν1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ν)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Integrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν)) volume := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hδ
  let M : ℝ := (∫ x, |x| ∂μ) + ∫ x, |x| ∂ν
  let C : ℝ := 2 * M + 4 * δ⁻¹
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    dsimp only [M]
    exact add_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hδinv : 0 ≤ δ⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hδ.le
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp only [C]
    positivity
  have hMajorant : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => C * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
    integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul C
  refine hMajorant.mono'
    (stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all volume fun t => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg _ _ t)]
  have hlocal :
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) t ≤ M :=
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_le μ ν (uniformSmoothingKernel δ) t).trans <| by
      simpa only [M] using charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_le_firstMoments hμ1 hν1 t
  have hden : 0 < 1 + t ^ 2 := by positivity
  by_cases htSmall : |t| ≤ 1
  · have htSq : t ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have hsq : |t| ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) (sub_nonneg.mpr htSmall)]
      simpa only [sq_abs] using hsq
    have hMmajor : M ≤ (2 * M) * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hden]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hM (sub_nonneg.mpr htSq)]
    calc
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) t ≤ M := hlocal
      _ ≤ (2 * M) * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := hMmajor
      _ ≤ C * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hden.le)
        dsimp only [C]
        nlinarith
  · have htLarge : 1 < |t| := lt_of_not_ge htSmall
    have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
      intro ht0
      subst t
      norm_num at htLarge
    have habsSq : 0 < |t| ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (abs_pos.mpr ht)
    have hdenle : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (|t| ^ 2) := by
      have hone : 1 ≤ |t| := htLarge.le
      have hsquare : 1 ≤ |t| ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) (sub_nonneg.mpr hone)]
      rw [sq_abs] at hsquare ⊢
      nlinarith
    have htail :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le μ ν hδ ht
    have htailMajor :
        2 * δ⁻¹ * (|t| ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤
          (4 * δ⁻¹) * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      change (2 * δ⁻¹) / (|t| ^ 2) ≤
        (4 * δ⁻¹) / (1 + t ^ 2)
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ habsSq hden]
      calc
        (2 * δ⁻¹) * (1 + t ^ 2) ≤
            (2 * δ⁻¹) * (2 * |t| ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdenle
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hδinv)
        _ = (4 * δ⁻¹) * |t| ^ 2 := by ring
    calc
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ μ) (uniformSmoothingKernel δ ∗ ν) t ≤
          2 * δ⁻¹ * (|t| ^ 2)⁻¹ := htail
      _ ≤ (4 * δ⁻¹) * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := htailMajor
      _ ≤ C * (1 + t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hden.le)
        dsimp only [C]
        nlinarith

/-- A pointwise Fourier-inversion estimate in Mathlib's normalized Fourier
convention.  It packages the analytic conclusion needed after identifying the
Fourier transform of a smoothed CDF difference. -/
theorem norm_le_integral_norm_fourier
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) (hFourier : Integrable (𝓕 f))
    {x : ℝ} (hcont : ContinuousAt f x) :
    ‖f x‖ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ‖𝓕 f t‖ := by
  rw [← hf.fourierInv_fourier_eq hFourier hcont, Real.fourierInv_eq]
  exact (norm_integral_le_integral_norm
    (μ := volume) (fun t : ℝ => 𝐞 (inner ℝ t x) • (𝓕 f) t)).trans_eq <| by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all volume fun t => Circle.norm_smul _ _

/-- Fourier inversion bounds the pointwise CDF gap between two uniformly
smoothed laws by the globally integrable, normalized characteristic-function
discrepancy quotient. -/
theorem cdfGap_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) x ≤
      ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel delta) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hdelta
  have hkappa1 := integrable_abs_uniformSmoothingKernel hdelta
  have hmuConv1 := integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments
    (uniformSmoothingKernel delta) mu hkappa1 hmu1
  have hnuConv1 := integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments
    (uniformSmoothingKernel delta) nu hkappa1 hnu1
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun y =>
    ((cdf (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu) y -
      cdf (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) y : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hf : Integrable f :=
    (integrable_cdf_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_sub mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hdelta).ofReal
  have hquot :=
    integrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv
      hmu1 hnu1 hdelta
  have hFourier : Integrable (𝓕 f) := by
    exact integrable_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_of_integrable_discrepancy
      (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
      (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) hmuConv1 hnuConv1 hquot
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    apply Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
    exact (continuous_cdf_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv mu hdelta).sub
      (continuous_cdf_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv nu hdelta)
  have hinv : ‖f x‖ ≤ ∫ w : ℝ, ‖𝓕 f w‖ :=
    norm_le_integral_norm_fourier f hf hFourier (x := x) hcont.continuousAt
  calc
    cdfGap (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) x = ‖f x‖ := by
      simp only [cdfGap, f, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ∫ w : ℝ, ‖𝓕 f w‖ := hinv
    _ = ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (0 : ℝ)] with w hw
      dsimp only [f]
      convert norm_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) hmuConv1 hnuConv1 hw using 1

/-- The same inversion estimate after the exact `-2π` change of variables. -/
theorem cdfGap_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy_scaled
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) x ≤
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) t := by
  calc
    cdfGap (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) x ≤
      ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) :=
      cdfGap_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hdelta x
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ nu) t := by
      rw [Measure.integral_comp_mul_left]
      have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
      rw [show |(-2 * Real.pi)⁻¹| = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ by
        rw [abs_inv, show -2 * Real.pi = -(2 * Real.pi) by ring,
          abs_neg, abs_of_pos hpi]]
      rfl

/-- Uniform comparison of two smoothed CDFs gives a shifted sandwich for the
underlying CDFs.  This is the deterministic interface between a compact
smoothing kernel and the Fourier estimate of the smoothed functions. -/
theorem cdf_shift_bounds_of_smoothing_approximation
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) {Hμ Hν : ℝ → ℝ} {δ ε : ℝ}
    (hμ : CDFSmoothingApproximation μ Hμ δ)
    (hν : CDFSmoothingApproximation ν Hν δ)
    (hdiff : ∀ x, |Hμ x - Hν x| ≤ ε) :
    (∀ x, cdf ν (x - 2 * δ) - ε ≤ cdf μ x) ∧
      (∀ x, cdf μ x ≤ cdf ν (x + 2 * δ) + ε) := by
  constructor
  · intro x
    have hνLeft := (hν (x - δ)).1
    have hμRight := (hμ (x - δ)).2
    have hcompare := (abs_le.mp (hdiff (x - δ))).1
    have hνLeft' : cdf ν (x - 2 * δ) ≤ Hν (x - δ) := by
      convert hνLeft using 1; ring
    have hμRight' : Hμ (x - δ) ≤ cdf μ x := by
      convert hμRight using 1; ring
    linarith
  · intro x
    have hμLeft := (hμ (x + δ)).1
    have hνRight := (hν (x + δ)).2
    have hcompare := (abs_le.mp (hdiff (x + δ))).2
    have hμLeft' : cdf μ x ≤ Hμ (x + δ) := by
      convert hμLeft using 1; ring
    have hνRight' : Hν (x + δ) ≤ cdf ν (x + 2 * δ) := by
      convert hνRight using 1; ring
    linarith

/-- Standard-normal Kolmogorov consequence of comparing two smoothed CDFs.
The remaining Berry--Esseen Fourier step can therefore target only the
uniform error `ε` between the smoothed functions. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_of_smoothing_approximation
    (μ : Measure ℝ) {Hμ Hγ : ℝ → ℝ} {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hμ : CDFSmoothingApproximation μ Hμ δ)
    (hγ : CDFSmoothingApproximation
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw Hγ δ)
    (hdiff : ∀ x, |Hμ x - Hγ x| ≤ ε) :
    kolmogorovDistance μ
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ε + (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * δ) := by
  rcases cdf_shift_bounds_of_smoothing_approximation
      μ NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hμ hγ hdiff with ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  exact kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_of_shift_bounds μ
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hδ) hlower hupper

/-- The Chapter 1 standard-normal law has a finite first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have hid : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x)
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    apply ProbabilityTheory.integrable_of_mem_interior_integrableExpSet
    simp
  simpa only [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    Real.norm_eq_abs] using hid.norm

/-- Exact first absolute moment of the standard normal law. -/
theorem integral_standardNormal_abs :
    (∫ x : ℝ, |x|
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  rw [show (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) * |x|) =
      fun x => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
        (|x| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) by
      funext x; ring,
    integral_const_mul]
  have hEven :
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) =
        2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (fun z : ℝ => z * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2)) |x| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with x
        rw [sq_abs]
      _ = 2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) :=
        integral_comp_abs (f := fun z : ℝ => z * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2))
  rw [hEven,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.GaussianTails.integral_Ioi_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two]
  simp
  ring

/-- Exact third absolute moment of the standard normal law. -/
theorem integral_standardNormal_abs_cube :
    (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
  rw [show (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) * |x| ^ 3) =
      fun x => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
        (|x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) by
      funext x
      ring,
    integral_const_mul]
  have hHalf :
      (∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) = 2 := by
    convert (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
      (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (3 : ℝ)) (b := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) using 1
    · apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro x hx
      simp only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [show ((3 : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num,
        Real.Gamma_add_one one_ne_zero, Real.Gamma_one]
      norm_num
  have hEven :
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) =
        2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2)) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2)) |x| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [] with x
        rw [sq_abs]
      _ = 2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) :=
        integral_comp_abs (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(z ^ 2) / 2))
  rw [hEven, hHalf]
  ring

/-- The real Fourier transform of the unnormalized standard Gaussian. -/
theorem integral_rexp_neg_sq_div_two_mul_cos (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
  let h : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 t : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hh : Integrable h := by
    have hpdfCont : Continuous
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1) := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_def]
      fun_prop
    have hcont : Continuous h :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hpdfCont).mul (by fun_prop)
    rw [← integrable_norm_iff hcont.aestronglyMeasurable]
    convert ProbabilityTheory.integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1 using 1
    funext t
    dsimp only [h]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 t),
      Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
  have hcf :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun x
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
    ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul
      (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)] at hcf
  have hcf' : (∫ t : ℝ, h t) =
      Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) := by
    simpa only [h, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul] using hcf
  have hreal := congrArg Complex.re hcf'
  have hreal' : (∫ t : ℝ, (h t).re) =
      (Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)).re :=
    (integral_re hh).trans hreal
  have hrhs : (Complex.exp (-(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)).re =
      Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
    rw [show -(x : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 = ((-(x ^ 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by
      push_cast
      ring,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_re]
  have hnormalized :
      (∫ t : ℝ,
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) =
        Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
    rw [hrhs] at hreal'
    calc
      (∫ t : ℝ, (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) =
          ∫ t : ℝ, ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by ring
      _ = Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
        simpa only [h, Complex.real_smul,
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, zero_mul, sub_zero] using hreal'
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hnormalized
  have hR : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  calc
    (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) =
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) *
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) := by
      field_simp [hR.ne']
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
        dsimp only
        rw [mul_comm t x]
    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
      rw [hnormalized]

/-- The exact positive-frequency half of the Gaussian cosine transform. -/
theorem integral_Ioi_rexp_neg_sq_div_two_mul_cos (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hEven : (∫ t : ℝ, f t) =
      2 * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t := by
    calc
      (∫ t : ℝ, f t) = ∫ t : ℝ, f |t| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
          dsimp only [f]
          by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
          · have ht' : t ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge ht
            rw [abs_of_nonpos ht']
            rw [show (-t) ^ 2 = t ^ 2 by ring,
              show x * -t = -(x * t) by ring, Real.cos_neg]
      _ = 2 * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t := integral_comp_abs
  have hfull := integral_rexp_neg_sq_div_two_mul_cos x
  change (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t) = _
  change (∫ t : ℝ, f t) = _ at hfull
  rw [hEven] at hfull
  linarith

/-- Exact first Gaussian moment on a finite positive frequency window. -/
theorem integral_Icc_mul_rexp_neg_sq_div_two
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, t * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) =
      1 - Real.exp (-(T ^ 2) / 2) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => t * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    have h := integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    apply h.congr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      dsimp only [f]
      congr 1
      ring
  have hsubset : Ici T ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro t ht
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hT ht
  have hdiff := integral_diff measurableSet_Ici hf.integrableOn hsubset
  have hset : Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Ici T = Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_Ioi, mem_Ici, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · intro ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, lt_of_not_ge ht.2⟩
    · intro ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, not_le.mpr ht.2⟩
  rw [hset, integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi] at hdiff
  rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo, hdiff]
  rw [show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t) = 1 by
    have h0 :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.GaussianTails.integral_Ioi_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two 0
    have hzeroArg : -((0 : ℝ) ^ 2) / 2 = 0 := by norm_num
    rw [hzeroArg, Real.exp_zero] at h0
    simpa only [f] using h0,
    show (∫ t in Ioi T, f t) = Real.exp (-(T ^ 2) / 2) by
      simpa only [f] using
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.GaussianTails.integral_Ioi_mul_exp_neg_sq_div_two T]

/-- Explicit standard-normal specialization of the weighted upper signed-CDF
tail control. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3 := by
  simpa only [integral_standardNormal_abs_cube] using
    h.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le

/-- Explicit standard-normal specialization for the lower signed CDF error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfLowerError_le_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) :
    (∫ x, |x| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3 := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le_explicit

/-- Explicit outside-radius upper signed-error bound with the standard-normal
third moment evaluated. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  simpa only [integral_standardNormal_abs_cube] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le hR

/-- Explicit outside-radius lower signed-error bound. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfLowerError_restrict_abs_ge_le_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x in {x : ℝ | R ≤ |x|}, |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
        4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_restrict_abs_ge_le_explicit hR

/-- Explicit combined central/tail `L¹` estimate for the upper signed error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x, |cdfUpperError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
          4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  simpa only [integral_standardNormal_abs_cube] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail hR

/-- Explicit combined central/tail estimate for the lower signed error. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.integral_abs_cdfLowerError_le_central_tail_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∫ x, |cdfLowerError nu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x|) ≤
      2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
          4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail_explicit hR

/-- The two standardized spatial cancellations specialized to the exact
Gaussian keep/innovation operator.  The innovation density contributes its
inverse-cubic scale and the keep pushforward contributes its exact cubic
weighted Jacobian. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) /
          normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 3) *
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 3 *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) := by
  let gamma := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let a := normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N
  let b := normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N
  let nuScaled := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) nu
  let gammaScaled := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => a * z) gamma
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nuScaled :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gammaScaled :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have ha : 0 < a := normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient_pos N
  have hb : 0 < b := normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient_pos N
  have hnu1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z) nuScaled :=
    integrable_id_map_mul_real nu a h.integrable_id
  have hgamma1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z) gammaScaled :=
    integrable_id_map_mul_real gamma a integrable_standardNormal_id
  have hnuAbs : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) nuScaled := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hnu1.norm
  have hgammaAbs : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) gammaScaled := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hgamma1.norm
  have hnu2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) nuScaled :=
    integrable_sq_map_mul_real nu a h.integrable_sq
  have hgamma2 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) gammaScaled :=
    integrable_sq_map_mul_real gamma a integrable_standardNormal_sq
  have hnu3 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ 3) nuScaled :=
    integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real nu a h.integrable_abs_cube
  have hgamma3 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z| ^ 3) gammaScaled :=
    integrable_abs_cube_map_mul_real gamma a integrable_standardNormal_abs_cube
  have he : Integrable (cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled) := by
    simpa only [cdfUpperError] using
      integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments _ _ hnuAbs hgammaAbs
  have he1 : Integrable (fun z => z * cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z) := by
    have hnuC := integrable_id_mul_centeredCDF nuScaled hnu2
    have hgammaC := integrable_id_mul_centeredCDF gammaScaled hgamma2
    apply (hnuC.sub hgammaC).congr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun z => by
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, cdfUpperError, centeredCDF]
      ring
  have he2 : Integrable
      (fun z => |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z|) := by
    unfold cdfUpperError
    exact integrable_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdf_sub_cdf _ _ hnu3 hgamma3
  have hzero : (∫ z, cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z) = 0 := by
    unfold cdfUpperError
    rw [integral_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_integral_id_sub _ _ hnuAbs hgammaAbs,
      integral_id_map_mul_real, integral_id_map_mul_real, h.centered,
      integral_standardNormal_id]
    ring
  have hone : (∫ z, z * cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z) = 0 := by
    unfold cdfUpperError
    rw [integral_id_mul_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_secondMoment_sub _ _ hnu2 hgamma2,
      integral_sq_map_mul_real, integral_sq_map_mul_real,
      h.unit_second_moment, integral_standardNormal_sq]
    ring
  have hsmooth :=
    abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_standardNormal_conv_le_of_cancellations
      nuScaled gammaScaled hb he he1 he2 hzero hone x
  change |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N gamma) x| ≤
    (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / b ^ 3) *
      ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z| at hsmooth
  rw [standardNormalLaw_normalizedGaussian_step N] at hsmooth
  calc
    |cdfUpperError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / b ^ 3) *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nuScaled gammaScaled z| := hsmooth
    _ = (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) / b ^ 3) *
        (a ^ 3 * ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu gamma z|) := by
      rw [integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_map_mul_eq nu gamma ha]
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the exact weighted cancellation branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) /
          normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 3) *
        (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 3 *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral N x

/-- Closed-form version of the upper second-order cancellation branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  calc
    |cdfUpperError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) /
            normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N ^ 3) *
          (normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N ^ 3 *
            ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z|) :=
      h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral N x
    _ = (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, normalizedGaussianCancellationCoefficient]

/-- Closed-form lower second-order cancellation branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfLowerError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral_explicit N x

/-- The upper cancellation branch with the weighted norm replaced by the
certified third absolute moments. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_thirdMoment
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfUpperError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  calc
    |cdfUpperError
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
        (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
          (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
            ∫ z, |z| ^ 2 * |cdfUpperError nu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| :=
      h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_weightedIntegral_explicit N x
    _ ≤ (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        h.integral_abs_sq_mul_abs_cdfUpperError_le_explicit
        (mul_nonneg
          (div_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))
            (by norm_num))
          (pow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) 3))

/-- Lower signed-error companion to the explicit third-moment branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_thirdMoment
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    |cdfLowerError
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x| ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  simpa only [cdfLowerError_eq_neg_upper, abs_neg] using
    h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_thirdMoment N x

/-- Full Kolmogorov version of the explicit two-cancellation branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_cancellation
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
          (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3) := by
  rw [kolmogorovDistance_eq_max_signed]
  apply max_le
  · apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans
      (h.abs_cdfUpperError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_thirdMoment N x)
  · apply csSup_le (Set.range_nonempty _)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans
      (h.abs_cdfLowerError_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_thirdMoment N x)

/-- Combining exact Gaussian `L¹ -> L∞` smoothing with the explicit
central/tail decomposition gives a second certified branch for one normalized
keep/innovation step. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_central_tail
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        (2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
          (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3)) := by
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
          ∫ z, |cdfUpperError nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw z| :=
      h.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_integral N
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
        (2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
          (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (h.integral_abs_cdfUpperError_le_central_tail_explicit hR)
        (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))

/-- Expanded central/tail branch.  In particular, its exact multiplicative
coefficient on the incoming Kolmogorov distance is
`2 R sqrt(N+1) / sqrt(2π)`; the remaining term is the certified tail cost. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_central_tail_expanded
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (2 * R * (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) *
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹)) *
          kolmogorovDistance nu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
          ((R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
            4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3)) := by
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
        (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
          (2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
            (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
              4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3)) :=
      h.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_central_tail N hR
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- The usable one-step estimate is the minimum of exact norm-one
nonexpansiveness and the quantitative central/tail smoothing branch. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_min_central_tail
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      min
        (kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
          (2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
            (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
              4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3))) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  apply le_min
  · exact kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le nu N
  · exact h.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_central_tail N hR

/-- Mechanical comparison of all three certified Gaussian-step branches:
norm-one transport, density-peak plus central/tail splitting, and the
second-order two-cancellation remainder. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_min_three
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B R : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B)
    (N : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    kolmogorovDistance
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      min
        (kolmogorovDistance nu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        (min
          ((Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) *
            (2 * R * kolmogorovDistance nu
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw +
              (R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
                4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3)))
          ((((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 2) *
              (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3) *
            (((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂nu) +
              4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / 3))) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure nu := h.probability
  apply le_min
  · exact kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le nu N
  · apply le_min
    · exact h.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_central_tail N hR
    · exact h.kolmogorovDistance_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_cancellation N

/-- The exact `L³` norm of the identity under the standard-normal law. -/
theorem lpNorm_id_standardNormal_three :
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) (3 : ℝ≥0∞)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw =
      (4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
  rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (p := (3 : ℝ≥0∞))
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖x‖ ^ ENNReal.toReal 3
        ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) ^
        (ENNReal.toReal 3)⁻¹ =
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ (3 : ℕ)
        ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) ^
        ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
          congr 1
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with x
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          norm_num
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun r : ℝ => r ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹))
      integral_standardNormal_abs_cube

/-- Explicit quantitative third-moment-root envelope for one Gaussian
keep/innovation step. -/
theorem lpNorm_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le_explicit
    (N : ℕ) (nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hnu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) nu) :
    lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 (normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu) ≤
      normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N *
          (4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * lpNorm (fun y : ℝ => y) 3 nu := by
  simpa only [lpNorm_id_standardNormal_three] using
    lpNorm_normalizedGaussianStepLaw_le N nu hnu3

/-- Explicit bounded standardized-law transport using the exact
standard-normal third-moment root. -/
theorem IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.normalizedGaussianStepLaw_explicit
    {nu : Measure ℝ} {B : ℝ} (h : IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw nu B) (N : ℕ) :
    IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.BerryEsseen.normalizedGaussianStepLaw N nu)
      (normalizedGaussianInnovationCoefficient N *
          (4 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) +
        normalizedGaussianKeepCoefficient N * B) := by
  simpa only [lpNorm_id_standardNormal_three] using
    IsStandardizedThirdMomentLaw.normalizedGaussianStepLaw h N

/-- Complete uniform-smoothing reduction for comparison with the standard
normal law. The only remaining quantitative input is the integral of the
smoothed characteristic-function discrepancy quotient. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_uniformSmoothing
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ t : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗ mu)
        (uniformSmoothingKernel delta ∗
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * delta) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel delta) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hdelta
  apply kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_of_smoothing_approximation
    mu hdelta.le
    (uniformSmoothedCDF_isSmoothingApproximation mu hdelta)
    (uniformSmoothedCDF_isSmoothingApproximation
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hdelta)
  intro x
  rw [smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv, smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv]
  exact cdfGap_uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy_scaled
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hdelta x

/-- Sharp global cubic remainder for the imaginary-axis exponential. Two
applications of the fundamental theorem of calculus preserve the optimal
Taylor coefficient because `x ↦ exp (i x)` has unit speed. -/
theorem norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le_sharp (y : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ ≤ |y| ^ 3 / 6 := by
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  let f2 : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => -f x + 1
  let f1 : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => f x * Complex.I - Complex.I + x
  let R : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
    f x - 1 - x * Complex.I + (((x ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)
  have hf (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f (f x * Complex.I) x := by
    convert
      ((Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := x)).mul_const Complex.I).cexp
        using 1
    change Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I =
      Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((1 : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    norm_num
  have hf2 (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f1 (f2 x) x := by
    have hfi : HasDerivAt (fun z => f z * Complex.I) (-f x) x := by
      convert (hf x).mul_const Complex.I using 1
      rw [mul_assoc, Complex.I_mul_I]
      ring
    have hone : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z : ℂ)) 1 x := by
      convert Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := x) using 1
    convert (hfi.sub_const Complex.I).add hone using 1
  have hR (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt R (f1 x) x := by
    have hxi : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (z : ℂ) * Complex.I) Complex.I x := by
      convert (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := x)).mul_const Complex.I using 1
      change Complex.I = Complex.ofRealCLM 1 * Complex.I
      rw [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply]
      norm_num
    have hx2 : HasDerivAt
        (fun z : ℝ => (((z ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) (x : ℂ) x := by
      convert (((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).ofReal_comp).div_const 2 using 1
      norm_num
    convert (((hf x).sub_const 1).sub hxi).add hx2 using 1
  have hf2cont : Continuous f2 := by
    dsimp only [f2, f]
    fun_prop
  have hf1cont : Continuous f1 := by
    dsimp only [f1, f]
    fun_prop
  have hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → ‖R x‖ ≤ x ^ 3 / 6 := by
    intro x hx
    have hnorm2 : ∀ z ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) x, ‖f2 z‖ ≤ z := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [f2, f]
      calc
        ‖-Complex.exp ((z : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 1‖ =
            ‖Complex.exp ((z : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1‖ := by
          rw [← norm_neg]
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ z := by
          simpa only [mul_comm, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hz.1] using
            (Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le (x := z))
    have hnorm1 : ∀ z ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) x, ‖f1 z‖ ≤ z ^ 2 / 2 := by
      intro z hz
      have hFTCz : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..z, f2 w) = f1 z := by
        have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
          (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := z) (f := f1) (f' := f2)
          (fun w _ => hf2 w) (hf2cont.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := z))
        simpa [f1, f] using h
      rw [← hFTCz]
      calc
        ‖∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..z, f2 w‖ ≤ ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..z, w := by
          apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hz.1
          · exact ae_of_all volume fun w hw =>
              hnorm2 w ⟨hw.1.le, hw.2.trans hz.2⟩
          · exact continuous_id.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := z)
        _ = z ^ 2 / 2 := by norm_num
    have hFTCR : (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, f1 z) = R x := by
      have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := x) (f := R) (f' := f1)
        (fun z _ => hR z) (hf1cont.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := x))
      simpa [R, f] using h
    rw [← hFTCR]
    calc
      ‖∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, f1 z‖ ≤ ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, z ^ 2 / 2 := by
        apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hx
        · exact ae_of_all volume fun z hz => hnorm1 z ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩
        · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 / 2) |>.intervalIntegrable
            (a := 0) (b := x)
      _ = x ^ 3 / 6 := by norm_num; ring
  change ‖R y‖ ≤ |y| ^ 3 / 6
  by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
  · simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hy] using hpos y hy
  · have hneg : 0 ≤ -y := le_of_lt (neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hy))
    have hsymmetric : ‖R y‖ = ‖R (-y)‖ := by
      rw [← Complex.norm_conj]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [R, f]
      simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_div₀,
        Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I, map_ofNat]
      rw [← Complex.exp_conj]
      simp [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
    rw [hsymmetric]
    simpa only [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hy)] using hpos (-y) hneg

/-- A global cubic remainder bound for the imaginary-axis exponential.

The constant is deliberately nonoptimal. Its global form is the useful point:
after substituting `y = u * X`, a finite third absolute moment supplies an
integrable majorant without any boundedness assumption on `X`. -/
theorem norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le (y : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ ≤
      4 * |y| ^ 3 := by
  by_cases hy : |y| ≤ 1
  · have hz : ‖(y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ≤ 1 := by
      simpa [Complex.norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hy
    calc
      ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I +
