          (((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ =
          ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
            ∑ m ∈ Finset.range 3,
              (((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ m / m.factorial)‖ := by
            congr 1
            simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.factorial]
            ring_nf
            rw [Complex.I_sq]
            ring
      _ ≤ ‖(y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ^ 3 *
          ((Nat.succ 3 : ℝ) * ((Nat.factorial 3) * (3 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        Complex.exp_bound hz (by decide)
      _ ≤ 4 * |y| ^ 3 := by
        simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.factorial]
        nlinarith [pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg y) 3]
  · have hy1 : 1 < |y| := lt_of_not_ge hy
    have hy1' : 1 ≤ |y| := hy1.le
    have hy_sq : |y| ≤ |y| ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg y) (sub_nonneg.mpr hy1')]
    have hy_cube : |y| ^ 2 ≤ |y| ^ 3 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg |y|) (sub_nonneg.mpr hy1')]
    have hone_cube : 1 ≤ |y| ^ 3 :=
      hy1'.trans (hy_sq.trans hy_cube)
    calc
      ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ ≤
          ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ +
            ‖(y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ + ‖(((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ := by
              calc
                _ ≤ ‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
                    (y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ + ‖(((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ :=
                  norm_add_le _ _
                _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1‖ +
                    ‖(y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖) +
                    ‖(((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ := by
                  gcongr
                  exact norm_sub_le _ _
                _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ +
                    ‖(y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖) +
                    ‖(((y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)‖ := by
                  gcongr
                  exact norm_sub_le _ _
                _ = _ := by ring
      _ = 2 + |y| + |y| ^ 2 / 2 := by
        norm_num [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, Complex.norm_mul,
          Complex.norm_div, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      _ ≤ 4 * |y| ^ 3 := by
        nlinarith [hy_sq.trans hy_cube, hone_cube]

/-- The cubic exponential remainder passes through expectation under a finite
third absolute moment. This is the quantitative Taylor input used in the
characteristic-function half of Berry--Esseen. -/
theorem norm_integral_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] {mu : Measure Omega}
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX3 : Integrable (fun omega => |X omega| ^ 3) mu) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ omega,
        (Complex.exp (((u * X omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
          ((u * X omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          ((((u * X omega) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂mu‖ ≤
      (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
  have hg : Integrable (fun omega => (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * |X omega| ^ 3) mu :=
    hX3.const_mul (|u| ^ 3 / 6)
  calc
    ‖∫ omega,
        (Complex.exp (((u * X omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
          ((u * X omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          ((((u * X omega) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂mu‖ ≤
        ∫ omega, (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg <| ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
        convert norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le_sharp (u * X omega) using 1
        simp only [abs_mul, mul_pow]; ring
    _ = (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- Coarser predecessor retained for compatibility with the already-certified
Berry--Esseen chain while the sharp coefficient is propagated incrementally. -/
theorem norm_integral_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX3 : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω| ^ 3) μ) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖∫ ω,
        (Complex.exp (((u * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
          ((u * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          ((((u * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂μ‖ ≤
      4 * |u| ^ 3 * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
  have hg : Integrable (fun ω => 4 * |u| ^ 3 * |X ω| ^ 3) μ :=
    hX3.const_mul (4 * |u| ^ 3)
  calc
    ‖∫ ω,
        (Complex.exp (((u * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
          ((u * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          ((((u * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂μ‖ ≤
        ∫ ω, 4 * |u| ^ 3 * |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg <| ae_of_all μ fun ω => by
        simpa only [abs_mul, mul_pow, mul_assoc] using
          norm_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le (u * X ω)
    _ = 4 * |u| ^ 3 * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- A centered unit-second-moment characteristic function differs from its
quadratic Taylor polynomial by at most one sixth of the cubic third-moment
term. This is the sharp Taylor input for the Berry--Esseen chain. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        (1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
  have hXint : Integrable X μ := hX.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hX2 : Integrable (fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2) μ :=
    (hX.mono_exponent (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≤ 3)).integrable_sq
  have hX3 : Integrable (fun ω => |X ω| ^ 3) μ := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hX.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hExp : Integrable
      (fun ω => Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1 ?_
    exact ae_of_all μ fun ω => by
      simp only [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
      norm_num
  have hOne : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℂ)) μ := integrable_const 1
  have hLin : Integrable
      (fun ω => ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) μ :=
    ((hXint.const_mul t).ofReal).mul_const Complex.I
  have hQuadReal : Integrable (fun ω => (t * X ω) ^ 2) μ := by
    simpa only [mul_pow] using hX2.const_mul (t ^ 2)
  have hQuad : Integrable
      (fun ω => ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) μ :=
    hQuadReal.ofReal.div_const 2
  have hLinZero :
      (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂μ) * Complex.I :=
        integral_mul_const _ _
      _ = ((∫ ω, t * X ω ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        have hc : (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂μ) =
            ((∫ ω, t * X ω ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) := integral_complex_ofReal
        rw [hc]
      _ = ((t * ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hMean]; simp
  have hQuadIntegral :
      (∫ ω, ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2) ∂μ) =
        (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    calc
      (∫ ω, ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2) ∂μ) =
          (∫ ω, (((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂μ) / 2 :=
        integral_div _ _
      _ = ((∫ ω, (t * X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2 := by
        have hc : (∫ ω, (((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∂μ) =
            ((∫ ω, (t * X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) := integral_complex_ofReal
        rw [hc]
      _ = ((t ^ 2 * ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2 := by
        congr 2
        simpa only [mul_pow] using
          (integral_const_mul (μ := μ) (t ^ 2) (fun ω => (X ω) ^ 2))
      _ = (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 := by rw [hSecond]; norm_num
  have hsubExp :
      (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 ∂μ) =
        (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ) -
          (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : ℂ) ∂μ) :=
    integral_sub hExp hOne
  have hsubLin :
      (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
        ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ) =
        (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 ∂μ) -
          (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ) :=
    integral_sub (hExp.sub hOne) hLin
  have hRemainderIntegral :
      (∫ ω,
        (Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
          ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂μ) =
        (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ) - 1 +
          (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
            ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ) +
          (∫ ω, ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2) ∂μ) := by
        exact integral_add (hExp.sub hOne |>.sub hLin) hQuad
      _ = ((∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 ∂μ) -
            (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ)) +
          (∫ ω, ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2) ∂μ) := by
        rw [hsubLin]
      _ = (((∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ) -
            (∫ _ : Ω, (1 : ℂ) ∂μ)) -
            (∫ ω, ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∂μ)) +
          (∫ ω, ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2) ∂μ) := by
        rw [hsubExp]
      _ = _ := by rw [hLinZero, hQuadIntegral]; simp [integral_const]
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw]
  simp_rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  calc
    ‖(∫ ω, Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂μ) -
        (1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ =
        ‖∫ ω,
          (Complex.exp (((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 -
            ((t * X ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            ((((t * X ω) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)) ∂μ‖ := by
      rw [hRemainderIntegral]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ :=
      norm_integral_cexp_mul_I_sub_quadratic_le_sharp X hX3 t

/-- Sharp real-coordinate consequence of the cubic characteristic-function
Taylor remainder. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_re_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    |(MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)| ≤
      (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
  let q : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
      ((1 - t ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hproxy : ((1 - t ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hq : ‖q‖ ≤ (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [hproxy]
    exact norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
      X hX hMean hSecond t
  have hre : q.re =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    simp only [q, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
  rw [← hre]
  exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm q).trans hq

/-- Sharp imaginary-coordinate consequence of the cubic characteristic-function
Taylor remainder; centering removes its linear term. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_im_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    |(MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).im| ≤
      (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
  let q : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
      ((1 - t ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hproxy : ((1 - t ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hq : ‖q‖ ≤ (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [hproxy]
    exact norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
      X hX hMean hSecond t
  have him : q.im =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).im := by
    simp only [q, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
  rw [← him]
  exact (Complex.abs_im_le_norm q).trans hq

/-- Signed real-coordinate form of the sharp cubic characteristic-function
Taylor estimate. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_re_sub_quadratic_mem_Icc_thirdMoment_sharp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) ∈
      Icc (-((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ))
        ((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) := by
  rw [mem_Icc, ← abs_le]
  exact abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_re_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t

/-- Signed imaginary-coordinate form of the sharp cubic characteristic-function
Taylor estimate. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_im_mem_Icc_thirdMoment_sharp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t).im ∈
      Icc (-((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ))
        ((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) := by
  rw [mem_Icc, ← abs_le]
  exact abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_im_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t

/-- Exact recurrence for the real coordinate of a complex power relative to a
real power baseline. -/
theorem complex_pow_succ_re_sub_real_pow
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z ^ (n + 1)).re - a ^ (n + 1) =
      a * ((z ^ n).re - a ^ n) +
        (z.re - a) * (z ^ n).re - z.im * (z ^ n).im := by
  simp only [pow_succ, Complex.mul_re]
  ring

/-- Exact recurrence for the imaginary coordinate of a complex power, split
around an arbitrary real baseline. -/
theorem complex_pow_succ_im_of_real_baseline
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z ^ (n + 1)).im =
      a * (z ^ n).im + (z.re - a) * (z ^ n).im +
        z.im * (z ^ n).re := by
  simp only [pow_succ, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

/-- Real-coordinate recurrence for powers of a characteristic function around
its quadratic Taylor baseline. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_succ_re_sub_quadratic_pow
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ (n + 1)).re -
        (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) ^ (n + 1) =
      (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) *
          (((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).re -
            (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) ^ n) +
        ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).re -
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t).im *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).im := by
  exact complex_pow_succ_re_sub_real_pow _ _ _

/-- Imaginary-coordinate recurrence for powers of a characteristic function
around its real quadratic Taylor baseline. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_succ_im_of_quadratic_baseline
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ (n + 1)).im =
      (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).im +
        ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).im +
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t).im *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).re := by
  exact complex_pow_succ_im_of_real_baseline _ _ _

/-- The geometric coefficient in the exact factorization of `z^n-a^n` when
the comparison baseline `a` is real. -/
noncomputable def complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ i * (a : ℂ) ^ (n - 1 - i)

/-- Exact real-coordinate telescoping formula for a complex power relative to
a real power. -/
theorem complex_pow_sub_real_pow_re_eq_geomSum
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z ^ n).re - a ^ n =
      (z.re - a) * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).re -
        z.im * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).im := by
  have h := (Commute.all z (a : ℂ)).mul_geom_sum₂ n
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow a n] at h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  simpa only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum]
      using hre.symm

/-- Exact imaginary-coordinate telescoping formula for a complex power
relative to a real baseline. -/
theorem complex_pow_sub_real_pow_im_eq_geomSum
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z ^ n).im =
      (z.re - a) * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).im +
        z.im * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).re := by
  have h := (Commute.all z (a : ℂ)).mul_geom_sum₂ n
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow a n] at h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simpa only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
    complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum] using him.symm

/-- Exact factorization of a complex power discrepancy into its one-step
residual against a real baseline, the common geometric coefficient, and a
remaining real target correction. -/
theorem complex_pow_sub_real_eq_taylorGeomSum
    (z : ℂ) (a g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    z ^ n - (g : ℂ) =
      (z - (a : ℂ)) * complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n +
        ((a ^ n - g : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  have h := (Commute.all z (a : ℂ)).mul_geom_sum₂ n
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow a n] at h
  change (z - (a : ℂ)) * complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n =
    z ^ n - ((a ^ n : ℝ) : ℂ) at h
  rw [h]
  push_cast
  ring

/-- Real coordinate of the exact Taylor/geometric factorization, recombined
as the real part of the powered discrepancy. -/
theorem taylorGeomSum_realCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_re
    (z : ℂ) (a g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z.re - a) * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).re -
        z.im * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).im + (a ^ n - g) =
      (z ^ n - (g : ℂ)).re := by
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re
    (complex_pow_sub_real_eq_taylorGeomSum z a g n)
  simpa only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] using hre.symm

/-- Imaginary coordinate of the exact Taylor/geometric factorization,
recombined as the imaginary part of the complex power. -/
theorem taylorGeomSum_imagCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_im
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (z.re - a) * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).im +
        z.im * (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).re = (z ^ n).im :=
  (complex_pow_sub_real_pow_im_eq_geomSum z a n).symm

/-- Real coordinate after multiplying a complex discrepancy by the negative
spatial Fourier phase. -/
theorem negativePhase_mul_re (theta : ℝ) (d : ℂ) :
    (Complex.exp (((-theta : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d).re =
      Real.cos theta * d.re + Real.sin theta * d.im := by
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  ring

/-- Imaginary coordinate after multiplying a complex discrepancy by the
negative spatial Fourier phase. -/
theorem negativePhase_mul_im (theta : ℝ) (d : ℂ) :
    (Complex.exp (((-theta : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d).im =
      Real.cos theta * d.im - Real.sin theta * d.re := by
  rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  ring

/-- Recombination of the Fejer-weighted sine/cosine coordinates into a
single real spatial phase. -/
theorem phase_fejer_coordinate (w g theta : ℝ) (d : ℂ) :
    w * (Real.sin theta * d.im + Real.cos theta * d.re + g) =
      w * ((Complex.exp (((-theta : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d).re + g) := by
  rw [negativePhase_mul_re]
  ring

/-- Recombination of the cotangent-weighted sine/cosine coordinates into a
single negative imaginary spatial phase. -/
theorem phase_cotangent_coordinate (c theta : ℝ) (d : ℂ) :
    c * (Real.sin theta * d.re - Real.cos theta * d.im) =
      -c * (Complex.exp (((-theta : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d).im := by
  rw [negativePhase_mul_im]
  ring

/-- Exact real-coordinate telescoping formula for a characteristic-function
power around its real quadratic Taylor baseline. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_re_eq_geomSum
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) ^ n =
      ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) *
          (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                X hX : Measure ℝ) t)
            (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).re -
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t).im *
          (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                X hX : Measure ℝ) t)
            (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).im := by
  exact complex_pow_sub_real_pow_re_eq_geomSum _ _ _

/-- Exact imaginary-coordinate telescoping formula for a characteristic-function
power around its real quadratic Taylor baseline. -/
theorem charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_im_eq_geomSum
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).im =
      ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t).re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) *
          (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                X hX : Measure ℝ) t)
            (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).im +
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX : Measure ℝ) t).im *
          (complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                X hX : Measure ℝ) t)
            (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).re := by
  exact complex_pow_sub_real_pow_im_eq_geomSum _ _ _

/-- Maximum-radius bound for the geometric coefficient in the exact complex
power factorization. -/
theorem norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_le
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n‖ ≤
      n * max ‖z‖ |a| ^ (n - 1) := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum]
  let r : ℝ := max ‖z‖ |a|
  have hrz : ‖z‖ ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
  have hra : |a| ≤ r := le_max_right _ _
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := (norm_nonneg z).trans hrz
  have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
  change ‖complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n‖ ≤
    n * r ^ (n - 1)
  rw [complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum]
  calc
    ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ i * (a : ℂ) ^ (n - 1 - i)‖ ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
          ‖z ^ i * (a : ℂ) ^ (n - 1 - i)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range n, r ^ (n - 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hi_lt : i < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc
        ‖z‖ ^ i * |a| ^ (n - 1 - i) ≤
            r ^ i * r ^ (n - 1 - i) := by
          gcongr
        _ = r ^ (n - 1) := by
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
    _ = n * r ^ (n - 1) := by simp

/-- Real-coordinate consequence of the maximum-radius geometric-coefficient
bound. -/
theorem abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_re_le
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).re| ≤
      n * max ‖z‖ |a| ^ (n - 1) :=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_le z a n)

/-- Imaginary-coordinate consequence of the maximum-radius
geometric-coefficient bound. -/
theorem abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_im_le
    (z : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z a n).im| ≤
      n * max ‖z‖ |a| ^ (n - 1) :=
  (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_le z a n)

/-- Coarser predecessor retained as a compatibility wrapper while the sharp
coefficient is propagated through the existing Berry--Esseen chain. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        (1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      4 * |t| ^ 3 * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ := by
  have hMomentNonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg fun ω => pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg (X ω)) 3
  have htNonneg : 0 ≤ |t| ^ 3 := pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) 3
  calc
    _ ≤ (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ :=
      norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
        X hX hMean hSecond t
    _ ≤ 4 * |t| ^ 3 * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) hMomentNonneg

/-- Powers of two points in the closed complex unit ball separate at most
linearly in the exponent. This elementary telescoping estimate is the bridge
from a one-summand characteristic-function estimate to an i.i.d. sum. -/
theorem norm_pow_sub_pow_le_of_norm_le_one
    (a b : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) (hb : ‖b‖ ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ ≤ n * ‖a - b‖ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        ‖a ^ (n + 1) - b ^ (n + 1)‖ =
            ‖a ^ n * (a - b) + (a ^ n - b ^ n) * b‖ := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ ‖a ^ n * (a - b)‖ + ‖(a ^ n - b ^ n) * b‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖a ^ n‖ * ‖a - b‖ + ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ * ‖b‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖a - b‖ + (n * ‖a - b‖) * 1 := by
          apply add_le_add
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (by simpa only [norm_pow] using
                pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg a) ha)
              (norm_nonneg _)
          · exact mul_le_mul ih hb (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ := by
          rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          ring

/-- The real quadratic Taylor proxy for a characteristic function remains in
the complex unit ball on the interval `|t| ≤ 2`. -/
theorem norm_one_sub_half_sq_le_one {t : ℝ} (ht : |t| ≤ 2) :
    ‖1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ ≤ 1 := by
  have htSq : t ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
    rw [← sq_abs]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg t]
  rw [show 1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 = ((1 - t ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by
    push_cast
    ring]
  rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]

/-- Cubic control of a centered unit-variance characteristic function passes
to arbitrary powers on the Taylor interval. -/
theorem norm_charFun_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_le_thirdMoment
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : |t| ≤ 2) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t ^ n -
        (1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n‖ ≤
      n * (4 * |t| ^ 3 * ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ n * ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        (1 - (t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ :=
      norm_pow_sub_pow_le_of_norm_le_one _ _
        (MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t)
        (norm_one_sub_half_sq_le_one ht) n
    _ ≤ n * (4 * |t| ^ 3 * ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment
          X hX hMean hSecond t)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

/-- Quantitative Taylor control for the characteristic function of the
normalized centered i.i.d. sum. The right side is the one-variable cubic
remainder multiplied by the number of summands. -/
theorem norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_quadratic_pow_le_thirdMoment
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 2) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable :
              Measure ℝ) t -
        (1 - ((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^
          (N + 1)‖ ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
          ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) := by
  let hX2 : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu := fun i =>
    (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw_normalizedCenteredIidSum
    X hX2 hIndep hIdent N t]
  have hcf :
      (∫ omega, Complex.exp
        ((((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * X 0 omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with omega
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hcf]
  exact norm_charFun_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_le_thirdMoment
    (X 0) (hX 0) hMean hSecond (N + 1) ht

/-- Sharp second-order remainder for the real exponential on the negative
half-line. -/
theorem abs_rexp_neg_sub_one_add_le_half_sq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |Real.exp (-x) - 1 + x| ≤ x ^ 2 / 2 := by
  let R : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => Real.exp (-z) - 1 + z
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => 1 - Real.exp (-z)
  have hR (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt R (d z) z := by
    have he := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-z)).comp z (hasDerivAt_neg z)
    convert (he.sub_const 1).add (hasDerivAt_id z) using 1
    dsimp only [R, d]; ring
  have hdcont : Continuous d := by
    dsimp only [d]
    fun_prop
  have hFTC : (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, d z) = R x := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := x) (f := R) (f' := d)
      (fun z _ => hR z) (hdcont.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := x))
    simpa [R] using h
  have hmono : (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, d z) ≤ ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, z := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hx
      (hdcont.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := x))
      (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable (a := 0) (b := x))
    intro z hz
    have hexp := Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg z
    dsimp only [d]
    change 1 - Real.exp (-z) ≤ z
    linarith
  have hRNonneg : 0 ≤ R x := by
    have hexp := Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg x
    dsimp only [R]
    linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonneg]
  · change R x ≤ x ^ 2 / 2
    rw [← hFTC]
    calc
      (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, d z) ≤ ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..x, z := hmono
      _ = x ^ 2 / 2 := by norm_num
  · simpa only [R] using hRNonneg

/-- On the unit Taylor window, the quadratic characteristic-function proxy
differs from the matching Gaussian exponential by the sharp quartic
remainder. -/
theorem norm_one_sub_half_sq_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_sharp
    (u : ℝ) :
    ‖(1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) - Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      |u| ^ 4 / 8 := by
  let x : ℝ := u ^ 2 / 2
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp only [x]; positivity
  have hreal :
      (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) - Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) =
        ((1 - x - Real.exp (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [show Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) =
        ((Real.exp (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ) by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_exp]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [x]
      push_cast
      ring]
    dsimp only [x]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hreal, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have h := abs_rexp_neg_sub_one_add_le_half_sq hx
  rw [show |1 - x - Real.exp (-x)| = |Real.exp (-x) - 1 + x| by
    rw [← abs_neg]
    congr 1
    ring]
  calc
    |Real.exp (-x) - 1 + x| ≤ x ^ 2 / 2 := h
    _ = |u| ^ 4 / 8 := by
      dsimp only [x]
      rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ u ^ 4)]
      ring

/-- Coarser predecessor retained for compatibility with the original
characteristic-function chain. -/
theorem norm_one_sub_half_sq_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖(1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) - Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      |u| ^ 4 / 4 := by
  let z : ℂ := -(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2
  have hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [z]
    rw [norm_div, norm_neg, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
    nlinarith [sq_abs u,
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg u) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
  calc
    ‖(1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) - Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ =
        ‖-(Complex.exp z - 1 - z)‖ := by
      congr 1
      dsimp [z]
      ring
    _ = ‖Complex.exp z - 1 - z‖ := norm_neg _
    _ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := Complex.norm_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hz
    _ = |u| ^ 4 / 4 := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [norm_div, norm_neg, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      norm_num
      rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ u ^ 4)]
      ring

/-- Raising the quadratic proxy and its matching Gaussian exponential to the
same power costs at most the exponent times the quartic one-step remainder. -/
theorem norm_one_sub_half_sq_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n‖ ≤
      n * (|u| ^ 4 / 4) := by
  have hquad : ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ ≤ 1 :=
    norm_one_sub_half_sq_le_one (hu.trans (by norm_num))
  have hexp : ‖Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    norm_num [pow_two, Complex.mul_re]
    nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg u]
  calc
    _ ≤ n * ‖(1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ :=
      norm_pow_sub_pow_le_of_norm_le_one _ _ hquad hexp n
    _ ≤ n * (|u| ^ 4 / 4) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_one_sub_half_sq_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le hu)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

/-- The Gaussian exponential at the normalized frequency, raised to the
number of summands, is exactly the standard-normal characteristic function. -/
theorem cexp_neg_half_sq_div_sqrt_pow_succ
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp
        (-((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (N + 1) =
      Complex.exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) := by
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hsqrtC : (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsqrt
  have hnC : (N + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero N)
  rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  rw [div_pow, hsqrtC]
  field_simp [hnC]

/-- Local characteristic-function comparison between a normalized centered
i.i.d. sum and the standard normal. It cleanly separates the cubic
third-moment error from the quartic Gaussian-proxy error. -/
theorem norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable :
              Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
            ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4) := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
    ← cexp_neg_half_sq_div_sqrt_pow_succ N t]
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable :
        Measure ℝ) t
  let B := (1 - ((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^
    (N + 1)
  let C := Complex.exp
    (-((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (N + 1)
  change ‖A - C‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖A - C‖ = ‖(A - B) + (B - C)‖ := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ‖A - B‖ + ‖B - C‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_quadratic_pow_le_thirdMoment
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N (ht.trans (by norm_num)))
      (norm_one_sub_half_sq_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le ht (N + 1))

/-- The local normalized-sum estimate in the discrepancy-quotient form used
by the Fourier smoothing reduction. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
              ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t| := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht0]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht)
      (abs_nonneg t)

/-- Algebraic normalization of the cubic and quartic quotient errors. -/
theorem normalized_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq
    (N : ℕ) (t rho : ℝ) :
    ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 * rho) +
          ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t|) =
      4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hn0 : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  generalize hsdef : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) = s at *
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hspos]
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [← hs2]
  field_simp [hspos.ne', hn0]
  rw [sq_abs]
  rw [show |t| ^ 3 = t ^ 2 * |t| by
    calc
      |t| ^ 3 = |t| ^ 2 * |t| := by ring
      _ = t ^ 2 * |t| := by rw [sq_abs]]
  ring

/-- Simplified local polynomial bound for the normalized-sum discrepancy
quotient. This is the form intended for direct integration on a finite
frequency window. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_polynomial
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
              ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t|) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht
    _ = _ := normalized_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq N t
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu)

/-- A damped telescoping estimate for complex powers. Unlike the unit-ball
bound above, this retains the geometric factor needed to integrate the
Berry--Esseen characteristic-function error on a growing window. -/
theorem norm_pow_sub_pow_le_max
    (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ ≤
      n * max ‖a‖ ‖b‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖a - b‖ := by
  let r : ℝ := max ‖a‖ ‖b‖
  have hra : ‖a‖ ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
  have hrb : ‖b‖ ≤ r := le_max_right _ _
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := (norm_nonneg a).trans hra
  change ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ ≤ n * r ^ (n - 1) * ‖a - b‖
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n
        simp
      · have hpowA : ‖a ^ n‖ ≤ r ^ n := by
          rw [norm_pow]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg a) hra n
        calc
          ‖a ^ (n + 1) - b ^ (n + 1)‖ =
              ‖a ^ n * (a - b) + (a ^ n - b ^ n) * b‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
          _ ≤ ‖a ^ n * (a - b)‖ + ‖(a ^ n - b ^ n) * b‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖a ^ n‖ * ‖a - b‖ + ‖a ^ n - b ^ n‖ * ‖b‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ r ^ n * ‖a - b‖ +
              (n * r ^ (n - 1) * ‖a - b‖) * r := by
            exact add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpowA (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul ih hrb (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ n * ‖a - b‖ := by
            have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
            have hp : r ^ (n - 1) * r = r ^ n := by
              rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn1]
            have hterm : (n : ℝ) * r ^ (n - 1) * ‖a - b‖ * r =
                (n : ℝ) * r ^ n * ‖a - b‖ := by
              calc
                _ = (n : ℝ) * (r ^ (n - 1) * r) * ‖a - b‖ := by ring
                _ = _ := by rw [hp]
            rw [hterm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring

/-- A centered unit-variance characteristic function contracts quadratically
on the window where its cubic remainder is dominated by the variance term. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_quarter_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      1 - u ^ 2 / 4 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  have hproxyNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs u,
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg u) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
  have hproxy : ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ = 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [show 1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 = ((1 - u ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by
      push_cast
      ring]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hproxyNonneg]
  have hscaleNonneg : 0 ≤ |u| ^ 2 / 4 := by positivity
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hscaleNonneg
  have hrem : 4 * |u| ^ 3 * rho ≤ u ^ 2 / 4 := by
    dsimp only [rho] at hscaled ⊢
    rw [sq_abs] at hscaled
    calc
      4 * |u| ^ 3 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) =
          (16 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u|) *
            (u ^ 2 / 4) := by
        rw [show |u| ^ 3 = |u| * u ^ 2 by
          calc
            |u| ^ 3 = |u| * |u| ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = |u| * u ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]]
        ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (u ^ 2 / 4) := hscaled
      _ = u ^ 2 / 4 := one_mul _
  calc
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
            (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ + ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
              (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)) + (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ 4 * |u| ^ 3 * rho + (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment
          X hX hMean hSecond u)
        hproxy.le
    _ ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 / 4 := by
      linarith

/-- Exponential version of the local quadratic contraction bound. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_quarter_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 4) := by
  exact (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_quarter_sq
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall).trans (by
      simpa only [neg_div] using Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (u ^ 2 / 4))

/-- Sharp local quadratic contraction obtained from the exact cubic Taylor
coefficient.  On the enlarged window `2 ρ |u| ≤ 1`, the cubic error consumes
at most one sixth of the quadratic variance term. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_five_twelfths_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      1 - 5 * u ^ 2 / 12 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  have hproxyNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs u,
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg u) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
  have hproxy : ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ = 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [show 1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 = ((1 - u ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by
      push_cast
      ring]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hproxyNonneg]
  have hscaleNonneg : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 / 12 := by positivity
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hscaleNonneg
  have hrem : (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * rho ≤ u ^ 2 / 12 := by
    dsimp only [rho] at hscaled ⊢
    calc
      (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) =
          (2 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u|) *
            (u ^ 2 / 12) := by
        rw [show |u| ^ 3 = |u| * u ^ 2 by
          calc
            |u| ^ 3 = |u| * |u| ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = |u| * u ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]]
        ring
      _ ≤ 1 * (u ^ 2 / 12) := hscaled
      _ = u ^ 2 / 12 := one_mul _
  calc
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
            (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ + ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
              (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)) + (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * rho + (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
          X hX hMean hSecond u)
        hproxy.le
    _ ≤ 1 - 5 * u ^ 2 / 12 := by
      nlinarith [hrem]

/-- Exponential form of the sharp local contraction. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_five_twelfths_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12)) := by
  exact (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_five_twelfths_sq
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall).trans (by
      simpa only using Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (5 * u ^ 2 / 12))

/-- Exponentially damped bound for the real-baseline geometric coefficient of
a centered unit-variance characteristic function. -/
theorem norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_le_exp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) * |u| ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ‖complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
        (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n‖ ≤
      n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1) := by
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs u,
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg u) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
  have hbase : |1 - u ^ 2 / 2| ≤ Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12)) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ha0]
    calc
      1 - u ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.exp (-(u ^ 2 / 2)) :=
        Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (u ^ 2 / 2)
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]
  have hcf := norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_five_twelfths_sq
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall
  calc
    ‖complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
        (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n‖ ≤
        n * max
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖
          |1 - u ^ 2 / 2| ^ (n - 1) :=
      norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_le _ _ _
    _ ≤ n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1) := by
      gcongr
      exact max_le hcf hbase

/-- Real-coordinate form of the exponentially damped geometric-coefficient
bound. -/
theorem abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_re_le_exp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) * |u| ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
        (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).re| ≤
      n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1) :=
  (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_le_exp
      X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n)

/-- Imaginary-coordinate form of the exponentially damped
geometric-coefficient bound. -/
theorem abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_im_le_exp
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) * |u| ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
        (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).im| ≤
      n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1) :=
  (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _).trans
    (norm_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_le_exp
      X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n)

/-- Powered real-coordinate Taylor estimate retaining the separate real and
imaginary geometric-coefficient magnitudes. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_re_le_geomSum
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    |((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).re -
        (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) ^ n| ≤
      ((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) *
        (|(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t)
          (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).re| +
        |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t)
          (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).im|) := by
  let z := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t
  let S := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n
  let eps := (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ
  have hre := abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_re_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t
  have him := abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_im_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t
  rw [charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_re_eq_geomSum]
  change |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.re - z.im * S.im| ≤
    eps * (|S.re| + |S.im|)
  calc
    |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.re - z.im * S.im| ≤
        |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.re| + |z.im * S.im| :=
      abs_sub _ _
    _ = |z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)| * |S.re| + |z.im| * |S.im| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ eps * |S.re| + eps * |S.im| := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hre (abs_nonneg _))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right him (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = eps * (|S.re| + |S.im|) := by ring

/-- Powered imaginary-coordinate Taylor estimate retaining the separate real
and imaginary geometric-coefficient magnitudes. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_im_le_geomSum
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    |((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t) ^ n).im| ≤
      ((|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) *
        (|(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t)
          (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).re| +
        |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t)
          (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n).im|) := by
  let z := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t
  let S := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum z (1 - t ^ 2 / 2) n
  let eps := (|t| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ
  have hre := abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_re_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t
  have him := abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_im_le_thirdMoment_sharp
    X hX hMean hSecond t
  rw [charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_im_eq_geomSum]
  change |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.im + z.im * S.re| ≤
    eps * (|S.re| + |S.im|)
  calc
    |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.im + z.im * S.re| ≤
        |(z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)) * S.im| + |z.im * S.re| :=
      abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |z.re - (1 - t ^ 2 / 2)| * |S.im| + |z.im| * |S.re| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ eps * |S.im| + eps * |S.re| := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hre (abs_nonneg _))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right him (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = eps * (|S.re| + |S.im|) := by ring

/-- Fully damped real-coordinate power bound obtained by bounding the two
geometric-coefficient coordinates independently. The explicit factor `2`
records that coordinate-separation loss. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_re_le_exp_two
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) * |u| ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    |((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u) ^ n).re -
        (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) ^ n| ≤
      2 * ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) *
        (n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1)) := by
  let eps := (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ
  let C := n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1)
  have heps : 0 ≤ eps := by
    dsimp only [eps]
    positivity
  have hbase :=
    abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_sub_quadratic_pow_re_le_geomSum
      X hX hMean hSecond u n
  have hre := abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_re_le_exp
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n
  have him := abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_im_le_exp
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n
  calc
    _ ≤ eps *
        (|(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
          (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).re| +
        |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
          (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).im|) := hbase
    _ ≤ eps * (C + C) := by
      gcongr
    _ = 2 * eps * C := by ring

/-- Fully damped imaginary-coordinate power bound obtained by bounding the two
geometric-coefficient coordinates independently. The explicit factor `2`
records that coordinate-separation loss. -/
theorem abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_im_le_exp_two
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (X : Ω → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 μ)
    (hMean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ ω, (X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) * |u| ≤ 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    |((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u) ^ n).im| ≤
      2 * ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ) *
        (n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1)) := by
  let eps := (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * ∫ ω, |X ω| ^ 3 ∂μ
  let C := n * (Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))) ^ (n - 1)
  have heps : 0 ≤ eps := by
    dsimp only [eps]
    positivity
  have hbase := abs_charFun_probabilityLaw_pow_im_le_geomSum
    X hX hMean hSecond u n
  have hre := abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_re_le_exp
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n
  have him := abs_complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum_charFun_im_le_exp
    X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall n
  calc
    _ ≤ eps *
        (|(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
          (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).re| +
        |(complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u)
          (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) n).im|) := hbase
    _ ≤ eps * (C + C) := by
      gcongr
    _ = 2 * eps * C := by ring

/-- The matching one-step Gaussian characteristic function contracts at
least as fast as `exp (-u²/4)`. -/
theorem norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_quarter_sq (u : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 4) := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  norm_num [pow_two, Complex.mul_re]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]

/-- The Gaussian one-step factor also lies below the sharper common damping
envelope used for the characteristic function. -/
theorem norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_five_twelfths_sq (u : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12)) := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  norm_num [pow_two, Complex.mul_re]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]

/-- Tunable quadratic damping coefficient obtained when the cubic Taylor
remainder is controlled on the window `c * rho * |u| ≤ 1`. -/
noncomputable def tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / 2 - 1 / (6 * c)

theorem tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_nonneg
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 ≤ c) :
    0 ≤ tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c := by
  unfold tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hc
  rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 6 * c)]
  nlinarith

/-- Parameterized local contraction.  Increasing `c` shrinks the Taylor
window while improving the quadratic contraction continuously toward the
Gaussian coefficient `1/2`. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_tunable_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c u : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      1 - tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  have hproxyNonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs u,
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg u) (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
  have hproxy : ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ = 1 - u ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [show 1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 = ((1 - u ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by
      push_cast
      ring]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hproxyNonneg]
  have hscaleNonneg : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 / (6 * c) := by positivity
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hscaleNonneg
  have hrem : (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * rho ≤ u ^ 2 / (6 * c) := by
    dsimp only [rho] at hscaled ⊢
    calc
      (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) =
          (c * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u|) *
            (u ^ 2 / (6 * c)) := by
        rw [show |u| ^ 3 = |u| * u ^ 2 by
          calc
            |u| ^ 3 = |u| * |u| ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = |u| * u ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]]
        field_simp [hc.ne']
      _ ≤ 1 * (u ^ 2 / (6 * c)) := hscaled
      _ = u ^ 2 / (6 * c) := one_mul _
  calc
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
            (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ + ‖1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2‖ := by
      calc
        _ = ‖(MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
              (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)) + (1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * rho + (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
          X hX hMean hSecond u)
        hproxy.le
    _ ≤ 1 - tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2 := by
      unfold tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient
      calc
        (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * rho + (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) ≤
            u ^ 2 / (6 * c) + (1 - u ^ 2 / 2) :=
          by simpa only [add_comm] using
            add_le_add_right hrem (1 - u ^ 2 / 2)
        _ = 1 - (1 / 2 - 1 / (6 * c)) * u ^ 2 := by ring

/-- Exponential form of the tunable characteristic-function contraction. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_tunable_sq
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c u : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2)) := by
  exact (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_one_sub_tunable_sq
    X hX hMean hSecond hc hu hsmall).trans (by
      simpa only using
        Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2))

/-- The one-step Gaussian factor is dominated by every positive-window
tunable damping envelope. -/
theorem norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_tunable_sq
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2)) := by
  rw [Complex.norm_exp]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  norm_num [pow_two, Complex.mul_re]
  unfold tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient
  have hinv : 0 ≤ 1 / (6 * c) := by positivity
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg u, mul_nonneg hinv (sq_nonneg u)]

/-- One-step characteristic-function comparison with the Gaussian
exponential, combining the cubic moment remainder and quartic proxy error. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      4 * |u| ^ 3 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 4 := by
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let B := 1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2
  let C := Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)
  change ‖A - C‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖A - C‖ = ‖(A - B) + (B - C)‖ := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ‖A - B‖ + ‖B - C‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment
        X hX hMean hSecond u)
      (norm_one_sub_half_sq_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le hu)

/-- Sharp one-step comparison with the Gaussian exponential. -/
theorem norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤
      (|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 8 := by
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let B := 1 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2
  let C := Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)
  change ‖A - C‖ ≤ _
  calc
    ‖A - C‖ = ‖(A - B) + (B - C)‖ := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ‖A - B‖ + ‖B - C‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
      (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_quadratic_le_thirdMoment_sharp
        X hX hMean hSecond u)
      (norm_one_sub_half_sq_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_sharp u)

/-- Powered characteristic-function comparison retaining the tunable local
contraction parameter. -/
theorem norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (n : ℕ) {c u : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u ^ n -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n‖ ≤
      n * Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2)) ^ (n - 1) *
        ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 8) := by
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let B := Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)
  let r := Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * u ^ 2))
  have hmax : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ≤ r := max_le
    (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_tunable_sq
      X hX hMean hSecond hc hu hsmall)
    (norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_tunable_sq hc u)
  have hpow : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) ≤ r ^ (n - 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hmax (n - 1)
  calc
    ‖A ^ n - B ^ n‖ ≤
        n * max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖A - B‖ :=
      norm_pow_sub_pow_le_max A B n
    _ ≤ n * r ^ (n - 1) *
        ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 8) := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_sharp
        X hX hMean hSecond hu

/-- Damped power comparison for a centered unit-variance characteristic
function. The geometric exponential factor is the key quantitative input
missing from the undamped polynomial estimate. -/
theorem norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u ^ n -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n‖ ≤
      n * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 4) ^ (n - 1) *
        (4 * |u| ^ 3 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 4) := by
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let B := Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)
  let r := Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 4)
  have hmax : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ≤ r := max_le
    (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_quarter_sq
      X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall)
    (norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_quarter_sq u)
  have hpow : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) ≤ r ^ (n - 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hmax (n - 1)
  calc
    ‖A ^ n - B ^ n‖ ≤
        n * max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖A - B‖ :=
      norm_pow_sub_pow_le_max A B n
    _ ≤ n * r ^ (n - 1) *
        (4 * |u| ^ 3 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 4) := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le
        X hX hMean hSecond hu

/-- Sharp damped power comparison, retaining both the exact cubic Taylor
coefficient and the stronger local contraction. -/
theorem norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : Omega → ℝ) (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : |u| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |u| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u ^ n -
        Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) ^ n‖ ≤
      n * Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12)) ^ (n - 1) *
        ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 8) := by
  let A := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      X hX.aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let B := Complex.exp (-(u : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)
  let r := Real.exp (-(5 * u ^ 2 / 12))
  have hmax : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ≤ r := max_le
    (norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_le_exp_neg_five_twelfths_sq
      X hX hMean hSecond hu hsmall)
    (norm_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_exp_neg_five_twelfths_sq u)
  have hpow : max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) ≤ r ^ (n - 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hmax (n - 1)
  calc
    ‖A ^ n - B ^ n‖ ≤
        n * max ‖A‖ ‖B‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖A - B‖ :=
      norm_pow_sub_pow_le_max A B n
    _ ≤ n * r ^ (n - 1) *
        ((|u| ^ 3 / 6) * (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) + |u| ^ 4 / 8) := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_charFun_probabilityLaw_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_le_sharp
        X hX hMean hSecond hu

/-- Damped characteristic-function comparison for the normalized centered
i.i.d. sum and the standard normal. -/
theorem norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable :
              Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4) := by
  let hX2 : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu := fun i =>
    (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
    ← cexp_neg_half_sq_div_sqrt_pow_succ N t,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw_normalizedCenteredIidSum
      X hX2 hIndep hIdent N t]
  have hcf :
      (∫ omega, Complex.exp
        ((((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * X 0 omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with omega
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hcf]
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
    (norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped
      (X 0) (hX 0) hMean hSecond (N + 1) ht hsmall)

/-- Sharp damped characteristic-function comparison for the normalized
centered i.i.d. sum and the standard normal. -/
theorem norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)

    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun

        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8) := by
  let hX2 : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu := fun i =>

  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
