      (∫ omega, Complex.exp
        ((((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * X 0 omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with omega
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hcf]

    (norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped_sharp
      (X 0) (hX 0) hMean hSecond (N + 1) ht hsmall)

/-- Damped normalized-sum estimate in discrepancy-quotient form. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t| := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht0]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall)
      (abs_nonneg t)

/-- Algebraic simplification of the damped normalized quotient. -/
theorem normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq
    (N : ℕ) (t rho damping : ℝ) :
    ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * damping *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 * rho +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t|) =
      damping * (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  calc
    _ = damping *
        (((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 * rho) +
            ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4))) / |t|) := by
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [normalized_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq N t rho]

/-- Simplified damped polynomial bound for the normalized discrepancy
quotient. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N *
        (4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t|) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall
    _ = _ := normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq N t
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu)
      (Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N)

/-- Sharp damped normalized-sum estimate in discrepancy-quotient form. -/

        Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8)) / |t| := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht0]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped_sharp
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall)
      (abs_nonneg t)

/-- Algebraic normalization of the sharp damped cubic/quartic quotient. -/
theorem normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq_sharp
    (N : ℕ) (t rho damping : ℝ) :
    ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * damping *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) * rho +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8)) / |t|) =
      damping * (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  calc
    _ = ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (damping / 2) *
        (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 * (rho / 12) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4)) / |t|) := by ring
    _ = (damping / 2) * (4 * (rho / 12) * |t| ^ 2 /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) :=
      normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq N t (rho / 12) (damping / 2)
    _ = _ := by
      have hn : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hs : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hn, hs]
      ring

/-- Sharp simplified damped polynomial bound for the normalized discrepancy
quotient. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8)) / |t|) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_sharp
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall
    _ = _ := normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq_sharp N t
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu)
      (Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N)

/-- Tunable damped characteristic-function comparison for the normalized
centered i.i.d. sum and the standard normal.  The window parameter is retained
so that the eventual smoothing cutoff and Gaussian envelope can be optimized
jointly. -/
theorem norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    ‖MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable :
              Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8) := by
  let hX2 : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu := fun i =>
    (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
    ← cexp_neg_half_sq_div_sqrt_pow_succ N t,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw_normalizedCenteredIidSum
      X hX2 hIndep hIdent N t]
  have hcf :
      (∫ omega, Complex.exp
        ((((t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * X 0 omega : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with omega
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hcf]
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
    (norm_charFun_pow_sub_cexp_neg_half_sq_pow_le_damped_tunable
      (X 0) (hX 0) hMean hSecond (N + 1) hc ht hsmall)

/-- Tunable damped normalized-sum estimate in discrepancy-quotient form. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8)) / |t|) := by
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · rw [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht0]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le_damped_tunable
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N hc ht hsmall)
      (abs_nonneg t)

/-- Simplified tunable damped polynomial bound for the normalized discrepancy
quotient. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N *
        ((|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 / 6) *
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
          |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 8)) / |t|) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_tunable
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N hc ht hsmall
    _ = _ := normalized_damped_cubic_quartic_quotient_eq_sharp N t
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu)
      (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
        (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N)

theorem tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) :
    0 < tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c := by
  unfold tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  rw [sub_pos, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 6 * c)]
  nlinarith

/-- Exact conversion of the normalized powered damping into a Gaussian in
the original Fourier frequency. -/
theorem rexp_neg_tunable_div_sqrt_sq_pow_eq
    (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
        (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N =
      Real.exp (-((N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) *
        tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2)) := by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  generalize hsdef : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) = s at *
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [← hs2]
  field_simp [hspos.ne']

/-- For at least two summands, the exact tunable exponent admits an
`N`-independent Gaussian envelope while retaining the window parameter. -/
theorem rexp_neg_tunable_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 ≤ c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
        (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) := by
  rw [rexp_neg_tunable_div_sqrt_sq_pow_eq]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hratio : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < N + 1)]
    have hNc : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    nlinarith
  have hcoeff : 0 ≤ tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c :=
    tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_nonneg hc
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio
    (mul_nonneg hcoeff (sq_nonneg t))
  nlinarith

/-- Endpoint of the local cubic-remainder frequency window. -/
noncomputable def tunableThirdMomentCutoff
    (c rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) / (c * rho)

/-- The tunable local Taylor condition is exactly the absolute-frequency
cutoff, provided its two scale parameters are positive. -/
theorem tunableThirdMomentCondition_iff_abs_le_cutoff
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    c * rho * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ↔
      |t| ≤ tunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N := by
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  unfold tunableThirdMomentCutoff
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  rw [show c * rho * (|t| / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) =
      (c * rho * |t|) / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) by ring,
    div_le_iff₀ hspos, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hc hrho)]
  simp only [mul_left_comm, mul_comm, one_mul]

/-- Polynomial moments are integrable against every positive tunable
Gaussian envelope. -/
theorem integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => |t| ^ k *
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) := by
  have hcoeff : 0 < tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c :=
    tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos hc
  have h := integrable_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq
    (b := tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c / 2) (by positivity)
    (s := (k : ℝ)) (by
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith)
  have hn := h.norm
  convert hn using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Real.rpow_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  congr 2
  ring

/-- `c`-dependent Gaussian moments governing the integrated tunable
characteristic-function estimate. -/
noncomputable def tunableGaussianDampedMoment (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t : ℝ, |t| ^ k *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))

theorem tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ tunableGaussianDampedMoment c k := by
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity

/-- The positive-frequency half of a tunable Gaussian moment is exactly half
of its full-line absolute moment.  This is the symmetry bridge needed to
integrate Prawitz bounds without losing a factor of two. -/
theorem integral_Ioi_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq
    (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), |t| ^ k *
        Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) =
      tunableGaussianDampedMoment c k / 2 := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ k *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * z ^ 2 / 2))
  have hEven : tunableGaussianDampedMoment c k =
      2 * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t := by
    unfold tunableGaussianDampedMoment
    calc
      (∫ t : ℝ, |t| ^ k *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) =
          ∫ t : ℝ, f |t| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
          dsimp only [f]
          rw [sq_abs]
      _ = 2 * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t := integral_comp_abs
  have hPositive :
      (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), |t| ^ k *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) =
        ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t := by
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
    intro t ht
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [abs_of_pos ht]
  rw [hPositive, hEven]
  ring

/-- Closed form of the quadratic tunable Gaussian moment. -/
theorem tunableGaussianDampedMoment_two
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) :
    tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 =
      (tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c / 2) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        (Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2) := by
  let a : ℝ := tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c / 2
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp only [a]
    exact div_pos (tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos hc) (by norm_num)
  have hHalf :
      (∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
        a ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * (1 / 2) * Real.Gamma (3 / 2) := by
    convert (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (2 : ℝ)) (b := a)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha) using 1
    · apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro x hx
      simp only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [a]
      ring
    · ring
  have hEven :
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
        2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 *
            Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * z ^ 2 / 2)))
              |x| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
          change |x| ^ 2 *
              Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2)) =
            |x| ^ 2 * Real.exp
              (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * |x| ^ 2 / 2))
          rw [sq_abs]
      _ = _ := integral_comp_abs
        (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * z ^ 2 / 2)))
  have hGamma : Real.Gamma (3 / 2) = Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2 := by
    rw [show (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / 2 + 1 by ring,
      Real.Gamma_add_one (by norm_num), Real.Gamma_one_half_eq]
    ring
  unfold tunableGaussianDampedMoment
  rw [hEven, hHalf, hGamma]
  dsimp only [a]
  ring

/-- Closed form of the cubic tunable Gaussian moment. -/
theorem tunableGaussianDampedMoment_three
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) :
    tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 =
      4 / tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c ^ 2 := by
  let a : ℝ := tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c / 2
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp only [a]
    exact div_pos (tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos hc) (by norm_num)
  have hHalf :
      (∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
        1 / (2 * a ^ 2) := by
    convert (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (3 : ℝ)) (b := a)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ha) using 1
    · apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro x hx
      simp only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [a]
      ring
    · rw [show ((3 : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num,
        Real.Gamma_add_one one_ne_zero, Real.Gamma_one]
      rw [show (-(3 + 1) / 2 : ℝ) = -2 by norm_num,
        Real.rpow_neg ha.le, Real.rpow_two]
      field_simp [ha.ne']
  have hEven :
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
        2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2))) =
          ∫ x : ℝ, (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 *
            Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * z ^ 2 / 2)))
              |x| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
          change |x| ^ 3 *
              Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * x ^ 2 / 2)) =
            |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp
              (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * |x| ^ 2 / 2))
          rw [sq_abs]
      _ = _ := integral_comp_abs
        (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 *
          Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * z ^ 2 / 2)))
  unfold tunableGaussianDampedMoment
  rw [hEven, hHalf]
  dsimp only [a]
  have hcoeff : tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c ≠ 0 :=
    (tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos hc).ne'
  field_simp [hcoeff]
  ring

/-- Kernel-independent positive-frequency cost of the tunable sharp Taylor
majorant at Fourier prefactor `1 / π`. -/
noncomputable def idealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.pi) *
    ((1 / 6) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
      (1 / 8) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3)

/-- Even with an ideal unit filter and no spatial smoothing remainder, the
absolute cubic/quartic tunable Taylor route remains above coefficient one. -/
theorem one_lt_idealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) :
    1 < idealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant c := by
  let a : ℝ := tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c
  have ha : 0 < a := tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient_pos hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have haHalf : a < 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp only [a, tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient]
    have hinv : 0 < 1 / (6 * c) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hb : a / 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have hquarter : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) = 8 := by
    norm_num [Real.rpow_neg]
  have hrpow : 8 ≤ (a / 2) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← hquarter]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hb (by norm_num)
  have hsqrt : 7 / 4 < Real.sqrt Real.pi := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 7 / 4)]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_d2]
  have hM2 : 4 * Real.sqrt Real.pi ≤
      tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 := by
    rw [tunableGaussianDampedMoment_two hc]
    dsimp only [a] at hrpow ⊢
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrpow
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt Real.pi / 2)]
  have hM3 : 16 < tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 := by
    rw [tunableGaussianDampedMoment_three hc]
    change 16 < 4 / a ^ 2
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos ha)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1 / 2)]
  have hsum : Real.pi <
      (1 / 6) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
        (1 / 8) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_d2]
  have heq : idealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant c =
      ((1 / 6) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
        (1 / 8) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3) / Real.pi := by
    unfold idealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  rw [heq]
  exact (one_lt_div Real.pi_pos).2 hsum

/-- Ideal positive-frequency coefficient after absorbing the quartic proxy
term into the cubic term on the tunable window. -/
noncomputable def absorbedIdealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
    (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.pi) * (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
    tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2

/-- At the concrete admissible choice `c = 2`, the absorbed Fourier cost is
strictly below one.  Thus the remaining coefficient-one obstruction belongs
to spatial smoothing, not to the local characteristic-function estimate. -/
theorem absorbedIdealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant_two_lt_one :
    absorbedIdealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant 2 < 1 := by
  have hc : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 2 := by norm_num
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < 5 / 24 := by norm_num
  have hrpow : (5 / 24 : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) =
      1 / ((5 / 24 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (5 / 24 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hb.le]
    rw [show (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 / 2 by ring,
      Real.rpow_add hb, Real.rpow_one, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    rw [one_div]
  have hM2eq : tunableGaussianDampedMoment 2 2 =
      Real.sqrt Real.pi /
        (2 * (5 / 24 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (5 / 24 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [tunableGaussianDampedMoment_two hc]
    have hcoeff : tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient 2 / 2 = (5 / 24 : ℝ) := by
      norm_num [tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient]
    rw [hcoeff]
    rw [hrpow]
    ring
  have hsqrtPi : Real.sqrt Real.pi < 2 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_lt_four]
  have hsqrtB : (9 / 20 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (5 / 24 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9 / 20)]
    norm_num
  have hden : (3 / 16 : ℝ) <
      2 * (5 / 24 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (5 / 24 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hden0 : 0 <
      2 * (5 / 24 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (5 / 24 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hM2 : tunableGaussianDampedMoment 2 2 < 32 / 3 := by
    rw [hM2eq, div_lt_iff₀ hden0]
    nlinarith
  unfold absorbedIdealTunableBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
  norm_num
  rw [show Real.pi⁻¹ * (11 / 48) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment 2 2 =
      ((11 / 48) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment 2 2) / Real.pi by ring,
    div_lt_one Real.pi_pos]
  nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_d2]

/-- Tunable Gaussian-majorized discrepancy quotient on its local Taylor
window, valid once the normalized sum contains at least two variables. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 ≤ c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hc
  have hpoly : 0 ≤
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
          (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
      integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
    positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c *
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2)) ^ N *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial_tunable
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N hc0 ht hsmall
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (rexp_neg_tunable_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le hc hN t) hpoly

theorem integrable_tunableGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 3
  have hsum :=
    (h2.const_mul (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)))).add
      (h3.const_mul (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))))
  convert hsum using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  ring

/-- Exact quadratic/cubic moment decomposition of the integrated tunable
Gaussian discrepancy majorant. -/
theorem integral_tunableGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ,
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 3
  rw [show (fun t : ℝ =>
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      fun t => (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          (|t| ^ 2 * Real.exp
            (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          (|t| ^ 3 * Real.exp
            (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))) by
    funext t
    ring]
  rw [integral_add (h2.const_mul _) (h3.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rfl

/-- Full frequency window on which both the unit-frequency Taylor hypothesis
and the tunable cubic-remainder condition hold. -/
def tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
    (c rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Set ℝ :=
  {t | |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
    c * rho * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1}

theorem measurableSet_tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
    (c rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N) := by
  simp only [tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow, Set.setOf_and]
  exact (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).inter
    (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))

/-- Maximal symmetric cutoff satisfying both constraints in the full tunable
window. -/
noncomputable def admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff
    (c rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  min (Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) (tunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N)

theorem admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    0 < admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N := by
  unfold admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff tunableThirdMomentCutoff
  exact lt_min (by positivity) (div_pos (by positivity) (mul_pos hc hrho))

theorem admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N =
      Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) / max 1 (c * rho) := by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hcr : 0 < c * rho := mul_pos hc hrho
  unfold admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff tunableThirdMomentCutoff
  by_cases h : 1 ≤ c * rho
  · rw [max_eq_right h, min_eq_right]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hcr]
    nlinarith
  · have hle : c * rho ≤ 1 := le_of_not_ge h
    rw [max_eq_left hle, div_one, min_eq_left]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hcr]
    nlinarith

/-- Increasing the damping-window parameter can only decrease the admissible
Taylor cutoff. -/
theorem admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_antitone
    {rho cOuter cInner : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hcOuter : 0 < cOuter) (hcOuterInner : cOuter ≤ cInner) (N : ℕ) :
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cInner rho N ≤
      admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter rho N := by
  have hcInner : 0 < cInner := hcOuter.trans_le hcOuterInner
  rw [admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max hcInner hrho N,
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max hcOuter hrho N]
  have hprod : cOuter * rho ≤ cInner * rho :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcOuterInner hrho.le
  have hmax : max 1 (cOuter * rho) ≤ max 1 (cInner * rho) :=
    max_le_max le_rfl hprod
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)) hmax

theorem Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    Icc (-(admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N))
        (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N) ⊆
      tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N := by
  intro t ht
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have habs : |t| ≤ admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N :=
    abs_le.mpr ht
  constructor
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs, div_le_one hs]
    exact habs.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  · exact (tunableThirdMomentCondition_iff_abs_le_cutoff hc hrho N t).2
      (habs.trans (min_le_right _ _))

/-- Integrated tunable characteristic-function discrepancy on its full
admissible window. -/
theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N,
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
      (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g]
    have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
    positivity
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using
      integrable_tunableGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant hc rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q :=
    stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  have hqS : Integrable q (volume.restrict S) := by
    apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
    exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc.le hN ht.1 ht.2
  change (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, g t := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hqS hg.integrableOn
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
      exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc.le hN ht.1 ht.2
    _ ≤ ∫ t, g t :=
      integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self
        (ae_of_all volume hgNonneg) hg
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [g, rho] using
        integral_tunableGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant hc rho N

theorem integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    IntegrableOn
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
      (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using
      integrable_tunableGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant hc rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q :=
    stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  change Integrable q (volume.restrict S)
  apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
  exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc.le hN ht.1 ht.2

/-- For at least two summands, the normalized geometric damping is bounded
by a fixed Gaussian in the original Fourier frequency. -/
theorem rexp_neg_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le_rexp_neg_sq_eighth
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N ≤
      Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) := by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  generalize hsdef : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) = s at *
  have hratio : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < N + 1)]
    have hNc : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    nlinarith
  have hexact :
      (N : ℝ) * (-(t / s) ^ 2 / 4) =
        -((N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ)) * t ^ 2 / 4 := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [← hs2]
    field_simp [hspos.ne']
  rw [hexact]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio
    (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg t) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4))
  nlinarith

/-- Fixed Gaussian envelope for the sharper powered contraction. -/
theorem rexp_neg_five_twelfths_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N ≤
      Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) := by
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  generalize hsdef : Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) = s at *
  have hratio : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < N + 1)]
    have hNc : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    nlinarith
  have hexact :
      (N : ℝ) * (-(5 * (t / s) ^ 2 / 12)) =
        -((N : ℝ) / (N + 1 : ℝ)) * (5 * t ^ 2 / 12) := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [← hs2]
    field_simp [hspos.ne']
  rw [hexact]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ 5 * t ^ 2 / 12)
  nlinarith

/-- Gaussian-majorized discrepancy quotient on the full third-moment Taylor
window, valid once the normalized sum contains at least two variables. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 16 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
        (4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hpoly : 0 ≤
      4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 4) ^ N *
        (4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (rexp_neg_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le_rexp_neg_sq_eighth hN t) hpoly

/-- Sharp Gaussian-majorized discrepancy quotient on the enlarged
third-moment Taylor window. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_sharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : 2 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hpoly : 0 ≤
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
          (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(5 * (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 12)) ^ N *
        ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
          |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_damped_polynomial_sharp
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N ht hsmall
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (rexp_neg_five_twelfths_div_sqrt_sq_pow_le_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq
        hN t)
      hpoly

/-- Every absolute polynomial moment is integrable against the fixed
Gaussian damping used above. -/
theorem integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_eighth (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => |t| ^ k * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8)) := by
  have h := integrable_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq
    (b := (1 / 8 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (s := (k : ℝ)) (by
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith)
  have hn := h.norm
  convert hn using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Real.rpow_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  congr 2
  ring

/-- Fixed Gaussian moments appearing in the integrated discrepancy bound. -/
noncomputable def gaussianDampedMoment (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t : ℝ, |t| ^ k * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8)

theorem gaussianDampedMoment_nonneg (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ gaussianDampedMoment k := by
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity

/-- The Gaussian-majorized normalized discrepancy is globally integrable. -/
theorem integrable_gaussianDiscrepancyMajorant (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
      (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_eighth 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_eighth 3
  have hsum :=
    (h2.const_mul (4 * rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))).add
      (h3.const_mul (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))))
  convert hsum using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  ring

/-- Exact decomposition of the integrated Gaussian discrepancy majorant into
two fixed universal moments. -/
theorem integral_gaussianDiscrepancyMajorant (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
      (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      (4 * rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * gaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * gaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_eighth 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_sq_eighth 3
  rw [show (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
      (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      fun t => (4 * rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) *
          (|t| ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8)) +
        (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          (|t| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8)) by
    funext t
    ring]
  rw [integral_add (h2.const_mul _) (h3.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rfl

/-- Every absolute polynomial moment is integrable against the sharper fixed
Gaussian damping. -/
theorem integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq (k : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => |t| ^ k * Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24))) := by
  have h := integrable_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq
    (b := (5 / 24 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (s := (k : ℝ)) (by
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith)
  have hn := h.norm
  convert hn using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Real.rpow_natCast, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  congr 2
  ring

/-- Fixed moments for the sharp Gaussian discrepancy majorant. -/
noncomputable def sharpGaussianDampedMoment (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t : ℝ, |t| ^ k * Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24))

theorem sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg (k : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ sharpGaussianDampedMoment k := by
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity

/-- Exact cubic moment of the fixed sharp Gaussian damping profile. -/
theorem sharpGaussianDampedMoment_three :
    sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3 = 576 / 25 := by
  unfold sharpGaussianDampedMoment
  have hHalf :
      (∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ), x ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24))) =
        288 / 25 := by
    convert (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (3 : ℝ)) (b := (5 / 24 : ℝ))
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) using 1
    · apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro x hx
      simp only [Real.rpow_ofNat]
      congr 1
      ring
    · rw [show ((3 : ℝ) + 1) / 2 = 1 + 1 by norm_num,
        Real.Gamma_add_one one_ne_zero, Real.Gamma_one]
      norm_num [Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 24)]
  have hEven :
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24))) =
        2 * ∫ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          x ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24)) := by
    calc
      (∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24))) =
          ∫ x : ℝ,
            (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * z ^ 2 / 24))) |x| := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
          change |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24)) =
            |x| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * |x| ^ 2 / 24))
          rw [sq_abs]
      _ = _ := integral_comp_abs
        (f := fun z : ℝ => z ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * z ^ 2 / 24)))
  rw [hEven, hHalf]
  ring

/-- A certified rational lower bound for the quadratic sharp Gaussian-
damped moment.  The elementary inequality `1-u ≤ exp(-u)` on `[-2,2]`
already suffices for the frequency-route audit. -/
theorem eight_div_three_le_sharpGaussianDampedMoment_two :
    8 / 3 ≤ sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x ^ 2 * (1 - 5 * x ^ 2 / 24)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => |x| ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24))
  have hf : IntegrableOn f (Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_Icc
    fun_prop
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using
      integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq 2
  have hgOn : IntegrableOn g (Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) := hg.integrableOn
  have hpoint : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x := by
    intro x
    dsimp only [f, g]
    rw [show |x| ^ 2 = x ^ 2 by exact sq_abs x]
    have hexp : 1 - 5 * x ^ 2 / 24 ≤
        Real.exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24)) := by
      convert Real.add_one_le_exp (-(5 * x ^ 2 / 24)) using 1; ring
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (sq_nonneg x)
  have hpoly : (∫ x in Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, f x) = 8 / 3 := by
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) volume (-2) 2 :=
      (continuous_id.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have h4 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) volume (-2) 2 :=
      (continuous_id.pow 4).intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (-2 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [show (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (1 - 5 * x ^ 2 / 24)) =
        fun x => x ^ 2 - (5 / 24) * x ^ 4 by funext x; ring,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub h2 (h4.const_mul (5 / 24)),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow, integral_pow]
    norm_num
  calc
    8 / 3 = ∫ x in Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, f x := hpoly.symm
    _ ≤ ∫ x in Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2, g x := setIntegral_mono hf hgOn hpoint
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, g x := setIntegral_le_integral hg
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => by dsimp only [g]; positivity)
    _ = sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 := rfl

/-- The sharp Gaussian-majorized discrepancy is globally integrable. -/
theorem integrable_sharpGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
      (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq 3
  have hsum :=
    (h2.const_mul (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)))).add
      (h3.const_mul (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))))
  convert hsum using 1
  funext t
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  ring

/-- Exact decomposition of the integrated sharp Gaussian discrepancy
majorant into two fixed universal moments. -/
theorem integral_sharpGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
      (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq 2
  have h3 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_five_twentyfourths_sq 3
  rw [show (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
      (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
        |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))) =
      fun t => (rho / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          (|t| ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24))) +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
          (|t| ^ 3 * Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24))) by
    funext t
    ring]
  rw [integral_add (h2.const_mul _) (h3.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rfl

/-- Frequency window on which the cubic characteristic-function remainder is
dominated by the quadratic variance term. -/
def normalizedThirdMomentWindow (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Set ℝ :=
  {t | |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
    16 * rho * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1}

theorem measurableSet_normalizedThirdMomentWindow (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N) := by
  simp only [normalizedThirdMomentWindow, Set.setOf_and]
  exact (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).inter
    (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))

/-- The integrated characteristic-function discrepancy on the third-moment
window has the required `rho / sqrt(n)` leading scale, plus a lower-order
`1 / n` Gaussian-proxy term. -/
theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_window_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in normalizedThirdMomentWindow
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N,
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * gaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * gaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
    (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
      |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g]
    positivity
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using integrable_gaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q := by
    exact stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  have hqS : Integrable q (volume.restrict S) := by
    apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
    exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2
  change (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, g t := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hqS hg.integrableOn
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
      exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2
    _ ≤ ∫ t, g t :=
      integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self
        (ae_of_all volume hgNonneg) hg
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [g, rho] using integral_gaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N

/-- Enlarged frequency window certified by the sharp cubic remainder. -/
def sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Set ℝ :=
  {t | |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 ∧
    2 * rho * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1}

theorem measurableSet_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    MeasurableSet (sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N) := by
  simp only [sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow, Set.setOf_and]
  exact (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).inter
    (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))

/-- Integrated sharp characteristic-function discrepancy on the enlarged
third-moment window. -/
theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpWindow_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N,
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
    (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
      |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g]
    positivity
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using integrable_sharpGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q := by
    exact stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  have hqS : Integrable q (volume.restrict S) := by
    apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
    exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_sharp
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2
  change (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, g t := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hqS hg.integrableOn
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
      exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_sharp
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2
    _ ≤ ∫ t, g t :=
      integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self
        (ae_of_all volume hgNonneg) hg
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [g, rho] using integral_sharpGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N

/-- One-sided absorption estimate for a smoothing measure with a controlled
right tail.  Unlike compact-spatial-support smoothing, the tail contribution
is proportional to the unknown Kolmogorov distance; this is the mechanism
used by compact-frequency Esseen kernels. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_right_tail
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) kappa)
    {a q m epsilon L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (htail : kappa.real (Ioi a) ≤ q)
    (hmoment : (∫ y, |a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m)
    (hnuLip : ∀ u v, |cdf nu u - cdf nu v| ≤ L * |u - v|)
    (hsmooth : ∀ x,
      |smoothedCDF mu kappa x - smoothedCDF nu kappa x| ≤ epsilon)
    (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
      epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  let d : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance mu nu
  let z : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => x + a - y
  let tail : ℝ → ℝ := (Ioi a).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := kolmogorovDistance_nonneg mu nu
  have hmomentInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |a - y|) kappa :=
    ((integrable_const a).sub hkappa1).norm
  have htailInt : Integrable tail kappa := by
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Ioi
  have hdiffInt : Integrable
      (fun y => cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y)) kappa := by
    exact (integrable_cdf_translate mu kappa (x + a)).sub
      (integrable_cdf_translate nu kappa (x + a))
  have hmajorInt : Integrable
      (fun y => cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) +
        L * |a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) kappa :=
    (hdiffInt.add (hmomentInt.const_mul L)).add
      (htailInt.const_mul (2 * d))
  have hpoint : ∀ y,
      cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
        cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) +
          L * |a - y| + 2 * d * tail y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ≤ a
    · have hmuMono : cdf mu x ≤ cdf mu (z y) := by
        apply monotone_cdf mu
        dsimp only [z]
        linarith
      have hnu := (abs_le.mp (hnuLip (z y) x)).2
      have hz : z y - x = a - y := by
        dsimp only [z]
        ring
      rw [hz] at hnu
      have htailZero : tail y = 0 := by
        simp only [tail, Set.indicator_apply]
        split_ifs with hya
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hy hya).elim
        · rfl
      rw [htailZero, mul_zero, add_zero]
      linarith
    · have hyTail : y ∈ Ioi a := lt_of_not_ge hy
      have hxGap : cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤ d := by
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans
          (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x)
      have hzGap : -d ≤ cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) := by
        exact (neg_le_neg
          (cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu (z y))).trans <| by
            simpa only [cdfGap] using neg_abs_le
              (cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y))
      have htailOne : tail y = 1 := by
        simp only [tail, Set.indicator_apply, hyTail, if_true]
      rw [htailOne, mul_one]
      have hmomentNonneg : 0 ≤ L * |a - y| :=
        mul_nonneg hL (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
  have hintegral :
      cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
        ∫ y, (cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) +
          L * |a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) ∂kappa := by
    calc
      cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
          ∫ _ : ℝ, (cdf mu x - cdf nu x) ∂kappa := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := integral_mono (integrable_const _) hmajorInt hpoint
  calc
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
        ∫ y, (cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) +
          L * |a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) ∂kappa := hintegral
    _ = (smoothedCDF mu kappa (x + a) -
          smoothedCDF nu kappa (x + a)) +
        L * (∫ y, |a - y| ∂kappa) +
        2 * d * kappa.real (Ioi a) := by
      calc
        _ = (∫ y, (cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) +
              L * |a - y|) ∂kappa) +
            ∫ y, 2 * d * tail y ∂kappa :=
          integral_add (hdiffInt.add (hmomentInt.const_mul L))
            (htailInt.const_mul (2 * d))
        _ = ((∫ y, cdf mu (z y) - cdf nu (z y) ∂kappa) +
              ∫ y, L * |a - y| ∂kappa) +
            ∫ y, 2 * d * tail y ∂kappa := by
          rw [integral_add hdiffInt (hmomentInt.const_mul L)]
        _ = (smoothedCDF mu kappa (x + a) -
              smoothedCDF nu kappa (x + a)) +
            L * (∫ y, |a - y| ∂kappa) +
            2 * d * (∫ y, tail y ∂kappa) := by
          rw [integral_sub (integrable_cdf_translate mu kappa (x + a))
              (integrable_cdf_translate nu kappa (x + a)),
            integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
          rfl
        _ = _ := by
          rw [show (∫ y, tail y ∂kappa) = kappa.real (Ioi a) by
            exact integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Ioi]
    _ ≤ epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * d := by
      have hs := (le_abs_self _).trans (hsmooth (x + a))
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hL
      have ht : (2 * d) * kappa.real (Ioi a) ≤ (2 * d) * q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail
          (mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) hd)
      nlinarith
    _ = epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
      rfl

/-- Mirrored one-sided absorption estimate for the left tail of a smoothing
measure. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_left_tail
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) kappa)
    {a q m epsilon L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (htail : kappa.real (Iio (-a)) ≤ q)
    (hmoment : (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m)
    (hnuLip : ∀ u v, |cdf nu u - cdf nu v| ≤ L * |u - v|)
    (hsmooth : ∀ x,
      |smoothedCDF mu kappa x - smoothedCDF nu kappa x| ≤ epsilon)
    (x : ℝ) :
    cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
      epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  let d : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance mu nu
  let z : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => x - a - y
  let tail : ℝ → ℝ := (Iio (-a)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := kolmogorovDistance_nonneg mu nu
  have hmomentInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |-a - y|) kappa :=
    ((integrable_const (-a)).sub hkappa1).norm
  have htailInt : Integrable tail kappa := by
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iio
  have hdiffInt : Integrable
      (fun y => cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y)) kappa := by
    exact (integrable_cdf_translate nu kappa (x - a)).sub
      (integrable_cdf_translate mu kappa (x - a))
  have hmajorInt : Integrable
      (fun y => cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) +
        L * |-a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) kappa :=
    (hdiffInt.add (hmomentInt.const_mul L)).add
      (htailInt.const_mul (2 * d))
  have hpoint : ∀ y,
      cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
        cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) +
          L * |-a - y| + 2 * d * tail y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : -a ≤ y
    · have hmuMono : cdf mu (z y) ≤ cdf mu x := by
        apply monotone_cdf mu
        dsimp only [z]
        linarith
      have hnu := (abs_le.mp (hnuLip x (z y))).2
      have hz : x - z y = a + y := by
        dsimp only [z]
        ring
      rw [hz, show |a + y| = |-a - y| by rw [← abs_neg]; congr 1; ring] at hnu
      have htailZero : tail y = 0 := by
        simp only [tail, Set.indicator_apply]
        split_ifs with hya
        · exact (not_lt_of_ge hy hya).elim
        · rfl
      rw [htailZero, mul_zero, add_zero]
      linarith
    · have hyTail : y ∈ Iio (-a) := lt_of_not_ge hy
      have hxGap : cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤ d := by
        exact (le_abs_self _).trans <| by
          simpa only [cdfGap, abs_sub_comm] using
            cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
      have hzGap : -d ≤ cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) := by
        have hgap := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu (z y)
        rw [cdfGap, abs_sub_comm] at hgap
        exact (neg_le_neg hgap).trans
          (neg_abs_le (cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y)))
      have htailOne : tail y = 1 := by
        simp only [tail, Set.indicator_apply, hyTail, if_true]
      rw [htailOne, mul_one]
      have hmomentNonneg : 0 ≤ L * |-a - y| :=
        mul_nonneg hL (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
  have hintegral :
      cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
        ∫ y, (cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) +
          L * |-a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) ∂kappa := by
    calc
      cdf nu x - cdf mu x =
          ∫ _ : ℝ, (cdf nu x - cdf mu x) ∂kappa := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := integral_mono (integrable_const _) hmajorInt hpoint
  calc
    cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
        ∫ y, (cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) +
          L * |-a - y| + 2 * d * tail y) ∂kappa := hintegral
    _ = (smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a) -
          smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a)) +
        L * (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂kappa) +
        2 * d * kappa.real (Iio (-a)) := by
      calc
        _ = (∫ y, (cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) +
              L * |-a - y|) ∂kappa) +
            ∫ y, 2 * d * tail y ∂kappa :=
          integral_add (hdiffInt.add (hmomentInt.const_mul L))
            (htailInt.const_mul (2 * d))
        _ = ((∫ y, cdf nu (z y) - cdf mu (z y) ∂kappa) +
              ∫ y, L * |-a - y| ∂kappa) +
            ∫ y, 2 * d * tail y ∂kappa := by
          rw [integral_add hdiffInt (hmomentInt.const_mul L)]
        _ = (smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a) -
              smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a)) +
            L * (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂kappa) +
            2 * d * (∫ y, tail y ∂kappa) := by
          rw [integral_sub (integrable_cdf_translate nu kappa (x - a))
              (integrable_cdf_translate mu kappa (x - a)),
            integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
          rfl
        _ = _ := by
          rw [show (∫ y, tail y ∂kappa) = kappa.real (Iio (-a)) by
            exact integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Iio]
    _ ≤ epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * d := by
      have hs : smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a) -
          smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a) ≤ epsilon := by
        calc
          smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a) -
              smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a) ≤
              |smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a) -
                smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a)| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |smoothedCDF mu kappa (x - a) -
                smoothedCDF nu kappa (x - a)| := abs_sub_comm _ _
          _ ≤ epsilon := hsmooth (x - a)
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmoment hL
      have ht : (2 * d) * kappa.real (Iio (-a)) ≤ (2 * d) * q :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail
          (mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) hd)
      nlinarith
    _ = epsilon + L * m + 2 * q * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
      rfl

/-- Esseen's deterministic absorption principle.  If a common smoothing
measure has both tails bounded by `q < 1/2`, its smoothed CDFs are uniformly
`epsilon`-close, and the target CDF is `L`-Lipschitz, then the unsmoothed
Kolmogorov distance is controlled with the tail loss absorbed into the factor
`(1 - 2q)⁻¹`. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_tails
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) kappa)
    {a q m epsilon L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hq : 2 * q < 1)
    (hRightTail : kappa.real (Ioi a) ≤ q)
    (hLeftTail : kappa.real (Iio (-a)) ≤ q)
    (hRightMoment : (∫ y, |a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m)
    (hLeftMoment : (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m)
    (hnuLip : ∀ u v, |cdf nu u - cdf nu v| ≤ L * |u - v|)
    (hsmooth : ∀ x,
      |smoothedCDF mu kappa x - smoothedCDF nu kappa x| ≤ epsilon) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu nu ≤
      (epsilon + L * m) / (1 - 2 * q) := by
  let d : ℝ := kolmogorovDistance mu nu
  let B : ℝ := epsilon + L * m
  have hpoint : ∀ x, cdfGap mu nu x ≤ B + 2 * q * d := by
    intro x
    rw [cdfGap, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have hleft := cdf_sub_cdf_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_left_tail
          mu nu kappa hkappa1 hL hLeftTail hLeftMoment hnuLip hsmooth x
      dsimp only [B, d]
      linarith
    · exact cdf_sub_cdf_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_right_tail
        mu nu kappa hkappa1 hL hRightTail hRightMoment hnuLip hsmooth x
  have hdBound : d ≤ B + 2 * q * d := by
    dsimp only [d]
    exact (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff mu nu (B + 2 * q * d)).2 hpoint
  have hden : 0 < 1 - 2 * q := by linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
  dsimp only [B, d] at hdBound ⊢
  nlinarith

/-- The deterministic tail-absorption inequality specialized to replacing
one centered variance-one summand by a standard Gaussian after an arbitrary
common convolution and positive scaled-Gaussian smoothing.  The tail and
shifted-moment estimates for the scaled Gaussian remain explicit inputs. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ a q m : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu)
    (hgamma1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
    (hq : 2 * q < 1)
    (hRightTail :
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real (Ioi a) ≤ q)
    (hLeftTail :
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real (Iio (-a)) ≤ q)
    (hRightMoment :
      (∫ y, |a - y| ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤ m)
    (hLeftMoment :
      (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤ m) :
    kolmogorovDistance (mu ∗ kappa)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ kappa) ≤
      ((((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6 *
          ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
              ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * m) / (1 - 2 * q) := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  apply kolmogorovDistance_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_tails
    (mu ∗ kappa)
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ kappa)
    gamma (by simpa only [gamma] using hgamma1) (by positivity) hq
    (by simpa only [gamma] using hRightTail)
    (by simpa only [gamma] using hLeftTail)
    (by simpa only [gamma] using hRightMoment)
    (by simpa only [gamma] using hLeftMoment)
  · intro u v
    rw [Measure.conv_comm
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa]
    exact standardNormalCDF_lipschitz_conv kappa u v
  · intro x
    rw [smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv, smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv]
    have h := abs_cdfUpperError_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_le
      kappa mu hσ x hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
    rw [cdfUpperError] at h
    have hmuConv : gamma ∗ (mu ∗ kappa) = mu ∗ (kappa ∗ gamma) := by
      rw [← Measure.conv_assoc, Measure.conv_comm gamma mu,
        Measure.conv_assoc, Measure.conv_comm gamma kappa]
    have hnormalConv :
        gamma ∗
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ kappa) =
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗
            (kappa ∗ gamma) := by
      rw [← Measure.conv_assoc,
        Measure.conv_comm gamma
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw,
        Measure.conv_assoc, Measure.conv_comm gamma kappa]
    rw [hmuConv, hnormalConv]
    simpa only [gamma] using h

theorem integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id (σ : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
