  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using integrable_standardNormal_id.const_mul σ

theorem integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal (σ : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|)
      (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) := by
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  exact (integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw.const_mul |σ|).congr <|
    ae_of_all _ fun z => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, abs_mul]

/-- First absolute moment of the standard Gaussian scaled by `σ`. -/
noncomputable def scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y, |y| ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)

theorem scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_eq (σ : ℝ) :
    scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ =
      |σ| * (2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) := by
  unfold scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment
  rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp only [abs_mul]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_standardNormal_abs]

theorem scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_nonneg (σ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ := by
  unfold scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _

/-- Markov radius at which both tails of a scaled standard Gaussian have
mass strictly below one quarter. -/
noncomputable def scaledStandardNormalTailRadius (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ + 1

theorem scaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos (σ : ℝ) :
    0 < scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ := by
  unfold scaledStandardNormalTailRadius
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_nonneg σ))
    zero_lt_one

theorem scaledStandardNormal_rightTail_lt_quarter (σ : ℝ) :
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real
        (Ioi (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)) < 1 / 4 := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let M : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ
  let a : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_nonneg σ
  have ha : 0 < a := scaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos σ
  have hMarkov : a * gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, gamma, scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all gamma fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        (by simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ) a
  have hratio : M / a < 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ ha]
    dsimp only [a, scaledStandardNormalTailRadius, M]
    nlinarith
  have hradial : gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
  have hsubset : Ioi a ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.le.trans (le_abs_self x)
  simpa only [gamma, a] using
    (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans_lt (hradial.trans_lt hratio)

theorem scaledStandardNormal_leftTail_lt_quarter (σ : ℝ) :
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real
        (Iio (-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)) < 1 / 4 := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let M : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ
  let a : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_nonneg σ
  have ha : 0 < a := scaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos σ
  have hMarkov : a * gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, gamma, scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all gamma fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        (by simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ) a
  have hratio : M / a < 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ ha]
    dsimp only [a, scaledStandardNormalTailRadius, M]
    nlinarith
  have hradial : gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
  have hsubset : Iio (-a) ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x < -a := hx
    have hxneg : x < 0 := hx.trans_le (neg_nonpos.mpr ha.le)
    change a ≤ |x|
    rw [abs_of_neg hxneg]
    linarith [hx']
  simpa only [gamma, a] using
    (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans_lt (hradial.trans_lt hratio)

/-- Common bound for both shifted first moments at the scaled-Gaussian
Markov radius. -/
noncomputable def scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ

theorem scaledStandardNormal_rightShiftedMoment_le (σ : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, |scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|
      ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤
      scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have habs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ
  have hid : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      |scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((integrable_const (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)).sub hid).norm
  have hInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) gamma :=
    (integrable_const _).add habs
  calc
    (∫ y, |scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ∂gamma) ≤
        ∫ y, (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_mono hLeftInt hInt
      intro y
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans_eq <| by
        rw [abs_of_pos (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos σ)]
    _ = scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) habs,
        scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound,
        scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment, gamma]

theorem scaledStandardNormal_leftShiftedMoment_le (σ : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, |-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|
      ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤
      scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have habs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ
  have hid : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      |-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((integrable_const (-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)).sub hid).norm
  have hRightInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) gamma :=
    (integrable_const _).add habs
  calc
    (∫ y, |-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ∂gamma) ≤
        ∫ y, (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_mono hLeftInt hRightInt
      intro y
      calc
        |-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ≤
            |-scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ| + |y| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = scaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y| := by
          rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (scaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos σ)]
    _ = scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) habs,
        scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound,
        scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment, gamma]

/-- Fully concrete Markov-tail specialization of the Gaussian-smoothed
one-summand replacement inequality. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_markov
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    kolmogorovDistance (mu ∗ kappa)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ kappa) ≤
      ((((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6 *
          ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
              ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4)) := by
  exact kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement
    kappa mu hσ hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
    (integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ) (by norm_num)
    (le_of_lt (scaledStandardNormal_rightTail_lt_quarter σ))
    (le_of_lt (scaledStandardNormal_leftTail_lt_quarter σ))
    (scaledStandardNormal_rightShiftedMoment_le σ)
    (scaledStandardNormal_leftShiftedMoment_le σ)

/-- Homogeneous Markov radius for a positively scaled standard Gaussian. -/
noncomputable def positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  5 * scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ

/-- Common shifted-moment bound at the homogeneous Markov radius. -/
noncomputable def positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  6 * scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound_eq
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ =
      12 * σ * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ := by
  rw [positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound,
    scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_eq, abs_of_pos hσ]
  ring

theorem scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    0 < scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ := by
  rw [scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_eq, abs_of_pos hσ]
  positivity

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    0 < positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ := by
  unfold positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos hσ)

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormal_rightTail_le_one_fifth
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real
        (Ioi (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)) ≤ 1 / 5 := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let M : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ
  let a : ℝ := positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ
  have hM : 0 < M := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos hσ
  have ha : 0 < a := positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos hσ
  have hMarkov : a * gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, gamma, scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all gamma fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        (by simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ) a
  have hradial : gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ 1 / 5 := by
    calc
      gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
      _ = 1 / 5 := by
        dsimp only [a, positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius, M]
        field_simp [(scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos hσ).ne']
  have hsubset : Ioi a ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.le.trans (le_abs_self x)
  simpa only [gamma, a] using (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans hradial

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormal_leftTail_le_one_fifth
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw).real
        (Iio (-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)) ≤ 1 / 5 := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  let M : ℝ := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment σ
  let a : ℝ := positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ
  have hM : 0 < M := scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos hσ
  have ha : 0 < a := positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos hσ
  have hMarkov : a * gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, gamma, scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all gamma fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        (by simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ) a
  have hradial : gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ 1 / 5 := by
    calc
      gamma.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
        simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
      _ = 1 / 5 := by
        dsimp only [a, positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius, M]
        field_simp [(scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment_pos hσ).ne']
  have hsubset : Iio (-a) ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x < -a := hx
    have hxneg : x < 0 := hx.trans_le (neg_nonpos.mpr ha.le)
    change a ≤ |x|
    rw [abs_of_neg hxneg]
    linarith [hx']
  simpa only [gamma, a] using (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans hradial

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormal_rightShiftedMoment_le
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫ y, |positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|
      ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤
      positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have habs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ
  have hid : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      |positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((integrable_const (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)).sub hid).norm
  have hRightInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) gamma :=
    (integrable_const _).add habs
  calc
    (∫ y, |positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ∂gamma) ≤
        ∫ y, (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_mono hLeftInt hRightInt
      intro y
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans_eq <| by
        rw [abs_of_pos (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos hσ)]
    _ = positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) habs,
        positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius,
        positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound,
        scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment, gamma]
      ring

theorem positiveScaledStandardNormal_leftShiftedMoment_le
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫ y, |-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|
      ∂(Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) ≤
      positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
  let gamma : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun z : ℝ => σ * z)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure gamma := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have habs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_abs_scaledStandardNormal σ
  have hid : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) gamma := by
    simpa only [gamma] using integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      |-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y|) gamma := by
    simpa only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      ((integrable_const (-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ)).sub hid).norm
  have hRightInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) gamma :=
    (integrable_const _).add habs
  calc
    (∫ y, |-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ∂gamma) ≤
        ∫ y, (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y|) ∂gamma := by
      apply integral_mono hLeftInt hRightInt
      intro y
      calc
        |-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ - y| ≤
            |-positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ| + |y| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius σ + |y| := by
          rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos
            (positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius_pos hσ)]
    _ = positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) habs,
        positiveScaledStandardNormalTailRadius,
        positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound,
        scaledStandardNormalFirstMoment, gamma]
      ring

/-- Homogeneous refinement of the concrete Markov replacement inequality,
using radius `5M`, shifted bound `6M`, and tail parameter `1/5`. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_markov_homogeneous
    (kappa mu : Measure ℝ)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu)
    (hmu2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) mu)
    (hmean : (∫ y, y ∂mu) = 0)
    (hsecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    (hmu3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) mu) :
    kolmogorovDistance (mu ∗ kappa)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ∗ kappa) ≤
      ((((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6 *
          ((∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
              ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 5)) := by
  exact kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement
    kappa mu hσ hmu1 hmu2 hmean hsecond hmu3
    (integrable_scaledStandardNormal_id σ) (by norm_num)
    (positiveScaledStandardNormal_rightTail_le_one_fifth hσ)
    (positiveScaledStandardNormal_leftTail_le_one_fifth hσ)
    (positiveScaledStandardNormal_rightShiftedMoment_le hσ)
    (positiveScaledStandardNormal_leftShiftedMoment_le hσ)

/-- The normalized coefficient-one recurrence with its replacement term
fully bounded by the concrete scaled-Gaussian Markov specialization. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_replacement_markov
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu) (N : ℕ)
    (hMean : (∫ omega, X (N + 1) omega ∂mu) = 0)
    (hSecond : (∫ omega, (X (N + 1) omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) = 1)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (Measure.map
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
            X (N + 1)) mu)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((((3 * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹) / σ ^ 3) / 6 *
          ((∫ omega, |X (N + 1) omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
            ∫ y, |y| ^ 3
              ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          scaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4)) +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i
  let lastLaw : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (X (N + 1)) mu
  let previousLaw : Measure ℝ := Measure.map Sprev mu
  have hXAEM : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) mu := fun i => (hX i).aemeasurable
  have hSprev : AEMeasurable Sprev mu := by
    dsimp only [Sprev]
    fun_prop
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure lastLaw :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure previousLaw :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hSprev
  have hlast1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) lastLaw := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable]
    exact (hX (N + 1)).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hlast2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) lastLaw := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable]
    exact ((hX (N + 1)).mono_exponent
      (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≤ 3)).integrable_sq
  have hlast3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) lastLaw := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hX (N + 1)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hlastMean : (∫ y, y ∂lastLaw) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    exact hMean
  have hlastSecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂lastLaw) = 1 := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    exact hSecond
  have hlastThird :
      (∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂lastLaw) =
        ∫ omega, |X (N + 1) omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
  have hrec :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_unscaledReplacement
      X hXAEM hIndep N
  have hreplace :=
    kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_markov
      previousLaw lastLaw hσ hlast1 hlast2 hlastMean hlastSecond hlast3
  rw [hlastThird] at hreplace
  exact hrec.trans (add_le_add hreplace le_rfl)

/-- The normalized coefficient-one recurrence with the homogeneous
scaled-Gaussian Markov replacement term. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_replacement_markov_homogeneous
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)

    (hMean : (∫ omega, X (N + 1) omega ∂mu) = 0)

              ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) +

          positiveScaledStandardNormalShiftedMomentBound σ) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 5)) +
        kolmogorovDistance
          (Measure.map
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            mu)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let Sprev : Omega → ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), X i

    exact (hX (N + 1)).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hlast2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) lastLaw := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable]
    exact ((hX (N + 1)).mono_exponent
      (by norm_num : (2 : ENNReal) ≤ 3)).integrable_sq
  have hlast3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y| ^ 3) lastLaw := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hX (N + 1)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hlastMean : (∫ y, y ∂lastLaw) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    exact hMean
  have hlastSecond : (∫ y, y ^ 2 ∂lastLaw) = 1 := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
    exact hSecond
  have hlastThird :
      (∫ y, |y| ^ 3 ∂lastLaw) =
        ∫ omega, |X (N + 1) omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
    dsimp only [lastLaw]
    rw [integral_map (hX (N + 1)).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
  have hrec :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_succ_le_unscaledReplacement
      X hXAEM hIndep N
  have hreplace :=
    kolmogorovDistance_conv_le_gaussianSmoothedReplacement_markov_homogeneous
      previousLaw lastLaw hσ hlast1 hlast2 hlastMean hlastSecond hlast3
  rw [hlastThird] at hreplace
  exact hrec.trans (add_le_add hreplace le_rfl)

/-- A probability smoothing measure is band-limited at frequency `T` when
its characteristic function vanishes strictly outside `[-T, T]`. -/
def IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow (kappa : Measure ℝ) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, T < |t| → MeasureTheory.charFun kappa t = 0

/-- A common band-limited convolution turns the locally integrable
characteristic-function discrepancy quotient into a globally integrable one.
Outside the frequency window the common multiplier is exactly zero. -/
theorem integrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_of_bandLimited
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hkappa : IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow kappa T) :
    Integrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu)) volume := by
  let S : Set ℝ := Icc (-T) T
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu
  have hTorder : -T ≤ T := by linarith
  have hqOn : IntegrableOn q S := by
    dsimp only [q, S]
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hTorder).mp
      (intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient hmu1 hnu1 (-T) T)
  have hmajor : Integrable (S.indicator q) volume :=
    hqOn.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  refine hmajor.mono'
    (stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all volume fun t => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) t)]
  by_cases ht : t ∈ S
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_le mu nu kappa t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_apply, ht, if_false]
    have htOutside : T < |t| := by
      by_contra hnot
      have habs : |t| ≤ T := le_of_not_gt hnot
      have hmem : t ∈ Icc (-T) T := (abs_le.mp habs)
      exact ht (by simpa only [S] using hmem)
    have hchar : MeasureTheory.charFun kappa t = 0 := hkappa t htOutside
    unfold charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, hchar]
      simp

/-- Convolution by an absolutely continuous probability kernel gives every
smoothed probability law an absolutely continuous, hence continuous, CDF. -/
theorem continuous_cdf_smoothingKernel_conv
    (mu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa] (hkappa : kappa ≪ volume) :
    Continuous (cdf (kappa ∗ mu)) := by
  apply continuous_cdf_of_absolutelyContinuous
  rw [Measure.conv_comm]
  exact Measure.conv_absolutelyContinuous hkappa

/-- Fourier inversion for a common absolutely continuous smoothing kernel,
before the exact `-2π` frequency rescaling. -/
theorem cdfGap_smoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) kappa)
    (hkappaAC : kappa ≪ volume)
    (hquot : Integrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu)) volume)
    (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x ≤
      ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) := by
  have hmuConv1 := integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments
    kappa mu hkappa1 hmu1
  have hnuConv1 := integrable_abs_conv_of_firstMoments
    kappa nu hkappa1 hnu1
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun y =>
    ((cdf (kappa ∗ mu) y - cdf (kappa ∗ nu) y : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hf : Integrable f :=
    (integrable_cdf_sub_cdf_of_firstMoments
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) hmuConv1 hnuConv1).ofReal
  have hFourier : Integrable (𝓕 f) := by
    exact integrable_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_of_integrable_discrepancy
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) hmuConv1 hnuConv1 hquot
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    apply Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
    exact (continuous_cdf_smoothingKernel_conv mu kappa hkappaAC).sub
      (continuous_cdf_smoothingKernel_conv nu kappa hkappaAC)
  have hinv : ‖f x‖ ≤ ∫ w : ℝ, ‖𝓕 f w‖ :=
    norm_le_integral_norm_fourier f hf hFourier (x := x) hcont.continuousAt
  calc
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x = ‖f x‖ := by
      simp only [cdfGap, f, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ∫ w : ℝ, ‖𝓕 f w‖ := hinv
    _ = ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (0 : ℝ)] with w hw
      dsimp only [f]
      convert norm_fourier_cdf_sub_cdf_eq_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) hmuConv1 hnuConv1 hw using 1

/-- The generic common-kernel inversion estimate after the exact `-2π`
change of variables. -/
theorem cdfGap_smoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy_scaled
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) kappa)
    (hkappaAC : kappa ≪ volume)
    (hquot : Integrable (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu)) volume)
    (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x ≤
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) t := by
  calc
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x ≤
      ∫ w : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) :=
      cdfGap_smoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy
        mu nu kappa hmu1 hnu1 hkappa1 hkappaAC hquot x
    _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) t := by
      rw [Measure.integral_comp_mul_left]
      have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
      rw [show |(-2 * Real.pi)⁻¹| = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ by
        rw [abs_inv, show -2 * Real.pi = -(2 * Real.pi) by ring,
          abs_neg, abs_of_pos hpi]]
      rfl

/-- For a band-limited smoothing kernel, Fourier inversion only sees the
unsmoothed discrepancy quotient on the certified compact frequency window. -/
theorem cdfGap_bandLimitedSmoothingKernel_conv_le_local_discrepancy
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) kappa)
    (hkappaAC : kappa ≪ volume)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hkappa : IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow kappa T)
    (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x ≤
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ t in Icc (-T) T, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  let S : Set ℝ := Icc (-T) T
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu
  let qk : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu)
  have hqk : Integrable qk := by
    simpa only [qk] using
      integrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_of_bandLimited
        mu nu kappa hmu1 hnu1 hT hkappa
  have hTorder : -T ≤ T := by linarith
  have hqOn : IntegrableOn q S := by
    dsimp only [q, S]
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hTorder).mp
      (intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient hmu1 hnu1 (-T) T)
  have hmajor : Integrable (S.indicator q) :=
    hqOn.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hpoint : ∀ t, qk t ≤ S.indicator q t := by
    intro t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ S
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
      exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_conv_le mu nu kappa t
    · simp only [Set.indicator_apply, ht, if_false]
      have htOutside : T < |t| := by
        by_contra hnot
        have habs : |t| ≤ T := le_of_not_gt hnot
        have hmem : t ∈ Icc (-T) T := abs_le.mp habs
        exact ht (by simpa only [S] using hmem)
      have hchar : MeasureTheory.charFun kappa t = 0 := hkappa t htOutside
      dsimp only [qk]
      unfold charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
      split_ifs
      · rfl
      · rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, hchar]
        simp
  have hintegral :
      (∫ t, qk t) ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := by
    calc
      (∫ t, qk t) ≤ ∫ t, S.indicator q t :=
        integral_mono hqk hmajor hpoint
      _ = ∫ t in S, q t := integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  calc
    cdfGap (kappa ∗ mu) (kappa ∗ nu) x ≤
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t, qk t := by
      exact cdfGap_smoothingKernel_conv_le_integral_discrepancy_scaled
        mu nu kappa hmu1 hnu1 hkappa1 hkappaAC hqk x
    _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ t in S, q t := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hintegral (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rfl

/-- Band-limited Fourier comparison stated directly for the averaged CDFs
used by the deterministic tail-absorption theorem. -/
theorem smoothedCDF_gap_bandLimited_le_local_discrepancy
    (mu nu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure nu] [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) nu)
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) kappa)
    (hkappaAC : kappa ≪ volume)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hkappa : IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow kappa T)
    (x : ℝ) :
    |smoothedCDF mu kappa x - smoothedCDF nu kappa x| ≤
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ t in Icc (-T) T, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  rw [smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv, smoothedCDF_eq_cdf_conv]
  exact cdfGap_bandLimitedSmoothingKernel_conv_le_local_discrepancy
    mu nu kappa hmu1 hnu1 hkappa1 hkappaAC hT hkappa x

/-- Complete abstract Esseen smoothing inequality for comparison with the
standard normal law.  All Fourier work is confined to `[-T,T]`; the remaining
kernel obligations are an absolutely continuous band-limited probability law
with finite first moment and two fixed spatial-tail bounds. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_bandLimitedSmoothingKernel
    (mu kappa : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure kappa]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    (hkappa1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) kappa)
    (hkappaAC : kappa ≪ volume)
    {T a q m : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hq : 2 * q < 1)
    (hkappaFreq : IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow kappa T)
    (hRightTail : kappa.real (Ioi a) ≤ q)
    (hLeftTail : kappa.real (Iio (-a)) ≤ q)
    (hRightMoment : (∫ y, |a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m)
    (hLeftMoment : (∫ y, |-a - y| ∂kappa) ≤ m) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          (∫ t in Icc (-T) T, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * m) / (1 - 2 * q) := by
  have hkappaId : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) kappa := by
    apply hkappa1.mono' (by fun_prop)
    exact ae_of_all kappa fun y => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply kolmogorovDistance_le_of_smoothedCDF_with_tails
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa
    hkappaId (by positivity) hq hRightTail hLeftTail
    hRightMoment hLeftMoment (fun u v => by
      simpa only using standardNormalCDF_lipschitz v u)
  intro x
  exact smoothedCDF_gap_bandLimited_le_local_discrepancy
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw kappa
    hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hkappa1 hkappaAC hT hkappaFreq x

/-- The removable cotangent factor in Prawitz's signed smoothing filter. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotFactor (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if t = 0 then 1 else Real.pi * t * Real.cot (Real.pi * t)

theorem prawitzCotFactor_zero : prawitzCotFactor 0 = 1 := by
  simp [prawitzCotFactor]

theorem prawitzCotFactor_neg (t : ℝ) :
    prawitzCotFactor (-t) = prawitzCotFactor t := by
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst t
    simp [prawitzCotFactor]
  · rw [prawitzCotFactor, prawitzCotFactor, if_neg ht,
      if_neg (neg_ne_zero.mpr ht), Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin,
      Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
    have harg : Real.pi * -t = -(Real.pi * t) := by ring
    rw [harg, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
    ring

/-- Real specialization of Mathlib's Mittag--Leffler expansion for cotangent
on the open unit interval. -/
theorem real_cot_series_rep
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    Real.pi * Real.cot (Real.pi * u) - 1 / u =
      ∑' n : ℕ,
        (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
  have huC : (u : ℂ) ∈ Complex.integerComplement := by
    rw [Complex.mem_integerComplement_iff]
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    apply_fun Complex.re at hn
    have hn' : (n : ℝ) = u := by simpa using hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (hn' ▸ hu0)
    have hn1 : n < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (hn' ▸ hu1)
    omega
  have hc := cot_series_rep' huC
  have hs := summable_cotTerm huC
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hc
  have hmap := (RCLike.reCLM : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ).map_tsum hs
  change
      (∑' n : ℕ,
        (1 / ((u : ℂ) - ((n : ℂ) + 1)) +
          1 / ((u : ℂ) + ((n : ℂ) + 1)))).re =
        ∑' n : ℕ,
          (1 / ((u : ℂ) - ((n : ℂ) + 1)) +
            1 / ((u : ℂ) + ((n : ℂ) + 1))).re at hmap
  rw [hmap] at hre
  have hcot :
      (Complex.cot ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (u : ℂ))).re =
        Real.cot (Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    apply Complex.ofReal_injective
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cot_ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_cot]
  simpa [Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, hcot, Complex.div_re,
    Complex.normSq_apply] using hre

theorem summable_real_cot_series
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 1)))) := by
  have huC : (u : ℂ) ∈ Complex.integerComplement := by
    rw [Complex.mem_integerComplement_iff]
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    apply_fun Complex.re at hn
    have hn' : (n : ℝ) = u := by simpa using hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (hn' ▸ hu0)
    have hn1 : n < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (hn' ▸ hu1)
    omega
  have hs := summable_cotTerm huC
  have hmap := hs.map (RCLike.reCLM : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (RCLike.reCLM : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  simpa [Function.comp_def, Complex.div_re, Complex.normSq_apply] using hmap

theorem prawitzCotFactor_eq_one_add_mul_tsum
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzCotFactor u = 1 + u *
      ∑' n : ℕ,
        (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
  have h := real_cot_series_rep hu0 hu1
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne']
  rw [show Real.pi * u * Real.cot (Real.pi * u) =
    u * (Real.pi * Real.cot (Real.pi * u)) by ring]
  rw [eq_add_of_sub_eq h]
  field_simp [hu0.ne']
  ring

/-- The positive inverse-square tail occurring in the spatial
Prawitz--Vaaler majorant remainder. -/
noncomputable def prawitzInverseSquareTail (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2

theorem summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
  have h := (Real.summable_one_div_nat_add_rpow (x + 1) 2).2 (by norm_num)
  apply h.congr
  intro n
  rw [show (n : ℝ) + (x + 1) = x + (n : ℝ) + 1 by ring]
  simp [sq_abs]

/-- The inverse-cube tail is the derivative coordinate naturally paired
with `prawitzInverseSquareTail` on the positive half-line. -/
noncomputable def prawitzInverseCubeTail (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3

/-- A summable, spatially uniform inverse-cube majorant for termwise
differentiation on the positive half-line. -/
theorem summable_two_div_nat_add_one_cube :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3) := by
  have h := (Real.summable_one_div_nat_add_rpow 1 3).2 (by norm_num)
  have hcubic : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3) := by
    apply h.congr
    intro n
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hn]
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ => 1 / z)
      (Real.rpow_natCast ((n : ℝ) + 1) 3)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hcubic.mul_left 2

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- On `x > 0`, the inverse-square tail can be differentiated termwise;
its derivative is minus twice the positive inverse-cube tail. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_prawitzInverseSquareTail
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasDerivAt prawitzInverseSquareTail (-2 * prawitzInverseCubeTail x) x := by
  unfold prawitzInverseSquareTail prawitzInverseCubeTail
  have hg : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y : ℝ, y ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => 1 / (z + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
        (-2 / (y + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3) y := by
    intro n y hy
    change 0 < y at hy
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => z + (n : ℝ) + 1) 1 y := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id y).add_const (n : ℝ)).add_const 1)
    have hden : y + (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hpow := (hlin.pow 2).inv (pow_ne_zero 2 hden)
    simp only [one_div, Pi.pow_apply] at hpow ⊢
    convert hpow using 1
    field_simp [hden]
    ring
  have hg' : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y : ℝ, y ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) →
      ‖-2 / (y + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3‖ ≤
        2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3 := by
    intro n y hy
    change 0 < y at hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num),
      abs_pow, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    have hbase : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ y + (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity)
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase 3)
  have hseries : HasDerivAt
      (fun z : ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (z + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
      (∑' n : ℕ, -2 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3) x :=
    hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected
      (u := fun n : ℕ => 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3)
      (g := fun (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) => 1 / (y + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)
      (g' := fun (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) => -2 / (y + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 3)
      (t := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (y₀ := (1 : ℝ))
      summable_two_div_nat_add_one_cube isOpen_Ioi isPreconnected_Ioi
      hg hg' (by norm_num) (summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail 1) hx
  convert hseries using 1
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  ring

/-- Integral-test bound for the positive inverse-square tail, proved by a
telescoping majorant. -/
theorem prawitzInverseSquareTail_le_inv
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : prawitzInverseSquareTail x ≤ 1 / x := by
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤
        1 / (x + (n : ℝ)) - 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have hxn : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hxns : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    field_simp [hxn.ne', hxns.ne']
    nlinarith
  have hsum (N : ℕ) :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / x := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          (1 / (x + (n : ℝ)) - 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ => hterm n
      _ = 1 / x - 1 / (x + (N : ℝ)) := by
        induction N with
        | zero => simp
        | succ N ih =>
            rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
            norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
      _ ≤ 1 / x := sub_le_self _ (by positivity)
  unfold prawitzInverseSquareTail
  exact Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le
    (fun n => by positivity) (by simpa only [Finset.sum_range] using hsum)

/-- The initial inverse-square term together with the positive tail also
dominates `1 / x`. This is the complementary telescoping estimate needed on
the reflected spatial half-line. -/
theorem inv_le_inv_sq_add_prawitzInverseSquareTail
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    1 / x ≤ 1 / x ^ 2 + prawitzInverseSquareTail x := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / (x + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2
  have hsum : Summable f := by
    have h := summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail (x - 1)
    apply h.congr
    intro n
    dsimp only [f]
    congr 2
    ring
  have hterm (n : ℕ) :
      1 / (x + (n : ℝ)) - 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ f n := by
    have hxn : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hxns : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    dsimp only [f]
    field_simp [hxn.ne', hxns.ne']
    nlinarith
  have hfinite (N : ℕ) :
      1 / x - 1 / (x + (N : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          (1 / (x + (n : ℝ)) - 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        induction N with
        | zero => simp
        | succ N ih =>
            rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← ih]
            norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ => hterm n
  have hle (N : ℕ) :
      1 / x - 1 / (x + (N : ℝ)) ≤ ∑' n, f n := by
    exact (hfinite N).trans
      (hsum.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range N)
        (fun n _ => by dsimp only [f]; positivity))
  have hden : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => x + (N : ℝ)) atTop atTop := by
    exact tendsto_atTop.2 fun b =>
      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually
        (eventually_ge_atTop (b - x))).mono (by
          intro N hN
          linarith)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => 1 / x - 1 / (x + (N : ℝ)))
      atTop (nhds (1 / x)) := by
    have hinv : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (x + (N : ℝ))⁻¹) atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hden
    simpa only [one_div, sub_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hinv :
        Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => x⁻¹ - (x + (N : ℝ))⁻¹) atTop
          (nhds (x⁻¹ - 0)))
  have hfull : 1 / x ≤ ∑' n, f n :=
    le_of_tendsto hlim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hle)
  have hsplit := hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1
  have htail : (∑' n : ℕ, f (n + 1)) = prawitzInverseSquareTail x := by
    unfold prawitzInverseSquareTail
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    dsimp only [f]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  calc
    1 / x ≤ ∑' n, f n := hfull
    _ = f 0 + ∑' n : ℕ, f (n + 1) := by simpa using hsplit.symm
    _ = 1 / x ^ 2 + prawitzInverseSquareTail x := by rw [htail]; simp [f]

/-- Manifestly nonnegative spatial remainder in the Prawitz--Vaaler
majorant on the positive half-line. -/
noncomputable def prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
    (1 / x - prawitzInverseSquareTail x)

theorem prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder_nonneg
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 ≤ prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x := by
  unfold prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _))
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (prawitzInverseSquareTail_le_inv hx))

/-- Manifestly nonnegative spatial remainder in the reflected
Prawitz--Vaaler majorant on the negative half-line. -/
noncomputable def prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
    (1 / x ^ 2 + prawitzInverseSquareTail x - 1 / x)

theorem prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_nonneg
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 ≤ prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder x := by
  unfold prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _))
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (inv_le_inv_sq_add_prawitzInverseSquareTail hx))

/-- The two spatial remainders add to the Fejér kernel at scale `π`. -/
theorem prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder_add_negative
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x +
        prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder x =
      2 * (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / (Real.pi * x)) ^ 2 := by
  unfold prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hx]
  ring

/-- The right-continuous centered half-line step `2 * 1_[0,∞) - 1`. -/
noncomputable def centeredHalfLineStep (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if x < 0 then -1 else 1

theorem centeredHalfLineStep_eq_indicator (x : ℝ) :
    centeredHalfLineStep x =
      2 * (Ici (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x - 1 := by
  by_cases hx : x < 0
  · simp [centeredHalfLineStep, hx, not_le.mpr hx]
  · simp [centeredHalfLineStep, hx, le_of_not_gt hx]
    norm_num

/-- Piecewise spatial form of the Beurling--Selberg majorant associated to
Prawitz's signed smoothing filter. -/
noncomputable def prawitzVaalerMajorant (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if 0 < x then 1 + prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x
  else if x < 0 then -1 + prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder (-x)
  else 1

/-- The explicit spatial Prawitz--Vaaler function majorizes the centered
right-continuous half-line step. -/
theorem centeredHalfLineStep_le_prawitzVaalerMajorant (x : ℝ) :
    centeredHalfLineStep x ≤ prawitzVaalerMajorant x := by
  by_cases hxpos : 0 < x
  · rw [centeredHalfLineStep, prawitzVaalerMajorant,
      if_pos hxpos, if_neg (not_lt_of_ge hxpos.le)]
    linarith [prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder_nonneg hxpos]
  · by_cases hxneg : x < 0
    · rw [centeredHalfLineStep, prawitzVaalerMajorant,
        if_neg hxpos, if_pos hxneg, if_pos hxneg]
      linarith [prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_nonneg (neg_pos.mpr hxneg)]
    · have hx : x = 0 := by linarith
      subst x
      simp [centeredHalfLineStep, prawitzVaalerMajorant]

theorem measurable_prawitzCotFactor : Measurable prawitzCotFactor := by
  unfold prawitzCotFactor
  apply Measurable.ite (measurableSet_singleton 0) measurable_const
  simp_rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  fun_prop

/-- The endpoint weight cancels the cotangent singularity uniformly on the
positive half of Prawitz's unit frequency window. -/
theorem abs_one_sub_mul_prawitzCotFactor_le_two
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    |(1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u| ≤ 2 := by
  rcases hu0.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu0
  · simp [prawitzCotFactor]
  have hu0' : u ≠ 0 := hu0.ne'
  have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
  have hArg0 : 0 < Real.pi * u := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hu0
  have hArgPi : Real.pi * u < Real.pi := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos Real.pi_pos (sub_pos.mpr hu1)]
  have hSin : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi * u) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hArg0 hArgPi
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0', Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  have hFormula :
      |(1 - u) * (Real.pi * u *
          (Real.cos (Real.pi * u) / Real.sin (Real.pi * u)))| =
        (1 - u) * Real.pi * u * |Real.cos (Real.pi * u)| /
          Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg hOne,
      abs_of_pos hArg0, abs_of_pos hSin]
    ring
  rw [hFormula]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hSin).2
  have hCos : |Real.cos (Real.pi * u)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one _
  have hWeighted :
      (1 - u) * Real.pi * u * |Real.cos (Real.pi * u)| ≤
        (1 - u) * Real.pi * u := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCos
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hOne Real.pi_pos.le) hu0.le)
  apply hWeighted.trans
  by_cases huHalf : u ≤ 1 / 2
  · have hArgHalf : Real.pi * u ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hJordan : 2 * u ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
      have := Real.mul_le_sin hArg0.le hArgHalf
      convert this using 1; field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    have hNum : (1 - u) * Real.pi * u ≤ 4 * u := by
      calc
        (1 - u) * Real.pi * u = (1 - u) * (Real.pi * u) := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * (Real.pi * u) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hArg0.le
        _ = Real.pi * u := by ring
        _ ≤ 4 * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Real.pi_le_four hu0.le
    nlinarith
  · have huHalf' : 1 / 2 ≤ u := le_of_not_ge huHalf
    have hOneHalf : 1 - u ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have hArgHalf : Real.pi * (1 - u) ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hJordan' : 2 * (1 - u) ≤ Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
      have hj := Real.mul_le_sin
        (mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hOne) hArgHalf
      have hSinEq : Real.sin (Real.pi * (1 - u)) =
          Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
        rw [show Real.pi * (1 - u) = Real.pi - Real.pi * u by ring,
          Real.sin_pi_sub]
      rw [hSinEq] at hj
      convert hj using 1; field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    have hPiU : Real.pi * u ≤ 4 := by
      calc
        Real.pi * u ≤ Real.pi * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu1.le Real.pi_pos.le
        _ ≤ 4 := by simpa using Real.pi_le_four
    have hNum : (1 - u) * Real.pi * u ≤ 4 * (1 - u) := by
      nlinarith
    nlinarith

/-- Prawitz's compactly supported signed smoothing filter. Its real part is
even, its imaginary part is odd, and the value at zero is supplied by the
removable limit of the cotangent factor. -/
noncomputable def prawitzSmoothingFilter (t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if |t| < 1 then
    (((1 - |t|) * prawitzCotFactor t + |t| : ℝ) : ℂ) -
      (((1 - |t|) * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  else 0

theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_zero : prawitzSmoothingFilter 0 = 1 := by
  simp [prawitzSmoothingFilter, prawitzCotFactor]

theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_eq_zero_of_one_le_abs
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 ≤ |t|) :
    prawitzSmoothingFilter t = 0 := by
  simp [prawitzSmoothingFilter, not_lt.mpr ht]

theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_neg (t : ℝ) :
    prawitzSmoothingFilter (-t) =
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (prawitzSmoothingFilter t) := by
  by_cases ht : |t| < 1
  · rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, prawitzSmoothingFilter,
      if_pos ht, if_pos (by simpa only [abs_neg] using ht),
      abs_neg, prawitzCotFactor_neg]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  · have ht' : ¬ |-t| < 1 := by simpa only [abs_neg] using ht
    rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, prawitzSmoothingFilter,
      if_neg ht, if_neg ht']
    simp

theorem measurable_prawitzSmoothingFilter :
    Measurable prawitzSmoothingFilter := by
  have habs : Measurable fun t : ℝ => |t| := by fun_prop
  have hre : Measurable fun t : ℝ =>
      (1 - |t|) * prawitzCotFactor t + |t| :=
    ((measurable_const.sub habs).mul measurable_prawitzCotFactor).add habs
  have him : Measurable fun t : ℝ =>
      (1 - |t|) * Real.pi * t :=
    ((measurable_const.sub habs).mul measurable_const).mul measurable_id
  unfold prawitzSmoothingFilter
  apply Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt habs measurable_const)
  · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp hre).sub
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp him).mul measurable_const)
  · exact measurable_const

/-- Exact real part of the Prawitz filter on the positive unit window. -/
theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re =
      (1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u + u := by
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, if_pos (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hu0] using hu1),
    abs_of_nonneg hu0]
  simp

/-- Exact imaginary part of the Prawitz filter on the positive unit window. -/
theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im =
      -((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) := by
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, if_pos (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hu0] using hu1),
    abs_of_nonneg hu0]
  simp

/-- Exact squared norm of the Prawitz filter on the positive unit window. -/
theorem sq_norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ^ 2 =
      ((1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u + u) ^ 2 +
        ((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) ^ 2 := by
  rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply,
    prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1,
    prawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1]
  ring

/-- Exact norm of the Prawitz filter on the positive unit window. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ =
      Real.sqrt (((1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u + u) ^ 2 +
        ((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) ^ 2) := by
  rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply,
    prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1,
    prawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The cotangent factor is nonnegative on the first half of the positive
unit window. -/
theorem prawitzCotFactor_nonneg_of_mem_Ioc_half
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (huHalf : u ≤ 1 / 2) :
    0 ≤ prawitzCotFactor u := by
  have hx0 : 0 < Real.pi * u := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hu0
  have hxHalf : Real.pi * u ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
    apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx0
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos (Real.pi * u) :=
    Real.cos_nonneg_of_neg_pi_div_two_le_of_le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hxHalf
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne', Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  positivity

/-- The positive first-half cotangent factor is at most its removable value
at zero. -/
theorem prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioo_half
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (huHalf : u < 1 / 2) :
    prawitzCotFactor u ≤ 1 := by
  have hx0 : 0 < Real.pi * u := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hu0
  have hxHalf : Real.pi * u < Real.pi / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have htanPos := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hx0 hxHalf
  have htan := Real.le_tan hx0.le hxHalf
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne', ← Real.tan_inv_eq_cot,
    ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one htanPos]
  exact htan

/-- The positive first-half cotangent factor is at most one, including the
midpoint endpoint. -/
theorem prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioc_half
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (huHalf : u ≤ 1 / 2) :
    prawitzCotFactor u ≤ 1 := by
  rcases huHalf.eq_or_lt with rfl | huHalf
  · rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    rw [show Real.pi * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.pi / 2 by ring,
      Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
    simp
  · exact prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioo_half hu0 huHalf

/-- On the positive first half-window the cotangent factor dominates the
corresponding cosine. -/
theorem cos_pi_mul_le_prawitzCotFactor_of_mem_Ioc_half
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (huHalf : u ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.cos (Real.pi * u) ≤ prawitzCotFactor u := by
  have hx0 : 0 < Real.pi * u := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hu0
  have hxHalf : Real.pi * u ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi * u) := by
    apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx0
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hcos : 0 ≤ Real.cos (Real.pi * u) :=
    Real.cos_nonneg_of_neg_pi_div_two_le_of_le
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hxHalf
  have hsinx : Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ≤ Real.pi * u :=
    Real.sin_le hx0.le
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne', Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  rw [show Real.pi * u *
      (Real.cos (Real.pi * u) / Real.sin (Real.pi * u)) =
      (Real.pi * u * Real.cos (Real.pi * u)) /
        Real.sin (Real.pi * u) by ring]
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hsin).2
    (by simpa only [mul_comm] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsinx hcos)

/-- The cotangent factor is nonpositive on the second half of the positive
unit window. -/
theorem prawitzCotFactor_nonpos_of_half_le
    {u : ℝ} (huHalf : 1 / 2 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzCotFactor u ≤ 0 := by
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hx0 : 0 < Real.pi * u := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hu0
  have hxPi : Real.pi * u < Real.pi := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hxHalf : Real.pi / 2 ≤ Real.pi * u := by
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (Real.pi * u) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hx0 hxPi
  have hcos : Real.cos (Real.pi * u) ≤ 0 :=
    Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le hxHalf (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne', Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hx0.le
    (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hcos hsin.le)

/-- Reflection through the midpoint exchanges the weighted cotangent terms. -/
theorem one_sub_mul_prawitzCotFactor_eq
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    (1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u =
      -u * prawitzCotFactor (1 - u) := by
  have hOne : 1 - u ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hu1.ne'
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne', prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hOne]
  have hcot : Real.cot (Real.pi * (1 - u)) =
      -Real.cot (Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [show Real.pi * (1 - u) = Real.pi - Real.pi * u by ring,
      Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin,
      Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.sin_pi_sub]
    ring
  rw [hcot]
  ring

/-- The real part of the positive-window Prawitz filter is nonnegative. -/
theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_nonneg_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    0 ≤ (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re := by
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1]
  rcases hu0.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu0
  · simp [prawitzCotFactor]
  by_cases huHalf : u ≤ 1 / 2
  · have hcot := prawitzCotFactor_nonneg_of_mem_Ioc_half hu0 huHalf
    have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hOne hcot]
  · have hOne0 : 0 < 1 - u := sub_pos.mpr hu1
    have hOneHalf : 1 - u < 1 / 2 := by linarith [lt_of_not_ge huHalf]
    have hcot := prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioo_half hOne0 hOneHalf
    rw [one_sub_mul_prawitzCotFactor_eq hu0 hu1]
    nlinarith

/-- The real part of the positive-window Prawitz filter is at most one. -/
theorem prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_le_one_of_mem_Ico
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re ≤ 1 := by
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1]
  rcases hu0.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu0
  · simp [prawitzCotFactor]
  by_cases huHalf : u < 1 / 2
  · have hcot := prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioo_half hu0 huHalf
    have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
    nlinarith
  · have hcot := prawitzCotFactor_nonpos_of_half_le (le_of_not_gt huHalf) hu1
    have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
    nlinarith

/-- The exact imaginary part and the unit bound on the real part give a
square-root norm majorant. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 + ((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) ^ 2) := by
  rw [norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have hre0 := prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_nonneg_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1
  have hre1 := prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_le_one_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0 hu1] at hre0 hre1
  nlinarith

/-- Elementary polynomial majorant for `sqrt (1 + x^2)`. -/
theorem sqrt_one_add_sq_le_one_add_half_sq (x : ℝ) :
    Real.sqrt (1 + x ^ 2) ≤ 1 + x ^ 2 / 2 := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
  constructor
  · positivity
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x ^ 2)]

/-- Polynomial positive-window majorant for the Prawitz filter norm. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_half_im_sq
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤
      1 + ((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) ^ 2 / 2 :=
  (norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_sqrt_one_add_sq hu0 hu1).trans
    (sqrt_one_add_sq_le_one_add_half_sq _)

/-- Uniform consequence of the polynomial norm majorant on the positive unit
window. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by
  have hprod0 : 0 ≤ (1 - u) * u :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le) hu0
  have hprod : (1 - u) * u ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - 1 / 2)]
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ (1 - u) * Real.pi * u := by
    rw [show (1 - u) * Real.pi * u = Real.pi * ((1 - u) * u) by ring]
    exact mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hprod0
  have hb : (1 - u) * Real.pi * u ≤ Real.pi / 4 := by
    calc
      (1 - u) * Real.pi * u = Real.pi * ((1 - u) * u) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.pi * (1 / 4) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod Real.pi_pos.le
      _ = Real.pi / 4 := by ring
  have hbSq := mul_self_le_mul_self hb0 hb
  calc
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤
        1 + ((1 - u) * Real.pi * u) ^ 2 / 2 :=
      norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_half_im_sq hu0 hu1
    _ ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by
      rw [pow_two, pow_two]
      nlinarith [hbSq]

/-- The Prawitz filter vanishes linearly at the upper endpoint of its positive
unit window. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_endpoint_linear
    {u : ℝ} (huHalf : 1 / 2 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤
      (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) * (1 - u) := by
  let v : ℝ := 1 - u
  have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
  have huOne : u ≤ 1 := hu1.le
  have hv0 : 0 < v := by dsimp only [v]; linarith
  have hvHalf : v ≤ 1 / 2 := by dsimp only [v]; linarith
  have hvOne : v ≤ 1 := hvHalf.trans (by norm_num)
  have hcot1 : prawitzCotFactor v ≤ 1 :=
    prawitzCotFactor_le_one_of_mem_Ioc_half hv0 hvHalf
  have hcosCot : Real.cos (Real.pi * v) ≤ prawitzCotFactor v :=
    cos_pi_mul_le_prawitzCotFactor_of_mem_Ioc_half hv0 hvHalf
  have hcosTaylor := Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (x := Real.pi * v)
  have hfactor0 : 0 ≤ 1 - prawitzCotFactor v := by linarith
  have hfactor : 1 - prawitzCotFactor v ≤ (Real.pi * v) ^ 2 / 2 := by
    linarith
  have hvSq : v ^ 2 ≤ v := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hv0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hvOne)]
  have hreEq : (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re =
      u * (1 - prawitzCotFactor v) := by
    rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hu0.le hu1,
      one_sub_mul_prawitzCotFactor_eq hu0 hu1]
    dsimp only [v]
    ring
  have hre0 : 0 ≤ (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re := by
    rw [hreEq]
    positivity
  have hre : (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re ≤
      Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 * v := by
    rw [hreEq]
    calc
      u * (1 - prawitzCotFactor v) ≤ 1 * ((Real.pi * v) ^ 2 / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul huOne hfactor hfactor0 (by positivity)
      _ ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 * v := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg Real.pi, hvSq]
  have himEq : (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im = -(v * Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hu0.le hu1]
  have him : |(prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im| ≤ Real.pi * v := by
    rw [himEq, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ v * Real.pi * u)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hv0.le]
  calc
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤
        |(prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re| +
          |(prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im| :=
      Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _
    _ = (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).re +
          |(prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hre0]
    _ ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 * v + Real.pi * v := add_le_add hre him
    _ = (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) * (1 - u) := by
      dsimp only [v]
      ring

/-- A coarse uniform norm bound for the Prawitz filter on the positive unit
window. The constant is chosen for a robust integrability majorant. -/
theorem norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤ 7 := by
  have habs : |u| = u := abs_of_nonneg hu0
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, if_pos (by simpa [habs] using hu1), habs]
  let a : ℝ := (1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u + u
  let b : ℝ := (1 - u) * Real.pi * u
  have ha : |a| ≤ 3 := by
    calc
      |a| ≤ |(1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u| + |u| := by
        dsimp only [a]
        exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 + u := by
        gcongr
        · exact abs_one_sub_mul_prawitzCotFactor_le_two hu0 hu1
        · exact habs.le
      _ ≤ 3 := by linarith
  have hb : |b| ≤ 4 := by
    have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp only [b]; positivity
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hb0]
    calc
      b ≤ Real.pi * u := by
        dsimp only [b]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hu0]
      _ ≤ 4 * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right Real.pi_le_four hu0
      _ ≤ 4 := by linarith
  change ‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ≤ 7
  calc
    ‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ≤
        ‖(a : ℂ)‖ + ‖(b : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = |a| + |b| := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
        Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ 7 := by linarith

/-- The odd imaginary part of the Prawitz filter vanishes linearly at zero. -/
theorem abs_im_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    |(prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im| ≤ Real.pi * u := by
  have habs : |u| = u := abs_of_nonneg hu0
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, if_pos (by simpa [habs] using hu1), habs]
  simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, zero_mul, mul_one,
    zero_sub, abs_neg, add_zero]
  have hOne : 0 ≤ 1 - u := sub_nonneg.mpr hu1.le
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hOne Real.pi_pos.le) hu0)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hu0]

/-- Frequency dilation of the Prawitz filter to the symmetric window
`[-T,T]`. -/
noncomputable def scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter (T t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  prawitzSmoothingFilter (t / T)

theorem scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re =
      (1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T := by
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico
    (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)

theorem scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im =
      -((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) := by
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact prawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico
    (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)

/-- Exact norm of the scaled Prawitz filter inside a positive frequency
window. -/
theorem norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_of_mem_Ico
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ =
      Real.sqrt
        (((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) ^ 2 +
          ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) ^ 2) := by
  rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter,
    norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_of_mem_Ico
      (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)]

/-- Square-root majorant for the scaled Prawitz filter norm inside a positive
frequency window. -/
theorem norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1 + ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) ^ 2) := by
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_sqrt_one_add_sq
    (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)

/-- Polynomial majorant for the scaled Prawitz filter norm inside a positive
frequency window. -/
theorem norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_half_im_sq
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ ≤
      1 + ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) ^ 2 / 2 := by
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_half_im_sq
    (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)

/-- Uniform scaled-window form of the positive Prawitz filter norm bound. -/
theorem norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t < T) :
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
    (div_nonneg ht0 hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 htT)

theorem scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_zero (T : ℝ) :
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T 0 = 1 := by
  simp [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter, prawitzSmoothingFilter_zero]

theorem scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_eq_zero_of_abs_ge
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : T ≤ |t|) :
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t = 0 := by
  apply prawitzSmoothingFilter_eq_zero_of_one_le_abs
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hT]
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hT).2 (by simpa only [one_mul] using ht)

theorem scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_neg (T t : ℝ) :
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T (-t) =
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t) := by
  rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter, scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter,
    neg_div, prawitzSmoothingFilter_neg]

theorem measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter (T : ℝ) :
    Measurable (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T) := by
  exact measurable_prawitzSmoothingFilter.comp (by fun_prop)

/-- Multiplying a characteristic function by a spatial Fourier phase retains
the first-moment linear modulus at frequency zero. -/
theorem norm_phase_mul_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment
    {mu : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) (x t : ℝ) :
    ‖Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - 1‖ ≤
      |t| * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) := by
  let e : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have he : ‖e‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  calc
    ‖e * MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - 1‖ =
        ‖e * (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - 1) + (e - 1)‖ := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ ‖e * (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - 1)‖ + ‖e - 1‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - 1‖ + ‖e - 1‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, he, one_mul]
    _ ≤ |t| * (∫ y, |y| ∂mu) + |t * x| := by
      apply add_le_add (norm_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment hmu1 t)
      dsimp only [e]
      simpa only [mul_comm Complex.I, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg] using
        (Real.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one_le (x := -(t * x)))
    _ = |t| * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      ring

/-- Conjugation symmetry required of a Fourier--Stieltjes transform of a real
measure. -/
def IsHermitianFrequencyFunction (f : ℝ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, f (-t) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (f t)

theorem isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (mu : Measure ℝ) :
    IsHermitianFrequencyFunction (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) := by
  intro t
  exact MeasureTheory.charFun_neg t

/-- The nonsingular numerator of the Prawitz principal-value integrand. -/
noncomputable def prawitzPVNumerator
    (T : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t * f t

/-- The singular integrand in the Prawitz principal-value inversion formula. -/
noncomputable def prawitzPVIntegrand
    (T : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  prawitzPVNumerator T f x t / (t : ℂ)

theorem prawitzPVNumerator_sub (T : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (x t : ℝ) :
    prawitzPVNumerator T f x t - prawitzPVNumerator T g x t =
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t * (f t - g t) := by
  unfold prawitzPVNumerator
  ring

theorem measurable_prawitzPVNumerator
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (prawitzPVNumerator T f x) := by
  unfold prawitzPVNumerator
  have hphase : Measurable (fun t : ℝ =>
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    fun_prop
  exact (hphase.mul (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T)).mul hf

/-- A finite first absolute moment makes the imaginary part of the Prawitz
numerator vanish linearly at zero, uniformly over its full positive window. -/
theorem abs_im_prawitzPVNumerator_charFun_le
    {mu : Measure ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioc 0 T) :
    |(prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t).im| ≤
      (7 * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) + Real.pi / T) * t := by
  have hMoment : 0 ≤ ∫ y, |y| ∂mu := integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hD : 0 ≤ |x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu := add_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) hMoment
  rcases ht.2.eq_or_lt with htEq | htT
  · subst t
    have hFilter : scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T T = 0 := by
      rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter, div_self hT.ne',
        prawitzSmoothingFilter]
      norm_num
    rw [prawitzPVNumerator, hFilter, mul_zero, zero_mul,
      Complex.zero_im, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hD)
        (div_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hT.le)) hT.le
  let u : ℝ := t / T
  let M : ℂ := prawitzSmoothingFilter u
  let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
    MeasureTheory.charFun mu t
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := div_nonneg ht.1.le hT.le
  have hu1 : u < 1 := (div_lt_one hT).2 htT
  have hMNorm : ‖M‖ ≤ 7 :=
    norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hu0 hu1
  have hMIm : |M.im| ≤ Real.pi * u :=
    abs_im_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le hu0 hu1
  have hq : ‖q - 1‖ ≤ t * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) := by
    simpa only [q, abs_of_pos ht.1] using
      norm_phase_mul_charFun_sub_one_le_firstMoment hmu1 x t
  have hNumerator :
      prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t = M * q := by
    dsimp only [prawitzPVNumerator, M, q, scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter, u]
    ring
  rw [hNumerator]
  have hDecomp : M * q = M * (q - 1) + M := by ring
  rw [hDecomp]
  calc
    |(M * (q - 1) + M).im| ≤
        |(M * (q - 1)).im| + |M.im| := by
      simpa only [Complex.add_im] using
        abs_add_le (M * (q - 1)).im M.im
    _ ≤ ‖M * (q - 1)‖ + |M.im| :=
      add_le_add (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) le_rfl
    _ = ‖M‖ * ‖q - 1‖ + |M.im| := by rw [norm_mul]
    _ ≤ 7 * (t * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu)) + Real.pi * u := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact mul_le_mul hMNorm hq (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      · exact hMIm
    _ = (7 * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) + Real.pi / T) * t := by
      dsimp only [u]
      ring

theorem measurable_prawitzPVIntegrand
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (prawitzPVIntegrand T f x) := by
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand
  exact (measurable_prawitzPVNumerator hf x).div
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_id)

theorem prawitzPVIntegrand_neg
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    prawitzPVIntegrand T f x (-t) =
      -(starRingEnd ℂ) (prawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) := by
  have hexp :
      Complex.exp (((-((-t) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (starRingEnd ℂ)
          (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    have harg :
        (((-((-t) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [harg, Complex.exp_conj]
  rw [prawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand,
    prawitzPVNumerator, prawitzPVNumerator, hexp,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_neg, hf]
  simp only [map_div₀, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_neg]
  rw [div_neg]

/-- Pairing positive and negative frequencies removes the principal-value
singularity algebraically. -/
noncomputable def symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
    (T : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  prawitzPVIntegrand T f x t + prawitzPVIntegrand T f x (-t)

theorem measurable_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : Measurable f) (x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x) := by
  exact (measurable_prawitzPVIntegrand hf x).add
    ((measurable_prawitzPVIntegrand hf x).comp measurable_neg)

/-- Pairing converts the norm of the principal-value integrand to the
imaginary part of its nonsingular positive-frequency numerator. -/
theorem norm_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ‖symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t‖ =
      2 * |(prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im| / |t| := by
  rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand_neg hf x ht,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.sub_conj, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
    Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  rw [prawitzPVIntegrand, Complex.div_ofReal_im, abs_div]
  ring

/-- Exact signed form of the paired Prawitz integrand at nonzero frequency. -/
theorem symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_eq_two_mul_im
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t =
      ((2 * (prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im / t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
  rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand_neg hf x ht,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.sub_conj, prawitzPVIntegrand,
    Complex.div_ofReal_im]
  push_cast
  ring

/-- Real part of a signed difference of paired Prawitz integrands, expressed
