without complex norms through the positive-frequency numerators. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub
    {T : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (hg : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction g)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T g x t)).re =
      -((prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T g x t).im) /
        (Real.pi * t) := by
  have hcoef :
      Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) =
        (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Complex.ofReal_inv]
    ring
  rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_eq_two_mul_im hf x ht,
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_eq_two_mul_im hg x ht, hcoef]
  change (((((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      ((((2 * (prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im / t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
        (((2 * (prawitzPVNumerator T g x t).im / t : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.I))).re = _
  simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_re,
    Complex.sub_im, zero_mul, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, ht]
  ring

/-- A linear bound on the imaginary part of the paired numerator removes the
Prawitz singularity and supplies absolute integrability on a finite window. -/
theorem integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_of_im_le
    {T C : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hfHermitian : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f) (hfMeasurable : Measurable f)
    (hIm : ∀ t ∈ Ioc 0 T,
      |(prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im| ≤ C * t) :
    IntegrableOn (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x) (Icc 0 T) := by
  apply Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded
      (μ := volume) (s := Icc 0 T) (M := 2 * C)
  · simp [Real.volume_Icc]
  · exact Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
      (measurable_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand hfMeasurable x)
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with rfl | ht0
    · simpa [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand] using hC
    rw [norm_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand hfHermitian x ht0.ne']
    rw [abs_of_pos ht0]
    calc
      2 * |(prawitzPVNumerator T f x t).im| / t ≤
          2 * (C * t) / t :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hIm t ⟨ht0, ht.2⟩) (by norm_num)) ht0.le
      _ = 2 * C := by field_simp

/-- The paired Prawitz principal-value integrand of any probability law with
a finite first absolute moment is absolutely integrable on every positive
frequency window. -/
theorem integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn
      (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x)
      (Icc 0 T) := by
  let C : ℝ := 7 * (|x| + ∫ y, |y| ∂mu) + Real.pi / T
  have hMoment : 0 ≤ ∫ y, |y| ∂mu := integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp only [C]
    positivity
  apply integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_of_im_le
    hT.le hC (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun mu)
    MeasureTheory.measurable_charFun
  intro t ht
  exact abs_im_prawitzPVNumerator_charFun_le hmu1 hT x ht

theorem star_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) =
      -symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t := by
  rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, map_add,
    prawitzPVIntegrand_neg hf x ht]
  simp

/-- Symmetrically truncated Prawitz inversion functional. The eventual
principal value is obtained by sending `epsilon` to zero. -/
noncomputable def truncatedPrawitzInversion
    (T epsilon : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
    ∫ t in Icc epsilon T, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t

theorem star_truncatedPrawitzInversion
    {T epsilon : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (x : ℝ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (truncatedPrawitzInversion T epsilon f x) =
      truncatedPrawitzInversion T epsilon f x := by
  have hstar : ∀ t ∈ Icc epsilon T,
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) =
        -symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t := by
    intro t ht
    exact star_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand hf x (ne_of_gt (hepsilon.trans_le ht.1))
  rw [truncatedPrawitzInversion, map_mul, map_div₀,
    Complex.conj_I, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hInt :
      (∫ t in Icc epsilon T,
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t)) =
        -(∫ t in Icc epsilon T,
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    exact hstar t ht
  have hConj :
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ t in Icc epsilon T,
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) =
        ∫ t in Icc epsilon T,
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) := by
    exact (integral_conj
      (μ := volume.restrict (Icc epsilon T))
      (f := fun t => symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t)).symm
  rw [hConj, hInt]
  ring

theorem truncatedPrawitzInversion_im_eq_zero
    {T epsilon : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (x : ℝ) :
    (truncatedPrawitzInversion T epsilon f x).im = 0 := by
  have hstar := star_truncatedPrawitzInversion (T := T) hf hepsilon x
  apply_fun Complex.im at hstar
  simp only [Complex.conj_im] at hstar
  linarith

/-- The full paired Prawitz inversion functional, defined when the removable
singularity at zero is integrable. -/
noncomputable def prawitzInversion
    (T : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
    ∫ t in Icc 0 T, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t

/-- Hermitian frequency symmetry makes the full paired Prawitz inversion
functional real-valued. -/
theorem star_prawitzInversion
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f) (x : ℝ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (prawitzInversion T f x) = prawitzInversion T f x := by
  have hstar : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) =
        -symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst t
      simp [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand]
    · exact star_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand hf x ht0
  rw [prawitzInversion, map_mul, map_div₀,
    Complex.conj_I, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hInt :
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t)) =
        -(∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    exact hstar t ht
  have hConj :
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) =
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t) := by
    exact (integral_conj
      (μ := volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))
      (f := fun t => symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t)).symm
  rw [hConj, hInt]
  ring

theorem prawitzInversion_im_eq_zero
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f) (x : ℝ) :
    (prawitzInversion T f x).im = 0 := by
  have hstar := star_prawitzInversion (T := T) hf x
  apply_fun Complex.im at hstar
  simp only [Complex.conj_im] at hstar
  linarith

/-- Translating a point mass and its evaluation point by the same amount does
not change the Prawitz principal-value integrand. -/
theorem prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_translate
    (T x y t : ℝ) :
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t =
      prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (y - x))) 0 t := by
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac, MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
  rw [show inner ℝ y t = y * t by
        change t * y = y * t
        ring,
      show inner ℝ (y - x) t = (y - x) * t by
        change t * (y - x) = (y - x) * t
        ring]
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero]
  have hExp :
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          Complex.exp ((((y * t : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.exp (((((y - x) * t : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [show Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
            Complex.exp ((((y * t : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) =
        scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
          (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            Complex.exp ((((y * t : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I)) by ring,
    hExp]
  simp

theorem symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_translate
    (T x y t : ℝ) :
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t =
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (y - x))) 0 t := by
  unfold symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    (prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_translate T x y t)
    (prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_translate T x y (-t))

theorem prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_translate (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x =
      prawitzInversion T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (y - x))) 0 := by
  unfold prawitzInversion
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all _ fun t =>
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_translate T x y t

/-- The deterministic Prawitz point kernel, normalized so its argument is the
displacement from the CDF evaluation point. -/
noncomputable def prawitzPointKernel (T z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (prawitzInversion T
    (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0).re

theorem prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_eq_pointKernel (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x =
      (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) : ℂ) := by
  rw [prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_translate]
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · simpa only [Complex.ofReal_im] using
      prawitzInversion_im_eq_zero
        (T := T) (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (Measure.dirac (y - x))) 0

/-- Positive dilation of the frequency window reduces a point-mass Prawitz
integrand to the unit window with the reciprocal Jacobian factor. -/
theorem prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (z u : ℝ) :
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 (T * u) =
      ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * prawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (T * z))) 0 u := by
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · subst u
    simp [prawitzPVIntegrand]
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac, MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
  rw [show inner ℝ z (T * u) = z * (T * u) by
        change (T * u) * z = z * (T * u)
        ring,
      show inner ℝ (T * z) u = (T * z) * u by
        change u * (T * z) = (T * z) * u
        ring]
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter]
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ u hT.ne', div_one]
  have hphase : z * (T * u) = (T * z) * u := by ring
  rw [hphase]
  push_cast
  field_simp

theorem symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (z u : ℝ) :
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 (T * u) =
      ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (T * z))) 0 u := by
  unfold symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
  rw [prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_scale hT z u,
    show -(T * u) = T * (-u) by ring,
    prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_scale hT z (-u)]
  ring

theorem prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 =
      prawitzInversion 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (T * z))) 0 := by
  let gT : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
    (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 t
  let g1 : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
    (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac (T * z))) 0 u
  have hsetT : (∫ t in Icc 0 T, gT t) = ∫ t in 0..T, gT t := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT.le]
  have hset1 : (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, g1 u) = ∫ u in 0..1, g1 u := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  have hchange :
      (∫ t in 0..T, gT t) = T • ∫ u in 0..1, gT (T * u) := by
    symm
    simpa only [mul_zero, mul_one] using
      (intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
        (f := gT) (a := 0) (b := 1) T)
  have hpoint : ∀ u, gT (T * u) = ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * g1 u := by
    intro u
    exact symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_scale hT z u
  have hintegral : (∫ t in Icc 0 T, gT t) = ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, g1 u := by
    rw [hsetT, hset1, hchange]
    have hcongr :
        (∫ u in 0..1, gT (T * u)) =
          ∫ u in 0..1, ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * g1 u := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro u hu
      exact hpoint u
    have hconst :
        (∫ u in 0..1, ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * g1 u) =
          ((T : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∫ u in 0..1, g1 u :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (T : ℂ)⁻¹ g1
    rw [hcongr, hconst, Complex.real_smul]
    change (T : ℂ) * ((T : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ u in 0..1, g1 u) =
      ∫ u in 0..1, g1 u
    have hTC : (T : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hT.ne'
    field_simp [hTC]
  unfold prawitzInversion
  change (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T, gT t) =
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (∫ u in Icc 0 1, g1 u)
  rw [hintegral]

theorem prawitzPointKernel_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel T z = prawitzPointKernel 1 (T * z) := by
  unfold prawitzPointKernel
  rw [prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_scale hT z]

/-- The real unit-window integrand whose integral is the deterministic
Prawitz point kernel. -/
noncomputable def prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (z u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 u).re

/-- Away from the removable endpoint, the real point integrand is the
negative imaginary part of the nonsingular numerator divided by `πu`. -/
theorem prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_neg_im_div
    (z : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z u =
      -(prawitzPVNumerator 1
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 u).im /
        (Real.pi * u) := by
  have hcomplex (a : ℝ) :
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (((2 * a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        ((-a / Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;>
      simp [Complex.div_re, Complex.div_im, Complex.normSq_apply]
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  rw [prawitzUnitPointIntegrand, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand,
    prawitzPVIntegrand_neg
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 hu,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.sub_conj, prawitzPVIntegrand,
    Complex.div_ofReal_im, hcomplex]
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hu]

/-- Explicit real trigonometric form of the unit-window Prawitz point
integrand on the open positive frequency window. -/
theorem prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_explicit
    (z : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z u =
      (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u) -
        (((1 - u) * prawitzCotFactor u + u) * Real.sin (z * u)) /
          (Real.pi * u) := by
  rw [prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_neg_im_div z hu0.ne']
  unfold prawitzPVNumerator scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  simp only [div_one]
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
  rw [show inner ℝ z u = z * u by
    change u * z = z * u
    ring]
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
    Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
  rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter,
    if_pos (by simpa [abs_of_pos hu0] using hu1), abs_of_pos hu0,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
    add_zero, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_sub,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hu0.ne']
  ring

/-- The only non-elementary spatial term left by the explicit Prawitz point
integrand on the positive frequency window. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - u) * Real.cot (Real.pi * u) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)

/-- At spatial argument `-2πx`, the Prawitz point integrand splits into an
elementary cosine term, an elementary sine term, and the cotangent term. -/
theorem prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_neg_two_pi_eq
    (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-2 * Real.pi * x) u =
      (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi +
          prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u := by
  rw [prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_explicit (-2 * Real.pi * x) hu0 hu1]
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * x * u = -(2 * Real.pi * x * u) by ring,
    Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  rw [prawitzCotFactor, if_neg hu0.ne']
  unfold prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hu0.ne']
  ring

/-- Endpoint-regularized terms in the real cotangent expansion. The zeroth
term is algebraically canceled at `u = 1`; later terms retain the symmetric
partial-fraction form. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotSeriesTerm (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, u => (-2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))) *
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)
  | n + 1, u => ((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
      (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 2)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 2))) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)

theorem prawitzCotSeriesTerm_eq
    (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u =
      ((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
        (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 1))) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesTerm, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add]
      have hu1ne : u - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hu1.ne
      have hupne : u + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hu0.ne', hu1ne, hupne]
      ring
  | succ n =>
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesTerm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      congr 3 <;> ring

theorem summable_prawitzCotSeriesTerm
    (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    Summable (fun n => prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) := by
  have hs := (summable_real_cot_series hu0 hu1).mul_left
    (((1 - u) / Real.pi) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u))
  apply hs.congr
  intro n
  rw [prawitzCotSeriesTerm_eq x n hu0 hu1]
  ring

/-- The removable `1/u` term separated from the real cotangent series. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (x u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - u) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / (Real.pi * u)

/-- Pointwise Mittag--Leffler expansion of the cotangent--sine integrand on
the open unit interval, with the endpoint-regularized series terms. -/
theorem prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_base_add_tsum
    (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u =
      prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u + ∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u := by
  have hcot := real_cot_series_rep hu0 hu1
  have htsum :
      (∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) =
        (((1 - u) / Real.pi) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)) *
          ∑' n : ℕ,
            (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) +
              1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    rw [prawitzCotSeriesTerm_eq x n hu0 hu1]
    ring
  rw [htsum]
  unfold prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand prawitzCotBaseIntegrand
  rw [← hcot]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hu0.ne']
  ring

/-- Uniform inverse-square bound for the endpoint-regularized cotangent
series on the closed unit interval. -/
theorem abs_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le
    (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u| ≤ 4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesTerm, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, one_pow,
        div_one]
      have hup : 0 < u + 1 := by linarith [hu.1]
      have hden : 0 < Real.pi * (u + 1) := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hup
      have hcoef : 2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1)) ≤ 4 := by
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
        nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
      calc
        |(-2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))) *
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| =
            (2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))) *
              |Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_div,
            abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1] : -2 * u ≤ 0),
            abs_of_pos hden]
          ring
        _ ≤ (2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))) * 1 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _)
            (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hu.1) hden.le)
        _ ≤ 4 := by simpa using hcoef
  | succ n =>
      let m : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 2
      have hm : 2 ≤ m := by
        dsimp [m]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
      have hum : u - m < 0 := by linarith [hu.2]
      have hup : 0 < u + m := by linarith [hu.1]
      have hden : 0 < m ^ 2 - u ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - u)]
      have hqeq :
          1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m) = -2 * u / (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
        field_simp [hum.ne, hup.ne']
        ring
      have hqabs :
          |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| =
            2 * u / (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
        rw [hqeq, abs_div,
          abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1] : -2 * u ≤ 0),
          abs_of_pos hden]
        ring
      have hq :
          |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| ≤ 4 / m ^ 2 := by
        rw [hqabs]
        have hmpos : 0 < m ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < m)
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden hmpos).2
        have hu_mul : 0 ≤ u * (1 - u) :=
          mul_nonneg hu.1 (sub_nonneg.mpr hu.2)
        have hu_sq : u ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
        have hm_sq : 4 ≤ m ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - 2)]
        have hleft : 2 * u * m ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m ^ 2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (by linarith [hu.2] : 2 * u ≤ 2) (sq_nonneg m)
        have hright : 2 * m ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
          nlinarith
        exact hleft.trans hright
      have hfac : |(1 - u) / Real.pi| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2] : 0 ≤ 1 - u),
          abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
        apply (div_le_one Real.pi_pos).2
        linarith [Real.two_le_pi, hu.1]
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesTerm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [show (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 2 by ring]
      change |((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
          (1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)) *
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| ≤ 4 / m ^ 2
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc
        |(1 - u) / Real.pi| *
              |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| *
            |Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| ≤
            |(1 - u) / Real.pi| *
              |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| * 1 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| := by
          simpa only [mul_one] using
            (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hfac)
        _ ≤ 4 / m ^ 2 := hq

theorem integrableOn_prawitzCotSeriesTerm (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n)
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        change Measurable (fun u : ℝ =>
          (-2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))) *
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u))
        fun_prop
    | succ n =>
        change Measurable (fun u : ℝ => ((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
          (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 2)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 2))) *
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u))
        fun_prop
  apply (integrable_const (4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 : ℝ)).mono' hmeas
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with u hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le x n hu

theorem integral_norm_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u‖) ≤
      4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 : ℝ) := by
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae
        (integrableOn_prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n).norm
        (integrable_const _) (by
          filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with u hu
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact abs_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le x n hu)
    _ = 4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by simp

theorem summable_integral_norm_prawitzCotSeriesTerm (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u‖) := by
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
    have h := (summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail (0 : ℝ)).mul_left 4
    simpa using h
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun n => integral_norm_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le x n) hs

/-- The endpoint-regularized cotangent series may be integrated term by
term on the unit interval. -/
theorem integral_tsum_prawitzCotSeriesTerm (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, ∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) =
      ∑' n, ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u := by
  have hset := (MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm
    (fun n => integrableOn_prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n)
    (summable_integral_norm_prawitzCotSeriesTerm x)).symm
  change (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) =
    ∑' n, ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u at hset
  simpa only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hset

theorem abs_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_le
    (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u| ≤ 2 * |x| := by
  by_cases hu0 : u = 0
  · subst u
    simp [prawitzCotBaseIntegrand]
  · have habsu : 0 < |u| := abs_pos.mpr hu0
    have hden : 0 < Real.pi * |u| := mul_pos Real.pi_pos habsu
    have hfac : |1 - u| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2] : 0 ≤ 1 - u)]
      linarith [hu.1]
    unfold prawitzCotBaseIntegrand
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    calc
      |1 - u| * |Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| /
          (Real.pi * |u|) ≤
          |1 - u| * |2 * Real.pi * x * u| /
            (Real.pi * |u|) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hden).2
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.abs_sin_le_abs :
            |Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u)| ≤ |2 * Real.pi * x * u|)
          (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = 2 * |1 - u| * |x| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
          abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
        field_simp [abs_ne_zero.mpr hu0, Real.pi_ne_zero]
      _ ≤ 2 * |x| := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfac (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2))
            (abs_nonneg x))

theorem integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x)
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    unfold prawitzCotBaseIntegrand
    fun_prop
  apply (integrable_const (2 * |x| : ℝ)).mono' hmeas
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with u hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_le x hu

/-- The unit Prawitz point kernel is exactly the interval integral of its
real trigonometric integrand. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_eq_integral_unitPointIntegrand (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 z =
      ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z u := by
  have hdirac : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.dirac z) :=
    integrable_dirac (by simp)
  have hInt : IntegrableOn
      (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0) (Icc 0 1) :=
    integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      (Measure.dirac z) hdirac (by norm_num) 0
  unfold prawitzPointKernel prawitzInversion prawitzUnitPointIntegrand
  symm
  calc
    (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 u).re) =
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 u).re :=
        integral_re (hInt.const_mul _)
    _ = ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0 u).re := by
      exact congrArg Complex.re
        (MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul
          (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
          (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0))

/-- At zero displacement the paired unit-window point integrand is the
elementary triangular imaginary kernel. -/
theorem symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_zero
    {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac 0)) 0 u =
      (((-2 * Real.pi * (1 - u) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I := by
  have hnum :
      prawitzPVNumerator 1
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac 0)) 0 u =
        prawitzSmoothingFilter u := by
    unfold prawitzPVNumerator scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
    rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
    simp
  have him : (prawitzSmoothingFilter u).im =
      -(1 - u) * Real.pi * u := by
    rw [prawitzSmoothingFilter, if_pos (by simpa [abs_of_pos hu0] using hu1)]
    simp only [abs_of_pos hu0, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
      zero_mul, mul_one, add_zero, zero_sub]
    ring
  rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand,
    prawitzPVIntegrand_neg
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (Measure.dirac 0)) 0 hu0.ne',
    ← sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.sub_conj, prawitzPVIntegrand,
    Complex.div_ofReal_im, hnum, him]
  push_cast
  field_simp [hu0.ne']

theorem integral_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_zero :
    (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac 0)) 0 u) =
      -Real.pi * Complex.I := by
  have hcongr :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac 0)) 0 u) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (((-2 * Real.pi * (1 - u) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
    exact symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_zero
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  rw [hcongr, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  have hpoly :
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ))) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    have hreal :
        (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 - u : ℝ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      calc
        _ = (∫ _u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 : ℝ)) -
            (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, u) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_sub
            intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const
            intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_id
        _ = (1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 := by
          rw [integral_one, integral_id]
          field_simp
          norm_num
        _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    rw [hreal]
    norm_num
  have hinner :
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ))) * Complex.I :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const Complex.I
          (fun u : ℝ => (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by rw [hpoly]
  have houter :
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
        (((-2 * Real.pi * (1 - u) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) =
        ((-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    rw [show (fun u : ℝ => (((-2 * Real.pi * (1 - u) : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        Complex.I) = fun u => (((-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ((((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I)) by
        funext u
        push_cast
        ring]
    calc
      _ = ((-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul ((-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)
          (fun u : ℝ => (((1 - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I)
      _ = ((-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by rw [hinner]
  rw [houter]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem prawitzPointKernel_zero : prawitzPointKernel 1 0 = 1 / 2 := by
  unfold prawitzPointKernel prawitzInversion
  rw [integral_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac_zero]
  have hcomplex :
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (-Real.pi * Complex.I) =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    rw [pow_two, Complex.I_mul_I]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hcomplex]
  norm_num

theorem integrableOn_prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (z : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hdirac : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.dirac z) :=
    integrable_dirac (by simp)
  have hInt : IntegrableOn
      (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand 1
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac z)) 0) (Icc 0 1) :=
    integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      (Measure.dirac z) hdirac (by norm_num) 0
  unfold prawitzUnitPointIntegrand
  exact (hInt.const_mul _).re

/-- The cotangent--sine term has removable endpoint singularities and is
integrable on the closed unit window. -/
theorem integrableOn_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x) (Icc 0 1) := by
  let e : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
    (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi
  have he : IntegrableOn e (Icc 0 1) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous e).integrableOn_Icc
  have hp := integrableOn_prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-2 * Real.pi * x)
  apply (hp.sub he).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
  have hpoint :
      prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-2 * Real.pi * x) u =
        e u + prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u := by
    dsimp only [e]
    exact prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_neg_two_pi_eq x
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  change prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-2 * Real.pi * x) u - e u = _
  rw [hpoint]
  ring

theorem integrableOn_tsum_prawitzCotSeriesTerm (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u => ∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hcot := integrableOn_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x
  have hbase := integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x
  apply (hcot.sub hbase).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
  have hpoint := prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_base_add_tsum x
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  change prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u -
    prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u = _
  linarith

/-- Integral form of the Mittag--Leffler expansion: the cotangent integral
is a removable base integral plus the sum of the regularized term integrals. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_base_add_tsum (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u) +
        ∑' n, ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u := by
  have hcongr :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u +
            ∑' n, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
    exact prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_base_add_tsum x
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x)
    (integrableOn_tsum_prawitzCotSeriesTerm x)] at hcongr
  simp_rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hcongr
  rw [hcongr, integral_tsum_prawitzCotSeriesTerm]

/-- Real Riemann--Lebesgue lemma in the sine-transform normalization used by
the Prawitz formulas. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_sin_mul_atTop_of_integrable
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    Tendsto (fun w : ℝ => ∫ v : ℝ, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let fc : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (f v : ℂ)
  have hfc : Integrable fc := hf.ofReal
  have hcomplex :=
    (Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact fc).mono_left
      (_root_.atTop_le_cocompact : atTop ≤ cocompact ℝ)
  have him := Complex.continuous_im.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcomplex
  have hneg := him.neg
  convert hneg using 1
  · funext w
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have hInt : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => 𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v) := by
      simpa only [real_inner_comm] using
        ((Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).2 hfc)
    change (∫ v : ℝ, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v) =
      -RCLike.im (∫ v : ℝ, 𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v)
    calc
      _ = -∫ v : ℝ, RCLike.im (𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v) := by
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
        apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with v
        have hexp :
            (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) * Complex.I)).im =
              -Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v * w) := by
          rw [show (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) : ℂ) * Complex.I =
              ((-(2 * Real.pi * v * w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
                push_cast
                ring,
            Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.sin_neg]
        rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply]
        change Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v =
          -(Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) * Complex.I) *
            (f v : ℂ)).im
        rw [Complex.mul_im, hexp]
        simp
      _ = _ := congrArg Neg.neg (integral_im hInt)
  · simp

/-- The frequency-independent coefficient of a regularized cotangent-series
term. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotSeriesWeight : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, u => -2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1))
  | n + 1, u => ((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
      (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 2)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 2)))

theorem prawitzCotSeriesTerm_eq_weight_mul (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u =
      prawitzCotSeriesWeight n u * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) := by
  cases n <;> simp [prawitzCotSeriesTerm, prawitzCotSeriesWeight]

theorem abs_prawitzCotSeriesWeight_le
    (n : ℕ) {u : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |prawitzCotSeriesWeight n u| ≤ 4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesWeight, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add,
        one_pow, div_one]
      have hup : 0 < u + 1 := by linarith [hu.1]
      have hden : 0 < Real.pi * (u + 1) := mul_pos Real.pi_pos hup
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1] : -2 * u ≤ 0),
        abs_of_pos hden]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
      nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
  | succ n =>
      let m : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 2
      have hm : 2 ≤ m := by
        dsimp [m]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
      have hum : u - m < 0 := by linarith [hu.2]
      have hup : 0 < u + m := by linarith [hu.1]
      have hden : 0 < m ^ 2 - u ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - u)]
      have hqeq :
          1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m) = -2 * u / (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
        field_simp [hum.ne, hup.ne']
        ring
      have hqabs :
          |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| =
            2 * u / (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
        rw [hqeq, abs_div,
          abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1] : -2 * u ≤ 0),
          abs_of_pos hden]
        ring
      have hq :
          |1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m)| ≤ 4 / m ^ 2 := by
        rw [hqabs]
        have hmpos : 0 < m ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < m)
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hden hmpos).2
        have hu_sq : u ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - u), hu.1, hu.2]
        have hm_sq : 4 ≤ m ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (m - 2)]
        have hleft : 2 * u * m ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m ^ 2 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (by linarith [hu.2] : 2 * u ≤ 2) (sq_nonneg m)
        have hright : 2 * m ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
          nlinarith
        exact hleft.trans hright
      have hfac : |(1 - u) / Real.pi| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hu.2] : 0 ≤ 1 - u),
          abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
        apply (div_le_one Real.pi_pos).2
        linarith [Real.two_le_pi, hu.1]
      simp only [prawitzCotSeriesWeight, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [show (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 2 by ring]
      change |((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
          (1 / (u - m) + 1 / (u + m))| ≤ 4 / m ^ 2
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hfac).trans hq

theorem integrableOn_prawitzCotSeriesWeight (n : ℕ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n) (Icc 0 1) := by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n)
      (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    apply Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        change Measurable (fun u : ℝ => -2 * u / (Real.pi * (u + 1)))
        fun_prop
    | succ n =>
        change Measurable (fun u : ℝ => ((1 - u) / Real.pi) *
          (1 / (u - ((n : ℝ) + 2)) + 1 / (u + ((n : ℝ) + 2))))
        fun_prop
  apply (integrable_const (4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 : ℝ)).mono' hmeas
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with u hu
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact abs_prawitzCotSeriesWeight_le n hu

theorem tendsto_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_atTop (n : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator
    (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n)
  have hf : Integrable f :=
    (integrableOn_prawitzCotSeriesWeight n).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hrl := tendsto_integral_sin_mul_atTop_of_integrable f hf
  apply hrl.congr'
  filter_upwards with x
  have hset :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) =
        ∫ u : ℝ, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u * x) * f u := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [show (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u * x) *
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n) u) =
      fun u => (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n) u *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u * x) by funext u; ring_nf]
    rw [show (fun u : ℝ =>
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (prawitzCotSeriesWeight n) u *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u * x)) =
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (fun u =>
        prawitzCotSeriesWeight n u * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u * x)) by
          funext u
          by_cases hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 <;> simp [hu]]
    rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with u
    rw [prawitzCotSeriesTerm_eq_weight_mul]
    ring_nf
  simpa only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hset.symm

theorem norm_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u‖ ≤
      4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
  have hEq :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u) =
        ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u := by
    simp only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  rw [← hEq]
  exact (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans
    (integral_norm_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le x n)

/-- The sum of all regularized cotangent-series integrals vanishes at high
spatial frequency. -/
theorem tendsto_tsum_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      ∑' n, ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotSeriesTerm x n u)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 4 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) := by
    have h := (summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail (0 : ℝ)).mul_left 4
    simpa using h
  have h := tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hs
    tendsto_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_atTop
    (Eventually.of_forall fun x n => norm_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_le x n)
  simpa using h

/-- The regularized cotangent-series contribution vanishes at high spatial
frequency; only the removable `1/u` base integral survives. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzCotangentIntegral_sub_base_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) -
        ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand x u)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  convert tendsto_tsum_integral_prawitzCotSeriesTerm_atTop using 1
  funext x
  rw [integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_base_add_tsum]
  ring

/-- Reflection cancels the odd cotangent/sine part of the real point
integrand, leaving an elementary Fejér-type cosine kernel. -/
theorem prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_add_neg
    (z : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z u +
        prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-z) u =
      2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u) := by
  rw [prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_explicit z hu0 hu1,
    prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_eq_explicit (-z) hu0 hu1]
  rw [show -z * u = -(z * u) by ring, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  ring

theorem integral_two_mul_one_sub_mul_cos
    {z : ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, 2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u)) =
      2 * (1 - Real.cos z) / z ^ 2 := by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => 2 *
    ((1 - u) * Real.sin (z * u) / z - Real.cos (z * u) / z ^ 2)
  have hF (u : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt F (2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u)) u := by
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 1 - v) (-1) u := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_const u 1).sub (hasDerivAt_id u) using 1; ring
    have harg : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => z * v) z u :=
      by convert (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul z using 1; simp
    have hsin : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.sin (z * v))
        (Real.cos (z * u) * z) u :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (z * u)).comp u harg
    have hcos : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.cos (z * v))
        (-Real.sin (z * u) * z) u :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (z * u)).comp u harg
    have h := ((hlin.mul hsin).div_const z).sub (hcos.div_const (z ^ 2))
    convert h.const_mul 2 using 1
    dsimp only [F]; field_simp [hz]; ring
  have hInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u : ℝ => 2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u)) volume 0 1 :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun u : ℝ =>
      2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (f := F)
    (f' := fun u => 2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u))
    (fun u _ => hF u) hInt
  rw [hFTC]
  dsimp only [F]
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, zero_div,
    Real.cos_zero]
  field_simp [hz]
  ring

theorem integral_one_sub_mul_cos
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 - u) * Real.cos (a * u)) =
      (1 - Real.cos a) / a ^ 2 := by
  have h := integral_two_mul_one_sub_mul_cos (z := a) ha
  rw [show (fun u : ℝ => 2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (a * u)) =
      fun u => 2 * ((1 - u) * Real.cos (a * u)) by funext u; ring,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h
  calc
    _ = (2 * (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 - u) * Real.cos (a * u))) / 2 := by
      ring
    _ = (2 * (1 - Real.cos a) / a ^ 2) / 2 := by rw [h]
    _ = (1 - Real.cos a) / a ^ 2 := by ring

theorem integral_sin_mul_div_pi
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, Real.sin (a * u) / Real.pi) =
      (1 - Real.cos a) / (Real.pi * a) := by
  have hchange := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left
    (f := Real.sin) (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) ha
  simp only [mul_zero, mul_one] at hchange
  rw [integral_sin] at hchange
  simp only [Real.cos_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hchange
  rw [show (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (a * u) / Real.pi) =
      fun u => (1 / Real.pi) * Real.sin (a * u) by funext u; ring,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hchange]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, ha]

/-- Exact reduction of the negative-spatial Prawitz point kernel to two
elementary integrals and one cotangent--sine integral. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_neg_two_pi_eq
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) =
      (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) / (2 * Real.pi * x) ^ 2 +
        (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) /
          (Real.pi * (2 * Real.pi * x)) +
        ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_eq_integral_unitPointIntegrand]
  have hcongr :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-2 * Real.pi * x) u) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ((1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi +
              prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
    exact prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_neg_two_pi_eq x
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  rw [hcongr]
  have hcos : IntegrableOn
      (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u))
      (Icc 0 1) := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun u : ℝ =>
        (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u)).integrableOn_Icc
  have hsin : IntegrableOn
      (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi)
      (Icc 0 1) := (by fun_prop : Continuous fun u : ℝ =>
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi).integrableOn_Icc
  have hsplit1 :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ((1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi) +
            prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
        (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ((1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi)) +
          ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_add (hcos.add hsin)
      (integrableOn_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x)
  have hsplit2 :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ((1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi)) =
        (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u)) +
          ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) / Real.pi :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_add hcos hsin
  rw [hsplit1, hsplit2]
  simp_rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
  rw [integral_one_sub_mul_cos (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      Real.pi_ne_zero) hx),
    integral_sin_mul_div_pi (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      Real.pi_ne_zero) hx)]

/-- The sole remaining analytic content of the positive-half-line Fourier
identification is an exact cotangent--sine integral. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity_iff_cotangentIntegral
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) - 1 =
        prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x) ↔
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
        1 / 2 - (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
          (prawitzInverseSquareTail x + 1 / (2 * x ^ 2)) := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_neg_two_pi_eq hx.ne']
  unfold prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder
  rw [show Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x) = Real.cos (2 * (Real.pi * x)) by
    congr 1
    ring]
  rw [Real.cos_two_mul]
  rw [show 1 - (2 * Real.cos (Real.pi * x) ^ 2 - 1) =
      2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * x) ^ 2 by rw [Real.sin_sq]; ring]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hx.ne']
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

/-- Shifting the spatial argument by one removes the cotangent singularity
from the difference of the two Prawitz integrands. -/
theorem prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ}
    (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u < 1) :
    prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u -
        prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u =
      (1 - u) * (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u)) := by
  unfold prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand
  rw [Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  have hsin : Real.sin (Real.pi * u) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_ne_zero_iff]
    intro n hn
    have : u = n := by
      apply (mul_left_cancel₀ Real.pi_ne_zero)
      simpa [mul_comm] using hn.symm
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (this ▸ hu0)
    have hn1 : n < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast (this ▸ hu1)
    omega
  have htrig :
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u) -
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * u) =
        2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * u) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u + Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u =
        (2 * Real.pi * x * u + Real.pi * u) + Real.pi * u by ring,
      show 2 * Real.pi * x * u =
        (2 * Real.pi * x * u + Real.pi * u) - Real.pi * u by ring,
      Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hcos :
      Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u) =
        2 * Real.cos (Real.pi * u) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u + Real.pi * u) := by
    rw [Real.two_mul_cos_mul_cos]
    rw [show Real.pi * u - (2 * Real.pi * x * u + Real.pi * u) =
        -(2 * Real.pi * x * u) by ring,
      Real.cos_neg]
    congr 1
    ring_nf
  rw [hcos, ← mul_sub, htrig]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring_nf
  have hsin' : Real.sin (u * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using hsin
  field_simp [hsin']

/-- The interval integral of the shifted cotangent--sine integrand differs by
two elementary cosine integrals. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u) -
        (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 - u) *
        (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u)) := by
  have hsub :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u) -
          (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u -
            prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub
      (integrableOn_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1))
      (integrableOn_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x)]
  have hcongr :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u -
          prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u)) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 - u) *
          (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
            Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u)) := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
    exact prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub x
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0)) (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
  simp_rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hsub hcongr
  rw [hsub, hcongr]

/-- Closed form of the unit-shift recurrence for the cotangent--sine
integral, away from the two removable spatial endpoints. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub_closed {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x + 1 ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (x + 1) u) -
        (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
      (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) / (2 * Real.pi * x) ^ 2 +
        (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1))) /
          (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub]
  rw [show (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) *
      (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u))) =
      fun u => (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u) +
        (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u) by
      funext u
      ring]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x * u))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) * Real.cos
        (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) * u))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
  rw [integral_one_sub_mul_cos
      (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero) hx),
    integral_one_sub_mul_cos
      (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero) hx1)]

/-- The cotangent--sine integral equals one half at the first positive integer. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_one :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand 1 u) = 1 / 2 := by
  have h := integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub (0 : ℝ)
  simp only [zero_add] at h
  have hzero :
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand 0 u) = 0 := by
    simp [prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand]
  rw [hzero, sub_zero] at h
  rw [show (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) *
      (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * 0 * u) +
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * 1 * u))) =
      fun u => (1 - u) + (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u) by
      funext u
      simp
      ring] at h
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => 1 - u)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    ((by fun_prop : Continuous
      (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u))).intervalIntegrable 0 1)] at h
  have hone : (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 - u)) = 1 / 2 := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ _u : ℝ in 0..1, (1 : ℝ)) - ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, u := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
          intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const
          intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_id]
      _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [integral_one, integral_id]; norm_num
  rw [hone, integral_one_sub_mul_cos
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero), Real.cos_two_pi] at h
  simpa only [sub_self, zero_div, add_zero] using h

/-- At every positive integer, the cotangent--sine integral is exactly one
half.  The shift recurrence makes the induction increments vanish. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_nat_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
      prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) u) = 1 / 2 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_one
  | succ n ih =>
      have hx : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hx1 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h := integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub_closed hx hx1
      have hc0 :
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 1 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.pi * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
            ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) by ring,
          Real.cos_nat_mul_two_pi]
      have hc1 :
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) =
            ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) by push_cast; ring,
          Real.cos_nat_mul_two_pi]
      rw [hc0, hc1] at h
      simp only [sub_self, zero_div, zero_add] at h
      rw [show ((Nat.succ n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
      linarith

/-- The positive-half-line Fourier identity holds on the positive integer
lattice. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity_nat_succ (n : ℕ) :
    2 * prawitzPointKernel 1
        (-2 * Real.pi * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) - 1 =
      prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  have hx : 0 < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  apply (prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity_iff_cotangentIntegral hx).2
  rw [integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_nat_succ]
  have hsin :
      Real.sin (Real.pi * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_comm, Real.sin_nat_mul_pi]
  rw [hsin]
  ring

/-- Real Riemann--Lebesgue lemma for cosine transforms in the normalization
used by the Prawitz formulas. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_cos_mul_atTop_of_integrable
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    Tendsto (fun w : ℝ => ∫ v : ℝ, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let fc : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (f v : ℂ)
  have hfc : Integrable fc := hf.ofReal
  have hcomplex :=
    (Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact fc).mono_left
      (_root_.atTop_le_cocompact : atTop ≤ cocompact ℝ)
  have hre := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcomplex
  convert hre using 1
  funext w
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  have hInt : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => 𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v) := by
    simpa only [real_inner_comm] using
      ((Real.fourierIntegral_convergent_iff w).2 hfc)
  change (∫ v : ℝ, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v) =
    RCLike.re (∫ v : ℝ, 𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v)
  calc
    _ = ∫ v : ℝ, RCLike.re (𝐞 (-(v * w)) • fc v) := by
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with v
      have hexp :
          (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) * Complex.I)).re =
            Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * v * w) := by
        rw [show (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) : ℂ) * Complex.I =
            ((-(2 * Real.pi * v * w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by
              push_cast
              ring,
          Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Real.cos_neg]
      rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply]
      change Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * v * w) * f v =
        (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * (-(v * w))) * Complex.I) *
          (f v : ℂ)).re
      rw [Complex.mul_re, hexp]
      simp
    _ = _ := integral_re hInt

/-- Continuity of a complex Fourier integral in the unnormalized phase
`exp (-i t x)`.  The explicit normalization bridge keeps later Prawitz
arguments independent of the library's `2 * pi` Fourier convention. -/
theorem continuous_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ,
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f t) := by
  have hFourier : Continuous
      (VectorFourier.fourierIntegral 𝐞 volume
        (LinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) f) :=
    VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_continuous
      Real.continuous_fourierChar (by fun_prop) hf
  have h := hFourier.comp
    (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * x))
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.mul_apply']
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

/-- Complex Riemann--Lebesgue decay in the positive spatial tail, written
with the unnormalized phase used by the signed Prawitz formulas. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul_atTop (f : ℝ → ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ,
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f t)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hscale :
      Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * x) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop
      (inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos))
  have hrl :=
    (Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact f).mono_left
      (_root_.atTop_le_cocompact : atTop ≤ cocompact ℝ)
  have h := hrl.comp hscale
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

/-- Complex Riemann--Lebesgue decay in the negative spatial tail, written
with the unnormalized phase used by the signed Prawitz formulas. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul_atBot (f : ℝ → ℂ) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ,
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f t)
      atBot (𝓝 0) := by
  have hscale :
      Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * x) atBot atBot :=
    tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot
      (inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos))
  have hrl :=
    (Real.tendsto_integral_exp_smul_cocompact f).mono_left
      (_root_.atBot_le_cocompact : atBot ≤ cocompact ℝ)
  have h := hrl.comp hscale
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [Circle.smul_def, Real.fourierChar_apply]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

/-- The removable coefficient in the difference of two shifted base
integrands. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight (x u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (x / 2) u

theorem abs_prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight_le
    (x : ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u| ≤ 2 * |x| := by
  unfold prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  calc
    2 * |prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (x / 2) u| ≤
        2 * (2 * |x / 2|) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_le (x / 2) hu)
        (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * |x| := by rw [abs_div]; norm_num; ring

theorem integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x) (Icc 0 1) := by
  unfold prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight
  exact (integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (x / 2)).const_mul 2

theorem prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub (w x u : ℝ) :
    prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u - prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u =
      Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
        prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u := by
  have htrig :
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (w + x) * u) -
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * w * u) =
        2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * x * u) *
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) := by
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (w + x) * u =
        (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) + Real.pi * x * u by ring,
      show 2 * Real.pi * w * u =
        (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) - Real.pi * x * u by ring,
      Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
    ring
  simp only [prawitzCotBaseIntegrand, prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight]
  rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (x / 2) * u = Real.pi * x * u by ring,
    ← sub_div, ← mul_sub, htrig]
  ring

theorem integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub (w x : ℝ) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u) -
        (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u) =
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
          prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u := by
  have hsub :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u) -
          (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u -
            prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub
      (integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x))
      (integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w)]
  have hcongr :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u -
          prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u)) =
        ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
            prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with u
    exact prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub w x u
  simp_rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hsub hcongr
  rw [hsub, hcongr]

theorem tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub_atTop (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun w : ℝ =>
      (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (w + x) u) -
        ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotBaseIntegrand w u)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x)
  have hf : Integrable f :=
    (integrableOn_prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hrl := (tendsto_integral_cos_mul_atTop_of_integrable f hf).comp
    (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (x / 2) tendsto_id)
  apply hrl.congr'
  filter_upwards with w
  rw [integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub]
  have hset :
      (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
          prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u) =
        ∫ u : ℝ, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) * f u := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [show (fun u : ℝ => Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x) u) =
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator (fun u =>
        Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u * (w + x / 2)) *
          prawitzCotBaseShiftWeight x u) by
          funext u
          by_cases hu : u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 <;> simp [hu]]
    rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  simpa only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] using hset.symm

/-- The removable base integral converges to one half along the positive
integer lattice, anchored by the exact lattice cotangent identity. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_nat_succ :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
        prawitzCotBaseIntegrand ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) u)
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) := by
  have hcast : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hrem := tendsto_prawitzCotangentIntegral_sub_base_atTop.comp hcast
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _n : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h := hconst.sub hrem
  convert h using 1
  · funext n
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_nat_succ]
    linarith
  · ring_nf

theorem tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_nat_succ_add (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
        prawitzCotBaseIntegrand (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x) u)
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) := by
  have hcast : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hdiff :=
    (tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_add_sub_atTop x).comp hcast
  have h := hdiff.add tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_nat_succ
  convert h using 1
  · funext n
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring_nf
  · ring_nf

/-- Every fixed translate of the cotangent--sine integral tends to one half
along the positive integer lattice. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_nat_succ_add (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      ∫ u : ℝ in 0..1,
        prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x) u)
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) := by
  have hcast : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hshift :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop x hcast
  have hrem := tendsto_prawitzCotangentIntegral_sub_base_atTop.comp hshift
  have h := hrem.add (tendsto_integral_prawitzCotBaseIntegrand_nat_succ_add x)
  convert h using 1
  · funext n
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    ring_nf
  · ring_nf

theorem prawitzInverseSquareTail_nonneg (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ prawitzInverseSquareTail x := by
  unfold prawitzInverseSquareTail
  exact tsum_nonneg fun _n => by positivity

/-- Removing the first inverse-square summand shifts the spatial tail by one. -/
theorem prawitzInverseSquareTail_eq_inv_add (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzInverseSquareTail x =
      1 / (x + 1) ^ 2 + prawitzInverseSquareTail (x + 1) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / (x + (n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2
  have hs : Summable f := summable_prawitzInverseSquareTail x
  unfold prawitzInverseSquareTail
  change (∑' n, f n) = _
  rw [hs.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  congr 1
  · simp [f]
  · apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    dsimp only [f]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring

/-- The apparent singularity of the inverse-square tail at zero is absent:
shifting its first summand expresses a neighborhood of zero through the
smooth positive-half-line series at one. -/
theorem continuousAt_prawitzInverseSquareTail_zero :
    ContinuousAt prawitzInverseSquareTail 0 := by
  have htailOne : ContinuousAt prawitzInverseSquareTail 1 :=
    (hasDerivAt_prawitzInverseSquareTail (by norm_num)).continuousAt
  have hshift : ContinuousAt
      (fun x : ℝ => prawitzInverseSquareTail (x + 1)) 0 := by
    have hadd : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x + 1) 0 :=
      continuousAt_id.add continuousAt_const
    have htailOne' :
        ContinuousAt prawitzInverseSquareTail ((0 : ℝ) + 1) := by
      simpa using htailOne
    exact ContinuousAt.comp' (f := fun x : ℝ => x + 1) htailOne' hadd
  have hinv : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 / (x + 1) ^ 2) 0 := by
    exact continuousAt_const.div
      ((continuousAt_id.add continuousAt_const).pow 2) (by norm_num)
  rw [show prawitzInverseSquareTail = fun x : ℝ =>
      1 / (x + 1) ^ 2 + prawitzInverseSquareTail (x + 1) by
    funext x
    exact prawitzInverseSquareTail_eq_inv_add x]
  exact hinv.add hshift

/-- Closed form predicted for the positive cotangent--sine integral. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / 2 - (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
    (prawitzInverseSquareTail x + 1 / (2 * x ^ 2))

theorem prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget_add_one_sub
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x + 1 ≠ 0) :
    prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget (x + 1) -
        prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget x =
      (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x)) / (2 * Real.pi * x) ^ 2 +
        (1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1))) /
          (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
  have hsin : Real.sin (Real.pi * (x + 1)) =
      -Real.sin (Real.pi * x) := by
    rw [show Real.pi * (x + 1) = Real.pi * x + Real.pi by ring,
      Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi, Real.cos_pi]
    ring
  have hcos0 : 1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * x) =
      2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * x) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * x = 2 * (Real.pi * x) by ring,
      Real.cos_two_mul, Real.sin_sq]
    ring
  have hcos1 : 1 - Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (x + 1)) =
      2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (x + 1)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (x + 1) =
        2 * (Real.pi * (x + 1)) by ring,
      Real.cos_two_mul, Real.sin_sq]
    ring
  unfold prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget
  rw [prawitzInverseSquareTail_eq_inv_add x, hcos0, hcos1, hsin]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hx, hx1]
  ring

/-- The cotangent sine integral on `[0, 1]` minus `prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget`. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotangentIntegralError (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) -
    prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget x

theorem prawitzCotangentIntegralError_add_one
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : x + 1 ≠ 0) :
    prawitzCotangentIntegralError (x + 1) =
      prawitzCotangentIntegralError x := by
  have hJ := integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_add_one_sub_closed hx hx1
  have hT := prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget_add_one_sub hx hx1
  unfold prawitzCotangentIntegralError
  linarith

theorem prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget_tendsto_nat_succ_add
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x))
      atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2)) := by
  let y : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x
  have hcast : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hy : Tendsto y atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop x hcast
  have hbound : Tendsto (fun n => 2 / y n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hy
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    prawitzInverseSquareTail (y n) + 1 / (2 * (y n) ^ 2)
  have ha_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ a n := by
    dsimp only [a]
    exact add_nonneg (prawitzInverseSquareTail_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have ha_le (n : ℕ) : a n ≤ 2 / y n := by
    have hyn : 0 < y n := by
      dsimp only [y]
      positivity
    have hy1 : 1 ≤ y n := by
      dsimp only [y]
      have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)
      linarith
    have hhalf : 1 / (2 * (y n) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / y n := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (y n) ^ 2) hyn).2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y n - 1)]
    dsimp only [a]
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 / y n + 1 / y n :=
        add_le_add (prawitzInverseSquareTail_le_inv hyn) hhalf
      _ = 2 / y n := by ring
  have ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero ha_nonneg ha_le hbound
  let q : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    (Real.sin (Real.pi * y n) / Real.pi) ^ 2
  have hq_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ q n := by
    dsimp only [q]
    positivity
  have hq_le (n : ℕ) : q n ≤ 1 := by
    have hratio : |Real.sin (Real.pi * y n) / Real.pi| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
      exact (div_le_one Real.pi_pos).2
        ((Real.abs_sin_le_one _).trans (by linarith [Real.two_le_pi]))
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [← sq_abs]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.sin (Real.pi * y n) / Real.pi)]
  have hqa : Tendsto (fun n => q n * a n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero
      (fun n => mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg n) (ha_nonneg n))
      (fun n => mul_le_of_le_one_left (ha_nonneg n) (hq_le n)) ha
  have h := (tendsto_const_nhds :
    Tendsto (fun _n : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (1 / 2))).sub hqa
  simpa only [prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget, q, a, y, sub_zero] using h

theorem prawitzCotangentIntegralError_nat_add
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (n : ℕ) :
    prawitzCotangentIntegralError (x + n) =
      prawitzCotangentIntegralError x := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [show x + ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (x + (n : ℝ)) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
      rw [prawitzCotangentIntegralError_add_one (by positivity) (by positivity), ih]

theorem prawitzCotangentIntegralError_eq_zero
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : prawitzCotangentIntegralError x = 0 := by
  have hJ := tendsto_integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_nat_succ_add x
  have hT := prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget_tendsto_nat_succ_add hx
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      prawitzCotangentIntegralError (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := hJ.sub hT
    simpa only [prawitzCotangentIntegralError, sub_self] using h
  have heq (n : ℕ) :
      prawitzCotangentIntegralError (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x) =
        prawitzCotangentIntegralError x := by
    rw [add_comm]
    exact prawitzCotangentIntegralError_nat_add hx (n + 1)
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      prawitzCotangentIntegralError (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + x))
      atTop (𝓝 (prawitzCotangentIntegralError x)) := by
    convert (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto
      (fun _n : ℕ => prawitzCotangentIntegralError x) atTop
        (𝓝 (prawitzCotangentIntegralError x))) using 1
    funext n
    exact heq n
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hconst hzero

/-- Exact evaluation of the remaining cotangent--sine integral on the
positive half-line. -/
theorem integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_target
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (∫ u : ℝ in 0..1, prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand x u) =
      prawitzCotangentIntegralTarget x := by
  have h := prawitzCotangentIntegralError_eq_zero hx
  unfold prawitzCotangentIntegralError at h
  linarith

/-- Exact positive-half-line Fourier identification for the Prawitz point
kernel and the nonnegative Vaaler remainder. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) - 1 =
      prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x := by
  apply (prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity_iff_cotangentIntegral hx).2
