  rw [integral_prawitzCotangentSineIntegrand_eq_target hx]
  rfl

/-- The reflected Prawitz point kernels add to the nonnegative Fejér
kernel, with the removable value `1` at the origin. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_add_neg (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 z + prawitzPointKernel 1 (-z) =
      if z = 0 then 1 else 2 * (1 - Real.cos z) / z ^ 2 := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    rw [if_pos rfl, neg_zero, prawitzPointKernel_zero]
    field_simp
    norm_num
  · rw [if_neg hz, prawitzPointKernel_eq_integral_unitPointIntegrand,
      prawitzPointKernel_eq_integral_unitPointIntegrand]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add
      (integrableOn_prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z)
      (integrableOn_prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-z))]
    have hcongr :
        (∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (prawitzUnitPointIntegrand z u +
            prawitzUnitPointIntegrand (-z) u)) =
          ∫ u in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            2 * (1 - u) * Real.cos (z * u) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
          (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 0,
          (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).ae_ne 1] with u hu hu0 hu1
      exact prawitzUnitPointIntegrand_add_neg z
        (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.1 (Ne.symm hu0))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne hu.2 hu1)
    rw [hcongr, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1),
      integral_two_mul_one_sub_mul_cos hz]

theorem prawitzPointKernel_add_neg_nonneg (z : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ prawitzPointKernel 1 z + prawitzPointKernel 1 (-z) := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_add_neg]
  split_ifs with hz
  · norm_num
  · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.cos_le_one z))) (sq_nonneg z)

/-- The sum of the positive and reflected Prawitz--Vaaler remainders is
exactly twice the reflected Prawitz point-kernel sum. -/
theorem prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder_add_negative_eq_pointKernel
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x +
        prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder x =
      2 * (prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) +
        prawitzPointKernel 1 (2 * Real.pi * x)) := by
  have hkernel := prawitzPointKernel_add_neg (-2 * Real.pi * x)
  rw [if_neg (by positivity : -2 * Real.pi * x ≠ 0)] at hkernel
  rw [show -(-2 * Real.pi * x) = 2 * Real.pi * x by ring] at hkernel
  rw [hkernel]
  rw [show Real.cos (-2 * Real.pi * x) = Real.cos (2 * (Real.pi * x)) by
    rw [show -2 * Real.pi * x = -(2 * (Real.pi * x)) by ring,
      Real.cos_neg]]
  rw [Real.cos_two_mul]
  rw [prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder, prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hx.ne']
  rw [Real.sin_sq]
  ring

/-- The positive-half-line Fourier identification implies its reflected
negative-half-line companion through the exact Fejér reflection identity. -/
theorem prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_eq_pointKernel_of_positive
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hpos : 2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) - 1 =
      prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x) :
    2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (2 * Real.pi * x) + 1 =
      prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder x := by
  linarith [prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder_add_negative_eq_pointKernel hx]

/-- Once the positive-half-line Fourier identity is supplied, the entire
piecewise spatial majorant is exactly the scaled Prawitz point kernel. -/
theorem prawitzVaalerMajorant_eq_pointKernel_of_positive
    (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) - 1 =
        prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder x) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzVaalerMajorant x =
      2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) := by
  by_cases hxpos : 0 < x
  · rw [prawitzVaalerMajorant, if_pos hxpos]
    linarith [hpos x hxpos]
  · by_cases hxneg : x < 0
    · rw [prawitzVaalerMajorant, if_neg hxpos, if_pos hxneg]
      have hy : 0 < -x := neg_pos.mpr hxneg
      have hneg := prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_eq_pointKernel_of_positive
        hy (hpos (-x) hy)
      rw [show -2 * Real.pi * x = 2 * Real.pi * (-x) by ring]
      linarith
    · have hx : x = 0 := by linarith
      subst x
      rw [prawitzVaalerMajorant]
      simp [prawitzPointKernel_zero]

/-- The explicit Vaaler majorant is exactly the spatial Prawitz point kernel
on the whole real line. -/
theorem prawitzVaalerMajorant_eq_pointKernel (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzVaalerMajorant x =
      2 * prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi * x) :=
  prawitzVaalerMajorant_eq_pointKernel_of_positive
    (fun _x hx => prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity hx) x

/-- The unit-window Prawitz point kernel takes the exact upper-step value at
the first negative Fourier lattice point. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_neg_two_pi :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 (-2 * Real.pi) = 1 / 2 := by
  have h := prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity
    (x := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  simp [prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder] at h
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi = -(2 * Real.pi) by ring]
  linarith

/-- The reflected unit-window point kernel takes the exact lower-step value
at the first positive Fourier lattice point. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_two_pi :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 (2 * Real.pi) = -(1 / 2) := by
  have hpos := prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity
    (x := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hneg := prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_eq_pointKernel_of_positive
    (x := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) hpos
  simp [prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder] at hneg
  linarith

/-- Positive scaling converts the centered CDF kernel exactly to the spatial
argument used by the Prawitz--Vaaler majorant. -/
theorem centeredHalfLineStep_scaled_eq_cdfKernel
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    centeredHalfLineStep (-T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 := by
  by_cases hy : y ≤ x
  · have harg : ¬ -T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi) < 0 := by
      have hnum : 0 ≤ -T * (y - x) :=
        mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by linarith) (sub_nonpos.mpr hy)
      exact not_lt.mpr (div_nonneg hnum (by positivity))
    rw [centeredHalfLineStep, if_neg harg]
    simp [hy]
    norm_num
  · have hy' : x < y := lt_of_not_ge hy
    have harg : -T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi) < 0 := by
      exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
        (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) (sub_pos.mpr hy')) (by positivity)
    rw [centeredHalfLineStep, if_pos harg]
    simp [hy]

/-- The exact Prawitz point kernel majorizes the centered lower-ray
indicator at every positive frequency scale. -/
theorem centeredCDFKernel_le_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ≤
      2 * prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) := by
  rw [← centeredHalfLineStep_scaled_eq_cdfKernel hT x y]
  calc
    centeredHalfLineStep (-T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤
        prawitzVaalerMajorant (-T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
      centeredHalfLineStep_le_prawitzVaalerMajorant _
    _ = 2 * prawitzPointKernel 1
          (-2 * Real.pi * (-T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi))) :=
      prawitzVaalerMajorant_eq_pointKernel _
    _ = 2 * prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) := by
      rw [prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
      congr 2
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

/-- The upper Prawitz point-kernel majorization is sharp on the atom-sensitive
diagonal selected by the right-continuous CDF convention. -/
theorem centeredCDFKernel_eq_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel_diagonal
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x - 1 =
      2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - x) := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
  simp only [mem_Iic, le_refl, Set.indicator_of_mem, mul_one, sub_self,
    mul_zero, prawitzPointKernel_zero]
  norm_num

/-- No positive uniform constant can be subtracted from the upper Prawitz
point-kernel majorant while retaining all spatial points. -/
theorem not_centeredCDFKernel_le_prawitzPointKernel_sub_pos
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    ¬ ∀ y : ℝ,
      2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ≤
        2 * prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) - delta := by
  intro h
  have hdiag := h x
  rw [centeredCDFKernel_eq_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel_diagonal
    hT x] at hdiag
  linarith

/-- Reflecting the same majorant gives the corresponding lower envelope,
with the right-continuous endpoint convention valid even at an atom. -/
theorem neg_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel_le_centeredCDFKernel
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    -2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ≤
      2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 := by
  have hscale :
      prawitzVaalerMajorant (T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) =
        2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) := by
    rw [prawitzVaalerMajorant_eq_pointKernel, prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
    congr 2
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    ring
  rw [show -2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) =
      -(2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) by ring, ← hscale]
  calc
    -prawitzVaalerMajorant (T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤
        -centeredHalfLineStep (T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
      neg_le_neg (centeredHalfLineStep_le_prawitzVaalerMajorant _)
    _ ≤ 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 := by
      by_cases hylt : y < x
      · have harg : T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi) < 0 := by
          exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos
            (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hT (sub_neg.mpr hylt)) (by positivity)
        simp [centeredHalfLineStep, hylt.le, harg]
        norm_num
      · by_cases hy : y = x
        · subst y
          simp [centeredHalfLineStep]
        · have hygt : x < y := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hylt) (Ne.symm hy)
          have harg : 0 < T * (y - x) / (2 * Real.pi) :=
            div_pos (mul_pos hT (sub_pos.mpr hygt)) (by positivity)
          simp [centeredHalfLineStep,
            not_le.mpr hygt, not_lt.mpr harg.le]

/-- Integrating the centered lower-ray indicator recovers twice the CDF
minus one. -/
theorem integral_centeredCDFKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ∂mu) =
      2 * cdf mu x - 1 := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      ((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) mu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  have hIntInd :
      (∫ y, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∂mu) =
        mu.real (Iic x) := integral_indicator_one measurableSet_Iic
  rw [integral_sub (hInd.const_mul 2) (integrable_const 1),
    integral_const_mul, hIntInd, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul,
    cdf_eq_real]

/-- The Prawitz point-kernel expectation is an upper envelope for the
centered CDF whenever that expectation is integrable. -/
theorem cdf_sub_half_le_integral_prawitzPointKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu) :
    cdf mu x - 1 / 2 ≤ ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  have hle :
      (∫ y, 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ y, 2 * prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu := by
    apply integral_mono hInd (hInt.const_mul 2)
    exact centeredCDFKernel_le_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel hT x
  rw [integral_centeredCDFKernel, integral_const_mul] at hle
  linarith

/-- Pointwise surplus in the upper Prawitz majorant.  Its expectation records
exactly how much the integrated envelope exceeds the centered CDF. -/
noncomputable def prawitzUpperSlack (T x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) -
    (2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1)

theorem prawitzUpperSlack_nonneg
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ prawitzUpperSlack T x y := by
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr
    (centeredCDFKernel_le_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel hT x y)

theorem integrable_prawitzUpperSlack
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu) :
    Integrable (prawitzUpperSlack T x) mu := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  exact (hInt.const_mul 2).sub hInd

/-- Half the expected upper slack is the exact gap between the Prawitz
expectation and the centered CDF. -/
theorem half_integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_envelope_gap
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu =
      (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) - (cdf mu x - 1 / 2) := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  unfold prawitzUpperSlack
  rw [integral_sub (hInt.const_mul 2) hInd,
    integral_const_mul, integral_centeredCDFKernel]
  ring

/-- Pointwise surplus in the reflected lower Prawitz majorant. -/
noncomputable def prawitzLowerSlack (T x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) +
    2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)

theorem prawitzLowerSlack_nonneg
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ prawitzLowerSlack T x y := by
  have h := neg_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel_le_centeredCDFKernel hT x y
  unfold prawitzLowerSlack
  linarith

theorem integrable_prawitzLowerSlack
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    Integrable (prawitzLowerSlack T x) mu := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  exact hInd.add (hInt.const_mul 2)

/-- Half the expected lower slack is the exact gap from the reflected Prawitz
envelope to the centered CDF. -/
theorem half_integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_envelope_gap
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu =
      (cdf mu x - 1 / 2) -
        (-(∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu)) := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  unfold prawitzLowerSlack
  rw [integral_add hInd (hInt.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
    integral_centeredCDFKernel]
  ring

/-- Exact two-law forward recentering: the CDF difference is the point-kernel
expectation difference corrected by half the upper-slack difference. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzUpperRecentered
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hmu : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hnu : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
      ((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          ((∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) -
            ∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂nu) := by
  have hmuGap := half_integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_envelope_gap mu x hmu
  have hnuGap := half_integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_envelope_gap nu x hnu
  linarith

/-- Exact two-law reflected recentering using the lower-slack correction. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzLowerRecentered
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hmu : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnu : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
      -((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          ((∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu) -
            ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂nu) := by
  have hmuGap := half_integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_envelope_gap mu x hmu
  have hnuGap := half_integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_envelope_gap nu x hnu
  linarith

/-- The one-sided Prawitz expectation bound is attained by a Dirac law at
its atom under the right-continuous CDF convention. -/
theorem cdf_dirac_sub_half_eq_integral_prawitzPointKernel
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf (Measure.dirac x) x - 1 / 2 =
      ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂Measure.dirac x := by
  rw [integral_dirac, prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
  simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, prawitzPointKernel_zero]
  rw [cdf_eq_real, Measure.real_def]
  simp
  norm_num

/-- No positive universal additive improvement of the integrated upper
Prawitz envelope can hold for arbitrary probability laws. -/
theorem not_cdf_dirac_sub_half_le_integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_pos
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) {delta : ℝ} (hdelta : 0 < delta) :
    ¬ cdf (Measure.dirac x) x - 1 / 2 ≤
      (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂Measure.dirac x) - delta := by
  rw [cdf_dirac_sub_half_eq_integral_prawitzPointKernel hT x]
  linarith

/-- The reflected Prawitz point-kernel expectation is a lower envelope for
the centered CDF, again without an atomlessness assumption. -/
theorem neg_integral_prawitzPointKernel_le_cdf_sub_half
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    -(∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) ≤ cdf mu x - 1 / 2 := by
  have hInd : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  have hle :
      (∫ y, -2 * prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) ≤
        ∫ y, 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ∂mu := by
    apply integral_mono (hInt.const_mul (-2)) hInd
    exact neg_two_mul_prawitzPointKernel_le_centeredCDFKernel hT x
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_centeredCDFKernel] at hle
  linarith

/-- Joint point-mass paired integrand used to exchange spatial expectation
with the finite-frequency Prawitz integral. -/
noncomputable def prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand
    (T x : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℂ :=
  symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
    (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac p.1)) x p.2

theorem measurable_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand (T x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x) := by
  have hphase : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      Complex.exp (((-(p.2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by fun_prop
  have hphaseNeg : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      Complex.exp (((-((-p.2) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by fun_prop
  have hfilter : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T p.2) :=
    (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T).comp measurable_snd
  have hfilterNeg : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T (-p.2)) :=
    (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T).comp
      (measurable_neg.comp measurable_snd)
  have hchar : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac p.1) p.2) := by
    simp_rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
    fun_prop
  have hcharNeg : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac p.1) (-p.2)) := by
    simp_rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
    fun_prop
  unfold prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
    prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  exact (((hphase.mul hfilter).mul hchar).div
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_snd)).add
    (((hphaseNeg.mul hfilterNeg).mul hcharNeg).div
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp
        (measurable_neg.comp measurable_snd)))

/-- The joint point-mass paired integrand has a first-moment majorant uniform
over the closed positive frequency window. -/
theorem norm_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand_le
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)‖ ≤
      2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T) := by
  rcases ht.1.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht0
  · simp [prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand,
      prawitzPVIntegrand]
    positivity
  have hDirac : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.dirac y) := by
    exact integrable_dirac (by simp)
  have hIm := abs_im_prawitzPVNumerator_charFun_le
    hDirac hT x (show t ∈ Ioc 0 T from ⟨ht0, ht.2⟩)
  simp only [integral_dirac] at hIm
  rw [prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand,
    norm_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x ht0.ne',
    abs_of_pos ht0]
  calc
    2 * |(prawitzPVNumerator T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t).im| / t ≤
        2 * ((7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T) * t) / t :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIm (by norm_num)) ht0.le
    _ = 2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T) := by field_simp

/-- A finite first absolute moment makes the point-mass Prawitz integrand
integrable on the spatial-frequency product space, licensing Fubini. -/
theorem integrable_prod_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x)
      (mu.prod (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) := by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x)
      (mu.prod (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) :=
    (measurable_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [integrable_prod_iff hmeas]
  constructor
  · exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
      have hDirac : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.dirac y) :=
        integrable_dirac (by simp)
      simpa only [prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand] using
        integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
          (Measure.dirac y) hDirac hT x
  · let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      T * (2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T))
    have hB : Integrable B mu := by
      have hAbs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => 14 * T * |y|) mu :=
        hmu1.const_mul (14 * T)
      have hConst : Integrable
          (fun _y : ℝ => 14 * T * |x| + 2 * Real.pi) mu :=
        integrable_const _
      apply (hAbs.add hConst).congr
      filter_upwards with y
      dsimp only [B]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      field_simp [hT.ne']
      ring
    apply hB.mono' hmeas.norm.integral_prod_right'
    filter_upwards with y
    have hSection : Integrable
        (fun t => prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t))
        (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := by
      have hDirac : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.dirac y) :=
        integrable_dirac (by simp)
      simpa only [prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand] using
        integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
          (Measure.dirac y) hDirac hT x
    have hConst : Integrable
        (fun _t : ℝ => 2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T))
        (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := integrable_const _
    have hle :
        (∫ t, ‖prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)‖
            ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) ≤
          ∫ _t, 2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T)
            ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hSection.norm hConst
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
      exact norm_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand_le hT x y ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)]
    calc
      (∫ t, ‖prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)‖
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) ≤
          ∫ _t, 2 * (7 * (|x| + |y|) + Real.pi / T)
            ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := hle
      _ = B y := by simp [B, hT.le]

/-- The translated forward Prawitz point kernel is integrable under every
probability law with a finite first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu := by
  have hProd := integrable_prod_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand mu hmu1 hT x
  have hInner : Integrable (fun y =>
      ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
        ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) mu :=
    hProd.integral_prod_left
  have hScaled : Integrable (fun y =>
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))).re) mu :=
    (hInner.const_mul _).re
  apply hScaled.congr
  filter_upwards with y
  have hDirac := prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_eq_pointKernel T x y
  apply_fun Complex.re at hDirac
  simpa only [prawitzInversion, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand,
    Complex.ofReal_re] using hDirac

/-- The reflected translated Prawitz point kernel has the same first-moment
integrability property. -/
theorem integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu := by
  let muNeg : Measure ℝ := Measure.map (fun y : ℝ => -y) mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure muNeg :=
    Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map measurable_neg.aemeasurable
  have hNeg1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) muNeg := by
    dsimp only [muNeg]
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) measurable_neg.aemeasurable]
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |-y|) mu
    simpa only [abs_neg] using hmu1
  have hForward : Integrable
      (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - (-x))) muNeg :=
    integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub muNeg hNeg1 hT (-x)
  have hComp := (integrable_map_measure hForward.aestronglyMeasurable
    measurable_neg.aemeasurable).mp hForward
  apply hComp.congr
  filter_upwards with y
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (prawitzPointKernel T) (by ring)

/-- For fixed frequency, the point-mass Prawitz integrand is integrable in
the spatial point under every finite measure. -/
theorem integrable_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (T x t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y => prawitzPVIntegrand T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t) mu := by
  let c : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t / (t : ℂ)
  have hExp : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      Complex.exp (((inner ℝ y t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) mu := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1
    exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have hEq : (fun y => prawitzPVIntegrand T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t) =
      fun y => c * Complex.exp (((inner ℝ y t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    funext y
    rw [prawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVNumerator,
      MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
    dsimp only [c]
    ring
  rw [hEq]
  exact hExp.const_mul c

/-- Averaging the fixed-frequency point-mass Prawitz integrand recovers the
Prawitz integrand of the averaged law. -/
theorem integral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (T x t : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t ∂mu) =
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t := by
  let c : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t / (t : ℂ)
  have hEq : (fun y => prawitzPVIntegrand T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t) =
      fun y => c * Complex.exp (((inner ℝ y t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    funext y
    rw [prawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVNumerator,
      MeasureTheory.charFun_dirac]
    dsimp only [c]
    ring
  rw [hEq]
  calc
    (∫ y, c * Complex.exp (((inner ℝ y t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        c * ∫ y, Complex.exp (((inner ℝ y t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu :=
      integral_const_mul c _
    _ = prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t := by
      rw [prawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVNumerator,
        MeasureTheory.charFun_apply]
      dsimp only [c]
      ring

/-- The same averaging identity holds for the paired Prawitz integrand. -/
theorem integral_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] (T x t : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t) ∂mu) =
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t := by
  change (∫ y,
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x t +
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x (-t)) ∂mu) =
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t +
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x (-t)
  rw [integral_add
      (integrable_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac mu T x t)
      (integrable_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac mu T x (-t)),
    integral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac,
    integral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_dirac]

/-- Fubini identifies the average point-mass Prawitz inversion with the
Prawitz inversion of the averaged probability law. -/
theorem integral_prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzInversion T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x ∂mu) =
      prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x := by
  have hProd := integrable_prod_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand mu hmu1 hT x
  have hSwap :
      (∫ y, ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) ∂mu) =
        ∫ t, ∫ y, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t) ∂mu
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) :=
    integral_integral_swap hProd
  unfold prawitzInversion
  change (∫ y, (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
        ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) ∂mu) =
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      ∫ t, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))
  calc
    (∫ y, (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) ∂mu) =
        (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          ∫ y, ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
            ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) ∂mu :=
      integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t, ∫ y, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t) ∂mu
          ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := by rw [hSwap]
    _ = (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := by
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun t => integral_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand mu T x t

/-- The forward Prawitz point-kernel expectation is the real part of the
Prawitz inversion of the law. -/
theorem integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) =
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x).re := by
  have hProd := integrable_prod_prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand mu hmu1 hT x
  have hInner : Integrable (fun y =>
      ∫ t, prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand T x (y, t)
        ∂(volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))) mu :=
    hProd.integral_prod_left
  have hInv : Integrable (fun y => prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x) mu := by
    unfold prawitzInversion
    simpa only [prawitzDiracPairedIntegrand] using hInner.const_mul
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
  calc
    (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) =
        ∫ y, (prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x).re ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _ fun y => by
        have hDirac := prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac_eq_pointKernel T x y
        apply_fun Complex.re at hDirac
        simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using hDirac.symm
    _ = (∫ y, prawitzInversion T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (Measure.dirac y)) x ∂mu).re :=
      integral_re hInv
    _ = (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x).re := by
      rw [integral_prawitzInversion_charFun_dirac mu hmu1 hT x]

/-- The exact signed Prawitz inversion is an upper envelope for the centered
CDF. -/
theorem cdf_sub_half_le_re_prawitzInversion
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x - 1 / 2 ≤
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x).re := by
  have h := cdf_sub_half_le_integral_prawitzPointKernel
    mu hT x (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
  rwa [integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
    mu hmu1 hT x] at h

/-- Exact one-sided signed smoothing inequality, before taking the norm of the
Prawitz inversion difference.  This retains cancellation with the reflected
Fejer remainder. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_re_prawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu := by
  have hMu := cdf_sub_half_le_re_prawitzInversion mu hmu1 hT x
  have hNu := neg_integral_prawitzPointKernel_le_cdf_sub_half
    nu hT x (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hNuForward := integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hNuReflected :=
    integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hForwardEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion nu hnu1 hT x
  have hSum :
      (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu) =
        (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu :=
    integral_add hNuForward hNuReflected
  rw [Complex.sub_re, hSum, hForwardEq]
  linarith

/-- One-sided signed smoothing inequality: the CDF discrepancy is bounded by
the finite-frequency Prawitz discrepancy plus the reflected Fejér remainder
of the comparison law. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_norm_prawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu := by
  have hMu := cdf_sub_half_le_re_prawitzInversion mu hmu1 hT x
  have hNu := neg_integral_prawitzPointKernel_le_cdf_sub_half
    nu hT x (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hNuForward := integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hNuReflected :=
    integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hForwardEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion nu hnu1 hT x
  have hSum :
      (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu) =
        (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu :=
    integral_add hNuForward hNuReflected
  have hRe :
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ :=
    Complex.re_le_norm _
  rw [Complex.sub_re] at hRe
  rw [hSum, hForwardEq]
  linarith

/-- Absolute integrability of the paired integrand is exactly the analytic
input needed to remove the symmetric truncation in Prawitz inversion. -/
theorem tendsto_truncatedPrawitzInversion_of_integrableOn
    {T : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ} {x : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hInt : IntegrableOn (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x) (Icc 0 T)) :
    Tendsto (fun epsilon => truncatedPrawitzInversion T epsilon f x)
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds (prawitzInversion T f x)) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x
  have hMeasure :
      Tendsto (fun epsilon : ℝ => volume (Ico 0 epsilon))
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
    simp_rw [Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    have hId : Tendsto (fun epsilon : ℝ => epsilon)
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hId
  have hSmall :
      Tendsto (fun epsilon : ℝ =>
          ∫ t in Ico 0 epsilon, (Icc 0 T).indicator g t)
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) :=
    Integrable.tendsto_setIntegral_nhds_zero
      (hInt.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc) hMeasure
  have hIntegral :
      Tendsto (fun epsilon : ℝ => ∫ t in Icc epsilon T, g t)
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds (∫ t in Icc 0 T, g t)) := by
    have hSub : Tendsto (fun epsilon : ℝ =>
          (∫ t in Icc 0 T, g t) -
            ∫ t in Ico 0 epsilon, (Icc 0 T).indicator g t)
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0)) (nhds (∫ t in Icc 0 T, g t)) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hSmall
    refine hSub.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin,
        (eventually_le_nhds hT).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with
      epsilon hepsilon hepsilonT
    have hsub : Ico 0 epsilon ⊆ Icc 0 T := by
      intro t ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le.trans hepsilonT⟩
    have hdiff : Icc 0 T \ Ico 0 epsilon = Icc epsilon T := by
      ext t
      simp only [mem_diff, mem_Icc, mem_Ico]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨ht0, htT⟩, ht⟩
        exact ⟨le_of_not_gt fun hte => ht ⟨ht0, hte⟩, htT⟩
      · rintro ⟨hte, htT⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hepsilon.le.trans hte, htT⟩,
          fun ht => (ht.2.trans_le hte).false⟩
    rw [← hdiff, integral_diff measurableSet_Ico hInt hsub]
    rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc,
      inter_eq_left.mpr hsub]
  simpa only [truncatedPrawitzInversion, prawitzInversion, g] using
    hIntegral.const_mul (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))

/-- For every probability law with a finite first absolute moment, the
symmetrically truncated Prawitz functional converges to its full paired
inversion integral as the truncation is removed. -/
theorem tendsto_truncatedPrawitzInversion_charFun
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun epsilon =>
        truncatedPrawitzInversion T epsilon (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x)
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Ioi 0))
      (nhds (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x)) :=
  tendsto_truncatedPrawitzInversion_of_integrableOn hT
    (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun mu hmu1 hT x)

/-- At a positive frequency, the difference of two paired Prawitz integrands
is controlled by twice the corresponding positive-frequency difference. -/
theorem norm_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_le
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t‖ ≤
      2 * ‖prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t‖ := by
  let z : ℂ := prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t
  have hmuNeg := prawitzPVIntegrand_neg (T := T)
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun mu) x ht.ne'
  have hnuNeg := prawitzPVIntegrand_neg (T := T)
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun nu) x ht.ne'
  have hEq :
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t =
        z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z := by
    rw [symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand,
      hmuNeg, hnuNeg]
    dsimp only [z]
    simp only [map_sub]
    ring
  rw [hEq]
  calc
    ‖z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖(starRingEnd ℂ) z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = 2 * ‖z‖ := by rw [Complex.norm_conj]; ring

/-- The positive-frequency Prawitz integrand difference is exactly the filter
norm times the characteristic-function discrepancy quotient. -/
theorem norm_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t‖ =
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  have hEq :
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t =
        Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
              (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t) /
                (t : ℂ) := by
    unfold prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
    ring
  rw [hEq, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul,
    Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient, if_neg ht]
  ring

/-- The scaled Prawitz filter retains the uniform unit-window bound throughout
its closed positive frequency window. -/
theorem norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ ≤ 7 := by
  rcases ht.2.eq_or_lt with htEq | htT
  · subst t
    simp [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter, hT.ne', prawitzSmoothingFilter]
  · apply norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven
    · exact div_nonneg ht.1 hT.le
    · exact (div_lt_one hT).2 htT

/-- The filter-weighted characteristic-function discrepancy is integrable on
every positive Prawitz frequency window. -/
theorem integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) (Icc 0 T) := by
  have hq : IntegrableOn (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu) (Icc 0 T) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hT.le).mp
      (intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient hmu1 hnu1 0 T)
  apply hq.bdd_mul (c := 7)
  · exact (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T).norm.aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using
      norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hT ht

/-- After subtracting two characteristic functions, the positive-frequency
Prawitz integrand has a genuinely removable singularity and is integrable on
the whole closed smoothing window.  This phase-sensitive form is the input
needed to apply Riemann--Lebesgue before taking norms. -/
theorem integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t =>
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t) (Icc 0 T) := by
  let d : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t
  have hq : IntegrableOn q (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [q] using
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
  have hd : AEStronglyMeasurable d (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)) := by
    dsimp only [d]
    exact ((measurable_prawitzPVIntegrand
      MeasureTheory.measurable_charFun x).sub
        (measurable_prawitzPVIntegrand
          MeasureTheory.measurable_charFun x)).aestronglyMeasurable
  apply hq.mono' hd
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
  rcases ht.1.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht0
  · simp [d, q, prawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVNumerator,
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
  · simpa only [d, q] using
      (norm_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq
        (T := T) mu nu ht0.ne' x).le

/-- The entire spatial dependence of a positive-frequency Prawitz
characteristic-function difference is its unit complex exponential phase. -/
theorem prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T x t : ℝ) :
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t =
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) 0 t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) 0 t) := by
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
    Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
  ring

/-- The phase-preserving positive-frequency Prawitz difference is continuous
in the spatial parameter. -/
theorem continuous_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t)) := by
  let a : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) 0 t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) 0 t
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) T).indicator a
  have ha : IntegrableOn a (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [a] using
      integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT 0
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    simpa only [f] using ha.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hFourier := continuous_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul f hf
  convert hFourier using 1
  funext x
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, f, a]
    exact prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero
      mu nu T x t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, f, mul_zero]

/-- The phase-preserving positive-frequency Prawitz difference vanishes in
the positive spatial tail before taking any complex norm. -/
theorem tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atTop
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let a : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) 0 t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) 0 t
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) T).indicator a
  have ha : IntegrableOn a (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [a] using
      integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT 0
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    simpa only [f] using ha.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hrl := tendsto_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul_atTop f
  convert hrl using 1
  funext x
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, f, a]
    exact prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero
      mu nu T x t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, f, mul_zero]

/-- The phase-preserving positive-frequency Prawitz difference also vanishes
in the negative spatial tail before taking any complex norm. -/
theorem tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atBot
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t))
      atBot (𝓝 0) := by
  let a : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) 0 t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) 0 t
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) T).indicator a
  have ha : IntegrableOn a (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [a] using
      integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT 0
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    simpa only [f] using ha.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hrl := tendsto_integral_cexp_neg_mul_I_mul_atBot f
  convert hrl using 1
  funext x
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, f, a]
    exact prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero
      mu nu T x t
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, f, mul_zero]

/-- The structural uniform filter bound reduces the weighted positive-window
discrepancy integral to its unweighted counterpart. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_le_const
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu
  let C : ℝ := 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32
  have hq : IntegrableOn q (Icc 0 T) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hT.le).mp
      (intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient hmu1 hnu1 0 T)
  have hweighted : IntegrableOn
      (fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [q] using
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤
    C * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply setIntegral_mono_on hweighted (hq.const_mul C) measurableSet_Icc
  intro s hs
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q s := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg mu nu s
  rcases hs.2.eq_or_lt with hsT | hsT
  · subst s
    rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_eq_zero_of_abs_ge hT
        (by rw [abs_of_pos hT])]
    simp only [norm_zero, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg hC hq0
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
        hT hs.1 hsT) hq0

/-- Uniform filter reduction on an initial subwindow of a possibly larger
Prawitz smoothing band. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_local_le_const
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 ≤ T₀) (hT : 0 < T) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu
  let C : ℝ := 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32
  have hq : IntegrableOn q (Icc 0 T₀) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hT₀).mp
      (intervalIntegrable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient hmu1 hnu1 0 T₀)
  have hweighted : IntegrableOn
      (fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) (Icc 0 T₀) := by
    have hfull :=
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
    exact hfull.mono_set (Icc_subset_Icc_right hT₀T)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤
    C * ∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply setIntegral_mono_on hweighted (hq.const_mul C) measurableSet_Icc
  intro t ht
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q t := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg mu nu t
  by_cases htEq : t = T
  · subst t
    rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_eq_zero_of_abs_ge hT
        (by rw [abs_of_pos hT])]
    simp only [norm_zero, zero_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg hC hq0
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
        hT ht.1 (lt_of_le_of_ne (ht.2.trans hT₀T) htEq)) hq0

/-- Exact decomposition of a filter-weighted discrepancy integral at an
arbitrary positive inner cutoff. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_split
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) =
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) +
      ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t
  have hf : IntegrableOn f (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [f] using
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
  have hf₀ : IntegrableOn f (Icc 0 T₀) :=
    hf.mono_set (Icc_subset_Icc_right hT₀T)
  have hftail : IntegrableOn f (Ioc T₀ T) := by
    apply hf.mono_set
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hT₀.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hunion : Icc (0 : ℝ) T₀ ∪ Ioc T₀ T = Icc 0 T := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Icc, mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hT₀T⟩
      · exact ⟨hT₀.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
    · intro ht
      by_cases h : t ≤ T₀
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ht.1, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, ht.2⟩
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (Icc (0 : ℝ) T₀) (Ioc T₀ T) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro t ht₀ htTail
    exact (not_lt_of_ge ht₀.2) htTail.1
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T, f t) =
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, f t) + ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, f t
  rw [← hunion, setIntegral_union hdisjoint measurableSet_Ioc hf₀ hftail]

/-- Two-cutoff Prawitz decomposition.  Frequencies up to `T₀` retain the
exact discrepancy, while the larger smoothing band uses only the universal
`2 / |t|` characteristic-function bound. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_le_twoCutoff
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) ≤
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) +
      ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|) := by
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
    (2 / |t|)
  have hf : IntegrableOn f (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [f] using
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
  have hf₀ : IntegrableOn f (Icc 0 T₀) :=
    hf.mono_set (Icc_subset_Icc_right hT₀T)
  have hftail : IntegrableOn f (Ioc T₀ T) := by
    apply hf.mono_set
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hT₀.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hgStrong : StronglyMeasurable g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact ((measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T).norm.mul
      (measurable_const.div measurable_abs)).stronglyMeasurable
  have hgTail : IntegrableOn g (Ioc T₀ T) := by
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => 14 / T₀) (Ioc T₀ T) :=
      integrableOn_const measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
    apply Integrable.mono' hconst hgStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by
      dsimp only [g]
      positivity : 0 ≤ g t)]
    have ht0 : 0 < t := hT₀.trans ht.1
    have hfilter : ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ ≤ 7 :=
      norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hT
        ⟨ht0.le, ht.2⟩
    have hdiv : 2 / |t| ≤ 2 / T₀ := by
      rw [abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hT₀ ht.1.le
    dsimp only [g]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 2 / |t| := by positivity
    calc
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|) ≤
          7 * (2 / |t|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfilter hnonneg
      _ ≤ 7 * (2 / T₀) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num)
      _ = 14 / T₀ := by ring
  have hunion : Icc (0 : ℝ) T₀ ∪ Ioc T₀ T = Icc 0 T := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_union, mem_Icc, mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hT₀T⟩
      · exact ⟨hT₀.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
    · intro ht
      by_cases h : t ≤ T₀
      · exact Or.inl ⟨ht.1, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, ht.2⟩
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (Icc (0 : ℝ) T₀) (Ioc T₀ T) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro t ht₀ htTail
    exact (not_lt_of_ge ht₀.2) htTail.1
  have hsplit : (∫ t in Icc 0 T, f t) =
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, f t) + ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, f t := by
    rw [← hunion, setIntegral_union hdisjoint measurableSet_Ioc hf₀ hftail]
  have htail : (∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, f t) ≤ ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, g t := by
    apply integral_mono hftail hgTail
    intro t
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_le_two_div_abs mu nu t) (norm_nonneg _)
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T, f t) ≤
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, f t) + ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T, g t
  rw [hsplit]
  simpa only [add_comm] using
    add_le_add_left htail (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, f t)

/-- Scaling the outer Prawitz band to the unit interval removes the smoothing
bandwidth from its universal discrepancy majorant. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_eq_unit
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)) =
      ∫ u in Ioc (T₀ / T) 1,
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ * (2 / |u|) := by
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  have hratio : T₀ / T ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hT).2 hT₀T
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT₀T,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hratio]
  have hchange := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_left
    (f := f) (a := T₀ / T) (b := 1) T
  calc
    (∫ t in T₀..T, f t) = T * ∫ u in T₀ / T..1, f (T * u) := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_div_cancel₀ T₀ hT.ne'] using
        hchange.symm
    _ = ∫ u in T₀ / T..1,
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ * (2 / |u|) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro u _
      by_cases hu : u = 0
      · subst u
        simp [f, scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter]
      · dsimp only [f, scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter]
        rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ u hT.ne', abs_mul, abs_of_pos hT]
        field_simp

/-- Optimization-ready form of the scaled outer-band identity, with its
universal characteristic-function factor pulled outside the unit integral. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_eq_two_mul
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)) =
      2 * ∫ u in Ioc (T₀ / T) 1,
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u := by
  rw [integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_eq_unit
    hT₀ hT₀T, ← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with u hu
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  have hu0 : 0 < u := (div_pos hT₀ hT).trans hu.1
  rw [abs_of_pos hu0]
  ring

/-- A closed logarithmic upper bound for the dimensionless Prawitz tail. -/
theorem integral_norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_div_le_log
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (∫ u in Ioc a 1, ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * Real.log (1 / a) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u
  let C : ℝ := 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => C * (1 / u)
  have hgStrong : StronglyMeasurable g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact (measurable_prawitzSmoothingFilter.norm.div
      measurable_id).stronglyMeasurable
  have hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioc a 1) := by
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => 7 / a) (Ioc a 1) :=
      integrableOn_const measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
    apply Integrable.mono' hconst hgStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := ha.trans hu.1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by
      dsimp only [g]
      positivity : 0 ≤ g u)]
    have hnorm : ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤ 7 := by
      rcases hu.2.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu1
      · simp [prawitzSmoothingFilter]
      · exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hu0.le hu1
    have hdiv : 1 / u ≤ 1 / a := by
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le ha hu.1.le
    dsimp only [g]
    calc
      ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u ≤ 7 / u :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hu0).2 hnorm
      _ ≤ 7 / a := by
        exact (div_le_div_iff₀ hu0 ha).2 (by nlinarith [hu.1])
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Ioc a 1) := by
    have hinv : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 1 / u) volume a 1 :=
      intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_one_div
        (f := fun u : ℝ => u)
        (fun u hu => by
          rw [uIcc_of_le ha1] at hu
          exact ne_of_gt (ha.trans_le hu.1)) continuousOn_id
    have hIcc := (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le ha1).mp
      (hinv.const_mul C)
    simpa only [G] using hIcc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hpoint : ∀ u ∈ Ioc a 1, g u ≤ G u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := ha.trans hu.1
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
    have hnorm : ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤ C := by
      rcases hu.2.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu1
      · dsimp only [C]
        simp [prawitzSmoothingFilter]
        positivity
      · dsimp only [C]
        exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_one_add_pi_sq_div_thirtytwo
          hu0.le hu1
    dsimp only [g, G]
    calc
      ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u ≤ C / u :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hu0).2 hnorm
      _ = C * (1 / u) := by ring
  change (∫ u in Ioc a 1, g u) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ u in Ioc a 1, g u) ≤ ∫ u in Ioc a 1, G u := by
      exact setIntegral_mono_on hg hG measurableSet_Ioc hpoint
    _ = C * Real.log (1 / a) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ha1]
      dsimp only [G]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        integral_one_div_of_pos ha zero_lt_one]
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Endpoint-sensitive unit-tail bound.  Unlike the uniform logarithmic
estimate, this majorant is quadratic as `a` tends to one. -/
theorem integral_norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_div_le_endpoint
    {a : ℝ} (haHalf : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (∫ u in Ioc a 1, ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u) ≤
      (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) *
        (Real.log (1 / a) - (1 - a)) := by
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) haHalf
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u
  let K : ℝ := Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => K * ((1 - u) / u)
  have hgStrong : StronglyMeasurable g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact (measurable_prawitzSmoothingFilter.norm.div
      measurable_id).stronglyMeasurable
  have hg : IntegrableOn g (Ioc a 1) := by
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => 7 / a) (Ioc a 1) :=
      integrableOn_const measure_Ioc_lt_top.ne
    apply Integrable.mono' hconst hgStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := ha.trans hu.1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by
      dsimp only [g]
      positivity : 0 ≤ g u)]
    have hnorm : ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ ≤ 7 := by
      rcases hu.2.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu1
      · simp [prawitzSmoothingFilter]
      · exact norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hu0.le hu1
    dsimp only [g]
    calc
      ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u ≤ 7 / u :=
        (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hu0).2 hnorm
      _ ≤ 7 / a := (div_le_div_iff₀ hu0 ha).2 (by nlinarith [hu.1])
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Ioc a 1) := by
    have hden : ∀ u ∈ Icc a 1, u ≠ 0 := fun u hu =>
      ne_of_gt (ha.trans_le hu.1)
    have hratio : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => (1 - u) / u) (Icc a 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id).div continuousOn_id hden
    have hcont : ContinuousOn G (Icc a 1) := by
      dsimp only [G]
      exact continuousOn_const.mul hratio
    exact hcont.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  have hpoint : ∀ u ∈ Ioc a 1, g u ≤ G u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := ha.trans hu.1
    rcases hu.2.eq_or_lt with rfl | hu1
    · simp [g, G, prawitzSmoothingFilter]
    · have hnorm := norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_le_endpoint_linear
        (haHalf.trans hu.1.le) hu1
      dsimp only [g, G, K]
      calc
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u ≤
            ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) * (1 - u)) / u :=
          (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hu0).2 hnorm
        _ = (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) * ((1 - u) / u) := by ring
  change (∫ u in Ioc a 1, g u) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ u in Ioc a 1, g u) ≤ ∫ u in Ioc a 1, G u := by
      exact setIntegral_mono_on hg hG measurableSet_Ioc hpoint
    _ = K * (Real.log (1 / a) - (1 - a)) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ha1]
      have hinv : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 1 / u) volume a 1 :=
        intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_one_div
          (f := fun u : ℝ => u)
          (fun u hu => by
            rw [uIcc_of_le ha1] at hu
            exact ne_of_gt (ha.trans_le hu.1)) continuousOn_id
      dsimp only [G]
      have hcongr : (∫ u in a..1, K * ((1 - u) / u)) =
          ∫ u in a..1, K * (1 / u - 1) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro u hu
        rw [uIcc_of_le ha1] at hu
        have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (ha.trans_le hu.1)
        field_simp
      rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hinv intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const,
        integral_one_div_of_pos ha zero_lt_one,
        integral_one]
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Closed logarithmic bound for the universal outer band in the original
frequency scale. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_le_log
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)) ≤
      2 * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * Real.log (T / T₀) := by
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  have ha : 0 < T₀ / T := div_pos hT₀ hT
  have ha1 : T₀ / T ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hT).2 hT₀T
  rw [integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_eq_two_mul
    hT₀ hT₀T]
  calc
    2 * (∫ u in Ioc (T₀ / T) 1,
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u) ≤
        2 * ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * Real.log (1 / (T₀ / T))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (integral_norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_div_le_log ha ha1) (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * Real.log (T / T₀) := by
      have harg : 1 / (T₀ / T) = T / T₀ := by
        field_simp
      rw [harg]
      ring

/-- Endpoint-sensitive scaled outer-band estimate, valid while the smoothing
bandwidth is at most twice the Taylor cutoff. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_le_endpoint
    {T₀ T : ℝ} (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T) (hTT₀ : T ≤ 2 * T₀) :
    (∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)) ≤
      2 * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) *
        (Real.log (T / T₀) - (1 - T₀ / T)) := by
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  have haHalf : 1 / 2 ≤ T₀ / T := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hT]
    nlinarith
  have ha1 : T₀ / T ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hT).2 hT₀T
  rw [integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_eq_two_mul
    hT₀ hT₀T]
  calc
    2 * (∫ u in Ioc (T₀ / T) 1,
        ‖prawitzSmoothingFilter u‖ / u) ≤
        2 * ((Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) *
          (Real.log (1 / (T₀ / T)) - (1 - T₀ / T))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (integral_norm_prawitzSmoothingFilter_div_le_endpoint haHalf ha1)
        (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) *
        (Real.log (T / T₀) - (1 - T₀ / T)) := by
      have harg : 1 / (T₀ / T) = T / T₀ := by field_simp
      rw [harg]
      ring

/-- Exact signed integral representation of the real part of a Prawitz
inversion difference. -/
theorem re_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re =
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t)).re := by
  have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    mu hmu1 hT x
  have hnu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    nu hnu1 hT x
  rw [prawitzInversion, prawitzInversion, ← mul_sub,
    ← integral_sub hmu hnu]

/-- The difference of two full Prawitz inversion functionals is bounded by
the integral norm of their paired-frequency discrepancy. -/
theorem norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_symmetricIntegral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ ≤
      ‖Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)‖ *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          ‖symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t‖ := by
  have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    mu hmu1 hT x
  have hnu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    nu hnu1 hT x
  rw [prawitzInversion, prawitzInversion, ← mul_sub,
    ← integral_sub hmu hnu, norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) (norm_nonneg _)

/-- Direct comparison of two Prawitz inversion functionals by their weighted
positive-frequency characteristic-function discrepancy. -/
theorem norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  let d : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t
  have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    mu hmu1 hT x
  have hnu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    nu hnu1 hT x
  have hd : IntegrableOn d (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [d] using hmu.sub hnu
  have hq : IntegrableOn q (Icc 0 T) := by
    simpa only [q] using
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT
  have hpoint : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ‖d t‖ ≤ 2 * q t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases ht.1.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht0
    · simp [d, q, symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand, prawitzPVIntegrand,
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient]
    · calc
        ‖d t‖ ≤ 2 *
            ‖prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
              prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t‖ := by
          simpa only [d] using
            norm_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_le mu nu ht0 x
        _ = 2 * q t := by
          rw [norm_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq mu nu ht0.ne' x]
  have hIntegral :
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖d t‖) ≤ 2 * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t := by
    calc
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖d t‖) ≤
          ∫ t in Icc 0 T, 2 * q t := by
        apply integral_mono_ae hd.norm (hq.const_mul 2)
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
        exact hpoint t ht
      _ = 2 * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t := integral_const_mul 2 q
  calc
    ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ ≤
        ‖Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)‖ * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, ‖d t‖ := by
      simpa only [d] using
        norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_symmetricIntegral
          mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
    _ ≤ ‖Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)‖ *
          (2 * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIntegral (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = (1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t := by
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)]
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    _ = (1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
            charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := rfl

/-- The unnormalized spatial density of the concrete Esseen smoothing
kernel.  The fourth power gives a finite first moment while retaining compact
Fourier support. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthWeight (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sinc x ^ 4

theorem sincFourthWeight_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ sincFourthWeight x := by
  unfold sincFourthWeight
  positivity

theorem continuous_sincFourthWeight : Continuous sincFourthWeight := by
  exact Real.continuous_sinc.pow 4

/-- The sinc-fourth kernel density is integrable. -/
theorem integrable_sincFourthWeight : Integrable sincFourthWeight := by
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul 2
  apply hmajor.mono' continuous_sincFourthWeight.aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sincFourthWeight_nonneg x)]
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ 1
    · have hs : |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ 1 := by
        exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sinc_le_one x)
      have hxSq : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      unfold sincFourthWeight
      rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 4 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 by
        rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
      calc
        |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ 1 := hs
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hden]
          linarith
    · have hxLarge : 1 < |x| := lt_of_not_ge hx
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst x
        norm_num at hxLarge
      have hsinc := abs_sinc_le_inv_abs hx0
      have hsPow : |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ |x|⁻¹ ^ 4 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hsinc 4
      have hxPow : 0 < |x| ^ 4 := pow_pos (abs_pos.mpr hx0) 4
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hfrac : (|x| ^ 4)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        have hxSq : 1 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
          rw [← sq_abs]
          nlinarith
        have hmul : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 - 1) :=
          mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (sub_nonneg.mpr hxSq)
        calc
          (|x| ^ 4)⁻¹ = 1 / (|x| ^ 4) := by rw [one_div]
          _ ≤ 2 / (1 + x ^ 2) := by
            rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hxPow hden]
            rw [show |x| ^ 4 = (x ^ 2) ^ 2 by
              calc
                |x| ^ 4 = (|x| ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
                _ = (x ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]]
            nlinarith
          _ = 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      unfold sincFourthWeight
      rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 4 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 by
        rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
      calc
        |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ |x|⁻¹ ^ 4 := hsPow
        _ = (|x| ^ 4)⁻¹ := by rw [inv_pow]
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := hfrac

/-- The sinc-fourth kernel has a finite first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_abs_mul_sincFourthWeight :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| * sincFourthWeight x) := by
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul 2
  apply hmajor.mono' (continuous_abs.mul continuous_sincFourthWeight).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    change ‖|x| * sincFourthWeight x‖ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) (sincFourthWeight_nonneg x))]
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ 1
    · have hs : sincFourthWeight x ≤ 1 := by
        unfold sincFourthWeight
        rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 4 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 by
          rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
        exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sinc_le_one x)
      have hprod : |x| * sincFourthWeight x ≤ 1 := by
        nlinarith [sincFourthWeight_nonneg x, abs_nonneg x]
      have hxSq : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      calc
        |x| * sincFourthWeight x ≤ 1 := hprod
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hden]
          linarith
    · have hxLarge : 1 < |x| := lt_of_not_ge hx
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst x
        norm_num at hxLarge
      have hsinc := abs_sinc_le_inv_abs hx0
      have hsPow : |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ |x|⁻¹ ^ 4 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hsinc 4
      have hxPow : 0 < |x| ^ 3 := pow_pos (abs_pos.mpr hx0) 3
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hfrac : (|x| ^ 3)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        have hxSq : 1 ≤ |x| ^ 2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
        have hmul : 0 ≤ |x| ^ 2 * (|x| - 1) :=
          mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg |x|) (sub_nonneg.mpr hxLarge.le)
        have habsSq : |x| ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := sq_abs x
        calc
          (|x| ^ 3)⁻¹ = 1 / (|x| ^ 3) := by rw [one_div]
          _ ≤ 2 / (1 + x ^ 2) := by
            rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hxPow hden]
            nlinarith [hmul]
          _ = 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      unfold sincFourthWeight
