      rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 4 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 by
        rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
      calc
        |x| * |Real.sinc x| ^ 4 ≤ |x| * |x|⁻¹ ^ 4 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsPow (abs_nonneg x)
        _ = (|x| ^ 3)⁻¹ := by field_simp [abs_ne_zero.mpr hx0]
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := hfrac

/-- Total mass of the unnormalized sinc-fourth density. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthMass : ℝ := ∫ x : ℝ, sincFourthWeight x

theorem sincFourthMass_pos : 0 < sincFourthMass := by
  unfold sincFourthMass
  exact integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero
    continuous_sincFourthWeight integrable_sincFourthWeight
    sincFourthWeight_nonneg (x := 0) (by norm_num [sincFourthWeight])

/-- The finite measure with density `sincFourthWeight` before normalization. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthBaseMeasure : Measure ℝ :=
  volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (sincFourthWeight x))

theorem sincFourthBaseMeasure_univ :
    sincFourthBaseMeasure Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal sincFourthMass := by
  rw [sincFourthBaseMeasure, withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,
    Measure.restrict_univ, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
      integrable_sincFourthWeight
      (ae_of_all volume sincFourthWeight_nonneg)]
  rfl

/-- The normalized sinc-fourth probability kernel at its base spatial scale. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthKernel : Measure ℝ :=
  (sincFourthBaseMeasure Set.univ)⁻¹ • sincFourthBaseMeasure

theorem sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure :
    IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel := by
  constructor
  rw [sincFourthKernel, Measure.smul_apply, sincFourthBaseMeasure_univ,
    smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel]
  · exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr sincFourthMass_pos).ne'
  · exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

theorem sincFourthBaseMeasure_absolutelyContinuous :
    sincFourthBaseMeasure ≪ volume := by
  exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous volume _

theorem sincFourthKernel_absolutelyContinuous :
    sincFourthKernel ≪ volume := by
  unfold sincFourthKernel
  exact Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous.trans
    sincFourthBaseMeasure_absolutelyContinuous

theorem integrable_abs_sincFourthBaseMeasure :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) sincFourthBaseMeasure := by
  rw [sincFourthBaseMeasure,
    integrable_withDensity_iff
      (continuous_sincFourthWeight.measurable.ennreal_ofReal)
      (ae_of_all volume fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sincFourthWeight_nonneg _),
    smul_eq_mul] using integrable_abs_mul_sincFourthWeight

theorem integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) sincFourthKernel := by
  unfold sincFourthKernel
  apply integrable_abs_sincFourthBaseMeasure.smul_measure
  rw [ENNReal.inv_ne_top]
  simpa only [sincFourthBaseMeasure_univ] using
    (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr sincFourthMass_pos).ne'

/-- First absolute moment of the normalized sinc-fourth kernel. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthFirstMoment : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ∂sincFourthKernel

theorem sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg : 0 ≤ sincFourthFirstMoment := by
  unfold sincFourthFirstMoment
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => abs_nonneg _

/-- A fixed spatial radius for which each sinc-fourth tail has mass strictly
less than one quarter. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthTailRadius : ℝ :=
  4 * sincFourthFirstMoment + 1

theorem sincFourthTailRadius_pos : 0 < sincFourthTailRadius := by
  unfold sincFourthTailRadius
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg) zero_lt_one

theorem sincFourthKernel_rightTail_lt_quarter :
    sincFourthKernel.real (Ioi sincFourthTailRadius) < 1 / 4 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  let M : ℝ := sincFourthFirstMoment
  let a : ℝ := sincFourthTailRadius
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  have ha : 0 < a := sincFourthTailRadius_pos
  have hMarkov :
      a * sincFourthKernel.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, sincFourthFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all sincFourthKernel fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel a
  have hratio : M / a < 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ ha]
    dsimp only [a, sincFourthTailRadius, M]
    nlinarith
  have hradial : sincFourthKernel.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
  have hsubset : Ioi a ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.le.trans (le_abs_self x)
  exact (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans_lt (hradial.trans_lt hratio)

theorem sincFourthKernel_leftTail_lt_quarter :
    sincFourthKernel.real (Iio (-sincFourthTailRadius)) < 1 / 4 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  let M : ℝ := sincFourthFirstMoment
  let a : ℝ := sincFourthTailRadius
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  have ha : 0 < a := sincFourthTailRadius_pos
  have hMarkov :
      a * sincFourthKernel.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M := by
    simpa only [M, a, sincFourthFirstMoment] using
      mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (ae_of_all sincFourthKernel fun x => abs_nonneg x)
        integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel a
  have hratio : M / a < 1 / 4 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ ha]
    dsimp only [a, sincFourthTailRadius, M]
    nlinarith
  have hradial : sincFourthKernel.real {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} ≤ M / a := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hMarkov
  have hsubset : Iio (-a) ⊆ {x : ℝ | a ≤ |x|} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x < -a := hx
    have hxneg : x < 0 := hx.trans_le (neg_nonpos.mpr ha.le)
    change a ≤ |x|
    rw [abs_of_neg hxneg]
    linarith [hx']
  exact (measureReal_mono hsubset).trans_lt (hradial.trans_lt hratio)

/-- Common upper bound for the two shifted first moments used in tail
absorption. -/
noncomputable def sincFourthShiftedMomentBound : ℝ :=
  sincFourthTailRadius + sincFourthFirstMoment

theorem sincFourthKernel_rightShiftedMoment_le :
    (∫ y, |sincFourthTailRadius - y| ∂sincFourthKernel) ≤
      sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      sincFourthTailRadius + |y|) sincFourthKernel :=
    (integrable_const sincFourthTailRadius).add integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel
  calc
    (∫ y, |sincFourthTailRadius - y| ∂sincFourthKernel) ≤
        ∫ y, (sincFourthTailRadius + |y|) ∂sincFourthKernel := by
      apply integral_mono
        ((integrable_const sincFourthTailRadius).sub
          (integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel.mono' (by fun_prop)
            (ae_of_all sincFourthKernel fun y => by
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]))).norm hInt
      intro y
      exact (abs_sub _ _).trans_eq <| by
        rw [abs_of_pos sincFourthTailRadius_pos]
    _ = sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel,
        sincFourthShiftedMomentBound, sincFourthFirstMoment]

theorem sincFourthKernel_leftShiftedMoment_le :
    (∫ y, |-sincFourthTailRadius - y| ∂sincFourthKernel) ≤
      sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hLeftInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      |-sincFourthTailRadius - y|) sincFourthKernel :=
    ((integrable_const (-sincFourthTailRadius)).sub
      (integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel.mono' (by fun_prop)
        (ae_of_all sincFourthKernel fun y => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]))).norm
  have hRightInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      sincFourthTailRadius + |y|) sincFourthKernel :=
    (integrable_const sincFourthTailRadius).add integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel
  calc
    (∫ y, |-sincFourthTailRadius - y| ∂sincFourthKernel) ≤
        ∫ y, (sincFourthTailRadius + |y|) ∂sincFourthKernel := by
      apply integral_mono hLeftInt hRightInt
      intro y
      calc
        |-sincFourthTailRadius - y| ≤
            |-sincFourthTailRadius| + |y| := abs_sub _ _
        _ = sincFourthTailRadius + |y| := by
          rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos sincFourthTailRadius_pos]
    _ = sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
      simp [integral_add (integrable_const _) integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel,
        sincFourthShiftedMomentBound, sincFourthFirstMoment]

/-- Convolution adds deterministic spatial support radii. -/
theorem isSupportedInSmoothingWindow_conv
    {κ η : Measure ℝ} {δ ε : ℝ} [SFinite η]
    (hκ : IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow κ δ)
    (hη : IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow η ε) :
    IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow (κ ∗ η) (δ + ε) := by
  unfold IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow at hκ hη ⊢
  unfold Measure.conv
  apply (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Icc).2
  refine (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae
    (measurableSet_Icc.preimage (by fun_prop :
      Measurable fun z : ℝ × ℝ => z.1 + z.2))).2 ?_
  filter_upwards [hκ] with x hx
  filter_upwards [hη] with y hy
  constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2]

/-- The sum of four independent uniform laws on `[-1,1]`. Its characteristic
function is the sinc-fourth spatial weight, while its spatial support supplies
the dual compact-frequency window for the Esseen kernel. -/
noncomputable def fourfoldUniformKernel : Measure ℝ :=
  let υ := uniformSmoothingKernel 1
  ((υ ∗ υ) ∗ υ) ∗ υ

theorem fourfoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure :
    IsProbabilityMeasure fourfoldUniformKernel := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  unfold fourfoldUniformKernel
  infer_instance

theorem fourfoldUniformKernel_supported :
    IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow fourfoldUniformKernel 4 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  let hυ := uniformSmoothingKernel_supported 1
  unfold fourfoldUniformKernel
  convert isSupportedInSmoothingWindow_conv
    (isSupportedInSmoothingWindow_conv
      (isSupportedInSmoothingWindow_conv hυ hυ) hυ) hυ using 1
  norm_num

theorem charFun_fourfoldUniformKernel (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun fourfoldUniformKernel t =
      (sincFourthWeight t : ℂ) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  have hchar :
      MeasureTheory.charFun (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) t =
        (Real.sinc t : ℂ) := by
    simpa using charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel (δ := 1) (by norm_num) t
  unfold fourfoldUniformKernel
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, MeasureTheory.charFun_conv,
    MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, hchar]
  simp only [sincFourthWeight, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  ring

/-- Lebesgue density of the uniform probability law on `[-1,1]`. -/
noncomputable def uniformUnitDensity (x : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1).indicator (fun _ => (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) x

/-- The triangular density of the sum of two independent uniform laws on
`[-1,1]`, kept in `ℝ≥0∞` form for measure convolution. -/
noncomputable def twofoldUniformDensity (x : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ *
    ENNReal.ofReal (max (2 - |x|) 0)

theorem uniformUnitDensity_lconvolution_self (x : ℝ) :
    (uniformUnitDensity ⋆ₗ[volume] uniformUnitDensity) x =
      twofoldUniformDensity x := by
  have hmem (y : ℝ) :
      -y + x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ↔
        y ∈ Icc (x - 1) (x + 1) := by
    constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  have hfun :
      (fun y : ℝ => uniformUnitDensity y * uniformUnitDensity (-y + x)) =
        (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∩ Icc (x - 1) (x + 1)).indicator
          (fun _ => (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) := by
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 <;>
      by_cases hxy : y ∈ Icc (x - 1) (x + 1) <;>
      simp [uniformUnitDensity, hy, hxy, hmem y]
  rw [MeasureTheory.lconvolution_def, hfun,
    lintegral_indicator (measurableSet_Icc.inter measurableSet_Icc)]
  simp only [setLIntegral_const, Set.Icc_inter_Icc, Real.volume_Icc]
  unfold twofoldUniformDensity
  congr 1
  by_cases hx0 : x ≤ 0
  · by_cases hxm : x < -2
    · have : x + 1 < -1 := by linarith
      simp [max_eq_left (by linarith : (-1 : ℝ) ≥ x - 1), abs_of_nonpos hx0]
      rw [min_eq_right (by linarith : x + 1 ≤ (1 : ℝ))]
      simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith : x + 1 + 1 ≤ 0),
        ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith : 2 + x ≤ 0)]
    · have hx2 : -2 ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hxm
      have hmax : max (-1 : ℝ) (x - 1) = -1 := max_eq_left (by linarith)
      have hmin : min (1 : ℝ) (x + 1) = x + 1 := min_eq_right (by linarith)
      rw [hmax, hmin, abs_of_nonpos hx0]
      congr 1
      rw [max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      ring
  · have hx0' : 0 ≤ x := le_of_not_ge hx0
    by_cases hx2 : 2 < x
    · have : 1 < x - 1 := by linarith
      simp [min_eq_left (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x + 1), abs_of_nonneg hx0']
      rw [max_eq_right (by linarith : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ x - 1)]
      simp [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith : 1 - (x - 1) ≤ 0),
        ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith : 2 - x ≤ 0)]
    · have hx2' : x ≤ 2 := le_of_not_gt hx2
      have hmax : max (-1 : ℝ) (x - 1) = x - 1 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
      have hmin : min (1 : ℝ) (x + 1) = 1 := min_eq_left (by linarith)
      rw [hmax, hmin, abs_of_nonneg hx0']
      congr 1
      rw [max_eq_left (by linarith)]
      ring

theorem measurable_uniformUnitDensity : Measurable uniformUnitDensity := by
  exact measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Icc

theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_one_eq_withDensity :
    uniformSmoothingKernel 1 = volume.withDensity uniformUnitDensity := by
  unfold uniformSmoothingKernel
  calc
    (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (1 : ℝ)))⁻¹ • volume.restrict (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) =
        (ENNReal.ofReal 2)⁻¹ •
          volume.withDensity ((Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1).indicator 1) := by
      rw [withDensity_indicator_one measurableSet_Icc]
      norm_num
    _ = volume.withDensity
        ((ENNReal.ofReal 2)⁻¹ • (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1).indicator 1) := by
      rw [withDensity_smul]
      exact measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Icc
    _ = volume.withDensity uniformUnitDensity := by
      congr 1
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 <;>
        simp [uniformUnitDensity, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hx]

/-- Real-valued triangular density `max (2 - |x|) 0 / 4`. -/
noncomputable def twofoldUniformDensityReal (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (2 - |x|) 0 / 4

theorem twofoldUniformDensity_toReal (x : ℝ) :
    (twofoldUniformDensity x).toReal = twofoldUniformDensityReal x := by
  simp only [twofoldUniformDensity, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_max_right (2 - |x|) 0)]
  unfold twofoldUniformDensityReal
  norm_num
  ring

theorem measurable_twofoldUniformDensity :
    Measurable twofoldUniformDensity := by
  unfold twofoldUniformDensity
  fun_prop

theorem continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal :
    Continuous twofoldUniformDensityReal := by
  unfold twofoldUniformDensityReal
  fun_prop

theorem twofoldUniformDensityReal_nonneg (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ twofoldUniformDensityReal x := by
  unfold twofoldUniformDensityReal
  positivity

theorem support_twofoldUniformDensityReal_subset :
    Function.support twofoldUniformDensityReal ⊆ Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 := by
  intro x hx
  change twofoldUniformDensityReal x ≠ 0 at hx
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    have hlt : x < -2 := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hxneg : x < 0 := by linarith
    have hinner : 2 - |x| ≤ 0 := by rw [abs_of_neg hxneg]; linarith
    simp [twofoldUniformDensityReal, max_eq_right hinner] at hx
  · by_contra h
    have hlt : 2 < x := lt_of_not_ge h
    have hxpos : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
    have hinner : 2 - |x| ≤ 0 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hxpos]; linarith
    simp [twofoldUniformDensityReal, max_eq_right hinner] at hx

theorem hasCompactSupport_twofoldUniformDensityReal :
    HasCompactSupport twofoldUniformDensityReal :=
  HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact isCompact_Icc
    support_twofoldUniformDensityReal_subset

theorem integrable_twofoldUniformDensityReal :
    Integrable twofoldUniformDensityReal :=
  continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    hasCompactSupport_twofoldUniformDensityReal

/-- Continuous compactly supported density of the fourfold uniform sum. -/
noncomputable def fourfoldUniformDensity : ℝ → ℝ :=
  twofoldUniformDensityReal ⋆[ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ, volume] twofoldUniformDensityReal

theorem continuous_fourfoldUniformDensity :
    Continuous fourfoldUniformDensity := by
  unfold fourfoldUniformDensity
  exact hasCompactSupport_twofoldUniformDensityReal.continuous_convolution_right
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
    continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal.locallyIntegrable
    continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal

theorem integrable_fourfoldUniformDensity :
    Integrable fourfoldUniformDensity := by
  unfold fourfoldUniformDensity
  exact integrable_twofoldUniformDensityReal.integrable_convolution
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) integrable_twofoldUniformDensityReal

theorem fourfoldUniformDensity_nonneg (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ fourfoldUniformDensity x := by
  rw [fourfoldUniformDensity, convolution_mul]
  exact integral_nonneg fun y => mul_nonneg
    (twofoldUniformDensityReal_nonneg y)
    (twofoldUniformDensityReal_nonneg (x - y))

theorem support_fourfoldUniformDensity_subset :
    Function.support fourfoldUniformDensity ⊆ Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := by
  refine (support_convolution_subset
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)).trans ?_
  rintro x ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  have ha' := support_twofoldUniformDensityReal_subset ha
  have hb' := support_twofoldUniformDensityReal_subset hb
  constructor <;> linarith [ha'.1, ha'.2, hb'.1, hb'.2]

theorem hasCompactSupport_fourfoldUniformDensity :
    HasCompactSupport fourfoldUniformDensity :=
  HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact isCompact_Icc
    support_fourfoldUniformDensity_subset

theorem twofoldUniformDensity_lconvolution_self (x : ℝ) :
    (twofoldUniformDensity ⋆ₗ[volume] twofoldUniformDensity) x =
      ENNReal.ofReal (fourfoldUniformDensity x) := by
  have hconv : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      twofoldUniformDensityReal y * twofoldUniformDensityReal (x - y)) :=
    (hasCompactSupport_twofoldUniformDensityReal.convolutionExists_right
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)
      continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal.locallyIntegrable
      continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal x)
  rw [MeasureTheory.lconvolution_def, fourfoldUniformDensity,
    convolution_mul,
    ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hconv
      (ae_of_all volume fun y => mul_nonneg
        (twofoldUniformDensityReal_nonneg y)
        (twofoldUniformDensityReal_nonneg (x - y)))]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro y
  have harg : -y + x = x - y := by ring
  rw [harg, ← twofoldUniformDensity_toReal,
    ← twofoldUniformDensity_toReal]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (by unfold twofoldUniformDensity; finiteness)]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (by unfold twofoldUniformDensity; finiteness)]

theorem uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_self_eq_withDensity :
    uniformSmoothingKernel 1 ∗ uniformSmoothingKernel 1 =
      volume.withDensity twofoldUniformDensity := by
  rw [uniformSmoothingKernel_one_eq_withDensity,
    conv_withDensity_eq_lconvolution measurable_uniformUnitDensity
      measurable_uniformUnitDensity]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact uniformUnitDensity_lconvolution_self x

theorem fourfoldUniformKernel_eq_withDensity :
    fourfoldUniformKernel =
      volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (fourfoldUniformDensity x)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  unfold fourfoldUniformKernel
  rw [Measure.conv_assoc, uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_self_eq_withDensity,
    conv_withDensity_eq_lconvolution measurable_twofoldUniformDensity
      measurable_twofoldUniformDensity]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact twofoldUniformDensity_lconvolution_self x

/-- Complex-valued form of `fourfoldUniformDensity` for Fourier inversion. -/
noncomputable def fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  fourfoldUniformDensity x

theorem continuous_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Continuous fourfoldUniformDensityComplex := by
  exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fourfoldUniformDensity

theorem integrable_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :=
  integrable_fourfoldUniformDensity.ofReal

theorem sincFourthWeight_eq_fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (t : ℝ) :
    (sincFourthWeight t : ℂ) =
      𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (t / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure fourfoldUniformKernel :=
    fourfoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  rw [← charFun_fourfoldUniformKernel t,
    fourfoldUniformKernel_eq_withDensity,
    MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      (continuous_fourfoldUniformDensity.measurable.ennreal_ofReal)
      (ae_of_all volume fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
      (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)),
    Real.fourierInv_eq']
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    dsimp only
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (fourfoldUniformDensity_nonneg x)]
    change (fourfoldUniformDensity x : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ x (t / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.I) * (fourfoldUniformDensity x : ℂ)
    rw [mul_comm]
    congr 2
    congr 1
    norm_cast
    rw [real_inner_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    have hre (z : ℝ) : RCLike.re z = z := rfl
    rw [hre]
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

theorem fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight (w : ℝ) :
    𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex w =
      (sincFourthWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
  rw [sincFourthWeight_eq_fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

theorem integrable_fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable (𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex) := by
  have htwoPi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hbase : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => (sincFourthWeight w : ℂ)) :=
    integrable_sincFourthWeight.ofReal
  have hscaled : Integrable (fun w : ℝ =>
      (sincFourthWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ)) :=
    hbase.comp_mul_left' htwoPi
  exact hscaled.congr (ae_of_all volume fun w =>
    (fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight w).symm)

theorem fourier_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight (w : ℝ) :
    𝓕 fourfoldUniformDensityComplex w =
      (sincFourthWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
  calc
    𝓕 fourfoldUniformDensityComplex w =
        𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-w) := by
      symm
      simpa using Real.fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg
        fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-w)
    _ = (sincFourthWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * (-w)) : ℂ) :=
      fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight (-w)
    _ = (sincFourthWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
      congr 2
      ring

theorem integrable_fourier_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable (𝓕 fourfoldUniformDensityComplex) := by
  have hnegTwoPi : (-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (-2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hbase : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => (sincFourthWeight w : ℂ)) :=
    integrable_sincFourthWeight.ofReal
  have hscaled : Integrable (fun w : ℝ =>
      (sincFourthWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ)) :=
    hbase.comp_mul_left' hnegTwoPi
  exact hscaled.congr (ae_of_all volume fun w =>
    (fourier_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight w).symm)

theorem fourier_fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :
    𝓕 (𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex) = fourfoldUniformDensityComplex :=
  continuous_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex.fourier_fourierInv_eq
    integrable_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex
    integrable_fourier_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex

theorem integral_eq_mul_integral_comp_mul_left
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, g x) = a • ∫ x : ℝ, g (a * x) := by
  rw [Measure.integral_comp_mul_left g a,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)]
  rw [Complex.real_smul]
  have haC : (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast ha.ne'
  change (∫ x : ℝ, g x) =
    (a : ℂ) * ((a⁻¹ : ℝ) • ∫ x : ℝ, g x)
  rw [@Complex.real_smul (a⁻¹) (∫ x : ℝ, g x)]
  rw [← mul_assoc]
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha.ne']
  simp

theorem integral_cexp_mul_sincFourthWeight_eq_density (s : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ)) =
      (2 * Real.pi) • (fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-s)) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
    Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ)
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ)) = ∫ x : ℝ, g x := rfl
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • ∫ w : ℝ, g ((2 * Real.pi) * w) :=
      integral_eq_mul_integral_comp_mul_left g Real.two_pi_pos
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • 𝓕 (𝓕⁻ fourfoldUniformDensityComplex) (-s) := by
      congr 1
      rw [Real.fourier_eq']
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all volume fun w => by
        dsimp only [g]
        rw [fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincFourthWeight]
        congr 1
        congr 1
        congr 1
        norm_cast
        rw [real_inner_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)]
        simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
        have hre (z : ℝ) : RCLike.re z = z := rfl
        rw [hre]
        norm_num
        ring
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-s) := by
      rw [fourier_fourierInv_fourfoldUniformDensityComplex]

theorem charFun_sincFourthKernel (s : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun sincFourthKernel s =
      (sincFourthMass⁻¹ : ℝ) •
        ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real, sincFourthKernel,
    integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    sincFourthBaseMeasure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal sincFourthMass_pos.le,
    sincFourthBaseMeasure,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      (continuous_sincFourthWeight.measurable.ennreal_ofReal)
      (ae_of_all volume fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
      (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I))]
  congr 1
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    dsimp only
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sincFourthWeight_nonneg x)]
    change (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (sincFourthWeight x : ℂ)
    rw [mul_comm]

theorem charFun_sincFourthKernel_eq_density (s : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun sincFourthKernel s =
      (sincFourthMass⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi)) •
        fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-s) := by
  rw [charFun_sincFourthKernel,
    integral_cexp_mul_sincFourthWeight_eq_density]
  simp only [Complex.real_smul]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem sincFourthKernel_charFun_supported :
    IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow sincFourthKernel 4 := by
  intro s hs
  rw [charFun_sincFourthKernel_eq_density]
  have hnot : -s ∉ Icc (-4 : ℝ) 4 := by
    intro h
    have habs : |s| ≤ 4 := (abs_le).2 ⟨by linarith [h.2], by linarith [h.1]⟩
    linarith
  have hzero : fourfoldUniformDensityComplex (-s) = 0 := by
    unfold fourfoldUniformDensityComplex
    norm_cast
    by_contra hne
    exact hnot (support_fourfoldUniformDensity_subset hne)
  rw [hzero]
  simp

/-- The unit-scale reflected Prawitz point kernel is exactly the
sinc-squared Fejér profile. -/
theorem prawitzPointKernel_add_neg_eq_sinc_sq (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel 1 z + prawitzPointKernel 1 (-z) =
      Real.sinc (z / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_add_neg]
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp [Real.sinc]
  · rw [if_neg hz, Real.sinc, if_neg (div_ne_zero hz (by norm_num))]
    have hrewrite : z = 2 * (z / 2) := by ring
    rw [hrewrite, Real.cos_two_mul]
    field_simp [hz]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (z / 2)]

theorem prawitzPointKernel_add_neg_scale_eq_sinc_sq
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (z : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel T z + prawitzPointKernel T (-z) =
      Real.sinc (T * z / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [prawitzPointKernel_scale hT, prawitzPointKernel_scale hT,
    show T * -z = -(T * z) by ring,
    prawitzPointKernel_add_neg_eq_sinc_sq]

theorem prawitzPointKernel_reflection_eq_sinc_sq
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) + prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) =
      Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [show x - y = -(y - x) by ring,
    prawitzPointKernel_add_neg_scale_eq_sinc_sq hT]

/-- The total bidirectional pointwise slack is exactly twice the translated
sinc-squared Fejér profile. -/
theorem prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzUpperSlack T x y + prawitzLowerSlack T x y =
      2 * Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [← prawitzPointKernel_reflection_eq_sinc_sq hT x y]
  unfold prawitzUpperSlack prawitzLowerSlack
  ring

/-- The total expected bidirectional slack is exactly twice the law's
translated sinc-squared mass. -/
theorem integral_prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) +
        ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu =
      2 * ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
  have hUpper := integrable_prawitzUpperSlack mu x hForward
  have hLower := integrable_prawitzLowerSlack mu x hReflected
  calc
    _ = ∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y + prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu :=
      (integral_add hUpper hLower).symm
    _ = ∫ y, 2 * Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all _
        (prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq hT x)
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul]

/-- For two laws, the sum of the two one-sided slack differences is exactly
twice their translated sinc-squared mass difference. -/
theorem prawitzSlackDifference_add_eq_two_mul_sincMassDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    ((∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂nu) +
      ((∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂nu) =
      2 * ((∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu) := by
  have hmu :=
    integral_prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
      mu hT x hmuForward hmuReflected
  have hnu :=
    integral_prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
      nu hT x hnuForward hnuReflected
  linarith

/-- Signed half-difference controlling how the fixed sinc-squared slack mass
is divided between the upper and lower Prawitz bounds. -/
noncomputable def prawitzSlackImbalance (T x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (prawitzUpperSlack T x y - prawitzLowerSlack T x y) / 2

/-- The signed imbalance is exactly the antisymmetric point-kernel component
minus the centered lower-ray step. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep
    (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) - prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) -
        (2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) := by
  unfold prawitzSlackImbalance prawitzUpperSlack prawitzLowerSlack
  ring

/-- The slack imbalance depends on the spatial variables only through their
displacement. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_translate (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalance T 0 (y - x) := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep]
  by_cases hy : y ≤ x
  · have hz : y - x ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr hy
    simp [hy, hz]
  · have hz : ¬y - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
    simp [hy, hz]

/-- Positive frequency scaling reduces the translated imbalance to its
universal unit-window profile. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (T * (y - x)) := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_translate T x y,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep,
    prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
  rw [show 0 - (y - x) = -(y - x) by ring,
    prawitzPointKernel_scale hT]
  rw [show T * (-(y - x)) = -(T * (y - x)) by ring]
  by_cases hz : y - x ≤ 0
  · have hTz : T * (y - x) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hT.le hz
    simp [hz, hTz]
  · have hzpos : 0 < y - x := lt_of_not_ge hz
    have hTzpos : 0 < T * (y - x) := mul_pos hT hzpos
    simp [not_le.mpr hzpos, not_le.mpr hTzpos]

/-- At the CDF jump itself, the right-continuous convention assigns the full
unit signed imbalance to the lower Prawitz slack. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_diagonal (T x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x x = -1 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep]
  simp
  norm_num

/-- To the right of the CDF evaluation point, the imbalance is the
antisymmetric point-kernel component plus one. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_of_lt
    (T : ℝ) {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x < y) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) - prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) + 1 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep]
  simp [not_le.mpr hxy]

/-- On and to the left of the CDF evaluation point, the imbalance is the
antisymmetric point-kernel component minus one. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_of_le
    (T : ℝ) {x y : ℝ} (hyx : y ≤ x) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) - prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) - 1 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep]
  simp [hyx]
  norm_num

/-- The universal imbalance profile vanishes at the first negative Fourier
lattice point. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_neg_two_pi :
    prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi) = 0 := by
  have hle : -2 * Real.pi ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_of_le 1 hle, sub_zero, zero_sub]
  rw [show -(-2 * Real.pi) = 2 * Real.pi by ring,
    prawitzPointKernel_neg_two_pi, prawitzPointKernel_two_pi]
  ring

/-- The universal imbalance profile also vanishes at the reflected first
Fourier lattice point. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_two_pi :
    prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (2 * Real.pi) = 0 := by
  have hlt : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_of_lt 1 hlt, sub_zero, zero_sub]
  rw [show -(2 * Real.pi) = -2 * Real.pi by ring,
    prawitzPointKernel_two_pi, prawitzPointKernel_neg_two_pi]
  ring

/-- The three certified values around the CDF jump already contribute two to
the variation of the universal imbalance profile. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation :
    |prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi) -
        prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 0| +
      |prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 0 -
        prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (2 * Real.pi)| = 2 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_neg_two_pi,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_diagonal,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_two_pi]
  norm_num

/-- Consequently, every proposed variation majorant for these three
increments has coefficient at least two. -/
theorem two_le_of_prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation_le
    {C : ℝ}
    (hC : |prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi) -
          prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 0| +
        |prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 0 -
          prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (2 * Real.pi)| ≤ C) :
    2 ≤ C := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation] at hC
  exact hC

/-- At every positive bandwidth, the imbalance vanishes one first-lattice
spacing to the left of the spatial center. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_left_latticePoint
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x - 2 * Real.pi / T) = 0 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_scale hT]
  convert prawitzSlackImbalance_neg_two_pi using 1
  field_simp [hT.ne']
  ring

/-- At every positive bandwidth, the imbalance vanishes one first-lattice
spacing to the right of the spatial center. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_right_latticePoint
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x + 2 * Real.pi / T) = 0 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_scale hT]
  convert prawitzSlackImbalance_two_pi using 1
  field_simp [hT.ne']
  ring

/-- The coefficient-two variation obstruction is invariant under positive
bandwidth scaling and spatial translation. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation_scaled
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x - 2 * Real.pi / T) -
        prawitzSlackImbalance T x x| +
      |prawitzSlackImbalance T x x -
        prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x + 2 * Real.pi / T)| = 2 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_left_latticePoint hT,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_diagonal,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_right_latticePoint hT]
  norm_num

/-- No bandwidth-dependent variation majorant for these three increments can
have coefficient strictly below two. -/
theorem two_le_of_prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation_scaled_le
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x C : ℝ)
    (hC : |prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x - 2 * Real.pi / T) -
          prawitzSlackImbalance T x x| +
        |prawitzSlackImbalance T x x -
          prawitzSlackImbalance T x (x + 2 * Real.pi / T)| ≤ C) :
    2 ≤ C := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalance_threePointVariation_scaled hT x] at hC
  exact hC

/-- The off-diagonal imbalance removes only the value at the CDF evaluation
point, leaving the rest of the universal profile unchanged. -/
noncomputable def prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal (T x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if y = x then 0 else prawitzSlackImbalance T x y

/-- The off-diagonal profile, like the raw imbalance, depends only on spatial
displacement. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_translate (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (y - x) := by
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]
  · have hsub : y - x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hy, hsub,
      prawitzSlackImbalance_translate]

/-- At positive bandwidth, dilation reduces the off-diagonal profile to the
universal unit-window profile without reintroducing the diagonal atom. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_scale
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (T * (y - x)) := by
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]
  · have hsub : y - x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
    have hscaled : T * (y - x) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hT.ne' hsub
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hy, hscaled,
      prawitzSlackImbalance_scale hT]

/-- Removing the exceptional diagonal value restores exact odd symmetry to
the centered imbalance profile. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg (T z : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (-z) =
      -prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 z := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]
  · have hneg_ne : -z ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr hz
    by_cases hzpos : 0 < z
    · rw [show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (-z) =
          prawitzSlackImbalance T 0 (-z) by
            simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hneg_ne],
        show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 z =
          prawitzSlackImbalance T 0 z by
            simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hz],
        prawitzSlackImbalance_of_le T (by linarith : -z ≤ 0),
        prawitzSlackImbalance_of_lt T hzpos]
      simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg]
      ring
    · have hzneg : z < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hzpos) hz
      rw [show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (-z) =
          prawitzSlackImbalance T 0 (-z) by
            simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hneg_ne],
        show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 z =
          prawitzSlackImbalance T 0 z by
            simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hz],
        prawitzSlackImbalance_of_lt T (neg_pos.mpr hzneg),
        prawitzSlackImbalance_of_le T hzneg.le]
      simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg]
      ring

/-- Around an arbitrary center, the off-diagonal imbalance changes sign
under spatial reflection. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_reflect (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (2 * x - y) =
      -prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y := by
  calc
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (2 * x - y) =
        prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (2 * x - y - x) :=
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_translate T x (2 * x - y)
    _ = prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (-(y - x)) := by
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = -prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T 0 (y - x) :=
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg T (y - x)
    _ = -prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y := by
      exact congrArg Neg.neg
        (prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_translate T x y).symm

/-- On the positive universal half-line, the off-diagonal imbalance is
exactly half the difference of the two nonnegative Prawitz--Vaaler
remainders. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_two_pi_mul
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a) =
      (prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder a -
        prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder a) / 2 := by
  have hz : 2 * Real.pi * a ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a) =
      prawitzSlackImbalance 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a) by
        simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hz],
    prawitzSlackImbalance_of_lt 1 (by positivity)]
  simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub]
  rw [show -(2 * Real.pi * a) = -2 * Real.pi * a by ring]
  have hpos := prawitzPointKernel_positive_identity ha
  have hneg :=
    prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder_eq_pointKernel_of_positive ha hpos
  linarith

/-- The negative universal half-line has the reflected remainder difference,
as forced by odd symmetry. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg_two_pi_mul
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi * a) =
      (prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder a -
        prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder a) / 2 := by
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * a = -(2 * Real.pi * a) by ring,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_two_pi_mul ha]
  ring

/-- Explicit positive-half-line coordinate for the universal off-diagonal
imbalance, with the inverse-square series isolated for differentiation. -/
noncomputable def prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
    (1 / x ^ 2 + 2 * prawitzInverseSquareTail x - 2 / x)

/-- The universal off-diagonal imbalance is the explicit half-profile after
the natural `2 * π` spatial rescaling. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_two_pi_mul_eq_halfProfile
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * x) =
      prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile x := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_two_pi_mul hx]
  unfold prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile prawitzVaalerNegativeRemainder
    prawitzVaalerPositiveRemainder
  ring

/-- Exact derivative of the universal positive half-profile. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    HasDerivAt prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile
      (2 * (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) * Real.cos (Real.pi * x) *
          (1 / x ^ 2 + 2 * prawitzInverseSquareTail x - 2 / x) +
        (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
          (-2 / x ^ 3 - 4 * prawitzInverseCubeTail x + 2 / x ^ 2)) x := by
  have hsinArg : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (Real.pi * y))
      (Real.pi * Real.cos (Real.pi * x)) x := by
    convert (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (Real.pi * x)).comp x
      ((hasDerivAt_const x Real.pi).mul (hasDerivAt_id x)) using 1; ring
  have hsin : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (Real.pi * y) / Real.pi)
      (Real.cos (Real.pi * x)) x := by
    convert hsinArg.div_const Real.pi using 1
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  have hInv : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 / y) (-1 / x ^ 2) x := by
    simpa only [one_div] using (hasDerivAt_id x).inv hx.ne'
  have hInvSq : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 / y ^ 2) (-2 / x ^ 3) x := by
    have h := hInv.pow 2
    convert h using 1
    · funext y
      rw [Pi.pow_apply]
      simp only [one_div]
      exact (inv_pow y 2).symm
    · simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.reduceSub, pow_one]
      field_simp [hx.ne']
  have hBracket : HasDerivAt
      (fun y : ℝ => 1 / y ^ 2 + 2 * prawitzInverseSquareTail y - 2 / y)
      (-2 / x ^ 3 - 4 * prawitzInverseCubeTail x + 2 / x ^ 2) x := by
    have h := hInvSq.add
      ((hasDerivAt_prawitzInverseSquareTail hx).const_mul 2) |>.sub
        (hInv.const_mul 2)
    convert h using 1
    · funext y
      change 1 / y ^ 2 + 2 * prawitzInverseSquareTail y - 2 / y =
        (1 / y ^ 2 + 2 * prawitzInverseSquareTail y) - 2 * (1 / y)
      ring
    · ring
  unfold prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile
  have h := (hsin.pow 2).mul hBracket
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at h
  convert h using 1; ring

/-- A sinc-based continuous extension of the positive half-profile through
the spatial center. -/
noncomputable def prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sinc (Real.pi * x) ^ 2 +
    2 * (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
      prawitzInverseSquareTail x -
    2 * x * Real.sinc (Real.pi * x) ^ 2

/-- Away from zero, the sinc extension agrees with the explicit half-profile. -/
theorem prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile_eq_extension
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile x =
      prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension x := by
  unfold prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile
    prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension
  rw [Real.sinc_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero Real.pi_ne_zero hx)]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hx]

/-- The sinc extension is continuous at the spatial center. -/
theorem continuousAt_prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension :
    ContinuousAt prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension 0 := by
  have hsinc : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sinc (Real.pi * x)) 0 := by
    fun_prop
  have hsin : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ =>
      Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) 0 := by
    fun_prop
  unfold prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension
  exact (hsinc.pow 2).add
    ((continuousAt_const.mul (hsin.pow 2)).mul
      continuousAt_prawitzInverseSquareTail_zero) |>.sub
        ((continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id).mul (hsinc.pow 2))

/-- The continuous extension takes the value one at the spatial center. -/
@[simp] theorem prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension_zero :
    prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension 0 = 1 := by
  simp [prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension]

/-- The universal positive half-profile tends to one on approach to its
deleted spatial center. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile_right :
    Tendsto prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
  have hext : Tendsto prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) = prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension 0 by simp]
    exact continuousAt_prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfileExtension.continuousWithinAt
  apply hext.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
  exact (prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile_eq_extension hx.ne').symm

/-- The off-diagonal imbalance has right-hand limit one at its deleted
center, after the natural `2 * π` rescaling. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_positive :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ =>
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
  apply tendsto_prawitzOffDiagonalHalfProfile_right.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with a ha
  exact
    (prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_two_pi_mul_eq_halfProfile ha).symm

/-- Odd symmetry gives the corresponding left-hand profile limit minus one. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_negative :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ =>
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi * a))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds (-1)) := by
  have hneg := tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_positive.neg
  apply hneg.congr'
  filter_upwards with a
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * a = -(2 * Real.pi * a) by ring,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg]

/-- The two increments adjacent to the deleted center tend to total variation
two; removing the diagonal atom therefore does not remove the coefficient-two
variation obstruction. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_twoJumpVariation :
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ =>
      |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi * a) -
          prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 0| +
        |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 0 -
          prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a)|)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 2) := by
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _a : ℝ => (2 : ℝ))
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 2) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have hlim :=
    hconst.mul tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_positive.abs
  have htwo : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ =>
      2 * |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a)|)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (nhds 2) := by
    simpa using hlim
  apply htwo.congr'
  filter_upwards with a
  rw [show -2 * Real.pi * a = -(2 * Real.pi * a) by ring,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_neg,
    show prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 0 = 0 by
      simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]]
  simp only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg]
  ring

/-- Every uniform upper bound on the two off-diagonal increments adjacent to
the center has coefficient at least two. -/
theorem two_le_of_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_twoJumpVariation_le
    (C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a →
      |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (-2 * Real.pi * a) -
          prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 0| +
        |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 0 -
          prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal 1 0 (2 * Real.pi * a)| ≤ C) :
    2 ≤ C := by
  apply le_of_tendsto
    tendsto_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_twoJumpVariation
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with a ha
  exact hC a ha

/-- Removing the diagonal atom sets the spatial center to zero. -/
@[simp] theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_self (T x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x x = 0 := by
  simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]

/-- The off-diagonal profile still vanishes at the first Fourier lattice
point to the left of the spatial center. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_left_latticePoint
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (x - 2 * Real.pi / T) = 0 := by
  have hshift : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / T := div_pos (by positivity) hT
  have hne : x - 2 * Real.pi / T ≠ x := ne_of_lt (sub_lt_self x hshift)
  simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hne,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_left_latticePoint hT]

/-- The reflected first Fourier lattice point also remains a zero of the
off-diagonal profile. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_right_latticePoint
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (x + 2 * Real.pi / T) = 0 := by
  have hshift : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / T := div_pos (by positivity) hT
  have hne : x + 2 * Real.pi / T ≠ x := ne_of_gt (lt_add_of_pos_right x hshift)
  simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hne,
    prawitzSlackImbalance_right_latticePoint hT]

/-- Once the diagonal atom is removed, the earlier three-point variation
obstruction vanishes exactly. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_threePointVariation
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (x - 2 * Real.pi / T) -
        prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x x| +
      |prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x x -
        prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x (x + 2 * Real.pi / T)| = 0 := by
  rw [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_left_latticePoint hT,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_self,
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_right_latticePoint hT]
  simp only [sub_self, abs_zero, add_zero]

/-- The full imbalance is the off-diagonal profile minus the singleton
indicator.  This isolates the atom created by the right-continuous CDF
convention. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_singletonIndicator
    (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalance T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y -
        ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal,
      prawitzSlackImbalance_diagonal]
  · simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal, hy]

/-- Equivalently, the off-diagonal profile restores the singleton indicator
to the full imbalance. -/
theorem prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_eq_add_singletonIndicator
    (T x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalance T x y +
        ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
  have h :=
    prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_singletonIndicator T x y
  linarith

/-- Removing the diagonal preserves integrability under the same point-kernel
hypotheses. -/
theorem integrable_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    Integrable (prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x) mu := by
  have hUpper := integrable_prawitzUpperSlack mu x hForward
  have hLower := integrable_prawitzLowerSlack mu x hReflected
  have hImbalance : Integrable (prawitzSlackImbalance T x) mu := by
    unfold prawitzSlackImbalance
    exact (hUpper.sub hLower).div_const 2
  have hSingleton : Integrable
      (({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) mu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_singleton x)
  have heq : prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x =
      fun y => prawitzSlackImbalance T x y +
        ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
    funext y
    exact prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_eq_add_singletonIndicator T x y
  rw [heq]
  exact hImbalance.add hSingleton

/-- The expected imbalance splits into its off-diagonal expectation minus the
law's atom at the CDF evaluation point. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_atom
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
      (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        mu.real {x} := by
  have hOff := integrable_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal
    mu x hForward hReflected
  have hSingleton : Integrable
      (({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) mu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_singleton x)
  have hAtom :
      (∫ y, ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∂mu) =
        mu.real {x} := by
    exact integral_indicator_one (μ := mu) (measurableSet_singleton x)
  calc
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
        ∫ y, (prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y -
          ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y) ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all mu
        (prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_singletonIndicator T x)
    _ = (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, ({x} : Set ℝ).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∂mu :=
      integral_sub hOff hSingleton
    _ = _ := by rw [hAtom]

/-- For two laws, the diagonal contribution is exactly their singleton-mass
difference and all remaining imbalance is off-diagonal. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_eq_offDiagonal_sub_atomDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu) =
      ((∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu) -
      (mu.real {x} - nu.real {x}) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_atom
      mu x hmuForward hmuReflected,
    integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_offDiagonal_sub_atom
      nu x hnuForward hnuReflected]
  ring

theorem prawitzUpperSlack_eq_sinc_sq_add_imbalance
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzUpperSlack T x y =
      Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 +
        prawitzSlackImbalance T x y := by
  have hsum := prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq hT x y
  unfold prawitzSlackImbalance
  linarith

theorem prawitzLowerSlack_eq_sinc_sq_sub_imbalance
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    prawitzLowerSlack T x y =
      Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 -
        prawitzSlackImbalance T x y := by
  have hsum := prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq hT x y
  unfold prawitzSlackImbalance
  linarith

/-- Nonnegativity of both one-sided slacks bounds their signed imbalance by
the common sinc-squared mass. -/
theorem abs_prawitzSlackImbalance_le_sinc_sq
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    |prawitzSlackImbalance T x y| ≤
      Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · have hUpper := prawitzUpperSlack_nonneg hT x y
    rw [prawitzUpperSlack_eq_sinc_sq_add_imbalance hT x y] at hUpper
    linarith
  · have hLower := prawitzLowerSlack_nonneg hT x y
    rw [prawitzLowerSlack_eq_sinc_sq_sub_imbalance hT x y] at hLower
    linarith

theorem integrable_prawitzSlackImbalance
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    Integrable (prawitzSlackImbalance T x) mu := by
  have hUpper := integrable_prawitzUpperSlack mu x hForward
  have hLower := integrable_prawitzLowerSlack mu x hReflected
  unfold prawitzSlackImbalance
  exact (hUpper.sub hLower).div_const 2

theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_half_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
      ((∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu) / 2 := by
  have hUpper := integrable_prawitzUpperSlack mu x hForward
  have hLower := integrable_prawitzLowerSlack mu x hReflected
  unfold prawitzSlackImbalance
  rw [integral_div, integral_sub hUpper hLower]

/-- Expectation of the imbalance in spatial point-kernel coordinates. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernelDifference_sub_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
      ((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
        (2 * cdf mu x - 1) := by
  have hStep : Integrable
      (fun y => 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) mu :=
    ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).const_mul 2 |>.sub
      (integrable_const 1)
  calc
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
        ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) -
            prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) -
          (2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1) ∂mu := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all mu fun y =>
        prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernel_sub_reflected_sub_centeredStep
          T x y
    _ = (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) -
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ∂mu :=
      integral_sub (hForward.sub hReflected) hStep
    _ = ((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, 2 * (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y - 1 ∂mu := by
      rw [integral_sub hForward hReflected]
    _ = ((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
        (2 * cdf mu x - 1) := by rw [integral_centeredCDFKernel]

theorem integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_sincMass_add_imbalance
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) =
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) +
        ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu := by
  have hsum := integral_prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
    mu hT x hForward hReflected
  have himb := integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_half_sub
    mu x hForward hReflected
  linarith

theorem integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_sincMass_sub_imbalance
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu) :
    (∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu) =
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu := by
  have hsum := integral_prawitzUpperSlack_add_lowerSlack_eq_two_mul_sinc_sq
    mu hT x hForward hReflected
  have himb := integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_half_sub
    mu x hForward hReflected
  linarith

/-- The difference of two upper-slack expectations splits exactly into the
difference of their common sinc-squared masses and the difference of their
signed imbalances. -/
theorem prawitzUpperSlackDifference_eq_sincMassDifference_add_imbalanceDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    ((∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzUpperSlack T x y ∂nu) =
      ((∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu) +
        ((∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu) := by
  have hmu := integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_sincMass_add_imbalance
    mu hT x hmuForward hmuReflected
  have hnu := integral_prawitzUpperSlack_eq_sincMass_add_imbalance
    nu hT x hnuForward hnuReflected
  linarith

/-- The corresponding lower-slack difference has the same common-mass
coordinate and the opposite signed-imbalance coordinate. -/
theorem prawitzLowerSlackDifference_eq_sincMassDifference_sub_imbalanceDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure mu] [IsFiniteMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    ((∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, prawitzLowerSlack T x y ∂nu) =
      ((∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu) -
        ((∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu) := by
  have hmu := integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_sincMass_sub_imbalance
    mu hT x hmuForward hmuReflected
  have hnu := integral_prawitzLowerSlack_eq_sincMass_sub_imbalance
    nu hT x hnuForward hnuReflected
  linarith

/-- Forward Prawitz recentering in common-mass and signed-imbalance
coordinates. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzUpperMassImbalanceRecentered
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
      ((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (((∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
              ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu) +
            ((∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
              ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu)) := by
  rw [cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzUpperRecentered mu nu x hmuForward hnuForward,
    prawitzUpperSlackDifference_eq_sincMassDifference_add_imbalanceDifference
      mu nu hT x hmuForward hmuReflected hnuForward hnuReflected]

/-- Reflected Prawitz recentering in the same coordinates, with the signed
imbalance entering with its opposite sign. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzLowerMassImbalanceRecentered
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ)
    (hmuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) mu)
    (hmuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) mu)
    (hnuForward : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (y - x)) nu)
    (hnuReflected : Integrable (fun y => prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) nu) :
    cdf mu x - cdf nu x =
      -((∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (((∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
              ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu) -
            ((∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
              ∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu)) := by
  rw [cdf_sub_cdf_eq_prawitzLowerRecentered mu nu x hmuReflected hnuReflected,
    prawitzLowerSlackDifference_eq_sincMassDifference_sub_imbalanceDifference
      mu nu hT x hmuForward hmuReflected hnuForward hnuReflected]

/-- The integrable sinc-squared profile underlying the reflected Fejér
remainder. -/
noncomputable def sincSquareWeight (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sinc x ^ 2

theorem sincSquareWeight_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ sincSquareWeight x := by
  unfold sincSquareWeight
  positivity

theorem continuous_sincSquareWeight : Continuous sincSquareWeight := by
  exact Real.continuous_sinc.pow 2

theorem integrable_sincSquareWeight : Integrable sincSquareWeight := by
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul 2
  apply hmajor.mono' continuous_sincSquareWeight.aestronglyMeasurable
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sincSquareWeight_nonneg x)]
    by_cases hx : |x| ≤ 1
    · have hs : |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
        pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sinc_le_one x)
      have hxSq : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg x]
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      unfold sincSquareWeight
      rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 2 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 by
        rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
      calc
        |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 ≤ 1 := hs
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hden]
          linarith
    · have hxLarge : 1 < |x| := lt_of_not_ge hx
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst x
        norm_num at hxLarge
      have hsinc := abs_sinc_le_inv_abs hx0
      have hsPow : |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 ≤ |x|⁻¹ ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hsinc 2
      have hxPow : 0 < |x| ^ 2 := pow_pos (abs_pos.mpr hx0) 2
      have hden : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hfrac : (|x| ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        have hxSq : 1 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
          rw [← sq_abs]
          nlinarith
        calc
          (|x| ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 / (|x| ^ 2) := by rw [one_div]
          _ ≤ 2 / (1 + x ^ 2) := by
            rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hxPow hden]
            rw [sq_abs]
            nlinarith
          _ = 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      unfold sincSquareWeight
      rw [show Real.sinc x ^ 2 = |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 by
        rw [← abs_pow, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]]
      calc
        |Real.sinc x| ^ 2 ≤ |x|⁻¹ ^ 2 := hsPow
        _ = (|x| ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [inv_pow]
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := hfrac

/-- Sum of two independent uniform laws on `[-1,1]`. -/
noncomputable def twofoldUniformKernel : Measure ℝ :=
  uniformSmoothingKernel 1 ∗ uniformSmoothingKernel 1

theorem twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure :
    IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  unfold twofoldUniformKernel
  infer_instance

theorem twofoldUniformKernel_supported :
    IsSupportedInSmoothingWindow twofoldUniformKernel 2 := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  let hUniform := uniformSmoothingKernel_supported 1
  unfold twofoldUniformKernel
  convert isSupportedInSmoothingWindow_conv hUniform hUniform using 1
  norm_num

theorem charFun_twofoldUniformKernel (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun twofoldUniformKernel t =
      (sincSquareWeight t : ℂ) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) :=
    uniformSmoothingKernel_isProbabilityMeasure (by norm_num)
  have hchar :
      MeasureTheory.charFun (uniformSmoothingKernel 1) t =
        (Real.sinc t : ℂ) := by
    simpa using charFun_uniformSmoothingKernel (δ := 1) (by norm_num) t
  unfold twofoldUniformKernel
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, hchar]
  simp only [sincSquareWeight, Complex.ofReal_pow]
  ring

theorem twofoldUniformKernel_eq_withDensity :
    twofoldUniformKernel = volume.withDensity twofoldUniformDensity := by
  exact uniformSmoothingKernel_conv_self_eq_withDensity

/-- Integration against the twofold uniform kernel in terms of its real
triangular Lebesgue density. -/
theorem integral_twofoldUniformKernel_eq_integral_density
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) :
    (∫ z, f z ∂twofoldUniformKernel) =
      ∫ z, (twofoldUniformDensityReal z : ℂ) * f z := by
  rw [twofoldUniformKernel_eq_withDensity,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      measurable_twofoldUniformDensity
      (ae_of_all volume fun x => by unfold twofoldUniformDensity; finiteness)
      f]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all volume fun z => by
    change (twofoldUniformDensity z).toReal • f z =
      (twofoldUniformDensityReal z : ℂ) * f z
    rw [twofoldUniformDensity_toReal]
    rw [Complex.real_smul]

/-- Complex-valued form of `twofoldUniformDensityReal` for Fourier inversion. -/
noncomputable def twofoldUniformDensityComplex (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  twofoldUniformDensityReal x

theorem continuous_twofoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Continuous twofoldUniformDensityComplex := by
  exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_twofoldUniformDensityReal

theorem integrable_twofoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable twofoldUniformDensityComplex :=
  integrable_twofoldUniformDensityReal.ofReal

theorem sincSquareWeight_eq_fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex (t : ℝ) :
    (sincSquareWeight t : ℂ) =
      𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex (t / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel :=
    twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  rw [← charFun_twofoldUniformKernel t,
    twofoldUniformKernel_eq_withDensity,
    MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      measurable_twofoldUniformDensity
      (ae_of_all volume fun x => by unfold twofoldUniformDensity; finiteness)
      (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)),
    Real.fourierInv_eq']
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all volume fun x => by
    dsimp only
    rw [twofoldUniformDensity_toReal]
    change (twofoldUniformDensityReal x : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ x (t / (2 * Real.pi)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.I) * (twofoldUniformDensityReal x : ℂ)
    rw [mul_comm]
    congr 2
    congr 1
    norm_cast
    rw [real_inner_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)]
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    have hre (z : ℝ) : RCLike.re z = z := rfl
    rw [hre]
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

theorem fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight (w : ℝ) :
    𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex w =
      (sincSquareWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
  rw [sincSquareWeight_eq_fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

theorem integrable_fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable (𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex) := by
  have htwoPi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hbase : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => (sincSquareWeight w : ℂ)) :=
    integrable_sincSquareWeight.ofReal
  have hscaled : Integrable (fun w : ℝ =>
      (sincSquareWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ)) :=
    hbase.comp_mul_left' htwoPi
  exact hscaled.congr (ae_of_all volume fun w =>
    (fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight w).symm)

theorem fourier_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight (w : ℝ) :
    𝓕 twofoldUniformDensityComplex w =
      (sincSquareWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
  calc
    𝓕 twofoldUniformDensityComplex w =
        𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex (-w) := by
      symm
      simpa using Real.fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg
        twofoldUniformDensityComplex (-w)
    _ = (sincSquareWeight ((2 * Real.pi) * (-w)) : ℂ) :=
      fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight (-w)
    _ = (sincSquareWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ) := by
      congr 2
      ring

theorem integrable_fourier_twofoldUniformDensityComplex :
    Integrable (𝓕 twofoldUniformDensityComplex) := by
  have hnegTwoPi : (-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (-2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hbase : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => (sincSquareWeight w : ℂ)) :=
    integrable_sincSquareWeight.ofReal
  have hscaled : Integrable (fun w : ℝ =>
      (sincSquareWeight ((-2 * Real.pi) * w) : ℂ)) :=
    hbase.comp_mul_left' hnegTwoPi
  exact hscaled.congr (ae_of_all volume fun w =>
    (fourier_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight w).symm)

theorem fourier_fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex :
    𝓕 (𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex) = twofoldUniformDensityComplex :=
  continuous_twofoldUniformDensityComplex.fourier_fourierInv_eq
    integrable_twofoldUniformDensityComplex
    integrable_fourier_twofoldUniformDensityComplex

theorem integral_cexp_mul_sincSquareWeight_eq_density (s : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (sincSquareWeight x : ℂ)) =
      (2 * Real.pi) • (twofoldUniformDensityComplex (-s)) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
    Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      (sincSquareWeight x : ℂ)
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (sincSquareWeight x : ℂ)) = ∫ x : ℝ, g x := rfl
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • ∫ w : ℝ, g ((2 * Real.pi) * w) :=
      integral_eq_mul_integral_comp_mul_left g Real.two_pi_pos
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • 𝓕 (𝓕⁻ twofoldUniformDensityComplex) (-s) := by
      congr 1
      rw [Real.fourier_eq']
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all volume fun w => by
        dsimp only [g]
        rw [fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex_eq_sincSquareWeight]
        congr 1
        congr 1
        congr 1
        norm_cast
        rw [real_inner_eq_re_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)]
        simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
        have hre (z : ℝ) : RCLike.re z = z := rfl
        rw [hre]
        norm_num
        ring
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) • twofoldUniformDensityComplex (-s) := by
      rw [fourier_fourierInv_twofoldUniformDensityComplex]

/-- The exact Lebesgue mass of the sinc-squared Fejér profile. -/
theorem integral_sincSquareWeight :
    (∫ x : ℝ, sincSquareWeight x) = Real.pi := by
  have h := integral_cexp_mul_sincSquareWeight_eq_density 0
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul,
    neg_zero, twofoldUniformDensityComplex, twofoldUniformDensityReal,
    abs_zero, sub_zero, max_eq_left (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
    Complex.real_smul] at h
  have hOfReal :
      (∫ x : ℝ, (sincSquareWeight x : ℂ)) =
        Complex.ofReal (∫ x : ℝ, sincSquareWeight x) :=
    integral_complex_ofReal
  rw [hOfReal] at h
  apply_fun Complex.re at h
  norm_num at h
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ, sincSquareWeight x) = 2 * Real.pi * (1 / 2 : ℝ) := h
    _ = Real.pi := by ring

/-- The sinc-squared profile is exactly the characteristic-function integral
of the twofold uniform kernel. -/
theorem sincSquareWeight_eq_integral_twofoldUniformKernel (s : ℝ) :
    (sincSquareWeight s : ℂ) =
      ∫ z, Complex.exp (((s * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel := by
  rw [← charFun_twofoldUniformKernel s,
    MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
    push_cast
    ring

/-- The bounded joint phase occurring when the Fejer profile is averaged
against a probability law is integrable on the product space. -/
theorem integrable_prod_prawitzReflectionFourierPhase
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (T x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      Complex.exp ((((T * (p.1 - x) / 2) * p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      (mu.prod twofoldUniformKernel) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel :=
    twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      Complex.exp ((((T * (p.1 - x) / 2) * p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      (mu.prod twofoldUniformKernel) := by
    fun_prop
  apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hmeas
  exact ae_of_all (mu.prod twofoldUniformKernel) fun p => by
    rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]

/-- Averaging a translated and scaled Fejer profile is exactly a compact
frequency integral involving the characteristic function of the law. -/
theorem integral_sincSquareWeight_eq_re_frequencyIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (T x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu) =
      (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
