          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel).re := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel :=
    twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hProd := integrable_prod_prawitzReflectionFourierPhase mu T x
  have hComplex :
      (∫ y, (sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) : ℂ) ∂mu) =
        ∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel := by
    simp_rw [sincSquareWeight_eq_integral_twofoldUniformKernel]
    rw [integral_integral_swap hProd]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
      change (∫ y,
          Complex.exp ((((T * (y - x) / 2) * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
      rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real]
      calc
        (∫ y,
            Complex.exp ((((T * (y - x) / 2) * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
            ∫ y,
              Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                Complex.exp (((T * z / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              ∂mu := by
          apply integral_congr_ae
          exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
            change Complex.exp
                ((((T * (y - x) / 2) * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
              Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                Complex.exp (((T * z / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            rw [← Complex.exp_add]
            congr 1
            push_cast
            ring
        _ = Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              ∫ y, Complex.exp (((T * z / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                ∂mu := integral_const_mul _ _
  have hReal := congrArg Complex.re hComplex
  have hOfReal :
      (∫ y, (sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) : ℂ) ∂mu) =
        Complex.ofReal (∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu) :=
    integral_complex_ofReal
  rw [hOfReal] at hReal
  simpa using hReal

/-- The difference of two translated sinc-squared masses is controlled by a
compact twofold-uniform average of the corresponding characteristic-function
discrepancy. -/
theorem abs_sincMassDifference_le_integral_charFunDiscrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (T x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu| ≤
      ∫ z, ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
        MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ ∂twofoldUniformKernel := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel :=
    twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hmu : Integrable (fun z =>
      Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)) twofoldUniformKernel := by
    apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
    · fun_prop
    · exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
        exact MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one _
  have hnu : Integrable (fun z =>
      Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)) twofoldUniformKernel := by
    apply (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
    · fun_prop
    · exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
        exact MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one _
  rw [show (fun y => Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2) =
      fun y => sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) by rfl,
    integral_sincSquareWeight_eq_re_frequencyIntegral mu T x,
    integral_sincSquareWeight_eq_re_frequencyIntegral nu T x,
    ← Complex.sub_re]
  calc
    |((∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel) -
        ∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel).re| ≤
        ‖(∫ z,
            Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
            ∂twofoldUniformKernel) -
          ∫ z,
            Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)
            ∂twofoldUniformKernel‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    _ = ‖∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
              MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2))
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel‖ := by
      rw [← integral_sub hmu hnu]
      congr 1
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by ring
    _ ≤ ∫ z, ‖Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
            MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2))‖
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ = ∫ z, ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
          MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
        change ‖Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
              MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2))‖ =
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
            MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]

/-- A uniform characteristic-function discrepancy bound on the support of the
twofold-uniform kernel gives the same uniform bound for every translated
sinc-squared mass difference. -/
theorem abs_sincMassDifference_le_of_charFunDiscrepancy_le
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (T x C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2,
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
        MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ ≤ C) :
    |(∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu| ≤ C := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure twofoldUniformKernel :=
    twofoldUniformKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  have hInt : Integrable (fun z =>
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
        MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖) twofoldUniformKernel := by
    apply (integrable_const (2 : ℝ)).mono'
    · fun_prop
    · exact ae_of_all twofoldUniformKernel fun z => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
        calc
          ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
              MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ ≤
              ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)‖ +
                ‖MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ 2 := by
            linarith [MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one
              (μ := mu) (T * z / 2),
              MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one
                (μ := nu) (T * z / 2)]
  have hIntegral :
      (∫ z, ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
          MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ ∂twofoldUniformKernel) ≤ C := by
    calc
      (∫ z, ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2) -
          MeasureTheory.charFun nu (T * z / 2)‖ ∂twofoldUniformKernel) ≤
          ∫ _z : ℝ, C ∂twofoldUniformKernel := by
        apply integral_mono_ae hInt (integrable_const C)
        filter_upwards [twofoldUniformKernel_supported] with z hz
        exact hC z hz
      _ = C := by simp
  exact (abs_sincMassDifference_le_integral_charFunDiscrepancy
    mu nu T x).trans hIntegral

/-- Window form of the preceding estimate: only frequencies of magnitude at
most the nonnegative scale `T` are needed. -/
theorem abs_sincMassDifference_le_of_charFunDiscrepancy_le_on_window
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (x C : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ t, |t| ≤ T →
      ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t‖ ≤ C) :
    |(∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2 ∂nu| ≤ C := by
  apply abs_sincMassDifference_le_of_charFunDiscrepancy_le mu nu T x C
  intro z hz
  apply hC
  have hzAbs : |z| ≤ 2 := (abs_le).2 hz
  calc
    |T * z / 2| = T * |z| / 2 := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hT]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ T * 2 / 2 := by gcongr
    _ = T := by ring

/-- Quantitative sinc-mass comparison between a normalized centered i.i.d.
sum and the standard normal on any window contained in the one-step Taylor
regime. -/
theorem abs_sincMassDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hWindow : T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable) -
        ∫ y, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2
          ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw| ≤
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (4 * (T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3 *
            ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 4 / 4) := by
  apply abs_sincMassDifference_le_of_charFunDiscrepancy_le_on_window
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x _
  intro t ht
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have htScale : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤
      T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hsqrt).2 ht
  have hlocal : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1 :=
    htScale.trans hWindow
  have hbase := norm_charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_le
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond N hlocal
  have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg fun omega => by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (4 * |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 3 *
            ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (|t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 / 4) := hbase
    _ ≤ ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (4 * (T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 3 *
            ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) +
        ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((T / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 4 / 4) := by
      gcongr

/-- The compact twofold-uniform frequency integral in the Prawitz remainder,
rescaled to the same real frequency variable used by the inversion integral. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_scaledDensity
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel) =
      (2 / T : ℝ) •
        ∫ t,
          (twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) := by
  rw [integral_twofoldUniformKernel_eq_integral_density]
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)
  have hcomp := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left g (T / 2)
  rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (div_pos hT (by norm_num)))] at hcomp
  have hfun :
      (fun z : ℝ => (twofoldUniformDensityReal z : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2))) =
        fun z => g ((T / 2) * z) := by
    funext z
    dsimp only [g]
    congr 3 <;> try ring
    field_simp [hT.ne']
  rw [hfun, hcomp]
  congr 1
  field_simp [hT.ne']

/-- The triangular frequency weight obtained by rescaling the density of the
sum of two independent uniform variables. -/
noncomputable def prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight (T t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (1 - |t| / T) 0 / T

theorem prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_of_mem_Icc
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T) :
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t = (1 - t / T) / T := by
  have hratio : t / T ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hT).2 htT
  unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
  rw [abs_of_nonneg ht0, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hratio)]

/-- Coefficient of the signed imaginary characteristic-function discrepancy
after expanding the real part of the Prawitz filter. -/
noncomputable def prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient (T t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) /
    (Real.pi * t)

theorem prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_nonneg
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t := by
  unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
  exact div_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hT.le

theorem prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_le_inv
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) :
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t ≤ 1 / T := by
  have hratio0 : 0 ≤ |t| / T := div_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) hT.le
  unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
  rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hT]
  exact max_le (by linarith) (by norm_num)

theorem prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_nonneg
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    0 ≤ prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t := by
  unfold prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient
  apply div_nonneg
  · rw [← scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2]
    unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
    exact prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_nonneg_of_mem_Ico
      (div_nonneg ht.1.le hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 ht.2)
  · exact mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le ht.1.le

theorem prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_le_inv
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t ≤ 1 / (Real.pi * t) := by
  unfold prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient
  have hden : 0 < Real.pi * t := mul_pos Real.pi_pos ht.1
  rw [div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hden]
  rw [← scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2]
  unfold scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
  exact prawitzSmoothingFilter_re_le_one_of_mem_Ico
    (div_nonneg ht.1.le hT.le) ((div_lt_one hT).2 ht.2)

/-- Inside the positive Prawitz window, the surviving imaginary-filter
coefficient is exactly twice the triangular Fejer weight. -/
theorem neg_two_mul_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_div_pi
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (q : ℝ) :
    (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im * q / t) / Real.pi =
      2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t * q := by
  rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2,
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_of_mem_Icc hT ht.1.le ht.2.le]
  field_simp [hT.ne', ht.1.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero]

/-- Inside the positive Prawitz window, the surviving real-filter coefficient
is exactly twice the cotangent frequency coefficient. -/
theorem two_mul_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_div_pi
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (q : ℝ) :
    (2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re * q / t) / Real.pi =
      2 * prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t * q := by
  rw [scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2]
  unfold prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient
  field_simp [ht.1.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero]

theorem two_div_mul_twofoldUniformDensityReal_scaled
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ) :
    (2 / T) * twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) =
      prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t := by
  unfold twofoldUniformDensityReal prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hT, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  by_cases ht : |t| ≤ T
  · have hratio : |t| / T ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hT).2 ht
    have hleft : 0 ≤ 2 - 2 * |t| / T := by
      calc
        0 ≤ 2 * (1 - |t| / T) :=
          mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.mpr hratio)
        _ = 2 - 2 * |t| / T := by ring
    have hright : 0 ≤ 1 - |t| / T := by
      linarith
    rw [max_eq_left hleft, max_eq_left hright]
    field_simp [hT.ne']
    ring
  · have ht' : T < |t| := lt_of_not_ge ht
    have hratio : 1 < |t| / T := (one_lt_div hT).2 ht'
    have hleft : 2 - 2 * |t| / T ≤ 0 := by
      calc
        2 - 2 * |t| / T = 2 * (1 - |t| / T) := by ring
        _ ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by norm_num)
          (sub_nonpos.mpr hratio.le)
    have hright : 1 - |t| / T ≤ 0 := by
      linarith
    rw [max_eq_right hleft, max_eq_right hright]
    ring

theorem integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Integrable (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T) := by
  have hscale : (2 / T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (by norm_num) hT.ne'
  have hdensity : Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      twofoldUniformDensityReal ((2 / T) * t)) :=
    integrable_twofoldUniformDensityReal.comp_mul_left' hscale
  have hscaled := hdensity.const_mul (2 / T)
  apply hscaled.congr
  exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [show (2 / T) * t = 2 * t / T by ring,
      two_div_mul_twofoldUniformDensityReal_scaled hT]

theorem prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_Icc
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∉ Icc (-T) T) :
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t = 0 := by
  have habs : T < |t| := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : |t| ≤ T := le_of_not_gt h
    exact ht (abs_le.mp hle)
  have hratio : 1 < |t| / T := (one_lt_div hT).2 habs
  unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
  rw [max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hratio.le)]
  simp

theorem prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_neg (T t : ℝ) :
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T (-t) =
      prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t := by
  simp only [prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight, abs_neg]

/-- Pair an integrable function on a symmetric closed window into its positive
and reflected positive-frequency sections. -/
theorem integral_Icc_neg_eq_integral_Icc_add_reflection
    (f : ℝ → ℂ) (hf : Integrable f) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc (-T) T, f t) =
      ∫ t in Icc 0 T, (f (-t) + f t) := by
  have hfNeg : Integrable (fun t => f (-t)) := hf.comp_neg
  have hFull :
      (∫ t in Icc (-T) T, f t) = ∫ t in (-T)..T, f t := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (neg_le_self hT)]
  have hPos :
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T, (f (-t) + f t)) =
        ∫ t in 0..T, (f (-t) + f t) := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hT]
  calc
    (∫ t in Icc (-T) T, f t) = ∫ t in (-T)..T, f t := hFull
    _ = (∫ t in (-T)..0, f t) + ∫ t in 0..T, f t :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        hf.intervalIntegrable hf.intervalIntegrable).symm
    _ = (∫ t in 0..T, f (-t)) + ∫ t in 0..T, f t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg]
      simp
    _ = ∫ t in 0..T, (f (-t) + f t) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_add
        hfNeg.intervalIntegrable hf.intervalIntegrable).symm
    _ = ∫ t in Icc 0 T, (f (-t) + f t) := hPos.symm

theorem const_mul_setIntegral_add_setIntegral_eq_integral_add
    (f g : ℝ → ℂ) (s : Set ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f s) (hg : IntegrableOn g s) (c : ℂ) :
    c * (∫ t in s, f t) + (∫ t in s, g t) =
      ∫ t in s, (c * f t + g t) := by
  calc
    c * (∫ t in s, f t) + (∫ t in s, g t) =
        (∫ t in s, c * f t) + (∫ t in s, g t) := by
      congr 1
      exact (integral_const_mul
        (μ := volume.restrict s) c f).symm
    _ = ∫ t in s, (c * f t + g t) :=
      (integral_add (hf.const_mul c) hg).symm

theorem integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun t =>
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) := by
  have h : Integrable (fun t =>
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) *
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ)) := by
    apply (integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight hT).ofReal.bdd_mul (c := 1)
    · fun_prop
    · exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
        exact MeasureTheory.norm_charFun_le_one t
  apply h.congr
  exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by ring

/-- The Prawitz reflection frequency integral with its exact triangular
Lebesgue weight on the whole real line. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_triangularIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel) =
      ∫ t,
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_scaledDensity mu hT x,
    Complex.real_smul]
  calc
    ((2 / T : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (∫ t,
          (twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) =
        ∫ t, ((2 / T : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ((twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) :=
      (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
    _ = ∫ t,
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by
        change ((2 / T : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ((twofoldUniformDensityReal (2 * t / T) : ℂ) *
                (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) =
          (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,
          two_div_mul_twofoldUniformDensityReal_scaled hT]

/-- The triangular weight vanishes off `[-T,T]`, so the reflection frequency
integral is exactly supported on the Prawitz window. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_triangularIntegral_Icc
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel) =
      ∫ t in Icc (-T) T,
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_triangularIntegral mu hT x,
    ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Icc (-T) T
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht]
      change (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) = 0
      rw [prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_eq_zero_of_not_mem_Icc hT ht]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]

/-- Positive-frequency pairing of the exact Prawitz reflection remainder. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_pairedTriangularIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel) =
      ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_triangularIntegral_Icc mu hT x]
  let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    simpa only [f] using integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand mu hT x
  rw [integral_Icc_neg_eq_integral_Icc_add_reflection f hf hT.le]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
  dsimp only [f]
  rw [prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_neg]
  rw [show -(x * -t) = x * t by ring]
  ring

theorem integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun t =>
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) := by
  let r : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)
  have hr : Integrable r := by
    simpa only [r] using
      integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand mu hT x
  apply (hr.comp_neg.add hr).congr
  exact ae_of_all volume fun t => by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_neg,
      show -(x * -t) = x * t by ring]
    ring

/-- For an arbitrary probability law, the real part of the paired triangular
reflection integrand is twice its positive-frequency phase coordinate. -/
theorem re_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand_charFun
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x t : ℝ) :
    ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)).re =
      2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re := by
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_neg]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

/-- The positive-frequency Fejér phase integral is exactly one half of a
translated sinc-squared average against the probability law. -/
theorem two_mul_integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_eq_sincSquare
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re) =
      ∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu := by
  have hsinc := integral_sincSquareWeight_eq_re_frequencyIntegral mu T x
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_pairedTriangularIntegral
    mu hT x] at hsinc
  have hpair : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand mu hT x).integrableOn
  calc
    2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re) =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        2 * (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
    _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)).re := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with t
      symm
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using
        re_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand_charFun mu T x t
    _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)).re := integral_re hpair
    _ = _ := hsinc.symm

/-- The real positive-frequency Fejér phase integral is nonnegative for
every probability law. -/
theorem integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_nonneg
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re := by
  have hsinc : 0 ≤ ∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu := by
    exact integral_nonneg fun y => sincSquareWeight_nonneg _
  have heq := two_mul_integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_eq_sincSquare
    mu hT x
  nlinarith

/-- The standard-normal characteristic function after multiplication by the
negative spatial phase has the expected Gaussian cosine real part. -/
theorem standardNormal_negativePhase_charFun_re (x t : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      MeasureTheory.charFun
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t).re =
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun]
  have hpos :
      -((t : ℂ) ^ 2) / 2 = (((-(t ^ 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    push_cast
    ring_nf
  rw [hpos, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
    Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  ring_nf

/-- Exact real part of the paired triangular reflection integrand for the
standard normal target. -/
theorem re_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand_standardNormal
    (T x t : ℝ) :
    ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re =
      2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun]
  have hneg :
      -(((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2) / 2 = (((-(t ^ 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hpos :
      -((t : ℂ) ^ 2) / 2 = (((-(t ^ 2) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hneg, hpos, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, zero_mul, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [Real.cos_neg]
  ring

/-- The exact Gaussian part of the paired positive-frequency Prawitz
integrand, before replacing its oscillatory cosine by the bound one. -/
noncomputable def prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)

/-- The signed Fejér part of the exact bidirectional law-phase envelope. -/
noncomputable def prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
    let d : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
      MeasureTheory.charFun
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
    let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      (q.re + 2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))

/-- The signed cotangent part of the exact bidirectional law-phase
envelope. -/
noncomputable def prawitzLawPhaseCotangentIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
    let d : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
      MeasureTheory.charFun
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
    let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d
    (-prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t * q.im)

/-- The exact bidirectional law-phase envelope: its signed Fejér coordinate
plus the absolute value of its signed cotangent coordinate. -/
noncomputable def prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral mu T x +
    |prawitzLawPhaseCotangentIntegral mu T x|

/-- Half of the exact Gaussian cosine remainder is a lower bound on the Fejér
part of the bidirectional law-phase envelope. -/
theorem half_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_le_lawPhaseFejerIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x ≤
      prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral mu T x := by
  unfold prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral
  let fmu : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re
  let fnormal : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t).re
  have hfmu : IntegrableOn fmu (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)).re) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand mu hT x).re.integrableOn
    simpa only [fmu, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using h
  have hfnormal : IntegrableOn fnormal (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re)
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).re.integrableOn
    simpa only [fnormal, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using h
  have hfmu0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t := by
    simpa only [fmu] using integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_nonneg mu hT x
  have htarget :
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let d : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
        let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (q.re + 2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) =
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t) +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t := by
    rw [← integral_add hfmu hfnormal]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    dsimp only [fmu, fnormal]
    rw [mul_sub, Complex.sub_re, mul_comm t x,
      standardNormal_negativePhase_charFun_re]
    ring
  have hgauss :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x =
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t := by
    unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
    rw [show (fun t : ℝ =>
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) =
        fun t => 2 * fnormal t by
      funext t
      dsimp only [fnormal]
      rw [standardNormal_negativePhase_charFun_re]
      ring,
      integral_const_mul]
    ring
  rw [htarget, hgauss]
  linarith

/-- Twice the Fejér coordinate of the exact law-phase envelope is the sum of
the translated sinc-squared smoothing masses of the law and the standard
normal. -/
theorem two_mul_prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral_eq_sincSquare_add
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    2 * prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral mu T x =
      (∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu) +
      ∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2)
        ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  let fmu : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).re
  let fnormal : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t).re
  have hfmu : IntegrableOn fmu (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun mu t)).re) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand mu hT x).re.integrableOn
    simpa only [fmu, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using h
  have hfnormal : IntegrableOn fnormal (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        ((prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re)
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_prawitzFejerFrequencyIntegrand
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).re.integrableOn
    simpa only [fnormal, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, sub_zero] using h
  have hsplit : prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral mu T x =
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t) +
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t := by
    unfold prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral
    rw [← integral_add hfmu hfnormal]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with t
    dsimp only [fmu, fnormal]
    rw [mul_sub, Complex.sub_re, mul_comm t x,
      standardNormal_negativePhase_charFun_re]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    2 * ((∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t) +
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t) =
        2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t) +
          2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show 2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fmu t) =
          ∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2) ∂mu by
        simpa only [fmu] using
          two_mul_integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_eq_sincSquare mu hT x,
        show 2 * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, fnormal t) =
          ∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2)
            ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw by
        simpa only [fnormal] using
          two_mul_integral_prawitzFejer_phase_re_eq_sincSquare
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x]

/-- For every fixed cutoff, the exact Gaussian cosine remainder is continuous
in the spatial parameter. -/
theorem continuous_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder (T : ℝ) :
    Continuous (prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T) := by
  unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  apply continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous
  · unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  · exact isCompact_Icc

/-- On every nonempty compact spatial interval, the exact Gaussian cosine
remainder attains its maximum. -/
theorem exists_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_isMaxOn_Icc
    (T : ℝ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ x ∈ Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Icc a b,
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T y ≤
        prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x := by
  simpa only [IsMaxOn] using
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (nonempty_Icc.mpr hab)
      (continuous_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T).continuousOn

/-- For a fixed Prawitz window, the exact Gaussian cosine remainder vanishes
in the positive spatial tail.  Thus the obstruction at `x = 0` is not a
uniform spatial floor; a sharper comparison may localize the remaining joint
frequency/spatial estimate to a bounded `x`-region. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atTop
    (T : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) T).indicator fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    have hamp : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
      apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
      unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
      fun_prop
    exact hamp.integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  have hscale :
      Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * x) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop
      (inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos))
  have hrl :=
    (tendsto_integral_cos_mul_atTop_of_integrable f hf).comp hscale
  convert hrl using 1
  funext x
  unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    simp only [f, Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
    have harg :
        2 * Real.pi * t * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * x) = x * t := by
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    rw [harg]
    ring
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, f, mul_zero]

/-- The exact Gaussian cosine remainder is even in the spatial parameter. -/
theorem prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_neg (T x : ℝ) :
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T (-x) =
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x := by
  unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [neg_mul, Real.cos_neg]

/-- For a fixed Prawitz window, the exact Gaussian cosine remainder also
vanishes in the negative spatial tail. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atBot
    (T : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
  have h := (tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atTop T).comp
    tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop
  refine Tendsto.congr' ?_ h
  filter_upwards with x
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_neg T x

/-- The forward Prawitz error with its characteristic-function phase and the
exact Gaussian cosine term kept together. -/
noncomputable def prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
            x t))).re +
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x

/-- The zero-spatial positive-frequency amplitude of a Prawitz difference. -/
noncomputable def prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) 0 t -
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) 0 t

/-- Real coordinate of the zero-phase Prawitz amplitude, retaining the real
and imaginary filter/discrepancy interaction exactly. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_re
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T t : ℝ) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu nu T t).re =
      ((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).re -
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).im) / t := by
  unfold prawitzZeroPhaseDifference prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
    Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
  rw [← sub_div, ← mul_sub]
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re]

/-- Imaginary coordinate of the zero-phase Prawitz amplitude, retaining the
real and imaginary filter/discrepancy interaction exactly. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_im
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T t : ℝ) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu nu T t).im =
      ((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).im +
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).re) / t := by
  unfold prawitzZeroPhaseDifference prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
    Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
  rw [← sub_div, ← mul_sub]
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im]

/-- Interior-window real coordinate after substituting the exact cotangent
and triangular coordinates of the scaled Prawitz filter. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_re_of_mem_Ioo
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu nu T t).re =
      (((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).re +
        ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).im) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_re mu nu T t,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2]
  ring

/-- Interior-window imaginary coordinate after substituting the exact
cotangent and triangular coordinates of the scaled Prawitz filter. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_im_of_mem_Ioo
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu nu T t).im =
      (((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).im -
        ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t).re) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_im mu nu T t,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2]
  ring

/-- Exact normalized-iid characteristic-function discrepancy as the power of
the common summand characteristic function minus the real Gaussian factor. -/
theorem charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X hX N).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1) -
        ((Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_charFun,
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw_normalizedCenteredIidSum
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t]
  have hcf := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.charFun_probabilityLaw
    (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))
  rw [hcf]
  congr 2
  · apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with omega
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_exp]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

/-- The zero-phase Prawitz difference is the scaled filter times the raw
characteristic-function discrepancy, divided by the real frequency. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_eq_filter_mul_charFun_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T t : ℝ) :
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu nu T t =
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
        (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t) / t := by
  unfold prawitzZeroPhaseDifference prawitzPVIntegrand prawitzPVNumerator
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
    Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
  rw [← sub_div, ← mul_sub]

/-- Exact normalized-iid discrepancy factorization into the one-step Taylor
residual, its full complex geometric coefficient, and the real Gaussian-proxy
correction. -/
theorem charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_taylorGeomSum
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X hX N).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t =
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) -
        ((1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
        complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)))
          (1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) (N + 1) +
        ((((1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (N + 1) -
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ) := by
  rw [charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N t]
  exact complex_pow_sub_real_eq_taylorGeomSum _ _ _ _

/-- Exact Taylor-product factorization inside the zero-phase Prawitz amplitude
for a normalized centered iid sum. No absolute value or complex norm is taken. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_taylorGeomSum
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t =
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
        ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) -
          ((1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
              (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)))
            (1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) (N + 1) +
          ((((1 - (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (N + 1) -
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ)) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_eq_filter_mul_charFun_sub,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_taylorGeomSum
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t]

/-- Real coordinate of a filtered complex Taylor residual times its geometric
coefficient, with a separate real correction and real frequency divisor. -/
theorem complex_mul_taylorProduct_div_re
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t : ℝ) :
    (k * (r * s + (c : ℂ)) / t).re =
      (k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
        k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t := by
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_re]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

/-- Imaginary coordinate of a filtered complex Taylor residual times its
geometric coefficient, with a separate real correction and real frequency
divisor. -/
theorem complex_mul_taylorProduct_div_im
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t : ℝ) :
    (k * (r * s + (c : ℂ)) / t).im =
      (k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
        k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t := by
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_im]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

/-- Real coordinate of a filtered conjugated complex Taylor residual times
its geometric coefficient, with a separate real correction and divisor. -/
theorem complex_mul_conj_taylorProduct_div_re
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t : ℝ) :
    (k * (starRingEnd ℂ) (r * s + (c : ℂ)) / t).re =
      (k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
        k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t := by
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_re]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, map_add, map_mul,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

/-- Imaginary coordinate of a filtered conjugated complex Taylor residual
times its geometric coefficient, with a separate real correction and divisor. -/
theorem complex_mul_conj_taylorProduct_div_im
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t : ℝ) :
    (k * (starRingEnd ℂ) (r * s + (c : ℂ)) / t).im =
      (-k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
        k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t := by
  rw [Complex.div_ofReal_im]
  simp only [Complex.mul_im, map_add, map_mul,
    Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

/-- Adding the forward and reflected Taylor phases cancels every real-filter
contribution, leaving only the imaginary filter coordinate. -/
theorem prawitzTaylorPhaseCoordinates_add
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t theta : ℝ) :
    (Real.sin theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
              k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
        Real.cos theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) +
      (-Real.sin theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
        Real.cos theta *
          ((-k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) =
      -2 * k.im *
        (Real.sin theta * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
          Real.cos theta * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t := by
  ring

/-- Subtracting the reflected Taylor phase from the forward phase cancels
every imaginary-filter contribution, leaving only the real filter coordinate. -/
theorem prawitzTaylorPhaseCoordinates_sub
    (k r s : ℂ) (c t theta : ℝ) :
    (Real.sin theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
              k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
        Real.cos theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) -
      (-Real.sin theta *
          ((k.re * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
        Real.cos theta *
          ((-k.re * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
              k.im * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) =
      2 * k.re *
        (Real.sin theta * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
          Real.cos theta * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t := by
  ring

/-- Exact real coordinate of the normalized-iid Prawitz Taylor-product
amplitude. The filter, residual, geometric coefficient, and real correction
remain separately visible. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
    let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
    let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
    let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
    let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
    let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).re =
      ((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_taylorGeomSum
    X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  exact complex_mul_taylorProduct_div_re _ _ _ _ _

/-- Exact imaginary coordinate of the normalized-iid Prawitz Taylor-product
amplitude. The filter, residual, geometric coefficient, and real correction
remain separately visible. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
    let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
    let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
    let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
    let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
    let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).im =
      ((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_taylorGeomSum
    X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  exact complex_mul_taylorProduct_div_im _ _ _ _ _

/-- Real coordinate of the exact normalized-iid characteristic-function
discrepancy. -/
theorem charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_re
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X hX N).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t).re =
      ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).re -
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
  rw [charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N t]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re]

/-- Imaginary coordinate of the exact normalized-iid characteristic-function
discrepancy; the Gaussian factor has zero imaginary part. -/
theorem charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_im
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X hX N).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t).im =
      ((MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).im := by
  rw [charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N t]
  simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]

/-- Interior Prawitz real amplitude for a normalized iid sum, with the powered
summand characteristic function and Gaussian factor exposed exactly. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_of_mem_Ioo
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).re =
      (((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) *
          (((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).re -
              Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) +
        ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).im) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_re_of_mem_Ioo _ _ hT ht,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_re
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_im
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t]

/-- Interior Prawitz imaginary amplitude for a normalized iid sum, with the
powered summand characteristic function and Gaussian factor exposed exactly. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_of_mem_Ioo
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X hX N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).im =
      (((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) *
          ((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).im -
        ((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) *
          (((MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
            (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) ^ (N + 1)).re -
              Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2))) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_im_of_mem_Ioo _ _ hT ht,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_re
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_im
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t]

/-- Exact sine/cosine coordinate expansion of the forward phase-preserving
Prawitz remainder. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (Real.sin (t * x) *
              (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).re -
            Real.cos (t * x) *
              (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).im) /
            Real.pi +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x t
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * z t
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hz : IntegrableOn z (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [z] using integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using hz.const_mul (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  unfold prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  change ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, z t)).re +
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t = _
  calc
    ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, z t)).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t =
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, P t).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
      congr 1
      exact congrArg Complex.re
        (integral_const_mul
          (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
          (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) z).symm
    _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (P t).re) +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ =>
        z + ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t) (integral_re hP).symm
    _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ((P t).re + G t) :=
      (integral_add hP.re hG).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with t
      dsimp only [P, z, G, prawitzZeroPhaseDifference]
      rw [prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero]
      rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re,
        Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
      simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div,
        zero_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
        Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
      ring

/-- The exact forward sine/cosine phase-coordinate integrand is integrable on
the closed Prawitz window. This is the analytic bridge for later signed
coordinate cancellations. -/
theorem integrableOn_prawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (Real.sin (t * x) *
            (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).re -
          Real.cos (t * x) *
            (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference mu
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T t).im) /
          Real.pi +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x t
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * z t
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hz : IntegrableOn z (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [z] using integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using hz.const_mul (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  apply (hP.re.add hG).congr
  filter_upwards with t
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  change Complex.re (P t) + G t = _
  dsimp only [P, z, G, prawitzZeroPhaseDifference]
  rw [prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero]
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re,
    Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div,
    zero_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  ring

/-- Exact Taylor-coordinate expansion of the forward phase-preserving Prawitz
remainder for a normalized centered iid sum. Every signed filter, residual,
geometric-coefficient, and real Gaussian-correction term remains visible. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_integral_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        (Real.sin (t * x) *
              (((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
                  (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
                    (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
            Real.cos (t * x) *
              (((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
                    (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
                  (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) /
            Real.pi +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
    law hLaw1 hT x]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]

/-- The phase-preserving forward Prawitz remainder is continuous in the
spatial parameter. -/
theorem continuous_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Continuous (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) := by
  unfold prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
  exact (Complex.continuous_re.comp
    (continuous_const.mul
      (continuous_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT))).add
    (continuous_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T)

/-- The phase-preserving forward Prawitz remainder vanishes in the positive
spatial tail. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atTop
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hphase : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul
        (tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atTop
          mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT) :
        Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
          (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
              (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                prawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t))) atTop (𝓝 ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * 0)))
  have hre := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphase
  have hgauss := tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atTop T
  simpa only [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder, mul_zero,
    Complex.zero_re, zero_add] using hre.add hgauss

/-- The phase-preserving forward Prawitz remainder also vanishes in the
negative spatial tail. -/
theorem tendsto_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atBot
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
  have hphase : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t))) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul
        (tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atBot
          mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT) :
        Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
          (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
              (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                prawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t))) atBot (𝓝 ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * 0)))
  have hre := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphase
  have hgauss := tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atBot T
  simpa only [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder, mul_zero,
    Complex.zero_re, zero_add] using hre.add hgauss

/-- A continuous real function vanishing in both tails has an
epsilon-accurate global upper bound given by a maximum on a symmetric compact
interval. -/
theorem exists_compact_max_le_global_max_epsilon_of_tendsto_zero
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f)
    (htop : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hbot : Tendsto f atBot (𝓝 0))
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ R x : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ x ∈ Icc (-R) R ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Icc (-R) R, f y ≤ f x) ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, f y ≤ max epsilon (f x) := by
  have htop' : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, f y < epsilon := by
    simpa only [sub_pos] using
      ((tendsto_order.1 htop).2 epsilon hepsilon)
  have hbot' : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atBot, f y < epsilon := by
    simpa only [sub_pos] using
      ((tendsto_order.1 hbot).2 epsilon hepsilon)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 htop'
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := eventually_atBot.1 hbot'
  let R : ℝ := max |a| |b|
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    exact (abs_nonneg a).trans (le_max_left |a| |b|)
  have hinterval : (-R : ℝ) ≤ R := by linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmax⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (nonempty_Icc.mpr hinterval)
      hf.continuousOn
  refine ⟨R, x, hR, hx, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Icc (-R) R
  · exact (hmax hy).trans (le_max_right epsilon (f x))
  by_cases hyleft : y < -R
  · have hnegR_le_b : -R ≤ b := by
      have habs : |b| ≤ R := by
        dsimp only [R]
        exact le_max_right |a| |b|
      exact (neg_le_neg habs).trans (neg_abs_le b)
    exact (hb y ((le_of_lt hyleft).trans hnegR_le_b)).le.trans
      (le_max_left epsilon (f x))
  · have hR_lt_y : R < y := by
      have hnegR_le_y : -R ≤ y := le_of_not_gt hyleft
      exact lt_of_not_ge fun hyR => hy ⟨hnegR_le_y, hyR⟩
    have ha_le_R : a ≤ R := by
      have habs : |a| ≤ R := by
        dsimp only [R]
