        exact le_max_left |a| |b|
      exact (le_abs_self a).trans habs
    exact (ha y (ha_le_R.trans (le_of_lt hR_lt_y))).le.trans
      (le_max_left epsilon (f x))

/-- The phase-preserving Prawitz remainder is globally controlled, up to any
positive epsilon, by an attained maximum on a symmetric compact interval. -/
theorem exists_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_compact_max_le_global
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ R x : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ x ∈ Icc (-R) R ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Icc (-R) R,
        prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T y ≤
          prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x) ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T y ≤
        max epsilon (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x) := by
  exact exists_compact_max_le_global_max_epsilon_of_tendsto_zero
    (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T)
    (continuous_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu hmu1 hT)
    (tendsto_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atTop mu hmu1 hT)
    (tendsto_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atBot mu hmu1 hT)
    hepsilon

/-- Exact truncation decomposition of the Gaussian Prawitz cosine term.  The
full positive-half-line transform is evaluated, while both the Gaussian tail
and the triangular first-moment correction remain signed. -/
theorem prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_eq_full_sub_tail_sub_correction
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / T) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) -
        (2 / T) * (∫ t in Ioi T,
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) -
        (2 / T ^ 2) * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          t * (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hgauss : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) := by
    have h := integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    apply h.congr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      ring
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    apply hgauss.mono' (by dsimp only [f]; fun_prop)
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (Real.exp_pos _).le
        (Real.abs_cos_le_one _)
  have htf : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t * f t) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [f]
    fun_prop
  have hsplit : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, f t) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) -
        ∫ t in Ioi T, f t := by
    have hsubset : Ici T ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hT ht
    have hdiff := integral_diff measurableSet_Ici hf.integrableOn hsubset
    have hset : Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Ici T = Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
      ext t
      simp only [mem_diff, mem_Ioi, mem_Ici, mem_Ioo]
      constructor
      · intro ht
        exact ⟨ht.1, lt_of_not_ge ht.2⟩
      · intro ht
        exact ⟨ht.1, not_le.mpr ht.2⟩
    rw [hset, integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi] at hdiff
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo, hdiff]
    rw [show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f t) =
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2) * Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) by
      simpa only [f] using integral_Ioi_rexp_neg_sq_div_two_mul_cos x]
  have hexpand : prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x =
      (2 / T) * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, f t) -
        (2 / T ^ 2) * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, t * f t) := by
    unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    have hfirst : IntegrableOn (fun t => (2 / T) * f t) (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (hf.const_mul (2 / T)).integrableOn
    have hsecond : IntegrableOn (fun t => (2 / T ^ 2) * (t * f t))
        (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (htf.mono_set Ioo_subset_Icc_self).const_mul (2 / T ^ 2)
    rw [show (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) =
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
          (2 / T) * f t - (2 / T ^ 2) * (t * f t) by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
      intro t ht
      dsimp only
      rw [prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_of_mem_Icc hT ht.1.le ht.2.le]
      dsimp only [f]
      field_simp [hT.ne']]
    rw [integral_sub hfirst hsecond, integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul]
    rw [← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    rw [show (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, t * f t) =
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, t * f t by
      exact integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo.symm]
  rw [hexpand, hsplit]
  dsimp only [f]
  ring

/-- The finite Gaussian Prawitz cosine remainder is uniformly maximized at
spatial frequency zero. -/
theorem prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_le_zero
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x ≤
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 := by
  unfold prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  have hleft : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  have hright : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (0 * t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  apply integral_mono hleft hright
  intro t
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_nonneg hT t))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le
  simpa only [zero_mul, Real.cos_zero, mul_one] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cos_le_one (x * t)) hcoef

/-- Exact value of the uniform Gaussian Prawitz remainder.  Compared with the
half-line extension, it retains both the missing Gaussian tail and the
strictly positive triangular correction. -/
theorem prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_zero
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 =
      (2 / T) * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) -
      (2 / T ^ 2) * (1 - Real.exp (-(T ^ 2) / 2)) := by
  have hdecomp :=
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_eq_full_sub_tail_sub_correction hT 0
  have hgauss : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) := by
    have h := integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    apply h.congr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      ring
  have hsubset : Ici T ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro t ht
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hT ht
  have hdiff := integral_diff measurableSet_Ici hgauss.integrableOn hsubset
  have hset : Ioi (0 : ℝ) \ Ici T = Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_Ioi, mem_Ici, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · intro ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, lt_of_not_ge ht.2⟩
    · intro ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, not_le.mpr ht.2⟩
  rw [hset, integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi] at hdiff
  have hmass : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2 -
        ∫ t in Ioi T, Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo, hdiff]
    rw [show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) =
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2 by
      simpa using integral_Ioi_rexp_neg_sq_div_two_mul_cos 0]
  simp only [zero_mul, Real.cos_zero, mul_one] at hdecomp
  have hexpZero : Real.exp (-((0 : ℝ) ^ 2) / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [show -((0 : ℝ) ^ 2) / 2 = 0 by norm_num, Real.exp_zero]
  rw [hexpZero, mul_one] at hdecomp
  rw [integral_Icc_mul_rexp_neg_sq_div_two hT] at hdecomp
  rw [hmass]
  rw [hdecomp]
  ring

/-- For every sufficiently wide window, the exact finite Gaussian remainder
still exceeds the reciprocal cutoff.  This is the rational core of the
coefficient-one obstruction; no numerical Gaussian approximation is used. -/
theorem one_div_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_zero
    {T : ℝ} (hT6 : 6 ≤ T) :
    1 / T < prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 := by
  have hT : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hT6
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let p : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 1 - t ^ 2 / 2
  have hp : IntegrableOn p (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [p]
    fun_prop
  have hf : IntegrableOn f (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [f]
    fun_prop
  have hfOne : IntegrableOn f (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [f]
    fun_prop
  have hpoint : ∀ t, p t ≤ f t := by
    intro t
    dsimp only [p, f]
    convert Real.add_one_le_exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) using 1; ring
  have hpoly : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, p t) = 5 / 6 := by
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) volume 0 1 :=
      (continuous_id.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_const (h2.div_const 2),
      intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_one, integral_pow]
    norm_num
  have hsmall : 5 / 6 ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f t := by
    rw [← hpoly]
    exact setIntegral_mono hp hfOne hpoint
  have hsubset : Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans (by linarith)⟩
  have hmass : 5 / 6 ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, f t := by
    exact hsmall.trans (setIntegral_mono_set hf
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) fun t => by
        dsimp only [f]
        positivity)
      hsubset.eventuallyLE)
  have hcorr : 1 - Real.exp (-(T ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 := by
    linarith [Real.exp_pos (-(T ^ 2) / 2)]
  rw [prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_zero hT]
  calc
    1 / T < (2 / T) * (5 / 6) - (2 / T ^ 2) * 1 := by
      field_simp [hT.ne']
      nlinarith
    _ ≤ (2 / T) * (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, f t) -
          (2 / T ^ 2) * (1 - Real.exp (-(T ^ 2) / 2)) := by
      exact sub_le_sub
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcorr (by positivity))
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- For every sufficiently wide window, the exact bidirectional law-phase
envelope has a strict reciprocal-cutoff floor at the spatial origin. -/
theorem one_div_two_mul_lt_prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope_zero
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT6 : 6 ≤ T) :
    1 / (2 * T) < prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope mu T 0 := by
  have hT : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hT6
  have hgauss : 1 / T < prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 :=
    one_div_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_zero hT6
  have hhalf :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 ≤
        prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral mu T 0 :=
    half_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_le_lawPhaseFejerIntegral mu hT 0
  have hstrict :
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / T) <
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgauss (by norm_num)
  have hscale : 1 / (2 * T) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / T) := by
    field_simp
  rw [prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope, hscale]
  exact (hstrict.trans_le hhalf).trans_le
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _))

/-- At unit standardized third moment, every admissible tunable parameter has
large-sample windows on which the exact Gaussian remainder alone exceeds the
coefficient-one Berry scale. -/
theorem inverse_sqrt_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_admissible_unit
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {N : ℕ}
    (hcut : 6 ≤ admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c 1 N) :
    1 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
        (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c 1 N) 0 := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let m : ℝ := max 1 c
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c 1 N
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := by
    dsimp only [m]
    exact le_max_left 1 c
  have hm0 : 0 < m := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hm
  have hT : T = s / m := by
    dsimp only [T, s, m]
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max hc
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) N
  have hinv : 1 / s ≤ 1 / T := by
    rw [hT, show 1 / (s / m) = m / s by field_simp [hs.ne', hm0.ne']]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hs).2 hm
  simpa only [T, s] using
    hinv.trans_lt (one_div_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_zero hcut)

/-- Every positive tunable parameter admits a sample size whose unit-moment
admissible cutoff is at least six. -/
theorem exists_nat_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_unit_ge_six
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧
      6 ≤ admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c 1 N := by
  let m : ℝ := max 1 c
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := by
    dsimp only [m]
    exact le_max_left 1 c
  have hm0 : 0 < m := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hm
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((6 * m) ^ 2)
  have hNpos : 1 ≤ N := by
    rw [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
    intro hzero
    subst N
    norm_num at hN
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (6 * m)]
  have hsquare : (6 * m) ^ 2 ≤ (N + 1 : ℕ) := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hN ⊢
    linarith
  refine ⟨N, hNpos, ?_⟩
  rw [admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max hc
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1), mul_one]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hm0]
  exact (Real.le_sqrt (by positivity) (by positivity)).2 (by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hsquare)

/-- Consequently, for every positive tunable parameter there is a valid
large-sample unit-third-moment regime in which the exact finite Gaussian
remainder alone exceeds the source's coefficient-one Berry scale. -/
theorem exists_inverse_sqrt_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_admissible_unit
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧
      1 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
        prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c 1 N) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hcut⟩ :=
    exists_nat_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_unit_ge_six hc
  exact ⟨N, hN,
    inverse_sqrt_lt_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_admissible_unit hc hcut⟩

/-- Pointwise real normal form of the forward cancellation-preserving
integrand at positive frequency. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re =
      -(Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).im /
          (Real.pi * t) +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [Complex.add_re,
    re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun mu)
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) x ht,
    re_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand_standardNormal]
  rw [← Complex.sub_im, prawitzPVNumerator_sub]

/-- The real forward integrand equals the real part of the positive-frequency
phase-preserving difference plus the exact Gaussian cosine contribution. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_phasePreserving
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re =
      ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
            x t)).re +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq mu ht x]
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand
  rw [← sub_div, ← prawitzPVNumerator_sub]
  congr 1
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im,
    Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im]
  simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div, zero_mul]
  field_simp [ht, Real.pi_ne_zero]
  ring

/-- Interior-window expansion of the forward signed integrand. It isolates
the cotangent coefficient of the imaginary characteristic-function error and
the triangular coefficient of its real part, while retaining the exact
Gaussian term. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_expanded
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re =
      -prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t *
          (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).im +
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq mu ht.1.ne' x]
  let q : ℂ :=
    Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  have hprod :
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) =
        scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t * q := by
    dsimp only [q]
    ring
  rw [hprod, Complex.mul_im,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2,
    scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_of_mem_Ico hT ht.1.le ht.2,
    prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_of_mem_Icc hT ht.1.le ht.2.le]
  change
    -(((1 - t / T) * prawitzCotFactor (t / T) + t / T) * q.im +
        -((1 - t / T) * Real.pi * (t / T)) * q.re) /
          (Real.pi * t) +
        2 * ((1 - t / T) / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) *
          Real.cos (x * t) = _
  unfold prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient
  dsimp only [q]
  field_simp [hT.ne', ht.1.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero]
  ring

/-- Pointwise signed majorant which bounds only the characteristic-function
components and keeps the oscillatory Gaussian term exact. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_with_exactGaussian
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t +
          prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t) *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_expanded mu hT ht x]
  let q : ℂ :=
    Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  let c := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t
  let w := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_nonneg hT ht
  have hw : 0 ≤ w := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_nonneg hT t
  have hqnorm :
      ‖q‖ = ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  have hIm : -c * q.im ≤ c * ‖q‖ := by
    calc
      -c * q.im = c * (-q.im) := by ring
      _ ≤ c * ‖q‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((neg_le_abs q.im).trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm q)) hc
  have hRe : w * q.re ≤ w * ‖q‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Complex.re_le_norm q) hw
  change -c * q.im + w * q.re +
      2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) ≤
    (c + w) *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ +
      2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  rw [← hqnorm]
  linarith

/-- Pointwise quantitative majorant obtained from the signed normal form. The
two characteristic-function components retain their distinct exact weights;
only the final scalar components are bounded by the discrepancy norm. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t +
          prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t) *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
  rw [re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_expanded mu hT ht x]
  let q : ℂ :=
    Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  let c := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t
  let w := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_nonneg hT ht
  have hw : 0 ≤ w := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_nonneg hT t
  have hqnorm :
      ‖q‖ = ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
        MeasureTheory.charFun
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  have hIm : -c * q.im ≤ c * ‖q‖ := by
    calc
      -c * q.im = c * (-q.im) := by ring
      _ ≤ c * ‖q‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        ((neg_le_abs q.im).trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm q)) hc
  have hRe : w * q.re ≤ w * ‖q‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Complex.re_le_norm q) hw
  have hGauss :
      2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) ≤
        2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ 2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by positivity
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cos_le_one (x * t)) hcoef
  change -c * q.im + w * q.re +
      2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) ≤
    (c + w) *
        ‖MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t‖ +
      2 * w * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  rw [← hqnorm]
  linarith

/-- Universal coefficient form of the signed pointwise majorant on the open
Prawitz window. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_discrepancyQuotient
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t +
        (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
  have hbase := re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le mu hT ht x
  have hc := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_le_inv hT ht
  have hw := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_le_inv hT ht.1.le
  have hq := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg mu
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
  have hnorm := norm_charFun_sub_eq_abs_mul_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ht.1.ne'
  rw [abs_of_pos ht.1] at hnorm
  rw [hnorm] at hbase
  calc
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
        (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t +
            prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t) *
          (t * charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := hbase
    _ ≤ (1 / (Real.pi * t) + 1 / T) *
          (t * charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
        2 * (1 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hc hw)
          (mul_nonneg ht.1.le hq)
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by norm_num))
          (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t +
        (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hT.ne', ht.1.ne']

/-- Universal coefficient form of the signed majorant with the finite-window
Gaussian cosine contribution left unchanged. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_discrepancyQuotient_with_exactGaussian
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  have hbase := re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_with_exactGaussian
    mu hT ht x
  have hc := prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient_le_inv hT ht
  have hw := prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight_le_inv hT ht.1.le
  have hq := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg mu
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
  have hnorm := norm_charFun_sub_eq_abs_mul_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ht.1.ne'
  rw [abs_of_pos ht.1] at hnorm
  rw [hnorm] at hbase
  calc
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
        (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t +
            prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t) *
          (t * charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := hbase
    _ ≤ (1 / (Real.pi * t) + 1 / T) *
          (t * charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hc hw)
          (mul_nonneg ht.1.le hq)) le_rfl
    _ = (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, hT.ne', ht.1.ne']

/-- Exact frequency-space form of the standard-normal Fejer remainder in the
Prawitz comparison. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_eq_re_frequencyIntegral
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y))
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) =
      (∫ z,
        Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
            (T * z / 2)
        ∂twofoldUniformKernel).re := by
  simp_rw [prawitzPointKernel_reflection_eq_sinc_sq hT]
  change (∫ y, sincSquareWeight (T * (y - x) / 2)
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) = _
  exact integral_sincSquareWeight_eq_re_frequencyIntegral
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw T x

/-- Exact mass of every translated, positively scaled Fejér profile. -/
theorem integral_sinc_sq_half_scale {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y : ℝ, Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2) =
      2 * Real.pi / T := by
  have hcomp := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left
    (fun z : ℝ => sincSquareWeight z) (T / 2)
  rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (div_pos hT (by norm_num)))] at hcomp
  have htrans :
      (∫ y : ℝ, sincSquareWeight ((T / 2) * (y - x))) =
        ∫ y : ℝ, sincSquareWeight ((T / 2) * y) := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
      (MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
        (μ := volume) (fun y : ℝ => sincSquareWeight ((T / 2) * y)) (-x))
  rw [show (fun y : ℝ => Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2) =
      fun y => sincSquareWeight ((T / 2) * (y - x)) by
        funext y
        unfold sincSquareWeight
        congr 2
        ring,
    htrans]
  rw [integral_sincSquareWeight] at hcomp
  calc
    (∫ y : ℝ, sincSquareWeight (T / 2 * y)) =
        (T / 2)⁻¹ • Real.pi := hcomp
    _ = 2 * Real.pi / T := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [hT.ne']

/-- Integrability companion to the exact translated Fejér mass. -/
theorem integrable_sinc_sq_half_scale {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2) := by
  have hscale : (T / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hT.ne' (by norm_num)
  have hscaled : Integrable
      (fun y : ℝ => sincSquareWeight ((T / 2) * y)) :=
    integrable_sincSquareWeight.comp_mul_left' hscale
  have htranslated :=
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume (-x)).integrable_comp_of_integrable hscaled
  apply htranslated.congr
  filter_upwards with y
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, sincSquareWeight]
  congr 2
  ring

/-- The reflected Prawitz remainder against the standard normal is bounded
by the sharp density supremum times the exact Fejér mass. -/
theorem integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_le
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y))
      ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let k : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => Real.sinc (T * (y - x) / 2) ^ 2
  let c : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹
  have hk : Integrable k := by
    simpa only [k] using integrable_sinc_sq_half_scale hT x
  have hkNonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ k y := fun y => by dsimp only [k]; positivity
  have hpdf : Integrable (fun y =>
      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y * k y) := by
    have hmajor : Integrable (fun y => c * k y) := hk.const_mul c
    apply hmajor.mono' (by fun_prop)
    exact ae_of_all volume fun y => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 1 y)
          (hkNonneg y))]
      have hbound : ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y ≤ c := by
        rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
        have hexp : Real.exp (-(y ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
          Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y])
        simpa only [mul_one, c] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp
          (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)))
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (hkNonneg y)
  have hle :
      (∫ y, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y * k y) ≤
        ∫ y, c * k y := by
    apply integral_mono hpdf (hk.const_mul c)
    intro y
    have hbound : ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y ≤ c := by
      rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw_pdf]
      have hexp : Real.exp (-(y ^ 2) / 2) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y])
      simpa only [mul_one, c] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp
        (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * Real.pi)))
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (hkNonneg y)
  rw [integral_const_mul, show (∫ y, k y) = 2 * Real.pi / T by
    simpa only [k] using integral_sinc_sq_half_scale hT x] at hle
  simp_rw [prawitzPointKernel_reflection_eq_sinc_sq hT]
  change (∫ y, k y
    ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T)
  rw [NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw]
  have hone : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  have hgauss :
      (∫ y, k y ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1) =
        ∫ y, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 y • k y :=
    ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul hone
  rw [hgauss]
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, k, c] using hle

/-- One-sided Prawitz comparison against the standard normal with both the
signed frequency integral and reflected Fejer remainder kept exact. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_signed
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t)).re +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y))
        ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have hsigned :=
    cdf_sub_cdf_le_re_prawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  rw [re_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x] at hsigned
  exact hsigned

/-- The forward standard-normal Prawitz comparison with the inversion and
Fejer terms combined inside one real part before any norm estimate. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_signed_frequency
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                x t)) +
        ∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
              (T * z / 2)
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel).re := by
  have hsigned := cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_signed
    mu hmu1 hT x
  rw [integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_eq_re_frequencyIntegral
    hT x] at hsigned
  simpa only [Complex.add_re] using hsigned

/-- The forward comparison as one signed positive-frequency integral. This is
the cancellation-preserving form: no norm or pointwise absolute value has yet
separated the Prawitz and Fejer contributions. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                x t) +
          (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
              Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re := by
  have hsigned := cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_signed_frequency
    mu hmu1 hT x
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_pairedTriangularIntegral
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x] at hsigned
  have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    mu hmu1 hT x
  have hnormal := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hP := (hmu.sub hnormal).const_mul
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hR : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t))
      (Icc 0 T) :=
    (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
  have hcombine :
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                x t)) +
        (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
              Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)) =
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
              (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t) +
            (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
                Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) := by
    calc
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
              (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t)) +
          (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
                Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)) =
          (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
              (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t)) +
          (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
                Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)) := by
        congr 1
        exact (integral_const_mul
          (μ := volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))
          (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
          (fun t =>
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                x t)).symm
      _ = ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
              (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t) +
            (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
                Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                  MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) :=
        (integral_add hP hR).symm
  rw [hcombine] at hsigned
  exact hsigned

/-- The forward signed CDF error is bounded by a single remainder that keeps
the characteristic-function phase and exact Gaussian cosine term together.
This is the cancellation-preserving bridge used for the remaining compact
spatial analysis. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
  have hsigned := cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    mu hmu1 hT x
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
            x t) +
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
          x t)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      mu hmu1 hT x
    have hnormal := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
    have hP := (hmu.sub hnormal).const_mul
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
    have hR : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t))
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
    simpa only [F] using hP.add hR
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using
      (integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x).const_mul
          (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  have heq : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re =
      prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
    calc
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re =
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re :=
        (integral_re hF).symm
      _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ((P t).re + G t) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [
          (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne 0] with t ht
        dsimp only [F, P, G]
        exact re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_phasePreserving mu ht x
      _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, P t).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
        exact (integral_add hP.re hG).trans
          (congrArg (fun z : ℝ =>
            z + ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t) (integral_re hP))
      _ = prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
        dsimp only [P, G]
        unfold prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
          prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
        congr 1
        exact congrArg Complex.re
          (integral_const_mul
            (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
            (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
            (fun t =>
              prawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
                prawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                  x t))
  simpa only [F] using hsigned.trans_eq heq

/-- One-sided Prawitz smoothing against the standard normal, with exact
frequency coefficient `1/π` and exact Fejér spatial remainder. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf mu x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  have hsigned :=
    cdf_sub_cdf_le_norm_prawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hfreq := norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hreflect := integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_le hT x
  exact hsigned.trans (add_le_add hfreq hreflect)

/-- The law obtained by reflecting a real-valued law through the origin. -/
noncomputable def reflectedLaw (mu : Measure ℝ) : Measure ℝ :=
  mu.map ((-1 : ℝ) * ·)

/-- Reflection preserves total probability mass. -/
theorem reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) := by
  unfold reflectedLaw
  exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)

/-- Reflection preserves finiteness of the first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu) :
    Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (reflectedLaw mu) := by
  unfold reflectedLaw
  rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  convert hmu1 using 1
  ext y
  simp

/-- The characteristic function of a reflected law is evaluated at the
opposite frequency. -/
theorem charFun_reflectedLaw (mu : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu) t =
      MeasureTheory.charFun mu (-t) := by
  unfold reflectedLaw
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_map_mul]
  congr 1
  ring

/-- Simultaneous reflection conjugates the raw characteristic-function
discrepancy while leaving the complex Prawitz filter itself in place. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflectedLaw_eq_filter_mul_conj_charFun_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T t : ℝ) :
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference (reflectedLaw mu) (reflectedLaw nu) T t =
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
        (starRingEnd ℂ)
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t) / t := by
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_eq_filter_mul_charFun_sub,
    charFun_reflectedLaw, charFun_reflectedLaw,
    MeasureTheory.charFun_neg, MeasureTheory.charFun_neg]
  simp only [map_sub]

/-- Exact conjugated Taylor-product factorization of the reflected
normalized-iid zero-phase Prawitz amplitude. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_conj_taylorGeomSum
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
    let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
    let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
    let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
    let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
    let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (reflectedLaw law)
        (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        T t =
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (r * s + (c : ℂ)) / t := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflectedLaw_eq_filter_mul_conj_charFun_sub,
    charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_taylorGeomSum
      X hX hIndep hIdent N t]

/-- Real coordinate of the exact reflected normalized-iid Prawitz Taylor
product. Reflection changes the discrepancy cross-term signs by conjugation. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
    let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
    let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
    let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
    let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
    let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (reflectedLaw law)
        (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        T t).re =
      ((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_conj_taylorGeomSum
    X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  exact complex_mul_conj_taylorProduct_div_re _ _ _ _ _

/-- Imaginary coordinate of the exact reflected normalized-iid Prawitz Taylor
product. Reflection changes the discrepancy cross-term signs by conjugation. -/
theorem prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) (T t : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
    let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
    let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
    let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
    let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
    let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
    (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference
        (reflectedLaw law)
        (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        T t).im =
      (-(scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
        (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
          (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_conj_taylorGeomSum
    X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  exact complex_mul_conj_taylorProduct_div_im _ _ _ _ _

/-- Simultaneous reflection preserves the characteristic-function discrepancy
quotient. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_reflectedLaw
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient (reflectedLaw mu) (reflectedLaw nu) t =
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  unfold charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · simp [ht]
  · rw [if_neg ht, if_neg ht, charFun_reflectedLaw, charFun_reflectedLaw,
      MeasureTheory.charFun_neg, MeasureTheory.charFun_neg,
      ← map_sub, Complex.norm_conj]

/-- The reflected translated point-kernel integral is the real part of the
Prawitz inversion functional of the reflected law. -/
theorem integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu) =
      (prawitzInversion T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x)).re := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  have hRef1 := integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1
  have hForward := integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub
    (reflectedLaw mu) hRef1 hT (-x)
  have hMap :
      (∫ z, prawitzPointKernel T (z - (-x)) ∂reflectedLaw mu) =
        ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂mu := by
    unfold reflectedLaw
    rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) hForward.aestronglyMeasurable]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all mu fun y => congrArg (prawitzPointKernel T) (by ring)
  rw [← hMap]
  exact integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
    (reflectedLaw mu) hRef1 hT (-x)

/-- Frequency-space form of the expected signed imbalance.  The centered-CDF
term is retained explicitly, recording the part not supplied by the compact
Prawitz inversion. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_re_inversions_sub_centeredCDF
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) =
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x).re -
        (prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x)).re -
        (2 * cdf mu x - 1) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_pointKernelDifference_sub_centeredCDF
      mu x
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub mu hmu1 hT x),
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion mu hmu1 hT x,
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
      mu hmu1 hT x]

/-- Exact reverse one-sided CDF comparison, retaining the real part of the
reflected Prawitz inversion difference before taking its norm. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_re_reflectedPrawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu := by
  have hNu := cdf_sub_half_le_integral_prawitzPointKernel nu hT x
    (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hMu := neg_integral_prawitzPointKernel_le_cdf_sub_half mu hT x
    (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
  have hNuForward := integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hNuReflected :=
    integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hMuEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
      mu hmu1 hT x
  have hNuEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
      nu hnu1 hT x
  have hSum :
      (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu) =
        (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu :=
    integral_add hNuForward hNuReflected
  rw [Complex.sub_re, ← hMuEq, ← hNuEq, hSum]
  linarith

/-- The reverse one-sided CDF comparison, expressed through Prawitz inversion
of reflected laws and the same point-kernel reflection remainder. -/
theorem cdf_sub_cdf_le_norm_reflectedPrawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf nu x - cdf mu x ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
        prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu := by
  have hNu := cdf_sub_half_le_integral_prawitzPointKernel nu hT x
    (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hMu := neg_integral_prawitzPointKernel_le_cdf_sub_half mu hT x
    (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
  have hNuForward := integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hNuReflected :=
    integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x
  have hMuEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
      mu hmu1 hT x
  have hNuEq :=
    integral_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub_eq_re_prawitzInversion
      nu hnu1 hT x
  have hSum :
      (∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y)) ∂nu) =
        (∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) ∂nu) +
          ∫ y, prawitzPointKernel T (x - y) ∂nu :=
    integral_add hNuForward hNuReflected
  have hRe :
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ :=
    Complex.re_le_norm _
  rw [Complex.sub_re] at hRe
  rw [← hMuEq, ← hNuEq] at hRe
  rw [hSum]
  linarith

/-- Simultaneous reflection leaves the weighted positive-frequency Prawitz
discrepancy estimate unchanged. -/
theorem norm_prawitzInversion_reflectedLaw_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw nu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure nu
  have hmuRef := integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1
  have hnuRef := integrable_abs_reflectedLaw nu hnu1
  have h := norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
    (reflectedLaw mu) (reflectedLaw nu) hmuRef hnuRef hT (-x)
  simpa only [charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_reflectedLaw] using h

/-- Subtracting the expected slack imbalances of two laws separates into the
two Prawitz inversion differences and twice their signed CDF difference. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_cdfDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu) =
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re -
      (prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re -
      2 * (cdf mu x - cdf nu x) := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_re_inversions_sub_centeredCDF
      mu hmu1 hT x,
    integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_eq_re_inversions_sub_centeredCDF
      nu hnu1 hT x]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re]
  ring

/-- The expected imbalance difference is controlled by the forward and
reflected inversion discrepancies together with twice the CDF gap. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_le_inversions_add_two_mul_cdfGap
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ +
      ‖prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ +
      2 * cdfGap mu nu x := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_cdfDifference
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x]
  let A : ℂ := prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x
  let B : ℂ := prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
    prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)
  let d : ℝ := cdf mu x - cdf nu x
  change |A.re - B.re - 2 * d| ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + 2 * |d|
  calc
    |A.re - B.re - 2 * d| ≤ |A.re - B.re| + |2 * d| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (|A.re| + |B.re|) + |2 * d| :=
      add_le_add (abs_sub A.re B.re) le_rfl
    _ = |A.re| + |B.re| + 2 * |d| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + 2 * |d| := by
      gcongr
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm A
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm B

/-- Applying the common positive-frequency discrepancy estimate to both
inversion terms exposes the factor-two CDF-gap feedback in the imbalance
comparison. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_le_two_mul_discrepancy_add_two_mul_cdfGap
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalance T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      2 * ((1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) +
      2 * cdfGap mu nu x := by
  have himbalance :=
    abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_le_inversions_add_two_mul_cdfGap
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hforward :=
    norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hreflected :=
    norm_prawitzInversion_reflectedLaw_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  linarith

/-- After removing the diagonal atom, the exact two-law imbalance retains one
closed-CDF difference and one strict-lower-tail difference, with their signs
kept explicit. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_cdf_sub_Iio
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu) =
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re -
      (prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re -
      (cdf mu x - cdf nu x) -
      (mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)) := by
  have himbalance :=
    integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_cdfDifference
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hsplit :=
    integral_prawitzSlackImbalance_sub_eq_offDiagonal_sub_atomDifference
      mu nu x
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub mu hmu1 hT x)
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
      (integrable_prawitzPointKernel_reflected_sub nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hatom := measureReal_singleton_sub_eq_cdf_sub_sub_Iio mu nu x
  linarith

/-- Midpoint-CDF form of the exact off-diagonal imbalance identity.  The two
CDF-side coordinates combine into twice their atom-symmetric midpoint. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_midpointCDFDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu) =
      (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x).re -
      (prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re -
      2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_cdf_sub_Iio
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x, midpointCDFDifference_eq]
  ring

/-- Taking norms in the midpoint-CDF identity keeps the residual CDF term as
one canonical quantity with its exact coefficient two. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_inversions_add_two_mul_midpointCDFDifference
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ +
      ‖prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ +
      2 * |midpointCDFDifference mu nu x| := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_midpointCDFDifference
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x]
  let A : ℂ := prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x
  let B : ℂ := prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
    prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)
  let d : ℝ := midpointCDFDifference mu nu x
  change |A.re - B.re - 2 * d| ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + 2 * |d|
  calc
    |A.re - B.re - 2 * d| ≤ |A.re - B.re| + |2 * d| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (|A.re| + |B.re|) + |2 * d| :=
      add_le_add (abs_sub A.re B.re) le_rfl
    _ = |A.re| + |B.re| + 2 * |d| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + 2 * |d| := by
      gcongr
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm A
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm B

/-- The off-diagonal imbalance difference is bounded by both inversion norms
plus its closed and strict-lower CDF coordinates. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_inversions_add_cdf_coordinates
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      ‖prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x‖ +
      ‖prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)‖ +
      cdfGap mu nu x +
      |mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)| := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_cdf_sub_Iio
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x]
  let A : ℂ := prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x -
    prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x
  let B : ℂ := prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
    prawitzInversion T
      (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)
  let d : ℝ := cdf mu x - cdf nu x
  let o : ℝ := mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)
  change |A.re - B.re - d - o| ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + |d| + |o|
  calc
    |A.re - B.re - d - o| ≤ |A.re - B.re - d| + |o| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ (|A.re - B.re| + |d|) + |o| :=
      add_le_add (abs_sub (A.re - B.re) d) le_rfl
    _ ≤ ((|A.re| + |B.re|) + |d|) + |o| := by
      gcongr
      exact abs_sub A.re B.re
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ + ‖B‖ + |d| + |o| := by
      gcongr
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm A
      · exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm B

/-- Applying the common frequency discrepancy estimate to both inversion
coordinates leaves exactly the two CDF-side coordinates. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_two_mul_discrepancy_add_cdf_coordinates
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      2 * ((1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) +
      cdfGap mu nu x +
      |mu.real (Iio x) - nu.real (Iio x)| := by
  have hoff :=
    abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_inversions_add_cdf_coordinates
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hforward :=
    norm_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hreflected :=
    norm_prawitzInversion_reflectedLaw_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  linarith

/-- Fully separating the two CDF coordinates recovers the same coefficient
two in Kolmogorov distance. -/
theorem abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_two_mul_discrepancy_add_two_mul_kolmogorovDistance
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu)| ≤
      2 * ((1 / Real.pi) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu nu t) +
      2 * kolmogorovDistance mu nu := by
  have hoff :=
    abs_integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_le_two_mul_discrepancy_add_cdf_coordinates
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  have hClosed := cdfGap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  have hOpen := measureReal_Iio_gap_le_kolmogorovDistance mu nu x
  linarith

/-- Exact signed-integral representation for the reflected Prawitz inversion
difference used in the reverse CDF comparison. -/
theorem re_reflectedPrawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
