    (prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) -
        prawitzInversion T (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x)).re =
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t)).re := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw nu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure nu
  exact re_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
    (reflectedLaw mu) (reflectedLaw nu)
    (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
    (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw nu hnu1) hT (-x)

/-- The joint positive-frequency integrand that retains the forward,
reflected, and midpoint-CDF coordinates before any triangle inequality. -/
noncomputable def midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T x t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t) -
    (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t) +
    (((4 * Real.pi / T * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.I)

/-- The joint forward/reflected/midpoint integrand is integrable on every
positive frequency window under finite first moments. -/
theorem integrableOn_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x)
      (Icc 0 T) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw nu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure nu
  have hForward : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
        symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t)
      (Icc 0 T) :=
    (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun mu hmu1 hT x).sub
      (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hReflected : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
        symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t)
      (Icc 0 T) :=
    (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
        (reflectedLaw mu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1) hT (-x)).sub
      (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
        (reflectedLaw nu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw nu hnu1) hT (-x))
  have hConstant : IntegrableOn (fun _t : ℝ =>
      (((4 * Real.pi / T * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.I)) (Icc 0 T) :=
    integrableOn_const (by simp [Real.volume_Icc])
  simpa only [midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand] using
    (hForward.sub hReflected).add hConstant

/-- Exact one-integral form of the off-diagonal Prawitz imbalance.  The
constant imaginary correction integrates to the midpoint-CDF term, so all
relative signs remain visible inside one positive-frequency integral. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_jointSignedIntegral
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu) =
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw nu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure nu
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t
  let R : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t
  let C : ℂ :=
    ((4 * Real.pi / T * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.I
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc 0 T) :=
    (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun mu hmu1 hT x).sub
      (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun nu hnu1 hT x)
  have hR : IntegrableOn R (Icc 0 T) :=
    (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
        (reflectedLaw mu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1) hT (-x)).sub
      (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
        (reflectedLaw nu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw nu hnu1) hT (-x))
  have hJoint :
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t) =
        (∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t) - (∫ t in Icc 0 T, R t) + T • C := by
    change (∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t - R t + C) = _
    have hC : IntegrableOn (fun _t : ℝ => C) (Icc 0 T) :=
      integrableOn_const (by simp [Real.volume_Icc])
    have hAdd := integral_add (hF.sub hR) hC
    change (∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t - R t + C) =
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t - R t) + (∫ _t in Icc 0 T, C) at hAdd
    rw [hAdd, integral_sub hF hR, setIntegral_const]
    congr 1
    rw [Measure.real, Real.volume_Icc,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sub_nonneg.mpr hT.le)]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    rfl
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_inversionDifferences_sub_two_mul_midpointCDFDifference
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x,
    re_prawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x,
    re_reflectedPrawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x, hJoint]
  change
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t)).re -
          ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (∫ t in Icc 0 T, R t)).re -
        2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x =
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ((∫ t in Icc 0 T, F t) - (∫ t in Icc 0 T, R t) + T • C)).re
  have hcoef :
      Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) =
        (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Complex.ofReal_inv]
    ring
  have hTC :
      T • C =
        (((4 * Real.pi * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.I) := by
    dsimp only [C]
    change ((T : ℂ) *
      (((4 * Real.pi / T * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.I)) = _
    push_cast
    field_simp [hT.ne']
  have hCorrection :
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (T • C)).re =
        -2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x := by
    rw [hcoef, hTC]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
      mul_one]
    field_simp [hT.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero]
    ring
  rw [mul_add, mul_sub]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, hCorrection]
  ring

/-- Exact real coordinate of the joint signed integrand at nonzero frequency. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      -((prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t).im) /
          (Real.pi * t) +
        ((prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t).im) /
          (Real.pi * t) -
        2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T := by
  have hForward := re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub (T := T)
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun mu)
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun nu) x ht
  have hReflected := re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub (T := T)
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (reflectedLaw mu))
    (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) ht
  have hCorrection :
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (((4 * Real.pi / T * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.I)).re =
        -2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T := by
    have hcoef :
        Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) =
          (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Complex.ofReal_inv]
      ring
    rw [hcoef]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
      mul_one]
    field_simp [hT, Real.pi_ne_zero]
    ring
  rw [midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand, mul_add, mul_sub]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, hForward, hReflected,
    hCorrection]
  ring

/-- Simultaneous reflection cancels the imaginary filter coordinate from the
signed difference of forward and reflected Prawitz numerators. -/
theorem reflected_sub_im_sub_forward_eq_filter_re_mul_phase_im
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) (T x t : ℝ) :
    -((prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t).im -
        (prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t).im) +
      ((prawitzPVNumerator T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t).im -
        (prawitzPVNumerator T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t).im) =
      -2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
        (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t)).im := by
  let M : ℂ := scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t
  let z : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
    (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t)
  have hForward :
      prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t -
          prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t = M * z := by
    rw [prawitzPVNumerator_sub]
    dsimp only [M, z]
    ring
  have hPhase :
      Complex.exp (((-(t * (-x)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu) t -
            MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu) t) =
        (starRingEnd ℂ) z := by
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [charFun_reflectedLaw, charFun_reflectedLaw,
      MeasureTheory.charFun_neg, MeasureTheory.charFun_neg]
    simp only [map_mul, map_sub]
    rw [← Complex.exp_conj]
    congr 2
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  have hReflected :
      prawitzPVNumerator T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
        prawitzPVNumerator T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t =
        M * (starRingEnd ℂ) z := by
    rw [prawitzPVNumerator_sub]
    calc
      Complex.exp (((-(t * -x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t *
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu) t -
            MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu) t) =
          M *
            (Complex.exp (((-(t * -x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu) t -
                MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu) t)) := by
            dsimp only [M]
            ring
      _ = M * (starRingEnd ℂ) z := by rw [hPhase]
  rw [← Complex.sub_im, ← Complex.sub_im, hForward, hReflected]
  dsimp only [M, z]
  simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
  ring

/-- The phase-shifted characteristic function has the expected sine
coordinate centered at the spatial point. -/
theorem phase_mul_charFun_im_eq_integral_sin_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (x t : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        MeasureTheory.charFun mu t).im =
      ∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂mu := by
  rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply_real]
  have hMul :
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (∫ y, Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu) =
        ∫ y, Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu :=
    (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
  rw [hMul]
  have hInt : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
      Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) mu := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1 ?_
    exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
      simp [Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re]
  have hIm :
      (∫ y, Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∂mu).im =
      ∫ y, (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im ∂mu := by
    simpa using (integral_im hInt).symm
  rw [hIm]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
    change (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
      Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
        Real.sin (t * (y - x))
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    have harg :
        (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
            ((t : ℂ) * (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          (((t * (y - x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [harg, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]

/-- The phase-shifted characteristic-function discrepancy is the difference
of centered sine expectations. -/
theorem phase_mul_charFun_sub_im_eq_integral_sin_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (x t : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
        (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t - MeasureTheory.charFun nu t)).im =
      (∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂nu := by
  rw [mul_sub, Complex.sub_im,
    phase_mul_charFun_im_eq_integral_sin_sub,
    phase_mul_charFun_im_eq_integral_sin_sub]

/-- Atom-symmetric lower-ray kernel: one below the cut, one half at the cut,
and zero above it. -/
noncomputable def midpointRayKernel (x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y) +
    ((Iio x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y)) / 2

/-- Joint measurability of the atom-symmetric lower-ray kernel in its cut and
evaluation coordinates. -/
theorem measurable_midpointRayKernel_uncurry :
    Measurable (Function.uncurry midpointRayKernel) := by
  change Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
    ((if p.2 ≤ p.1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) +
      (if p.2 < p.1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) / 2)
  apply Measurable.div_const
  apply Measurable.add
  · exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_le measurable_snd measurable_fst)
      measurable_const measurable_const
  · exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_snd measurable_fst)
      measurable_const measurable_const

theorem integral_midpointRayKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (x : ℝ) :
    ∫ y, midpointRayKernel x y ∂mu = midpointCDF mu x := by
  have hClosed : Integrable
      ((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) mu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic
  have hOpen : Integrable
      ((Iio x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))) mu :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iio
  have hClosedInt :
      (∫ y, (Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∂mu) =
        mu.real (Iic x) := by
    simpa only [Pi.one_apply] using
      (integral_indicator_one (μ := mu) measurableSet_Iic)
  have hOpenInt :
      (∫ y, (Iio x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∂mu) =
        mu.real (Iio x) := by
    simpa only [Pi.one_apply] using
      (integral_indicator_one (μ := mu) measurableSet_Iio)
  change (∫ y, (((Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y) +
    ((Iio x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y)) / 2 ∂mu) = _
  rw [integral_div, integral_add hClosed hOpen,
    hClosedInt, hOpenInt,
    midpointCDF, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real]

/-- One-law real kernel whose expectation combines the centered sine
coordinate with the atom-symmetric midpoint correction. -/
noncomputable def midpointCorrectedSineKernel
    (T x t y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
      (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x)) -
    (2 / T) * midpointRayKernel x y

/-- Joint measurability of the midpoint-corrected sine kernel in frequency
and space. -/
theorem measurable_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_uncurry (T x : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x p.1 p.2) := by
  unfold midpointCorrectedSineKernel
  have hfilter : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T p.1) :=
    (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T).comp measurable_fst
  have hray : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => midpointRayKernel x p.2) := by
    unfold midpointRayKernel
    exact (((measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Iic).comp measurable_snd).add
      ((measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Iio).comp measurable_snd)).div_const 2
  fun_prop

theorem integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (T x t : ℝ) :
    ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂mu =
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂mu)) /
        (Real.pi * t) -
      2 * midpointCDF mu x / T := by
  have hSin : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (t * (y - x))) mu := by
    refine Integrable.of_bound (by fun_prop) 1 ?_
    exact ae_of_all mu fun y => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_sin_le_one (t * (y - x))
  have hMid : Integrable (midpointRayKernel x) mu := by
    unfold midpointRayKernel
    exact (((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iic).add
      ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator measurableSet_Iio)).div_const 2
  change (∫ y,
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
          (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x)) -
        (2 / T) * midpointRayKernel x y ∂mu) = _
  rw [integral_sub (hSin.const_mul _) (hMid.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_midpointRayKernel]
  ring

theorem midpointRayKernel_of_lt {x y : ℝ} (hyx : y < x) :
    midpointRayKernel x y = 1 := by
  simp [midpointRayKernel, hyx, hyx.le]

@[simp] theorem midpointRayKernel_self (x : ℝ) :
    midpointRayKernel x x = 1 / 2 := by
  simp [midpointRayKernel]

theorem midpointRayKernel_of_lt' {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x < y) :
    midpointRayKernel x y = 0 := by
  simp [midpointRayKernel, hxy.le, not_le_of_gt hxy]

/-- The atom-symmetric lower-ray kernel always takes values in the unit
interval. -/
theorem abs_midpointRayKernel_le_one (x y : ℝ) :
    |midpointRayKernel x y| ≤ 1 := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy y x with hyx | hxy | hxy
  · rw [midpointRayKernel_of_lt hyx]
    norm_num
  · subst y
    rw [midpointRayKernel_self]
    norm_num
  · rw [midpointRayKernel_of_lt' hxy]
    norm_num

theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_of_lt
    (T t : ℝ) {x y : ℝ} (hyx : y < x) :
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y =
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
        (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x)) - 2 / T := by
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel, midpointRayKernel_of_lt hyx]
  ring

@[simp] theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_self
    (T x t : ℝ) :
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t x = -1 / T := by
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel, midpointRayKernel_self]
  simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, zero_sub]
  ring

theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_of_lt'
    (T t : ℝ) {x y : ℝ} (hxy : x < y) :
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y =
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
        (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x)) := by
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel, midpointRayKernel_of_lt' hxy]
  ring

/-- A first-moment-compatible majorant for the midpoint-corrected sine
kernel on the positive Prawitz frequency window.  The apparent singularity
at `t = 0` is removed by `|sin (t z)| ≤ |t z|`. -/
theorem abs_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_le
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht0 : 0 < t) (htT : t ≤ T)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y| ≤
      14 * |y - x| + 2 / T := by
  have hfilter : |(scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re| ≤ 7 := by
    exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
      (norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hT ⟨ht0.le, htT⟩)
  have hsin : |Real.sin (t * (y - x))| ≤ t * |y - x| := by
    calc
      |Real.sin (t * (y - x))| ≤ |t * (y - x)| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
      _ = t * |y - x| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos ht0]
  have hpi : 1 ≤ Real.pi := by
    nlinarith [Real.one_le_pi_div_two]
  have hfirst :
      |(-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
          (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x))| ≤
        14 * |y - x| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_neg,
      abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
      abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, abs_of_pos ht0]
    calc
      (2 * |(scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re| / (Real.pi * t)) *
          |Real.sin (t * (y - x))| ≤
        (2 * 7 / (Real.pi * t)) * (t * |y - x|) := by
          gcongr
      _ = (14 / Real.pi) * |y - x| := by
        field_simp [ht0.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero]
        ring
      _ ≤ 14 * |y - x| := by
        gcongr
        exact (div_le_iff₀ Real.pi_pos).2 (by nlinarith)
  have hray : |(2 / T) * midpointRayKernel x y| ≤ 2 / T := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le)
      (abs_midpointRayKernel_le_one x y)
  unfold midpointCorrectedSineKernel
  calc
    |_ - _| ≤
        |(-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re /
          (Real.pi * t)) * Real.sin (t * (y - x))| +
        |(2 / T) * midpointRayKernel x y| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ 14 * |y - x| + 2 / T := add_le_add hfirst hray

/-- Closed-window form of the first-moment majorant, including the removable
frequency `t = 0`. -/
theorem abs_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_le_of_mem_Icc
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
    (x y : ℝ) :
    |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y| ≤
      14 * |y - x| + 2 / T := by
  rcases ht with ⟨ht0, htT⟩
  rcases ht0.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht0
  · unfold midpointCorrectedSineKernel
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.sin_zero, zero_mul, div_zero,
      zero_sub, abs_neg]
    have hray : |(2 / T) * midpointRayKernel x y| ≤ 2 / T := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le)
        (abs_midpointRayKernel_le_one x y)
    exact hray.trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (abs_nonneg _)))
  · exact abs_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_le hT ht0 htT x y

/-- Finite first moment makes the midpoint-corrected sine kernel integrable
on the product of its closed frequency window with the probability law. -/
theorem integrable_prod_midpointCorrectedSineKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x p.1 p.2)
      ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod mu) := by
  have hid : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) mu := by
    refine (integrable_norm_iff
      (f := fun y : ℝ => y) measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mp ?_
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hmu1
  have hshift : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y - x) mu :=
    hid.sub (integrable_const x)
  have habs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y - x|) mu := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hshift.norm
  have hmajorY : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => 14 * |y - x| + 2 / T) mu :=
    (habs.const_mul 14).add (integrable_const (2 / T))
  have hmajor : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      14 * |p.2 - x| + 2 / T) ((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod mu) :=
    hmajorY.comp_snd (volume.restrict (Icc 0 T))
  apply hmajor.mono'
  · exact (measurable_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_uncurry T x).aestronglyMeasurable
  · have hmem : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂((volume.restrict (Icc 0 T)).prod mu),
        p.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae
        (measurableSet_Icc.preimage measurable_fst)]
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with t ht
      exact ae_of_all mu fun _ => ht
    filter_upwards [hmem] with p hp
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (abs_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_le_of_mem_Icc hT hp x p.2)

/-- Spatial kernel obtained by retaining the signed midpoint-corrected
frequency average over the full Prawitz window. -/
noncomputable def midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel
    (T x y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in Icc 0 T, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y

/-- The averaged kernel retains the centered diagonal value exactly. -/
@[simp] theorem midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_self
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x x = -1 := by
  unfold midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel
  simp_rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel_self]
  simp [hT.le]
  field_simp [hT.ne']

/-- The frequency-averaged spatial kernel is integrable under every
probability law with a finite first absolute moment. -/
theorem integrable_midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    Integrable (midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x) mu := by
  exact (integrable_prod_midpointCorrectedSineKernel mu hmu1 hT x).integral_prod_right

/-- Fubini identifies the frequency integral of kernel expectations with the
expectation of the signed frequency-averaged spatial kernel. -/
theorem integral_integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂mu) =
      ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y ∂mu := by
  exact integral_integral_swap
    (integrable_prod_midpointCorrectedSineKernel mu hmu1 hT x)

/-- One full sine period to the left of the center, the sine coordinate
vanishes and only the lower-ray correction remains. -/
theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_left_latticePoint
    {T t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : ℝ) :
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x - 2 * Real.pi / t) = -2 / T := by
  have hyx : x - 2 * Real.pi / t < x := by
    have hdiv : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / t := div_pos (by positivity) ht
    linarith
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel_of_lt T t hyx]
  have hphase : t * ((x - 2 * Real.pi / t) - x) = -2 * Real.pi := by
    field_simp [ht.ne']
    ring
  rw [hphase, show -2 * Real.pi = -(2 * Real.pi) by ring,
    Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_two_pi]
  ring

/-- One full sine period to the right of the center, both terms in the
midpoint-corrected kernel vanish. -/
theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_right_latticePoint
    {T t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (x : ℝ) :
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x + 2 * Real.pi / t) = 0 := by
  have hxy : x < x + 2 * Real.pi / t := by
    have hdiv : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / t := div_pos (by positivity) ht
    linarith
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel_of_lt' T t hxy]
  have hphase : t * ((x + 2 * Real.pi / t) - x) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    field_simp [ht.ne']
    ring
  rw [hphase, Real.sin_two_pi]
  ring

/-- Three exact values across the midpoint jump already contribute `2 / T`
to the variation of the pointwise-frequency kernel. -/
theorem midpointCorrectedSineKernel_threePointVariation
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : 0 < t) (x : ℝ) :
    |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x - 2 * Real.pi / t) -
        midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t x| +
      |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t x -
        midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x + 2 * Real.pi / t)| = 2 / T := by
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel_left_latticePoint ht,
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel_self,
    midpointCorrectedSineKernel_right_latticePoint ht]
  have hneg1 : -2 / T - (-1 / T) ≤ 0 := by
    have hTinv : 0 ≤ 1 / T := div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le
    rw [show -2 / T - (-1 / T) = -(1 / T) by ring]
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr hTinv
  have hneg2 : -1 / T - 0 ≤ 0 := by
    have hTinv : 0 ≤ 1 / T := div_nonneg (by norm_num) hT.le
    rw [show -1 / T - 0 = -(1 / T) by ring]
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr hTinv
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hneg1, abs_of_nonpos hneg2]
  ring

/-- Any `C / T` majorant for these three increments has coefficient at least
two, so the joint signed kernel cannot yield coefficient-one Kolmogorov
control through a plain total-variation estimate. -/
theorem two_le_of_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_threePointVariation_le
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : 0 < t) (x C : ℝ)
    (hC :
      |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x - 2 * Real.pi / t) -
          midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t x| +
        |midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t x -
          midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t (x + 2 * Real.pi / t)| ≤ C / T) :
    2 ≤ C := by
  rw [midpointCorrectedSineKernel_threePointVariation hT ht x] at hC
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hT).mp hC

/-- The pointwise joint coordinate depends only on the real Prawitz-filter
coordinate; simultaneous reflection cancels its imaginary coordinate. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_filter_re
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          (Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            (MeasureTheory.charFun mu t -
              MeasureTheory.charFun nu t)).im) /
        (Real.pi * t) -
      2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T := by
  rw [re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand
    mu nu hT x ht]
  have hCancel :=
    reflected_sub_im_sub_forward_eq_filter_re_mul_phase_im mu nu T x t
  calc
    -((prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t).im) /
          (Real.pi * t) +
        ((prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t).im) /
          (Real.pi * t) -
        2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T =
      (-((prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun mu) x t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T (MeasureTheory.charFun nu) x t).im) +
        ((prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t).im -
          (prawitzPVNumerator T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw nu)) (-x) t).im)) /
          (Real.pi * t) -
        2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hCancel]

/-- Real measure-coordinate form of the joint signed integrand.  The frequency
term is the difference of centered sine expectations, kept signed against the
midpoint-CDF correction. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_sine
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
          ((∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂mu) -
            ∫ y, Real.sin (t * (y - x)) ∂nu)) /
        (Real.pi * t) -
      2 * midpointCDFDifference mu nu x / T := by
  rw [re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_filter_re
    mu nu hT x ht,
    phase_mul_charFun_sub_im_eq_integral_sin_sub]

/-- The joint signed Prawitz coordinate is one real-kernel expectation
difference, before any triangle or variation bound. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_kernel
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      (∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂nu := by
  rw [re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_sine
    mu nu hT x ht,
    integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel,
    integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel]
  unfold midpointCDFDifference
  ring

/-- Retaining the signed frequency integral turns the joint Prawitz
coordinate into an integral of real kernel-expectation differences.  This is
the pre-Fubini form needed before constructing an averaged spatial kernel. -/
theorem re_jointSignedIntegral_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_expectation_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ((∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂nu) := by
  have hJoint : IntegrableOn
      (midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x) (Icc 0 T) :=
    integrableOn_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x
  let c : ℂ := Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)
  have hScaled : IntegrableOn (fun t => c *
      midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t) (Icc 0 T) :=
    hJoint.const_mul c
  calc
    (c * ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
        (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          c * midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re := by
      congr 1
      exact (integral_const_mul
        (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) c
        (midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x)).symm
    _ = ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        (c * midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re :=
      (integral_re hScaled).symm
    _ = ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ((∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂mu) -
          ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineKernel T x t y ∂nu) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne 0] with t ht
      dsimp only [c]
      exact re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand_eq_kernel
        mu nu hT.ne' x ht

/-- Fubini form of the exact joint signed coordinate: it is the difference
of expectations of one frequency-averaged spatial kernel. -/
theorem re_jointSignedIntegral_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          midpointCorrectedPrawitzJointIntegrand mu nu T x t).re =
      (∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y ∂nu := by
  rw [re_jointSignedIntegral_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel_expectation_sub
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x]
  have hmuProd := integrable_prod_midpointCorrectedSineKernel mu hmu1 hT x
  have hnuProd := integrable_prod_midpointCorrectedSineKernel nu hnu1 hT x
  rw [integral_sub hmuProd.integral_prod_left hnuProd.integral_prod_left,
    integral_integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel mu hmu1 hT x,
    integral_integral_midpointCorrectedSineKernel nu hnu1 hT x]

/-- The off-diagonal imbalance difference and the averaged-kernel difference
are the same signed law coordinate. -/
theorem integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_sub
    (mu nu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] [IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    (hnu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) nu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂mu) -
        (∫ y, prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y ∂nu) =
      (∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y ∂mu) -
        ∫ y, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y ∂nu := by
  rw [integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_re_jointSignedIntegral
    mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x,
    re_jointSignedIntegral_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_sub
      mu nu hmu1 hnu1 hT x]

/-- Pointwise identification of the frequency-averaged kernel: averaging
removes the diagonal atom from the imbalance profile and changes only a
law-independent constant. -/
theorem midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_eq_offDiagonal_sub_one
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x y : ℝ) :
    midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel T x y =
      prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x y - 1 := by
  have hy1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.dirac y) :=
    integrable_dirac (by simp)
  have hx1 : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |z|) (Measure.dirac x) :=
    integrable_dirac (by simp)
  have h :=
    integral_prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal_sub_eq_integral_midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_sub
      (Measure.dirac y) (Measure.dirac x) hy1 hx1 hT x
  simp only [integral_dirac] at h
  have hOff : prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal T x x = 0 := by
    simp [prawitzSlackImbalanceOffDiagonal]
  rw [hOff, midpointCorrectedSineAveragedKernel_self hT x] at h
  linarith

/-- Reverse one-sided Prawitz comparison against the standard normal with the
signed reflected-frequency integral and Fejer remainder both kept exact. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_signed
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x - cdf mu x ≤
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
              (-x) t)).re +
      ∫ y, (prawitzPointKernel T (y - x) +
          prawitzPointKernel T (x - y))
        ∂NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw := by
  have hsigned :=
    cdf_sub_cdf_le_re_reflectedPrawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  rw [re_reflectedPrawitzInversion_charFun_sub_eq_signedIntegral
    mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
    hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x] at hsigned
  exact hsigned

/-- The reverse standard-normal Prawitz comparison with the reflected
inversion and Fejer terms combined inside one real part. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_signed_frequency
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x - cdf mu x ≤
      (((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          ∫ t in Icc 0 T,
            (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  (reflectedLaw
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
                (-x) t)) +
        ∫ z,
          Complex.exp (((-(T * x * z / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
              (T * z / 2)
          ∂twofoldUniformKernel).re := by
  have hsigned := standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_signed
    mu hmu1 hT x
  rw [integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_eq_re_frequencyIntegral
    hT x] at hsigned
  simpa only [Complex.add_re] using hsigned

/-- The reflected reverse comparison as one signed positive-frequency
integral, preserving pointwise cancellation with the Gaussian Fejer term. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x - cdf mu x ≤
      (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
            (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
              symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  (reflectedLaw
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
                (-x) t) +
          (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
              Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                MeasureTheory.charFun
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re := by
  have hsigned := standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_signed_frequency
    mu hmu1 hT x
  rw [integral_prawitzReflectionFrequency_eq_pairedTriangularIntegral
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x] at hsigned
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
      symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (reflectedLaw
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
        (-x) t
  let R : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
      (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
        Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc 0 T) := by
    exact (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      (reflectedLaw mu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1) hT (-x)).sub
      (integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
        (reflectedLaw
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT (-x))
  have hR : IntegrableOn R (Icc 0 T) := by
    exact (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
  have hcombine := const_mul_setIntegral_add_setIntegral_eq_integral_add
    P R (Icc 0 T) hP hR (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
  change cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x -
      cdf mu x ≤
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T, P t) +
      ∫ t in Icc 0 T, R t).re at hsigned
  change cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x -
      cdf mu x ≤
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
      ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) * P t + R t)).re
  rw [hcombine] at hsigned
  exact hsigned

/-- Pairing Hermitian positive and negative frequencies has the same real
coefficient as twice the positive-frequency principal-value difference. -/
theorem re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub_eq_positiveFrequency
    {T : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hf : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction f)
    (hg : IsHermitianFrequencyFunction g)
    (x : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T f x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T g x t)).re =
      ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T f x t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T g x t)).re := by
  rw [re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub hf hg x ht]
  rw [← Complex.sub_im]
  unfold prawitzPVIntegrand
  rw [← sub_div]
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im,
    Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.div_ofReal_im]
  simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div, zero_mul]
  field_simp [ht, Real.pi_ne_zero]
  ring

/-- The reverse Prawitz error keeps the reflected characteristic-function
phase and exact Gaussian cosine term together. -/
noncomputable def reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) (T x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (reflectedLaw
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
            (-x) t))).re +
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T x

/-- Exact sine/cosine coordinate expansion of the reflected reverse
phase-preserving Prawitz remainder. -/
theorem reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (-Real.sin (t * x) *
              (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference (reflectedLaw mu)
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                T t).re -
            Real.cos (t * x) *
              (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference (reflectedLaw mu)
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
                T t).im) /
            Real.pi +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (reflectedLaw
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) (-x) t
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * z t
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hz : IntegrableOn z (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [z] using integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
      (reflectedLaw mu)
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT (-x)
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using hz.const_mul (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  unfold reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
  change ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, z t)).re +
        ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t = _
  calc
    ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, z t)).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t =
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, P t).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
      congr 1
      exact congrArg Complex.re
        (integral_const_mul
          (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
          (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) z).symm
    _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (P t).re) +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ =>
        z + ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t) (integral_re hP).symm
    _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ((P t).re + G t) :=
      (integral_add hP.re hG).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with t
      dsimp only [P, z, G, prawitzZeroPhaseDifference]
      rw [prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero]
      rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re,
        Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
      simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div,
        zero_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
        Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      rw [show t * -x = -(t * x) by ring, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
      ring

/-- The exact reflected reverse sine/cosine phase-coordinate integrand is
integrable on the closed Prawitz window. -/
theorem integrableOn_reversePrawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (-Real.sin (t * x) *
            (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference (reflectedLaw mu)
              (reflectedLaw
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              T t).re -
          Real.cos (t * x) *
            (prawitzZeroPhaseDifference (reflectedLaw mu)
              (reflectedLaw
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              T t).im) /
          Real.pi +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
      prawitzPVIntegrand T
        (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (reflectedLaw
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) (-x) t
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * z t
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hz : IntegrableOn z (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [z] using integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
      (reflectedLaw mu)
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT (-x)
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using hz.const_mul (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  apply (hP.re.add hG).congr
  filter_upwards with t
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  change Complex.re (P t) + G t = _
  dsimp only [P, z, G, prawitzZeroPhaseDifference]
  rw [prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_eq_phase_mul_zero]
  rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.div_ofReal_re,
    Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  simp only [Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_div, one_div,
    zero_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
    Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  rw [show t * -x = -(t * x) by ring, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  ring

/-- Adding the forward and reflected reverse phase-preserving remainders for a
normalized iid sum cancels the real filter coordinate exactly. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_integral
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x +
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
              (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
                Real.cos (t * x) *
                  (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t) /
            Real.pi +
          4 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
      law hLaw1 hT x,
    reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
      law hLaw1 hT x]
  rw [← integral_add
    (integrableOn_prawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand law hLaw1 hT x)
    (integrableOn_reversePrawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand law hLaw1 hT x)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1)
  let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
  let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
  let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
  let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let k : ℂ := scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t
  let g : ℝ := 2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
    Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hcancel := prawitzTaylorPhaseCoordinates_add k r s c t (t * x)
  dsimp only [u, phi, a, r, s, c, k, g] at hcancel ⊢
  linear_combination (1 / Real.pi) * hcancel

/-- Subtracting the reflected reverse phase-preserving remainder from the
forward remainder cancels the imaginary filter coordinate and the Gaussian
term exactly. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_integral
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x -
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        (2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
              (Real.sin (t * x) *
                  (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
                Real.cos (t * x) *
                  (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) /
            Real.pi := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
      law hLaw1 hT x,
    reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
      law hLaw1 hT x]
  rw [← integral_sub
    (integrableOn_prawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand law hLaw1 hT x)
    (integrableOn_reversePrawitzPhaseCoordinateIntegrand law hLaw1 hT x)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]
  let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1)
  let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
  let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
  let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
  let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let k : ℂ := scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t
  let g : ℝ := 2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
    Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hcancel := prawitzTaylorPhaseCoordinates_sub k r s c t (t * x)
  dsimp only [u, phi, a, r, s, c, k, g] at hcancel ⊢
  linear_combination (1 / Real.pi) * hcancel

/-- Exact Taylor-coordinate expansion of the reflected reverse
phase-preserving Prawitz remainder for a normalized centered iid sum. -/
theorem reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_normalizedCenteredIidSum_eq_integral_taylorCoordinates
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        (-Real.sin (t * x) *
              (((scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
                  (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
                    (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) -
            Real.cos (t * x) *
              ((-(scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
                    (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
                  (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t)) /
            Real.pi +
          2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
            Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  rw [reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_eq_integral_phaseCoordinates
    law hLaw1 hT x]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_re_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t,
    prawitzZeroPhaseDifference_reflected_normalizedCenteredIidSum_im_eq_taylorCoordinates
      X hX hIndep hIdent N T t]

/-- The reflected reverse phase-preserving remainder is continuous in the
spatial parameter. -/
theorem continuous_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Continuous (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  have hphase :=
    (continuous_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
      (reflectedLaw mu)
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT).comp continuous_neg
  unfold reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
  exact (Complex.continuous_re.comp
    (continuous_const.mul hphase)).add
      (continuous_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T)

/-- The reflected reverse phase-preserving remainder vanishes in the positive
spatial tail. -/
theorem tendsto_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atTop
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  have hraw :=
    (tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atBot
      (reflectedLaw mu)
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT).comp
      tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot
  have hphase : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          (prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
            prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
              (-x) t))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hraw : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
        (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
            (prawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
              prawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  (reflectedLaw
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
                (-x) t))) atTop
          (𝓝 ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * 0)))
  have hre := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphase
  simpa only [reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder, mul_zero,
    Complex.zero_re, zero_add] using
      hre.add (tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atTop T)

/-- The reflected reverse phase-preserving remainder also vanishes in the
negative spatial tail. -/
theorem tendsto_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atBot
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  have hraw :=
    (tendsto_setIntegral_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub_atTop
      (reflectedLaw mu)
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT).comp
      tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop
  have hphase : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          (prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
            prawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
              (-x) t))) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul hraw : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
        (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
            (prawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
              prawitzPVIntegrand T
                (MeasureTheory.charFun
                  (reflectedLaw
                    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
                (-x) t))) atBot
          (𝓝 ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) * 0)))
  have hre := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hphase
  simpa only [reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder, mul_zero,
    Complex.zero_re, zero_add] using
      hre.add (tendsto_prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_atBot T)

/-- The reflected reverse signed integrand has the positive-frequency phase
form plus the same exact Gaussian cosine contribution. -/
theorem re_reversePrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_phasePreserving
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {T t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (reflectedLaw
                  NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
              (-x) t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re =
      ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
          prawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (reflectedLaw
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
            (-x) t)).re +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  rw [Complex.add_re,
    re_prawitzCoefficient_mul_symmetric_sub_eq_positiveFrequency
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun (reflectedLaw mu))
      (isHermitianFrequencyFunction_charFun
        (reflectedLaw
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)) (-x) ht,
    re_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand_standardNormal]

/-- The reverse signed CDF error is bounded by the reflected
phase-preserving Prawitz remainder without an intervening complex norm. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x - cdf mu x ≤
      reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
  have hsigned := standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    mu hmu1 hT x
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (reflectedLaw mu) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure mu
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure
      (reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw) :=
    reflectedLaw_isProbabilityMeasure
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun
              (reflectedLaw
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
            (-x) t) +
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)
  let P : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ)) *
      (prawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
        prawitzPVIntegrand T
          (MeasureTheory.charFun
            (reflectedLaw
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
          (-x) t)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have hmu := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      (reflectedLaw mu) (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1) hT (-x)
    have hnormal := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
        integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT (-x)
    have hP := (hmu.sub hnormal).const_mul
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
    have hR : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t))
        (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
      (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
    simpa only [F] using hP.add hR
  have hP : IntegrableOn P (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [P] using
      (integrableOn_prawitzPVIntegrand_charFun_sub
        (reflectedLaw mu)
        (reflectedLaw NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
        (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw mu hmu1)
        (integrable_abs_reflectedLaw
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
          integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw) hT (-x)).const_mul
            (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
  have hG : IntegrableOn G (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [G]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  have heq : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re =
      reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
    calc
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re =
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re :=
        (integral_re hF).symm
      _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ((P t).re + G t) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [
          (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne 0] with t ht
        dsimp only [F, P, G]
        exact re_reversePrawitzSingleIntegrand_eq_phasePreserving mu ht x
      _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, P t).re +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t := by
        exact (integral_add hP.re hG).trans
          (congrArg (fun z : ℝ =>
            z + ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, G t) (integral_re hP))
      _ = reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x := by
        dsimp only [P, G]
        unfold reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
          prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
        congr 1
        exact congrArg Complex.re
          (integral_const_mul
            (μ := volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
            (Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℝ))
            (fun t =>
              prawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun (reflectedLaw mu)) (-x) t -
                prawitzPVIntegrand T
                  (MeasureTheory.charFun
                    (reflectedLaw
                      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw))
                  (-x) t))
  simpa only [F] using hsigned.trans_eq heq

/-- The two signed phase-preserving Prawitz inequalities combine into a
pointwise absolute CDF bound through the exact sum and difference of their
remainders. -/
theorem cdfGap_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_add_abs_sub
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdfGap mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x +
          reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x +
        |prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x -
          reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x|) / 2 := by
  rw [cdfGap_eq_max_signed]
  calc
    max
        (cdfUpperError mu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x)
        (cdfLowerError mu
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x) ≤
      max (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x)
        (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x) :=
      max_le_max
        (cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
          mu hmu1 hT x)
        (standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
          mu hmu1 hT x)
    _ = _ := max_eq_add_add_abs_sub_div_two _ _

/-- For normalized centered iid sums, the bidirectional Prawitz CDF bound can
be written as one integral containing only the imaginary filter coordinate
plus the absolute value of one integral containing only the real coordinate.
The Gaussian correction remains only in the first integral. -/
theorem cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_taylorPhaseIntegrals
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    cdfGap law NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      ((∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
          let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
          let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
          let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
          let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
          let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
          (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im *
                (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
                  Real.cos (t * x) *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)) / t) /
              Real.pi +
            4 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
              Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) +
        |∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
          let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
          let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
          let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
          let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
          let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
          (2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re *
                (Real.sin (t * x) *
                    (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
                  Real.cos (t * x) *
                    (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) / t) /
              Real.pi|) / 2 := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
