    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hEnvelope :=
    cdfGap_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_add_abs_sub
      law hLaw1 hT x
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x,
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x] at hEnvelope
  simpa only [law, Y] using hEnvelope

/-- After exact interior-window coefficient substitution, the sum of the two
phase-preserving remainders is twice a Fejer-weighted Taylor-coordinate
integral. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_two_mul_integral
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x +
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      2 * ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
            Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
            2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_integral
    X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
    (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne 0,
    (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne T] with t htmem ht0 htT
  have ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
    ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne htmem.1 (Ne.symm ht0),
      lt_of_le_of_ne htmem.2 htT⟩
  let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1)
  let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
  let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
  let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
  let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let q : ℝ :=
    Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
      Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c)
  change
    (-2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).im * q / t) / Real.pi +
        4 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) =
      2 * (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
        (q + 2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)))
  rw [neg_two_mul_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_im_div_pi hT ht q]
  ring

/-- After exact interior-window coefficient substitution, the difference of
the two phase-preserving remainders is twice a cotangent-weighted
Taylor-coordinate integral. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_two_mul_integral
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x -
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x =
      2 * ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t *
          (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
            Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_integral
    X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc,
    (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne 0,
    (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).ae_ne T] with t htmem ht0 htT
  have ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
    ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne htmem.1 (Ne.symm ht0),
      lt_of_le_of_ne htmem.2 htT⟩
  let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1)
  let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
    (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
  let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
  let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
  let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
  let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let q : ℝ :=
    Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
      Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re)
  change
    (2 * (scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t).re * q / t) / Real.pi =
      2 * (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t * q)
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    two_mul_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_re_div_pi hT ht q

/-- The exact bidirectional phase envelope after removing the common factor
two: one signed Fejer-weighted integral plus the absolute value of one
cotangent-weighted integral. -/
theorem cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_simplifiedTaylorPhaseIntegrals
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    cdfGap law NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
        let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
        let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
        let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re) +
            Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) +
            2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) +
        |∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
          let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
          let a : ℝ := 1 - u ^ 2 / 2
          let r : ℂ := phi - (a : ℂ)
          let s : ℂ := complexPowerRealBaselineGeomSum phi a (N + 1)
          let c : ℝ := a ^ (N + 1) - Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
          prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t *
            (Real.sin (t * x) * (r.re * s.re - r.im * s.im + c) -
              Real.cos (t * x) * (r.re * s.im + r.im * s.re))| := by
  dsimp only
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp X hX N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hEnvelope :=
    cdfGap_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_add_abs_sub
      law hLaw1 hT x
  rw [prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_two_mul_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x,
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_two_mul_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x] at hEnvelope
  have htwo (a b : ℝ) : (2 * a + |2 * b|) / 2 = a + |b| := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring
  simpa only [law, Y, htwo] using hEnvelope

/-- The simplified bidirectional phase envelope with its Taylor/geometric
coordinates recombined into the full powered characteristic-function
discrepancy.  The Fejer/Gaussian interaction remains signed. -/
theorem cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_poweredPhaseIntegrals
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    cdfGap law NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
        let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
        let d : ℂ := phi ^ (N + 1) -
          (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℂ)
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (Real.sin (t * x) * d.im + Real.cos (t * x) * d.re +
            2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) +
        |∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          let u : ℝ := t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
          let phi : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
              (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ) u
          let d : ℂ := phi ^ (N + 1) -
            (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℂ)
          prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t *
            (Real.sin (t * x) * d.re - Real.cos (t * x) * d.im)| := by
  have h := cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_simplifiedTaylorPhaseIntegrals
    X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x
  simpa only [taylorGeomSum_imagCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_im,
    taylorGeomSum_realCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_re,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    sub_zero] using h

/-- The bidirectional normalized-iid Prawitz envelope in its compact law-level
phase form: a signed Fejer-weighted real phase plus the absolute value of a
cotangent-weighted imaginary phase. -/
theorem cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_lawPhaseIntegrals
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    cdfGap law NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        let d : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun law t -
          MeasureTheory.charFun
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
        let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d
        prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          (q.re + 2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))) +
        |∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
          let d : ℂ := MeasureTheory.charFun law t -
            MeasureTheory.charFun
              NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t
          let q : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(t * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * d
          (-prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t * q.im)| := by
  dsimp only
  have h := cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_poweredPhaseIntegrals
    X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x
  simp_rw [← charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N] at h
  simpa only [phase_fejer_coordinate, phase_cotangent_coordinate] using h

/-- The average of the forward and reverse normalized-iid one-sided Prawitz
bounds is exactly the Fejér coordinate of the named law-phase envelope. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_average_eq_lawPhaseFejer
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x +
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x) / 2 =
      prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral law T x := by
  dsimp only
  have h :=
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_add_eq_two_mul_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x
  simp only [taylorGeomSum_imagCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_im,
    taylorGeomSum_realCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_re,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    sub_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  have htwo (a : ℝ) : (2 * a) / 2 = a := by ring
  rw [htwo]
  unfold prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N]
  dsimp only
  simpa only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] using
    (phase_fejer_coordinate
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t)
      (2 * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t))
      (t * x)
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ (N + 1) -
        (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℂ)))

/-- The half-difference of the forward and reverse normalized-iid one-sided
Prawitz bounds is exactly the cotangent coordinate of the named law-phase
envelope. -/
theorem prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_halfDifference_eq_lawPhaseCotangent
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x -
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T x) / 2 =
      prawitzLawPhaseCotangentIntegral law T x := by
  dsimp only
  have h :=
    prawitzPhasePreservingRemainders_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_eq_two_mul_integral
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x
  simp only [taylorGeomSum_imagCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_im,
    taylorGeomSum_realCoordinate_eq_pow_sub_real_re,
    Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    sub_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  have htwo (a : ℝ) : (2 * a) / 2 = a := by ring
  rw [htwo]
  unfold prawitzLawPhaseCotangentIntegral
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with t
  rw [charFun_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sub_standardNormalLaw_eq_pow
    X hX hIndep hIdent N]
  dsimp only
  simpa only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] using
    (phase_cotangent_coordinate
      (prawitzCotangentFrequencyCoefficient T t) (t * x)
      (MeasureTheory.charFun
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (X 0) (hX 0).aemeasurable : Measure ℝ)
          (t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) ^ (N + 1) -
        (Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) : ℂ)))

/-- API form of the exact bidirectional normalized-iid Prawitz bound using
the named law-phase envelope. -/
theorem cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 2 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (N : ℕ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    let law : Measure ℝ :=
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
          X hX N).aemeasurable
    cdfGap law NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope law T x := by
  simpa only [prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope, prawitzLawPhaseFejerIntegral,
    prawitzLawPhaseCotangentIntegral] using
    cdfGap_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_lawPhaseIntegrals
      X hX hIndep hIdent N hT x

/-- The reflected reverse phase-preserving remainder is globally controlled,
up to any positive epsilon, by an attained compact maximum. -/
theorem exists_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_compact_max_le_global
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    ∃ R x : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ x ∈ Icc (-R) R ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Icc (-R) R,
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T y ≤
          reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x) ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T y ≤
        max epsilon (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T x) := by
  exact exists_compact_max_le_global_max_epsilon_of_tendsto_zero
    (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu T)
    (continuous_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder mu hmu1 hT)
    (tendsto_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atTop mu hmu1 hT)
    (tendsto_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_atBot mu hmu1 hT)
    hepsilon

/-- At the admissible tunable cutoff, the absolute CDF gap of a normalized
centered iid sum is controlled, up to epsilon, by attained compact maxima of
the forward and reflected phase-preserving remainders. -/
theorem exists_normalizedCenteredIidSum_bidirectionalPrawitzPhase_compact_bound
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hrhoPos : 0 < ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (N : ℕ)
    {epsilon : ℝ} (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    let Y := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
    let hY := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
    let law := NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      Y hY.aemeasurable
    let rho := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
    let T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
    ∃ Rf xf Rr xr : ℝ,
      0 ≤ Rf ∧ xf ∈ Icc (-Rf) Rf ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Icc (-Rf) Rf,
        prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T y ≤
          prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T xf) ∧
      0 ≤ Rr ∧ xr ∈ Icc (-Rr) Rr ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Icc (-Rr) Rr,
        reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T y ≤
          reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T xr) ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ,
        cdfGap law
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw y ≤
          max
            (max epsilon (prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T xf))
            (max epsilon
              (reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder law T xr)) := by
  dsimp only
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := by simpa only [rho] using hrhoPos
  have hT : 0 < T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc hrho0 N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  obtain ⟨Rf, xf, hRf, hxf, hFmax, hFglobal⟩ :=
    exists_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_compact_max_le_global
      law hLaw1 hT hepsilon
  obtain ⟨Rr, xr, hRr, hxr, hRmax, hRglobal⟩ :=
    exists_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder_compact_max_le_global
      law hLaw1 hT hepsilon
  refine ⟨Rf, xf, Rr, xr, hRf, hxf, hFmax, hRr, hxr, hRmax, ?_⟩
  intro y
  rw [cdfGap_eq_max_signed]
  apply max_le_max
  · exact (cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
      law hLaw1 hT y).trans (hFglobal y)
  · exact (standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_reversePrawitzPhasePreservingRemainder
      law hLaw1 hT y).trans (hRglobal y)

/-- The opposite one-sided Prawitz smoothing estimate against the standard
normal, with the same frequency and exact Fejér terms. -/
theorem standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x - cdf mu x ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  have hsigned :=
    cdf_sub_cdf_le_norm_reflectedPrawitzInversion_sub_add_reflection
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hfreq :=
    norm_prawitzInversion_reflectedLaw_sub_le_integral_discrepancy
      mu NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      hmu1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
  have hreflect := integral_prawitzReflection_standardNormal_le hT x
  exact hsigned.trans (add_le_add hfreq hreflect)

/-- The two one-sided Prawitz inequalities combine into a pointwise CDF
bound against the standard normal. -/
theorem cdfBound_standardNormal_le_prawitz
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    CDFBound mu
      NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
      ((1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T)) := by
  intro x
  rw [cdfGap, abs_le]
  constructor
  · have h := standardNormalCDF_sub_cdf_le_prawitz mu hmu1 hT x
    linarith
  · exact cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz mu hmu1 hT x

/-- Supremum-form bidirectional Prawitz smoothing inequality against the
standard normal. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_prawitz
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
          charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) :=
  (kolmogorovDistance_le_iff _ _ _).2
    (cdfBound_standardNormal_le_prawitz mu hmu1 hT)

/-- The sinc-fourth kernel rescaled so its characteristic function is
supported in the target frequency window. -/
noncomputable def scaledSincFourthKernel (T : ℝ) : Measure ℝ :=
  sincFourthKernel.map ((4 / T) * ·)

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (scaledSincFourthKernel T) := by
  unfold scaledSincFourthKernel
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure sincFourthKernel :=
    sincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure
  exact Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_charFun_supported {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    IsCharFunSupportedInFrequencyWindow (scaledSincFourthKernel T) T := by
  intro t ht
  rw [scaledSincFourthKernel, MeasureTheory.charFun_map_mul]
  apply sincFourthKernel_charFun_supported
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos (by norm_num) hT)]
  calc
    4 = (4 / T) * T := by field_simp
    _ < (4 / T) * |t| :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht (div_pos (by norm_num) hT)

theorem integrable_abs_scaledSincFourthKernel {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (scaledSincFourthKernel T) := by
  unfold scaledSincFourthKernel
  have hr : 0 < 4 / T := div_pos (by norm_num) hT
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : ℝ => (4 / T) * x) :=
    (Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (4 / T) hr.ne').measurableEmbedding
  rw [hemb.integrable_map_iff]
  have h := integrable_abs_sincFourthKernel.const_mul (4 / T)
  exact h.congr (ae_of_all sincFourthKernel fun x => by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr])

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_absolutelyContinuous {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    scaledSincFourthKernel T ≪ volume := by
  unfold scaledSincFourthKernel
  have hr : (4 / T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (div_pos (by norm_num) hT).ne'
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : ℝ => (4 / T) * x) :=
    (Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ (4 / T) hr).measurableEmbedding
  have hmap := hemb.absolutelyContinuous_map
    sincFourthKernel_absolutelyContinuous
  rw [Real.map_volume_mul_left hr] at hmap
  exact hmap.trans Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_rightTail_lt_quarter {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (scaledSincFourthKernel T).real
        (Ioi ((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius)) < 1 / 4 := by
  rw [scaledSincFourthKernel,
    map_measureReal_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Ioi]
  have hpre : (fun x : ℝ => (4 / T) * x) ⁻¹'
      Ioi ((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius) = Ioi sincFourthTailRadius := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_Ioi]
    rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left (div_pos (by norm_num) hT)]
  rw [hpre]
  exact sincFourthKernel_rightTail_lt_quarter

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_leftTail_lt_quarter {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (scaledSincFourthKernel T).real
        (Iio (-((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius))) < 1 / 4 := by
  rw [scaledSincFourthKernel,
    map_measureReal_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Iio]
  have hpre : (fun x : ℝ => (4 / T) * x) ⁻¹'
      Iio (-((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius)) = Iio (-sincFourthTailRadius) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_Iio]
    rw [show -((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius) =
        (4 / T) * (-sincFourthTailRadius) by ring]
    rw [mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_left (div_pos (by norm_num) hT)]
  rw [hpre]
  exact sincFourthKernel_leftTail_lt_quarter

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_rightShiftedMoment_le {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ y, |(4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius - y|
      ∂scaledSincFourthKernel T) ≤
      (4 / T) * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
  rw [scaledSincFourthKernel, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hr : 0 < 4 / T := div_pos (by norm_num) hT
  have hfun : (fun y : ℝ =>
      |(4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius - (4 / T) * y|) =
      fun y => (4 / T) * |sincFourthTailRadius - y| := by
    funext y
    rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr]
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    sincFourthKernel_rightShiftedMoment_le hr.le

theorem scaledSincFourthKernel_leftShiftedMoment_le {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ y, |-((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius) - y|
      ∂scaledSincFourthKernel T) ≤
      (4 / T) * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
  rw [scaledSincFourthKernel, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  have hr : 0 < 4 / T := div_pos (by norm_num) hT
  have hfun : (fun y : ℝ =>
      |-((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius) - (4 / T) * y|) =
      fun y => (4 / T) * |-sincFourthTailRadius - y| := by
    funext y
    rw [show -((4 / T) * sincFourthTailRadius) - (4 / T) * y =
      (4 / T) * (-sincFourthTailRadius - y) by ring,
      abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr]
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    sincFourthKernel_leftShiftedMoment_le hr.le

theorem kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_scaledSincFourthKernel
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (hmu1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) mu)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    kolmogorovDistance mu
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          (∫ t in Icc (-T) T, charFunDiscrepancyQuotient mu
            NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / T) * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound)) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure (scaledSincFourthKernel T) :=
    scaledSincFourthKernel_isProbabilityMeasure hT
  exact kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_bandLimitedSmoothingKernel
    mu (scaledSincFourthKernel T) hmu1
    (integrable_abs_scaledSincFourthKernel hT)
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_absolutelyContinuous hT)
    hT.le (by norm_num)
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_charFun_supported hT)
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_rightTail_lt_quarter hT).le
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_leftTail_lt_quarter hT).le
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_rightShiftedMoment_le hT)
    (scaledSincFourthKernel_leftShiftedMoment_le hT)

/-- A positive symmetric cutoff contained in the normalized third-moment
window for every nonnegative third moment. -/
noncomputable def berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) / (1 + 16 * rho)

theorem berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    0 < berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
  unfold berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
  exact div_pos (by positivity) (by positivity)

theorem Icc_berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_normalizedThirdMomentWindow
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    Icc (-(berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N))
        (berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) ⊆
      normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N := by
  intro t ht
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hden : 0 < 1 + 16 * rho := by positivity
  have habs : |t| ≤ berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
    exact abs_le.mpr ht
  constructor
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      |t| ≤ berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := habs
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      16 * rho * |t| ≤
          16 * rho * berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hrho)
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith

/-- Enlarged positive cutoff certified by the sharp Taylor window. -/
noncomputable def sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) / (1 + 2 * rho)

theorem sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    0 < sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
  unfold sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
  exact div_pos (by positivity) (by positivity)

theorem Icc_sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    Icc (-(sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N))
        (sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) ⊆
      sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N := by
  intro t ht
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hden : 0 < 1 + 2 * rho := by positivity
  have habs : |t| ≤ sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
    exact abs_le.mpr ht
  constructor
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      |t| ≤ sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := habs
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      2 * rho * |t| ≤
          2 * rho * sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hrho)
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith

/-- The maximal symmetric cutoff allowed by the sharp cubic window once the
standardized Lyapunov bound `rho ≥ 1` is known. -/
noncomputable def maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
    (rho : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) / (2 * rho)

theorem maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 1 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    0 < maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
  unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
  exact div_pos (by positivity) (mul_pos (by norm_num) (by positivity))

/-- The reciprocal half of the maximal sharp cutoff is exactly the
coefficient-one Berry--Esseen scale. -/
theorem one_div_two_mul_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    1 / (2 * maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) =
      rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
  field_simp

/-- At every sufficiently wide maximal sharp cutoff, the exact bidirectional
law-phase envelope already strictly exceeds the coefficient-one
Berry--Esseen scale at the spatial origin. -/
theorem berryScale_lt_prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope_maximalSharp_zero
    (mu : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ)
    (hcut6 : 6 ≤ maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) :
    rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
      prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope mu
        (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) 0 := by
  rw [← one_div_two_mul_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff hrho N]
  exact one_div_two_mul_lt_prawitzLawPhaseEnvelope_zero mu hcut6

theorem Icc_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 1 ≤ rho) (N : ℕ) :
    Icc (-(maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N))
        (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) ⊆
      sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N := by
  intro t ht
  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hrhoPos : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hden : 0 < 2 * rho := mul_pos (by norm_num) hrhoPos
  have habs : |t| ≤ maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
    exact abs_le.mpr ht
  constructor
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      |t| ≤ maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := habs
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith
  · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_one hsqrt]
    calc
      2 * rho * |t| ≤
          2 * rho * maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs hden.le
      _ = Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
        unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
        field_simp [hden.ne']

theorem integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_window
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    IntegrableOn
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (normalizedThirdMomentWindow
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 8) *
    (4 * rho * |t| ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) +
      |t| ^ 3 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using integrable_gaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q := by
    exact stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  change Integrable q (volume.restrict S)
  apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
  exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2

theorem integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpWindow
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    IntegrableOn
      (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
      (sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-(5 * t ^ 2 / 24)) *
    (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) +
      |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)))
  let S : Set ℝ := sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    simpa only [g] using integrable_sharpGaussianDiscrepancyMajorant rho N
  have hqStrong : StronglyMeasurable q := by
    exact stronglyMeasurable_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  change Integrable q (volume.restrict S)
  apply Integrable.mono' hg.integrableOn hqStrong.aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
    (charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)]
  exact charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_sharp
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN ht.1 ht.2

theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_cutoff_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in Icc
        (-(berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * gaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * gaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let S : Set ℝ := normalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  let J : Set ℝ := Icc (-(berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N))
    (berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using
      integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_window
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  have hJS : J ⊆ S := by
    simpa only [J, S] using
      Icc_berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_normalizedThirdMomentWindow
        hrho N
  have hlocal : (∫ t in J, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := by
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqS
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict S) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hJS.eventuallyLE
  calc
    (∫ t in Icc
        (-(berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) =
        ∫ t in J, q t := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := hlocal
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using
        integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_window_le
          X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN

theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpCutoff_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)

    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :

        (-(sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff

  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using

        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  have hJS : J ⊆ S := by

        (-(sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp

        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) =
