theorem one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    {X : Omega → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 3 mu)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, X omega ^ 2 ∂mu = 1) :
    1 ≤ ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
  have hmonoE : eLpNorm X 2 mu ≤ eLpNorm X 3 mu :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hX.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hmono : lpNorm X 2 mu ≤ lpNorm X 3 mu := by
    rw [← toReal_eLpNorm hX.aestronglyMeasurable,
      ← toReal_eLpNorm hX.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hX.eLpNorm_ne_top hmonoE
  have hnorm2 : lpNorm X 2 mu = 1 := by
    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hX.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [show (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ (2 : ℝ) ∂mu) = 1 by
      simpa only [Real.rpow_two, sq_abs] using hSecond]
    norm_num
  have hnorm3 : lpNorm X 3 mu =
      (∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      hX.aestronglyMeasurable]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact ae_of_all mu fun omega => by
      dsimp only
      norm_num [Real.rpow_natCast]
  rw [hnorm2, hnorm3] at hmono
  have hrho : 0 ≤ ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu :=
    integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  calc
    1 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 3 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ ((∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ 3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hmono 3
    _ = ∫ omega, |X omega| ^ 3 ∂mu := by
      exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hrho (by norm_num)

/-- On the full tunable window, the quartic Gaussian-proxy term is absorbed
into the standardized cubic term.  This removes the frequency obstruction
caused by converting a separate `1 / n` contribution to Berry--Esseen scale. -/
theorem charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable_absorbed
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1) :
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t ≤
      Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hsmall' : c * rho * |t| ≤ s := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs] at hsmall
    rw [show c * rho * (|t| / s) = (c * rho * |t|) / s by ring,
      div_le_one hs] at hsmall
    exact hsmall
  have hcabs : c * |t| ≤ c * rho * |t| := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrho
      (mul_nonneg hc0.le (abs_nonneg t))
    nlinarith
  have hsrho : s ≤ rho * s := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrho hs.le
    nlinarith
  have hbase : c * |t| ≤ rho * s :=
    hcabs.trans (hsmall'.trans hsrho)
  have hscaled : c * |t| ^ 3 ≤ rho * s * |t| ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbase (sq_nonneg |t|)
    nlinarith
  have hquartic : |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
      (1 / (8 * c)) * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s := by
    rw [← hsSq]
    rw [show (1 / (8 * c)) * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s =
      (rho * |t| ^ 2) / (8 * c * s) by ring]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 8 * s ^ 2)
      (by positivity : 0 < 8 * c * s)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscaled
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 8) hs.le)
    nlinarith
  have hpoly :
      rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * s) + |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
        (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s := by
    calc
      rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * s) + |t| ^ 3 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
          rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * s) +
            (1 / (8 * c)) * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s :=
        by simpa only [add_comm] using
          add_le_add_left hquartic (rho * |t| ^ 2 / (6 * s))
      _ = (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s := by ring
  have h :=
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc.le hN ht hsmall
  simpa only [rho, s] using h.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoly (Real.exp_pos _).le)

/-- Pointwise signed-Prawitz majorant for a normalized centered iid sum on a
tunable local window. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T)
    (htaylor : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                  (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N)
                  (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
                    X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable))
              x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
            ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) +
        (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) := by
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hbase := re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_discrepancyQuotient
    law hT ht x
  have hq :=
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable_absorbed
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN htaylor hsmall
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 1 / Real.pi + t / T :=
    add_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos.le)
      (div_nonneg ht.1.le hT.le)
  exact hbase.trans (add_le_add
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hcoef) le_rfl)

/-- Normalized-iid signed majorant with the finite-window Gaussian cosine
term preserved exactly. -/
theorem re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_with_exactGaussian
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T t : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T)
    (htaylor : |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (hsmall : c * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) *
        |t / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)| ≤ 1)
    (x : ℝ) :
    ((Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
          (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
                  (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum
                    X N)
                  (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
                    X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable))
              x t -
            symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
              (MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw)
              x t) +
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun
                NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t)).re ≤
      (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
            ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) +
        2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t) := by
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  have hbase :=
    re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_le_discrepancyQuotient_with_exactGaussian
      law hT ht x
  have hq :=
    charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable_absorbed
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN htaylor hsmall
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ 1 / Real.pi + t / T :=
    add_nonneg (div_nonneg (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos.le)
      (div_nonneg ht.1.le hT.le)
  exact hbase.trans (add_le_add
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hcoef) le_rfl)

/-- The absorbed characteristic-function contribution integrates to its two
positive-half-line tunable moments.  No Gaussian remainder is included in
this estimate. -/
theorem integral_Icc_absorbedPrawitzFrequencyMajorant_le
    {c A T : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
            (A * |t| ^ 2))) ≤
      A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
        (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) := by
  let f2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |t| ^ 2 *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))
  let f3 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |t| ^ 3 *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t
  have hf2 : Integrable f2 := by
    simpa only [f2] using
      integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 2
  have hf3 : Integrable f3 := by
    simpa only [f3] using
      integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 3
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact (hf2.const_mul (A / Real.pi)).add (hf3.const_mul (A / T))
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g, f2, f3]
    positivity
  have hrewrite :
      (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
          (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
            (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
              (A * |t| ^ 2))) =
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, g t := by
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
    intro t ht
    dsimp only [g, f2, f3]
    rw [abs_of_pos ht.1]
    ring
  calc
    (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
          (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
            (A * |t| ^ 2))) =
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
          (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
            (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
              (A * |t| ^ 2)) := integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo
    _ = ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, g t := hrewrite
    _ ≤ ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g t := by
      exact integral_mono_measure
        (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume Ioo_subset_Ioi_self)
        (ae_of_all (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) hgNonneg) hg.integrableOn
    _ = (A / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (A / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2) := by
      rw [show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g t) =
          (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (A / Real.pi) * f2 t) +
            ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (A / T) * f3 t by
        simpa only [g, Pi.add_apply] using
          integral_add
            (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
            (hf2.const_mul (A / Real.pi)).integrableOn
            (hf3.const_mul (A / T)).integrableOn,
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
        show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f2 t) =
            tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2 by
          simpa only [f2] using
            integral_Ioi_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq c 2,
        show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f3 t) =
            tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2 by
          simpa only [f3] using
            integral_Ioi_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq c 3]
    _ = A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) := by ring

/-- Integrating the absorbed positive-frequency Prawitz majorant costs exactly
one half of the full-line quadratic and cubic tunable moments.  The finite
window is retained on the left; extending only the nonnegative majorant to the
positive half-line yields the displayed universal upper bound. -/
theorem integral_Icc_absorbedPrawitzMajorant_le
    {c A T : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
            (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
              (A * |t| ^ 2)) +
          (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) ≤
      A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
        (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / T := by
  let f2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |t| ^ 2 *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))
  let f3 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |t| ^ 3 *
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2))
  let f0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t + (2 / T) * f0 t
  have hf2 : Integrable f2 := by
    simpa only [f2] using
      integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 2
  have hf3 : Integrable f3 := by
    simpa only [f3] using
      integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 3
  have hf0 : Integrable f0 := by
    have h := integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
    apply h.congr
    exact ae_of_all _ fun t => by
      dsimp only [f0]
      congr 1
      ring
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact ((hf2.const_mul (A / Real.pi)).add
      (hf3.const_mul (A / T))).add (hf0.const_mul (2 / T))
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g, f2, f3, f0]
    positivity
  have hrewrite :
      (∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
          (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
              (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
                (A * |t| ^ 2)) +
            (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) =
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, g t := by
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
    intro t ht
    dsimp only [g, f2, f3, f0]
    rw [abs_of_pos ht.1]
    ring
  have hgauss : (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f0 t) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2 := by
    rw [show (fun t : ℝ => f0 t) =
        fun t => Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * t ^ 2) by
      funext t
      dsimp only [f0]
      congr 1
      ring,
      integral_gaussian_Ioi]
    congr 2
    ring
  calc
    (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
            (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
              (A * |t| ^ 2)) +
          (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)) =
        ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
          (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
              (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
                (A * |t| ^ 2)) +
            (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) :=
      integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo
    _ = ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, g t := hrewrite
    _ ≤ ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g t := by
      exact integral_mono_measure
        (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume Ioo_subset_Ioi_self)
        (ae_of_all (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))) hgNonneg) hg.integrableOn
    _ = (A / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (A / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2) +
          (2 / T) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / 2) := by
      have h12 :
          (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
              (A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t) =
            (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (A / Real.pi) * f2 t) +
              ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (A / T) * f3 t := by
        simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using
          integral_add
            (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
            (hf2.const_mul (A / Real.pi)).integrableOn
            (hf3.const_mul (A / T)).integrableOn
      have h123 :
          (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
              ((A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t) +
                (2 / T) * f0 t) =
            (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
              (A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t) +
              ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (2 / T) * f0 t := by
        simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using
          integral_add
            (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
            ((hf2.const_mul (A / Real.pi)).add
              (hf3.const_mul (A / T))).integrableOn
            (hf0.const_mul (2 / T)).integrableOn
      change (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
          (A / Real.pi) * f2 t + (A / T) * f3 t + (2 / T) * f0 t) = _
      rw [h123, h12]
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
        show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f2 t) =
            tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2 by
          simpa only [f2] using
            integral_Ioi_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq c 2,
        show (∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), f3 t) =
            tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2 by
          simpa only [f3] using
            integral_Ioi_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq c 3,
        hgauss]
    _ = A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / T := by ring

/-- Forward signed-CDF consequence of the absorbed Prawitz integrand bound at
the maximal cutoff allowed by the tunable Taylor window.  This keeps the
quadratic and cubic frequency costs separate from the exact Gaussian Fejér
remainder. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_signedPrawitz_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) *
        ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) *
            (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
        Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) /
          admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  let A : ℝ := (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho /
    Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun law) x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun target) x t) +
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun target (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun target t)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
        (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
          (A * |t| ^ 2)) +
      (2 / T) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hT : 0 < T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc0 hrho0 N
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by
    dsimp only [A]
    positivity
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have hLaw := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      law hLaw1 hT x
    have hTarget := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      target integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
    have hP := (hLaw.sub hTarget).const_mul
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
    have hR : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun target (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun target t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
      simpa only [target] using
        (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
    simpa only [F] using hP.add hR
  have hg : IntegrableOn g (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous g).integrableOn_Icc
  have hFre : IntegrableOn (fun t => (F t).re) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    Integrable.re hF
  have hwindow : Icc (-T) T ⊆
      tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N := by
    simpa only [T] using
      Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window hc0 hrho0 N
  have hIntegral : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re) ≤
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, g t := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    apply integral_mono_ae
      (hFre.mono_set Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
      (hg.mono_set Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
    have htJ : t ∈ Icc (-T) T := ⟨by linarith [hT.le, ht.1], ht.2.le⟩
    have htWindow := hwindow htJ
    have hpoint :=
      re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN hT ht
          htWindow.1 htWindow.2 x
    dsimp only [F, g, law, target, T, A, Y, rho]
    convert hpoint using 1; ring
  have hsigned := cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    law hLaw1 hT x
  have hmajor := integral_Icc_absorbedPrawitzMajorant_le hc hA hT
  change cdf law x - cdf target x ≤ _
  calc
    cdf law x - cdf target x ≤ (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re := by
      simpa only [F, target] using hsigned
    _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re :=
      (integral_re hF).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, g t := hIntegral
    _ ≤ A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
          Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / T := by
      simpa only [g] using hmajor
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Forward signed-CDF bound at the admissible tunable cutoff which bounds
only the characteristic-function contribution and retains the exact uniform
finite-window Gaussian remainder. -/
theorem cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_signedPrawitz_tunable_finiteGaussian
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (x : ℝ) :
    cdf
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          x -
        cdf NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw x ≤
      ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) *
        ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) *
            (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
        prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) 0 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  let A : ℝ := (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho /
    Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
    (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) *
        (symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T (MeasureTheory.charFun law) x t -
          symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand T
            (MeasureTheory.charFun target) x t) +
      (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun target (-t) +
          Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            MeasureTheory.charFun target t)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    (1 / Real.pi + t / T) *
      (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
        (A * |t| ^ 2))
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    2 * prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t *
      Real.exp (-(t ^ 2) / 2) * Real.cos (x * t)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hT : 0 < T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc0 hrho0 N
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by
    dsimp only [A]
    positivity
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |y|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hF : IntegrableOn F (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    have hLaw := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      law hLaw1 hT x
    have hTarget := integrableOn_symmetricPrawitzPVIntegrand_charFun
      target integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT x
    have hP := (hLaw.sub hTarget).const_mul
      (Complex.I / (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))
    have hR : IntegrableOn (fun t =>
        (prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight T t : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun target (-t) +
            Complex.exp (((-(x * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
              MeasureTheory.charFun target t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
      simpa only [target] using
        (integrable_pairedPrawitzReflectionFrequencyIntegrand
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw hT x).integrableOn
    simpa only [F] using hP.add hR
  have hg : IntegrableOn g (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous g).integrableOn_Icc
  have hr : IntegrableOn r (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply Continuous.integrableOn_Icc
    dsimp only [r]
    unfold prawitzFejerFrequencyWeight
    fun_prop
  have hgr : IntegrableOn (fun t => g t + r t) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using hg.add hr
  have hFre : IntegrableOn (fun t => (F t).re) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    Integrable.re hF
  have hwindow : Icc (-T) T ⊆
      tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N := by
    simpa only [T] using
      Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window hc0 hrho0 N
  have hIntegral : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re) ≤
      ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (g t + r t) := by
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    apply integral_mono_ae
      (hFre.mono_set Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
      (hgr.mono_set Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
    have htJ : t ∈ Icc (-T) T := ⟨by linarith [hT.le, ht.1], ht.2.le⟩
    have htWindow := hwindow htJ
    have hpoint :=
      re_forwardPrawitzSingleIntegrand_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_with_exactGaussian
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN hT ht
          htWindow.1 htWindow.2 x
    dsimp only [F, g, r, law, target, T, A, Y, rho]
    convert hpoint using 1; ring
  have hsigned := cdf_sub_standardNormalCDF_le_prawitz_singleSignedIntegral
    law hLaw1 hT x
  have hmajor := integral_Icc_absorbedPrawitzFrequencyMajorant_le hc hA hT
  have hrBound : (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, r t) ≤
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 := by
    simpa only [r, prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder] using
      prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder_le_zero hT x
  change cdf law x - cdf target x ≤ _
  calc
    cdf law x - cdf target x ≤ (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, F t).re := by
      simpa only [F, target] using hsigned
    _ = ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (F t).re :=
      (integral_re hF).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, (g t + r t) := hIntegral
    _ = (∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, g t) +
          ∫ t in Icc (0 : ℝ) T, r t := by
      exact integral_add hg hr
    _ ≤ A * ((1 / Real.pi) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 / 2) +
          (1 / T) * (tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3 / 2)) +
        prawitzGaussianCosineRemainder T 0 := add_le_add hmajor hrBound
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Integrated absorbed tunable discrepancy: only the quadratic damped
moment remains in the leading Berry--Esseen scale. -/
theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow_le_absorbed
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N,
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let A : ℝ := (1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho / s
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => A *
    (|t| ^ 2 * Real.exp
      (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient c * t ^ 2 / 2)))
  let S : Set ℝ := tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp only [A]; positivity
  have hgNonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ g t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [g]
    positivity
  have hg : Integrable g := by
    have h2 := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hc 2
    simpa only [g] using h2.const_mul A
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using
      integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    simpa only [S] using measurableSet_tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  change (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ _
  calc
    (∫ t in S, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, g t := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hqS hg.integrableOn
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hS] with t ht
      have hpoint :=
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable_absorbed
          X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN ht.1 ht.2
      dsimp only [g, A, q, law, target, rho, s]
      convert hpoint using 1; ring
    _ ≤ ∫ t, g t :=
      integral_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self
        (ae_of_all volume hgNonneg) hg
    _ = A * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      rfl
    _ = _ := rfl

theorem integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_maximalSharpCutoff_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in Icc
        (-(maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      ((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
      (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
        X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let S : Set ℝ := sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N
  let J : Set ℝ := Icc (-(maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N))
    (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using
      integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpWindow
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  have hJS : J ⊆ S := by
    simpa only [J, S] using
      Icc_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
        hrho N
  have hlocal : (∫ t in J, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := by
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqS
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict S) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hJS.eventuallyLE
  calc
    (∫ t in Icc
        (-(maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N))
        (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) =
        ∫ t in J, q t := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := hlocal
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho] using
        integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpWindow_le
          X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN

/-- The maximal sharp normalized-iid discrepancy window with the certified
uniform Prawitz-filter factor. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_maximalSharpCutoff_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0
        (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
          (maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        (((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
          (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let T : ℝ := maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N
  let J : Set ℝ := Icc (-T) T
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT : 0 < T := maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos hrho N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hweighted :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_le_const
      law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT
  have hqJ : IntegrableOn q J := by
    have hqS : IntegrableOn q (sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N) := by
      simpa only [q, law, target, rho, Y] using
        integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_sharpWindow
          X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
    have hJS : J ⊆ sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow rho N := by
      simpa only [J, T] using
        Icc_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_subset_sharpNormalizedThirdMomentWindow
          hrho N
    exact hqS.mono_set hJS
  have hpositive : (∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t) ≤ ∫ t in J, q t := by
    have hsubset : Icc 0 T ⊆ J := by
      intro t ht
      exact ⟨by linarith [hT.le, ht.1], ht.2⟩
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqJ
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict J) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hsubset.eventuallyLE
  have hlocal :=
    integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_maximalSharpCutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  have hC : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by positivity
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t := hweighted
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * ∫ t in J, q t :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpositive hC
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC
      simpa only [J, T, q, rho, law, target, Y] using hlocal

/-- Explicit bidirectional Prawitz smoothing estimate for normalized centered
iid sums at the maximal certified sharp Taylor cutoff. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_maximalSharp
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
              (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          (2 * Real.pi /
            maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T : ℝ := maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT : 0 < T := maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos hrho N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth := kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_prawitz law hLaw1 hT
  have hlocal :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_maximalSharpCutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
            charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

  have hqS : IntegrableOn q
      (tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N) := by
    simpa only [q, law, target, rho, Y] using

  have hJS : J ⊆ tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N := by

  have hqJ : IntegrableOn q J := hqS.mono_set hJS
