      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * ∫ t in Icc 0 T, q t := hweighted
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * ∫ t in J, q t :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpositive hC
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC
      exact hJwindow.trans (by
        simpa only [q, rho, law, target, Y] using hlocal)

/-- Bidirectional Prawitz smoothing for the normalized iid sum at the full
tunable cutoff, with the spatial term kept exact. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                (6 * Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
                  tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
              (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) *
                  tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          (2 * Real.pi /
            admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT : 0 < T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    (lt_trans (by norm_num) hc) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho) N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth := kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_prawitz law hLaw1 hT
  have hlocal :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableCutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
            charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

/-- The absorbed tunable discrepancy controls an initial Taylor band even
when the Prawitz filter uses a larger smoothing bandwidth. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableLocal_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0
        (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  let J : Set ℝ := Icc (-T₀) T₀
  let S : Set ℝ := tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ :=
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc0 hrho0 N
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hfilter :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_local_le_const
      law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT₀.le hT
        (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho, Y] using
      integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  have hJS : J ⊆ S := by
    simpa only [J, S, T₀] using
      Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window hc0 hrho0 N
  have hqJ : IntegrableOn q J := hqS.mono_set hJS
  have hpositive : (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t) ≤ ∫ t in J, q t := by
    have hsubset : Icc 0 T₀ ⊆ J := by
      intro t ht
      exact ⟨by linarith [hT₀.le, ht.1], ht.2⟩
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqJ
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict J) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hsubset.eventuallyLE
  have hJwindow : (∫ t in J, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := by
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqS
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict S) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hJS.eventuallyLE
  have habsorbed :=
    integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow_le_absorbed
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  have hlocal : (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t) ≤
      ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho /
        Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 := by
    exact hpositive.trans (hJwindow.trans (by
      simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho, Y] using habsorbed))
  have hC : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by positivity
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤ _
  exact hfilter.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal hC)

/-- The normalized-iid Prawitz integral with independent Taylor and smoothing
cutoffs.  The certified absorbed discrepancy controls the Taylor window, while
the exact scaled-filter tail is retained on the additional smoothing band. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableTwoCutoff_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N ≤ T) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2) +
      ∫ t in Ioc
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) T,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  let J : Set ℝ := Icc (-T₀) T₀
  let S : Set ℝ := tunableNormalizedThirdMomentWindow c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ :=
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc0 hrho0 N
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsplit :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_le_twoCutoff
      law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT₀
        (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hfilter :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_local_le_const
      law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hT₀.le hT
        (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hqS : IntegrableOn q S := by
    simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho, Y] using
      integrableOn_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  have hJS : J ⊆ S := by
    simpa only [J, S, T₀] using
      Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window hc0 hrho0 N
  have hqJ : IntegrableOn q J := hqS.mono_set hJS
  have hpositive : (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t) ≤ ∫ t in J, q t := by
    have hsubset : Icc 0 T₀ ⊆ J := by
      intro t ht
      exact ⟨by linarith [hT₀.le, ht.1], ht.2⟩
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqJ
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict J) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hsubset.eventuallyLE
  have hJwindow : (∫ t in J, q t) ≤ ∫ t in S, q t := by
    exact setIntegral_mono_set hqS
      (ae_of_all (volume.restrict S) fun t =>
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_nonneg law target t)
      hJS.eventuallyLE
  have habsorbed :=
    integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableWindow_le_absorbed
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  have hlocal : (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t) ≤
      ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) * rho /
        Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 := by
    exact hpositive.trans (hJwindow.trans (by
      simpa only [q, S, law, target, rho, Y] using habsorbed))
  have hC : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32 := by positivity
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * q t) +
        ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|) := hsplit
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T₀, q t) +
        ∫ t in Ioc T₀ T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|) :=
      add_le_add hfilter le_rfl
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [T₀, rho] using
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal hC) le_rfl

/-- Nested tunable windows keep Berry-scale Gaussian control on the outer
annulus instead of replacing it by the scale-free universal discrepancy
bound.  The exact smoothing filter remains inside the annular integral. -/
theorem integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableNested_le
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {cOuter cInner : ℝ} (hcOuter : 1 / 3 < cOuter)
    (hcOuterInner : cOuter ≤ cInner) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    (∫ t in Icc 0
        (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) t‖ *
        charFunDiscrepancyQuotient
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
            (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
              X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
          NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw t) ≤
      (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cInner)) *
          (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
            Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment cInner 2) +
      ∫ t in Ioc
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cInner
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N)
          (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
            (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
            (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) t‖ *
          (Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient cOuter * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
            ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cOuter)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target
  let TInner : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cInner rho N
  let TOuter : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter rho N
  let AOuter : ℝ := 1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cOuter)
  let m : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    Real.exp (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient cOuter * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
      (AOuter * rho * |t| ^ 2 / s)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hcOuter0 : 0 < cOuter := lt_trans (by norm_num) hcOuter
  have hcInner : 1 / 3 < cInner := hcOuter.trans_le hcOuterInner
  have hcInner0 : 0 < cInner := lt_trans (by norm_num) hcInner
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hTInner : 0 < TInner :=
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hcInner0 hrho0 N
  have hTOuter : 0 < TOuter :=
    admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hcOuter0 hrho0 N
  have hcut : TInner ≤ TOuter := by
    dsimp only [TInner, TOuter]
    exact admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_antitone hrho0 hcOuter0
      hcOuterInner N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsplit :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_split
      law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hTInner hcut
  have hinner :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableLocal_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hcInner hN
        (by simpa only [TInner, TOuter, rho] using hcut)
  have hm : Integrable m := by
    have hbase := integrable_abs_pow_mul_rexp_neg_tunable_sq hcOuter 2
    have hscaled := hbase.const_mul (AOuter * rho / s)
    convert hscaled using 1
    funext t
    dsimp only [m]
    ring
  have hm0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ m t := fun t => by
    dsimp only [m, AOuter]
    positivity
  have hmajor : IntegrableOn
      (fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * m t)
      (Ioc TInner TOuter) := by
    apply hm.integrableOn.bdd_mul (c := 7)
    · exact (measurable_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter).norm
        |>.aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with t ht
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] using
        norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_le_seven hTOuter
          ⟨hTInner.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hactual : IntegrableOn
      (fun t => ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t)
      (Ioc TInner TOuter) := by
    have hfull :=
      integrableOn_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy
        law target hLaw1 integrable_abs_standardNormalLaw hTOuter
    apply hfull.mono_set
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hTInner.le.trans ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have htail : (∫ t in Ioc TInner TOuter,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t) ≤
      ∫ t in Ioc TInner TOuter,
        ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * m t := by
    apply setIntegral_mono_on hactual hmajor measurableSet_Ioc
    intro t ht
    have htWindow :=
      Icc_admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_subset_window
        hcOuter0 hrho0 N
        (show t ∈ Icc (-TOuter) TOuter from
          ⟨by linarith [hTInner.le, ht.1], ht.2⟩)
    have hpoint :=
      charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_gaussian_tunable_absorbed
        X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hcOuter hN
          htWindow.1 htWindow.2
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (by simpa only [q, m, AOuter, law, target, rho, s, Y] using hpoint)
      (norm_nonneg _)
  change (∫ t in Icc 0 TOuter,
      ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t) ≤ _
  calc
    _ = (∫ t in Icc 0 TInner,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t) +
        ∫ t in Ioc TInner TOuter,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t := hsplit
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
          (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cInner)) * rho / s) *
            tunableGaussianDampedMoment cInner 2) +
        ∫ t in Ioc TInner TOuter,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ * q t := by
      simpa only [TInner, TOuter, rho, s, q, law, target, Y] using
        add_le_add hinner le_rfl
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [TInner, TOuter, rho, s, q, m, AOuter, law, target, Y] using
        add_le_add le_rfl htail

/-- Bidirectional Prawitz smoothing with two nested tunable characteristic-
function windows and the exact outer-annulus filter integral. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunableNested
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {cOuter cInner : ℝ} (hcOuter : 1 / 3 < cOuter)
    (hcOuterInner : cOuter ≤ cInner) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cInner)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) *
                  tunableGaussianDampedMoment cInner 2) +
            ∫ t in Ioc
                (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cInner
                  (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N)
                (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
                  (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N),
              ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter
                  (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
                    (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) t‖ *
                (Real.exp
                    (-(tunableCharFunDampingCoefficient cOuter * t ^ 2 / 2)) *
                  ((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * cOuter)) *
                    (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) * |t| ^ 2 /
                      Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)))) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          (2 * Real.pi /
            admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let TOuter : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff cOuter rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hTOuter : 0 < TOuter := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    (lt_trans (by norm_num) hcOuter) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho) N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth :=
    kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_prawitz law hLaw1 hTOuter
  have hweighted :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableNested_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hcOuter hcOuterInner hN
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 TOuter,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter TOuter t‖ *
            charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / TOuter) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [TOuter, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

/-- Bidirectional Prawitz smoothing with the Taylor cutoff decoupled from the
smoothing bandwidth.  This is the exact two-cutoff endpoint from which the
remaining dimensionless filter tail can be optimized. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable_twoCutoff
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N ≤ T) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2) +
            ∫ t in Ioc
                (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
                  (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) T,
              ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ * (2 / |t|)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    (lt_trans (by norm_num) hc) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho) N
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth := kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_prawitz law hLaw1 hT
  have hlocal :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_discrepancy_normalizedCenteredIidSum_tunableTwoCutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN hT₀T
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Icc 0 T,
          ‖scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter T t‖ *
            charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T₀, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

/-- The two-cutoff normalized-iid Prawitz estimate with its outer filter band
replaced by a closed logarithmic function of the bandwidth ratio. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable_twoCutoff_log
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N ≤ T) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2) +
            2 * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
              Real.log (T /
                admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
                  (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N)) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    (lt_trans (by norm_num) hc) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho) N
  have htail :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_le_log
      hT₀ (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
  have hexact :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable_twoCutoff
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN hT₀T
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤ _ := hexact
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T₀, rho] at htail
      gcongr

/-- The endpoint-sensitive two-cutoff Prawitz estimate.  Its explicit outer
cost is quadratic as the smoothing bandwidth approaches the Taylor cutoff. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable_twoCutoff_endpoint
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N)
    {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N ≤ T)
    (hTT₀ : T ≤ 2 * admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
      (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          ((1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
            (((1 / 6 + 1 / (8 * c)) *
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
                Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2) +
            2 * (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2 + Real.pi) *
              (Real.log (T /
                  admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
                    (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) -
                (1 - admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c
                    (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N / T))) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos
    (lt_trans (by norm_num) hc) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho) N
  have htail :=
    integral_norm_scaledPrawitzSmoothingFilter_mul_two_div_abs_tail_le_endpoint
      hT₀ (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hT₀T)
        (by simpa only [T₀, rho] using hTT₀)
  have hexact :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable_twoCutoff
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN hT₀T
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤ _ := hexact
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T₀, rho] at htail
      gcongr

/-- If the Taylor cutoff is `s / (2 rho)` and the smoothing bandwidth stays
within the endpoint-sensitive factor-two range, then the spatial Prawitz term
alone is strictly larger than the target Berry--Esseen scale `rho / s`. -/
theorem prawitzEndpointSpatialTerm_gt_berryScale
    {rho s T₀ T : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hT₀Eq : T₀ = s / (2 * rho)) (hT₀T : T₀ ≤ T)
    (hTT₀ : T ≤ 2 * T₀) :
    rho / s < (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  have hR : 1 < R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
  have hRSq : R ^ 2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ := by rw [hT₀Eq]; positivity
  have hT : 0 < T := hT₀.trans_le hT₀T
  have hUpper : T * rho ≤ s := by
    have hEq : 2 * T₀ = s / rho := by
      rw [hT₀Eq]
      field_simp
    rw [hEq] at hTT₀
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hrho).mp hTT₀
  have hInv : rho / s ≤ 1 / T := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hs hT]
    simpa only [mul_one, mul_comm] using hUpper
  have hStrict : 1 / T < R / T :=
    (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hT).2 hR
  have hSpatial : R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) = R / T := by
    field_simp [hT.ne', (lt_trans zero_lt_one hR).ne']
    nlinarith [hRSq]
  rw [show (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) =
      R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) by rfl, hSpatial]
  exact hInv.trans_lt hStrict

/-- Concrete `c = 2` consequence: every bandwidth covered by the sharpened
endpoint tail estimate still has a spatial term exceeding coefficient one. -/
theorem prawitzTunableTwoCutoffEndpoint_spatial_gt_berryScale
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 1 ≤ rho) {N : ℕ} {T : ℝ}
    (hT₀T : admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff 2 rho N ≤ T)
    (hTT₀ : T ≤ 2 * admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff 2 rho N) :
    rho / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let T₀ : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff 2 rho N
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hmax : max 1 (2 * rho) = 2 * rho :=
    max_eq_right (by nlinarith)
  have hT₀Eq : T₀ = s / (2 * rho) := by
    dsimp only [T₀, s]
    rw [admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max
      (by norm_num) hrho0 N, hmax]
  exact prawitzEndpointSpatialTerm_gt_berryScale hrho0 hs hT₀Eq
    (by simpa only [T₀] using hT₀T)
    (by simpa only [T₀] using hTT₀)

/-- Every admissible tunable Taylor cutoff is capped by `sqrt (N+1)`.  Hence
the Prawitz spatial remainder alone exceeds the coefficient-one scale when
the standardized third moment takes its minimal value `rho = 1`, independently
of how the tunable frequency window is split. -/
theorem prawitzAdmissibleTunableCutoff_spatial_gt_minimalBerryScale
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    1 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
        (2 * Real.pi / admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N) := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hT : 0 < T := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc hrho N
  have hTs : T ≤ s := by
    dsimp only [T, s, admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hR : 1 < R := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
  have hRSq : R ^ 2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hInv : 1 / s ≤ 1 / T := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hT hTs
  have hStrict : 1 / T < R / T :=
    (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hT).2 hR
  have hSpatial : R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) = R / T := by
    field_simp [hT.ne', (lt_trans zero_lt_one hR).ne']
    nlinarith [hRSq]
  change 1 / s < R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T)
  rw [hSpatial]
  exact hInv.trans_lt hStrict

/-- The Gaussian half-line term produced by the integrated signed majorant is
algebraically the same Prawitz spatial remainder that appears in the original
one-sided smoothing inequality. -/
theorem sqrt_two_pi_div_eq_prawitzSpatialRemainder
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) / T =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
  let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp only [R]; positivity
  have hRSq : R ^ 2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  change R / T = R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T)
  field_simp [hT.ne', hR.ne']
  nlinarith

/-- Consequently, the positive Gaussian remainder left by the componentwise
signed-integrand estimate already exceeds the minimal coefficient-one
Berry--Esseen scale at every admissible tunable cutoff. -/
theorem signedPrawitzTunableGaussianRemainder_gt_minimalBerryScale
    {c rho : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hrho : 0 < rho) (N : ℕ) :
    1 / Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) <
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) /
        admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N := by
  rw [sqrt_two_pi_div_eq_prawitzSpatialRemainder
    (admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_pos hc hrho N)]
  exact prawitzAdmissibleTunableCutoff_spatial_gt_minimalBerryScale
    hc hrho N

/-- Universal coefficient exposed by the tunable Prawitz route after the
exact admissible cutoff is converted to the Berry--Esseen scale. -/
noncomputable def prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant (c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.pi) * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
      ((1 / 6) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
        (1 / 8) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3) +
    Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) * max 1 c

theorem prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant_nonneg
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    0 ≤ prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant c := by
  have hM2 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 2
  have hM3 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 3
  unfold prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant
  positivity

/-- The exact spatial term alone rules out coefficient one for every
admissible value of the tunable Prawitz parameter. -/
theorem one_lt_prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) :
    1 < prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant c := by
  have hM2 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 2
  have hM3 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 3
  have hR : 1 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
  have hmax : 1 ≤ max 1 c := le_max_left _ _
  have hfreq : 0 ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        ((1 / 6) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2 +
          (1 / 8) * tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3) := by positivity
  unfold prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax (by positivity :
    0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))]

/-- Consolidated normalized-iid consequence of the tunable Prawitz route. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 / 3 < c) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant c *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let M2 : ℝ := tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 2
  let M3 : ℝ := tunableGaussianDampedMoment c 3
  let C : ℝ := 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32
  let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  let T : ℝ := admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff c rho N
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hc0 : 0 < c := lt_trans (by norm_num) hc
  have hrho0 : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hn : 0 < (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
  have hM2 : 0 ≤ M2 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 2
  have hM3 : 0 ≤ M3 := tunableGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg c 3
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp only [R]; positivity
  have hRSq : R ^ 2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hInv : 1 / (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho / s := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hn hs]
    have hs_le_n : s ≤ (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hsSq]
      nlinarith
    have hn_le : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho * (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using hs_le_n.trans hn_le
  have hFirst :
      (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 = ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have hSecondTerm :
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
        ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
    calc
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 8) * M3) * (1 / (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hn.ne']
      _ ≤ ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInv (by positivity)
  have hFrequency :
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3)) ≤
        ((1 / Real.pi) * C *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3)) * (rho / s) := by
    rw [hFirst]
    have hadd := add_le_add_left hSecondTerm (((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s))
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s)) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s))) := by
        gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hmax : max 1 (c * rho) ≤ max 1 c * rho := by
    apply max_le
    · calc
        (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ max 1 c * rho := mul_le_mul
          (le_max_left _ _) hrho (by norm_num) (by positivity)
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hrho0.le
  have hSpatialExact :
      R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) = R * max 1 (c * rho) / s := by
    rw [show T = s / max 1 (c * rho) by
      dsimp only [T, s]
      exact admissibleTunableThirdMomentCutoff_eq_sqrt_div_max hc0 hrho0 N]
    have hm : 0 < max 1 (c * rho) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
    field_simp [hs.ne', hR.ne', hm.ne']
    nlinarith [hRSq]
  have hSpatial :
      R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) ≤
        (R * max 1 c) * (rho / s) := by
    rw [hSpatialExact]
    calc
      R * max 1 (c * rho) / s ≤ R * (max 1 c * rho) / s := by
        gcongr
      _ = (R * max 1 c) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have h := kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_tunable
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hc hN
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3)) +
        R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi / T) := by
      simpa only [rho, s, M2, M3, C, R, T] using h
    _ ≤ ((1 / Real.pi) * C *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3)) * (rho / s) +
        (R * max 1 c) * (rho / s) :=
      add_le_add hFrequency hSpatial
    _ = prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant c * rho / s := by
      dsimp only [prawitzTunableBerryEsseenConstant, C, M2, M3, R]
      ring
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- Universal constant exposed by the maximal-cutoff bidirectional Prawitz
route with the certified uniform filter factor. -/
noncomputable def prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant : ℝ :=
  (1 / Real.pi) * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
      ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) +
    2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

theorem prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant_nonneg :
    0 ≤ prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
  have hM2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  unfold prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
  positivity

/-- The exact Fejer term at the maximal sharp Taylor cutoff already forces
this Prawitz-route constant above the source coefficient one. -/
theorem one_lt_prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant :
    1 < prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
  have hM2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hR : 1 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
    nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
  have hfreq : 0 ≤
      (1 / Real.pi) * (1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32) *
        ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
          (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) := by
    positivity
  unfold prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
  nlinarith

/-- Consolidated normalized-iid consequence of the maximal-cutoff Prawitz
route. -/
theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let M2 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2
  let M3 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3
  let C : ℝ := 1 + Real.pi ^ 2 / 32
  let R : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hrhoPos : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hs : 0 < s := by dsimp only [s]; positivity
  have hn : 0 < (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
  have hM2 : 0 ≤ M2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 : 0 ≤ M3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp only [C]; positivity
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp only [R]; positivity
  have hRSq : R ^ 2 = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
    positivity
  have hInv : 1 / (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho / s := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hn hs]
    have hs_le_n : s ≤ (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hsSq]
      nlinarith
    have hn_le : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho * (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using hs_le_n.trans hn_le
  have hFirst :
      (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 = ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have hSecondTerm :
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
        ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
    calc
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 8) * M3) * (1 / (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hn.ne']
      _ ≤ ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInv (by positivity)
  have hFrequency :
      (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3)) ≤
        ((1 / Real.pi) * C *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3)) * (rho / s) := by
    rw [hFirst]
    have hadd := add_le_add_left hSecondTerm (((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s))
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s)) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s))) := by
        gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hSpatial :
      R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi /
          maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) =
        (2 * R) * (rho / s) := by
    rw [show maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N = s / (2 * rho) by rfl]
    field_simp [hs.ne', hrhoPos.ne', hR.ne']
    nlinarith [hRSq]
  have h := kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_prawitz_maximalSharp
    X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / Real.pi) *
          (C * ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3)) +
        R⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi /
          maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) := by
      simpa only [rho, s, M2, M3, C, R] using h
    _ ≤ ((1 / Real.pi) * C *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3)) * (rho / s) +
        (2 * R) * (rho / s) := by
      rw [hSpatial]
      exact add_le_add hFrequency le_rfl
    _ = prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant * rho / s := by
      dsimp only [prawitzMaximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant, C, M2, M3, R]
      ring
    _ = _ := rfl

theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_explicit
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((4 * (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
              Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)) * gaussianDampedMoment 2 +
            (1 / (4 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * gaussianDampedMoment 3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff
              (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) N) *
            sincFourthShiftedMomentBound)) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let Y : Omega → ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N
  have hY : MemLp Y 2 mu :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
      X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N
  let law : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw Y hY.aemeasurable
  let target : Measure ℝ :=
    NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw
  let T : ℝ := berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure law := inferInstance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure target := inferInstance
  have hrho : 0 ≤ rho := integral_nonneg fun _ => by positivity
  have hT : 0 < T := berryEsseenFrequencyCutoff_pos hrho N
  have hLaw1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) law := by
    change Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) (Measure.map Y mu)
    rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hY.aemeasurable]
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth := kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_scaledSincFourthKernel
    law hLaw1 hT
  have hlocal :=
    integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_cutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (∫ t in Icc (-T) T,
              charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((4 / T) * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound)) /
          (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      (hY.integrable (by norm_num)).norm
  have hsmooth := kolmogorovDistance_standardNormal_le_scaledSincFourthKernel
    law hLaw1 hT
  have hlocal :=
    integral_charFunDiscrepancyQuotient_normalizedCenteredIidSum_maximalSharpCutoff_le
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  change kolmogorovDistance law target ≤ _
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance law target ≤
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (∫ t in Icc (-T) T,
              charFunDiscrepancyQuotient law target t) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((4 / T) * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound)) /
          (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := hsmooth
    _ ≤ _ := by
      dsimp only [T, rho, law, target, Y]
      gcongr

/-- A universal constant certified by the concrete sinc-fourth smoothing
kernel and the Gaussian-damped Fourier majorant. -/
noncomputable def berryEsseenConstant : ℝ :=
  2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      (4 * gaussianDampedMoment 2 + (1 / 4) * gaussianDampedMoment 3) +
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
      (68 * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound))

theorem berryEsseenConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ berryEsseenConstant := by
  have hM2 := gaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 := gaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hK : 0 ≤ sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
    unfold sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  unfold berryEsseenConstant
  exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM2)
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM3)))
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK)))

/-- Improved universal constant obtained from the sharp Taylor route while
retaining the existing sinc-fourth smoothing kernel. -/
noncomputable def sharpBerryEsseenConstant : ℝ :=
  2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) +
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
      (12 * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound))

theorem sharpBerryEsseenConstant_nonneg : 0 ≤ sharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
  have hM2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hK : 0 ≤ sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
    unfold sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  unfold sharpBerryEsseenConstant
  exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM2)
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM3)))
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK)))

/-- Frequency-only part of the maximal-cutoff sharp sinc-fourth route. -/
noncomputable def maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant : ℝ :=
  2 * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
      (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3)

/-- The sharp sinc-fourth route already exceeds coefficient one in its
frequency term, before adding its nonnegative spatial smoothing remainder. -/
theorem one_lt_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant :
    1 < maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant := by
  have hsum : Real.pi <
      (1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3 := by
    rw [sharpGaussianDampedMoment_three]
    nlinarith [eight_div_three_le_sharpGaussianDampedMoment_two,
      Real.pi_lt_d2]
  have heq : maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant =
      ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) / Real.pi := by
    unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  rw [heq]
  exact (one_lt_div Real.pi_pos).2 hsum

/-- Universal constant obtained from the maximal cutoff allowed by the sharp
Taylor window and the existing sinc-fourth smoothing kernel. -/
noncomputable def maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant : ℝ :=
  2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ((1 / 6) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2 +
        (1 / 8) * sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3) +
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
      (8 * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound))

theorem maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant_nonneg :
    0 ≤ maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
  have hM2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hK : 0 ≤ sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
    unfold sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
  exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (add_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM2)
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM3)))
    (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK)))

/-- Consequently the complete sharp sinc-fourth constant also exceeds one. -/
theorem one_lt_maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant :
    1 < maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
  have hK : 0 ≤ sincFourthShiftedMomentBound := by
    unfold sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  calc
    1 < maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant :=
      one_lt_maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
    _ ≤ maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant := by
      unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyConstant
        maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
      have hspatial : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          (8 * sincFourthShiftedMomentBound) := by positivity
      nlinarith

theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_sharpBerryEsseenConstant
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      sharpBerryEsseenConstant *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let M2 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2
  let M3 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3
  let K : ℝ := sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    dsimp only [s]
    positivity
  have hn : 0 < (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
  have hsOne : 1 ≤ s := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
    dsimp only [s]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_left 1 N)
  have hM2 : 0 ≤ M2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 : 0 ≤ M3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp only [K, sincFourthShiftedMomentBound]
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  have hInv : 1 / (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho / s := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hn hs]
    have hs_le_n : s ≤ (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hsSq]
      nlinarith
    have hn_le : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho * (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using hs_le_n.trans hn_le
  have hFirst :
      (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 = ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have hSecondTerm :
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
        ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
    calc
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 8) * M3) * (1 / (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hn.ne']
      _ ≤ ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInv (by positivity)
  have hden : 0 < 1 + 2 * rho := by positivity
  have hdenBound : 1 + 2 * rho ≤ 3 * rho := by nlinarith
  have hSpatial :
      (4 / sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K ≤
        (12 * K) * (rho / s) := by
    have hcut : sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N = s / (1 + 2 * rho) := rfl
    rw [hcut]
    calc
      (4 / (s / (1 + 2 * rho))) * K =
          (4 * K) * ((1 + 2 * rho) / s) := by
        field_simp [hs.ne', hden.ne']
      _ ≤ (4 * K) * ((3 * rho) / s) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          ((div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hs).2 hdenBound) (by positivity)
      _ = (12 * K) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have hFourier :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K) ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (12 * K)) *
        (rho / s) := by
    have hLocalPart :
        (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
          ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
      calc
        (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 := by rw [hFirst]
        _ ≤ ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl hSecondTerm
    calc
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
              (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((4 / sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K) ≤
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
              ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s)) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((12 * K) * (rho / s)) := by
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLocalPart
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSpatial
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)))
      _ = ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (12 * K)) *
          (rho / s) := by ring
  have hexplicit :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_explicit_sharp
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K)) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [rho, s, M2, M3, K] using hexplicit
    _ = 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / sharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (12 * K)) *
          (rho / s)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFourier (by norm_num)
    _ = sharpBerryEsseenConstant * rho / s := by
      unfold sharpBerryEsseenConstant
      dsimp only [M2, M3, K]
      ring
    _ = sharpBerryEsseenConstant *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := rfl

theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
  let rho : ℝ := ∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ)
  let M2 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 2
  let M3 : ℝ := sharpGaussianDampedMoment 3
  let K : ℝ := sincFourthShiftedMomentBound
  have hrho : 1 ≤ rho := by
    simpa only [rho] using
      one_le_thirdAbsoluteMoment_of_secondMoment_eq_one (hX 0) hSecond
  have hrhoPos : 0 < rho := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrho
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    dsimp only [s]
    positivity
  have hn : 0 < (N + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt hn.le]
  have hM2 : 0 ≤ M2 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 2
  have hM3 : 0 ≤ M3 := sharpGaussianDampedMoment_nonneg 3
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp only [K, sincFourthShiftedMomentBound]
    exact add_nonneg sincFourthTailRadius_pos.le sincFourthFirstMoment_nonneg
  have hInv : 1 / (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho / s := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hn hs]
    have hs_le_n : s ≤ (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hsSq]
      nlinarith
    have hn_le : (N + 1 : ℝ) ≤ rho * (N + 1 : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using hs_le_n.trans hn_le
  have hFirst :
      (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 = ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) := by ring
  have hSecondTerm :
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
        ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
    calc
      (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 8) * M3) * (1 / (N + 1 : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp [hn.ne']
      _ ≤ ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hInv (by positivity)
  have hSpatial :
      (4 / maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K =
        (8 * K) * (rho / s) := by
    have hcut : maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N = s / (2 * rho) := rfl
    rw [hcut]
    field_simp [hs.ne', hrhoPos.ne']
    ring
  have hFourier :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K) ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (8 * K)) *
        (rho / s) := by
    have hLocalPart :
        (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 ≤
          ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) := by
      calc
        (rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 =
          ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3 := by rw [hFirst]
        _ ≤ ((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
            ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl hSecondTerm
    calc
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
              (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((4 / maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K) ≤
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (((1 / 6) * M2) * (rho / s) +
              ((1 / 8) * M3) * (rho / s)) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
            ((8 * K) * (rho / s)) := by
          rw [hSpatial]
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLocalPart
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (by positivity)))
            le_rfl
      _ = ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (8 * K)) *
          (rho / s) := by ring
  have hexplicit :=
    kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_explicit_maximalSharp
      X hX hIndep hIdent hMean hSecond hN
  calc
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
        NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.standardNormalLaw ≤
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K)) /
        (1 - 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [rho, s, M2, M3, K] using hexplicit
    _ = 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((rho / (6 * s)) * M2 +
            (1 / (8 * (N + 1 : ℝ))) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
          ((4 / maximalSharpBerryEsseenFrequencyCutoff rho N) * K)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ((1 / 6) * M2 + (1 / 8) * M3) +
        (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (8 * K)) *
          (rho / s)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFourier (by norm_num)
    _ = maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant * rho / s := by
      unfold maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant
      dsimp only [M2, M3, K]
      ring
    _ = maximalSharpBerryEsseenConstant *
        (∫ omega, |X 0 omega| ^ 3 ∂mu) /
          Real.sqrt (N + 1 : ℝ) := rfl

theorem kolmogorovDistance_normalizedCenteredIidSum_le_berryEsseenConstant
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega]
    {mu : Measure Omega} [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (X : ℕ → Omega → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, MemLp (X i) 3 mu)
    (hIndep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X mu)
    (hIdent : ∀ i, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) mu mu)
    (hMean : ∫ omega, X 0 omega ∂mu = 0)
    (hSecond : ∫ omega, (X 0 omega) ^ 2 ∂mu = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    kolmogorovDistance
        (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.probabilityLaw
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum X N)
          (NumStability.HDP.Scalar.LimitTheorems.normalizedCenteredIidSum_memLp
            X (fun i => (hX i).mono_exponent (by norm_num)) N).aemeasurable)
